title: The Access Layer of AI Visibility: A robots.txt Census and Policy-Diffusion Analysis of AI-Crawler Blocking Across 100 Indonesian News Media (2020-2026)
affiliations: Universitas Prasetiya Mulya

detail.title: The Access Layer of AI Visibility: A robots.txt Census and Policy-Diffusion Analysis of AI-Crawler Blocking Across 100 Indonesian News Media (2020-2026)
detail.abstract: Generative search engines answer questions by synthesizing a small set of retrieved web sources, making whether and how an organization's content can be surfaced a strategic problem — the concern this paper frames as AI Visibility Optimization (AIVO). AIVO has so far been examined mostly at the contentselection layer, where Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) shows that page-level tactics can raise the odds of being cited (Aggarwal et al., 2024). Logically prior to selection, however, is a supply-side question rarely measured in emerging markets: can AI crawlers reach the content at all? This paper isolates that access layer. Motivated by prior audits in which Indonesian mainstream media appear only sparingly among the sources generative systems cite (Budiman, 2026b, 2026c), I test one intuitive supply-side explanation — that publishers withhold content from AI crawlers through the Robots Exclusion Protocol (robots.txt) — and largely reject it. Using an honest, rate-limited crawler I collected the current robots.txt of 100 Indonesian news outlets across national, business/specialist, regional, and digital-native tiers, coding directives for 16 named AI crawlers (training and retrieval) plus two conventional search bots as controls, and reconstructed each outlet's policy history from the Internet Archive Wayback Machine (2020–2026, monthly resolution). Blocking is uncommon. GPTBot, the most-blocked crawler, is fully disallowed by just 20% of readable outlets (95% Wilson CI 13–29%) — far below the 48–79% reported for high-income markets (Fletcher, 2024) — and 77% declare no AI-crawler policy at all. Even these rates are an upper bound on the national picture: only 5.8% of Indonesian news sites generally block AI crawlers and only 40.3% carry a robots.txt file at all (Dhyatmika et al., 2026), against 97 of the 100 outlets sampled here. Most consequentially for AIVO, 85% of outlets are fully open to every retrieval crawler — the agents that ground live cited answers — and no outlet blocks retrieval without also blocking training. Control crawlers are never fully blocked, validating the coding. The salient gap is organizational rather than geographic: digital-native outlets are almost entirely open (95% zero-policy), and policy is not uniform within media groups. Longitudinally, the first AI-crawler directives appear in May 2023; the largest single-month wave of adoption falls in October 2023, two months after GPTBot's release, after which cumulative adoption plateaus near 44% of archived outlets — an Indonesian echo of the global “rapid crescendo” (Longpre et al., 2024), readable through a diffusion-of-innovations lens (Rogers, 2003). Read together with evidence that blocking rarely prevents citation anyway (Longpre et al., 2024), the results imply that the scarcity of Indonesian mainstream media in generative answers is a demand-side (modelselection) phenomenon, not publisher opt-out. The paper contributes the first cross-domain, longitudinal robots.txt census for Indonesia — complementing qualitative and traffic-based Indonesian work (Dhyatmika et al., 2026) with a per-crawler, per-outlet record of declarations; positions it as the access layer of an AI Visibility Supply Chain linking crawlability, provenance interpretability, and citation selection; and, consistent with the field's limitations, frames robots.txt as declared intent rather than enforced access.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度尼西亚主流新闻媒体对AI爬虫的开放程度。通过对100家新闻机构的robots.txt进行横断面和纵向（2020-2026）分析，发现AI爬虫封锁并不普遍——仅20%的网站完全封锁GPTBot，85%的网站对所有检索爬虫完全开放。结论是印度尼西亚主流媒体在生成式搜索中被引用不足的主要原因是需求侧（模型选择）而非供给侧（出版商主动封锁）。
AI.research_question: 在印度尼西亚新兴市场中，AI爬虫在供给端（访问层）能否触达媒体内容？出版商是否通过robots.txt封锁AI爬虫，从而导致主流媒体在生成式搜索中被引用不足？
AI.motivation: 先前审计发现印度尼西亚主流媒体在生成式AI系统的引用来源中非常稀少。作者希望检验一个直观的供给侧解释——出版商是否因封锁AI爬虫而导致内容不可见，从而为AI可见性优化（AIVO）提供访问层的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI可见性优化（AIVO）、AI可见性供应链（AI Visibility Supply Chain）、创新扩散理论（Diffusion of Innovations, Rogers, 2003）、机器人排除协议（robots.txt）作为声明的意图框架。
AI.method: 使用限速的诚实爬虫收集100家印度尼西亚新闻机构（涵盖国家级、商业/专业、区域及数字原生四个层级）的当前robots.txt文件；对16个命名AI爬虫（训练和检索类）及2个传统搜索爬虫进行编码；通过互联网档案馆Wayback Machine重建2020-2026年按月分辨率的政策历史。使用Wilson置信区间进行统计推断。
AI.findings: （1）AI爬虫封锁罕见：仅20%的可读网站完全封锁GPTBot（95% Wilson CI 13-29%），远低于高收入市场的48-79%；77%的网站无任何AI爬虫政策。（2）85%的网站对所有检索爬虫完全开放，没有网站只封锁检索而不封锁训练。（3）对照爬虫从未被完全封锁，验证了编码有效性。（4）组织性差异大于地理性差异：数字原生媒体几乎完全开放（95%零政策），媒体集团内部政策不统一。（5）时间上：首个AI爬虫指令出现在2023年5月，最大单月采用浪潮在2023年10月（GPTBot发布两个月后），之后累计采用率在44%附近趋平。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为印度尼西亚提供跨领域、纵向的robots.txt普查；从爬虫可访问性角度补充了AIVO文献的访问层维度；提出AI可见性供应链概念，将可爬取性、来源可解释性和引用选择联系起来；用创新扩散理论解读AI爬虫政策的采用模式，呼应全球"快速攀升"现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度尼西亚新闻媒体提供AI爬虫政策现状的全面画像；表明出版商封锁并非印度尼西亚媒体在生成式搜索中可见性低的原因，从而将政策建议指向模型选择层面；为其他新兴市场提供可复制的robots.txt审计方法。

title: Signal, Gate, Consider, Decide: A Process Framework for AI-Mediated B2B Vendor Discovery

detail.title: Signal, Gate, Consider, Decide: A Process Framework for AI-Mediated B2B Vendor Discovery
detail.abstract: AI answer engines increasingly mediate how business buyers discover vendors, citing a small set of names from a much larger competitive field. Four established literatures, gatekeeping theory, consideration-set theory, organizational buying theory, and signaling theory, each explain a piece of this process, but no published framework connects them, despite each describing an adjacent link in what this paper argues is a single causal sequence. This paper integrates the four into a four-stage process framework: vendor signal strength shapes algorithmic citation selection, citation selection shapes the buyer's evoked consideration set, and the buyer's reliance on that set shifts by purchase stage and buying-center role. A fifth link closes the sequence into a selfreinforcing loop, in which citation success funds further signal investment, consistent with cumulative-advantage dynamics documented since Merton's (1968) Matthew effect. The framework extends signaling theory, rather than introducing a separate construct, to treat vendor incumbency as a status-based signal following Podolny's (1993) model of market competition, and it scopes its central mechanism explicitly to retrieval-grounded AI architectures, distinguishing this account from source-fabrication dynamics documented in ungrounded language models. Five falsifiable propositions follow from the integration, along with stated boundary conditions and a research agenda naming the specific empirical studies, including a matched-pairs test of the incumbency moderation and an intervention design testing the compounding claim, that the framework implies but does not itself execute. The contribution is an integrative, generative synthesis: four adjacent literatures organized into one testable process.

AI.tldr: 本文整合了把关理论、考虑集理论、组织购买理论与信号理论四大文献，提出一个四阶段过程框架，解释AI回答引擎如何中介B2B买家发现供应商的过程：供应商信号强度塑造算法引用选择，引用选择塑造买家考虑集，买家对考虑集的依赖随购买阶段和购买中心角色而变化，第五条链路形成自我强化循环（引用成功反哺信号投资）。框架将供应商在位性视为基于地位的信号，并明确限定于检索增强型AI架构，提出五个可证伪命题及具体研究议程。
AI.research_question: AI回答引擎如何中介B2B买家发现供应商的过程？即：供应商的信号强度如何通过算法引用选择影响买家的考虑集，并形成自我强化的累积优势循环？
AI.motivation: AI回答引擎日益成为B2B买家发现供应商的关键中介渠道，但现有四大文献（把关理论、考虑集理论、组织购买理论、信号理论）各自只解释了这一过程的片段，缺乏一个将它们连接起来的整合框架。尽管每篇文献描述的恰好是同一因果序列中的相邻环节，却没有任何已发表框架将其贯通。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文整合五大理论资源：(1) 把关理论（gatekeeping theory）；(2) 考虑集理论（consideration-set theory）；(3) 组织购买理论（organizational buying theory）；(4) 信号理论（signaling theory），并延伸至Podolny（1993）的市场竞争模型，将供应商在位性视为地位型信号；(5) Merton（1968）的马太效应/累积优势动态。
AI.method: 理论整合与推理研究（conceptual/integrative paper），通过将四大既有文献整合为单一因果序列构建四阶段过程框架，并推导出五个可证伪命题、边界条件及具体研究议程（包括匹配对检验和干预设计）。
AI.findings: (1) 提出四阶段过程框架：供应商信号强度→算法引用选择→买家唤起考虑集→买家依赖随购买阶段和购买中心角色变化；(2) 第五条链路形成自我强化循环：引用成功反哺信号投资，符合累积优势动态；(3) 将供应商在位性概念化为基于地位的信号（延伸Podolny模型）；(4) 明确将机制限定于检索增强型AI架构，区别于无地面语言模型中的来源捏造动态；(5) 推导出五个可证伪命题，并明确边界条件和具体实证研究议程。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次将把关理论、考虑集理论、组织购买理论与信号理论四大文献整合为一个可检验的单一过程框架；(2) 延伸信号理论而非引入新构念，将供应商在位性建模为地位型信号（基于Podolny的市场竞争框架）；(3) 将机制精确限定于检索增强型AI架构，在理论上区分于无地面语言模型的来源捏造问题；(4) 通过五条链路闭环识别出自强化累积优势机制，将马太效应具身于B2B供应商发现情境。总体贡献为整合性、生成性的理论综合。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为B2B供应商理解并优化其在AI回答引擎中的可见性提供过程性指导（识别信号投资的杠杆点）；(2) 为平台设计者和算法开发者提供关于引用选择机制的清晰理论图景；(3) 为买家组织识别自身对AI中介信息的依赖模式及其随购买阶段的变化提供认知框架；(4) 通过明确指出需要执行的实证研究（匹配对检验、干预设计），为后续实证验证提供可操作的研究蓝图。

title:
From Job Description to Purpose

Description: An Organizational Theory of Dynamic Role Design and Future Value Creation in the Age of AI

detail.title:
From Job Description to Purpose

Description: An Organizational Theory of Dynamic Role Design and Future Value Creation in the Age of AI
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly expanding the scope of analysis, prediction,
generation, decision support, and task execution, rendering human roles within firms
increasingly fluid. In many organizations, however, roles are still defined around the
Job Description (JD)—a collection of assigned tasks, areas of responsibility, required
competencies, and reporting relationships. While this static allocation model serves
stable divisions of labor well, it cannot adequately express the purpose of a role or the
value it creates in environments where the mapping between tasks and humans
changes continuously and the human-AI collaborative system itself becomes an object
of redesign.
Connecting work design theory with dynamic capabilities research, this paper
proposes the Purpose Description (PD), a concept of dynamic role design positioned
above the JD. A PD is an organizational design unit that articulates—in light of the
future expectations shared by markets and society and the future the firm seeks to
realize—why an individual or team exists, for whom it creates what future value, and on
the basis of which questions and decision principles it acts.
The paper’s central thesis is that whereas a JD allocates present tasks, a PD distributes
the creation of future value. The PD is positioned as structural middleware that connects the market’s expectations of the future captured by Future Value Theory
(Kadowaki, 2026a) and the continuous redesign of the enterprise addressed by
Enterprise Redefinition (Kadowaki, 2026b) to the actions of individuals and teams.
The paper presents a Two-Tier Dynamic Role Architecture that integrates PD and JD as
complements, together with a synchronization protocol. It further sets out the causal
mechanism by which purposeless local optimization in AI adoption is avoided, nine
testable propositions, directions for measurement, legal and labor governance,
safeguards against over-adaptation, and human authority to halt AI systems. The
creation of future value depicted by the PD and the execution of PD-defined roles are
carried out by integrated human-AI systems, but the determination of purpose and
decision principles, exception handling, halt authority, and legal and ethical
accountability remain vested in humans. The PD does not substitute for working
conditions, authority, or accountability; it preserves them while placing existential
purpose and the connection to future value above ever-changing means.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"目的描述（PD）"这一动态角色设计概念，作为职位描述（JD）之上的组织结构单元，将市场与社会对未来期望以及企业愿景转化为个人和团队创造未来价值的行动框架，并通过双层动态角色架构整合PD与JD，以应对AI时代角色流动性增强的挑战。
AI.research_question: 在AI不断重新定义任务与人类之间映射关系的环境中，企业应如何设计动态角色，以超越静态的职位描述（JD）来表达角色的目的及其创造的价值？
AI.motivation: AI正在快速扩展分析、预测、生成、决策支持和任务执行的范围，使人类在企业中的角色日益流动。然而，许多组织的角色仍围绕静态的职位描述（JD）来定义，这种静态分配模式无法充分表达角色目的或在任务—人类映射持续变化的环境中创造的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文连接了工作设计理论与动态能力研究，并结合未来价值理论（Future Value Theory, Kadowaki, 2026a）和企业重新定义理论（Enterprise Redefinition, Kadowaki, 2026b）。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过理论整合提出PD概念，构建双层动态角色架构，提出同步协议、因果机制、九个可检验命题及测量方向。
AI.findings: 本文的核心命题是：JD分配现有任务，而PD分配未来价值的创造。PD作为"结构中间件"，连接市场对未来期望与企业持续重新设计。提出双层动态角色架构整合PD与JD为互补关系，并阐明避免AI采用中无目的局部优化的因果机制，以及人类对AI系统的暂停权、法律伦理问责等保障机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将工作设计理论与动态能力研究相连接，提出PD作为新的组织设计单元概念，推进了角色设计与未来价值创造的理论整合，并为未来价值理论与企业重新定义理论提供微观层面的执行桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了双层动态角色架构、同步协议、九个可检验命题、测量方向、法律与劳动治理建议、防止过度适应的保障措施以及人类暂停AI系统的权力设计，帮助组织在AI时代实现动态角色设计并确保人类对目的和决策原则的最终掌控。

title: Impacts of Noisy Certification and Price Signaling on Product Quality Disclosure
affiliations: National Taiwan University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University - Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies and Hong Kong Polytechnic University - Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies

detail.title: Impacts of Noisy Certification and Price Signaling on Product Quality Disclosure
detail.abstract: This study investigates the strategic interaction between noisy certification and price signaling of product quality. We develop a game-theoretic model in which costly and imperfect certification is available to a firm, under both mandatory and voluntary regimes. Our analysis explores the firm's decisions regarding certification application and pricing, the impact of certification accuracy and associated costs, and the design of certification schemes. We find that noisy certification reshapes the role of price signaling and that the voluntary certification decision is jointly determined by accuracy and costs. When certification is sufficiently accurate and moderately costly, the high-quality firm applies, whereas the low-quality firm is deterred. In particular, the high-quality firm can mitigate or eliminate price distortion upon successful certification, while failure restores subsequent pricing as a signaling device. Relative to the no-certification benchmark, we show that voluntary certification generally benefits firms, whereas mandatory certification may harm high-quality firms but benefit low-quality firms under low accuracy and moderate costs. Comparing regimes, high-quality firms prefer voluntary certification, whereas low-quality firms favor mandatory certification when accuracy is insufficient. Our findings provide managerial insights for policymakers, emphasizing the need to assess certification accuracy and costs in deciding between mandatory and voluntary regimes.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建博弈论模型，探讨在有噪声（不完美）认证与价格信号并存时，企业在强制性和自愿性两种认证制度下的策略性互动。研究发现，噪声认证重塑了价格信号的角色，认证足够准确且成本适中时高质量企业会申请认证，成功认证可缓解价格扭曲，失败后价格重新成为信号工具；自愿认证通常对企业有利，而低精度下强制认证可能损害高质量企业但惠及低质量企业。
AI.research_question: 噪声认证与价格信号之间的策略互动如何影响企业的认证决策、定价行为以及认证制度（强制vs自愿）的设计？
AI.motivation: 现实中的产品认证往往存在噪声（不完美），并非总能准确揭示产品质量，且认证成本高昂。现有研究对认证与价格信号共同作用下的企业策略行为缺乏系统性理解，尤其是强制性与自愿性认证制度的对比分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、信号传递理论（价格信号）、认证理论
AI.method: 博弈论模型分析：构建企业认证申请与定价决策的均衡模型，考察强制性与自愿性两种制度下的比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 1. 噪声认证重塑了价格信号的角色；2. 自愿认证决策由认证精度和成本共同决定，高精度且中等成本时高质量企业申请认证而低质量企业被威慑；3. 认证成功可缓解或消除价格扭曲，失败后价格恢复为信号工具；4. 自愿认证总体上对企业有利，而在低精度、中等成本下强制认证可能损害高质量企业但有利于低质量企业；5. 高质量企业偏好自愿认证，低质量企业在精度不足时偏好强制认证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不完美（噪声）认证纳入价格信号传递的理论框架，揭示了认证与定价策略之间的复杂互动机制，拓展了信号传递理论和认证经济学的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在选择强制性或自愿性认证制度时提供了管理洞见，强调需评估认证精度和成本对两类企业（高质量与低质量）差异化福利的影响。

title: Converting Browsers to Buyers: Exploring What Drives Consumer Choice in Internet E-Commerce

detail.title: Converting Browsers to Buyers: Exploring What Drives Consumer Choice in Internet E-Commerce
detail.abstract: Why do internet users behave as they do, are their activities solely determined by website design? Or do they create their own pathways as a response to designated systems. For many, internet design is about the imposition of schemas, predetermined flows and consumer motifs, allowing the shepherding of an understood and mapped user towards buying products and services. However, if this were true then every browser would also be a buyer. The underlying concepts of current website design rely on a number of pretexts which, when reviewed in relation to human activity and interaction, become questionable in their veracity.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑网站设计的核心假设，指出互联网用户行为并非仅由网站设计决定，用户在既定系统中会创造自己的路径。当前网站设计依赖的诸多前提假设，在人类活动与互动的视角下其真实性值得商榷。
AI.research_question: 互联网用户行为的决定因素是什么？网站设计是否真正主导用户行为，还是用户会构建自己的行为路径来回应既定系统？
AI.motivation: 质疑当前网站设计所依赖的基本前提假设——即设计可以"引导"用户完成预设流程从而促成购买。作者指出如果这一假设成立，那么每个浏览者都应当是购买者，但现实显然并非如此。
AI.theoretical_framework: 用户能动性理论、人机交互中的社会建构视角、批判性网站设计理论。
AI.method: 概念性/批判性分析，通过对网站设计底层假设的理论审视与人类活动/互动本质的对照分析。
AI.findings: 网站设计基于的诸多前提（如用户可被"驯化"、可被预设流程引导）在人类真实活动与互动中经不起推敲；用户并非被动接受设计约束，而是会在系统中主动创造属于自己的使用路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统网站设计理论中"设计主导用户行为"的核心假设，提出应重视用户的能动性和创造性回应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网站设计实践提供批判性反思，提示设计师不应想当然地依赖预设用户模型和流程，而需考虑用户自主行为对设计效果的实质影响。

title: Learning While Earning: Algorithmic Learning and Pricing Strategies in Ship-Then-Shop Retailing
affiliations: Tsinghua University - Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management, Tsinghua University - Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management and Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business

detail.title: Learning While Earning: Algorithmic Learning and Pricing Strategies in Ship-Then-Shop Retailing
detail.abstract: In algorithm-driven ship-then-shop (STS) retailing, retailers ship preselected products to customers for trial before purchase. Yet STS retailers exhibit striking pricing heterogeneity, relying on subscription fees, product prices, or both. We develop a two-period game-theoretic model to explain this divergence, endogenizing how consumer subscriptions and subsequent keep-or-return decisions generate the data required to improve matching accuracy. We model three key algorithmic characteristics: the cold-start threshold, learning capacity, and baseline matching probability. Driven by the tension between data acquisition and data monetization, we first identify three optimal pricing regimes-ex-ante, balanced, and ex-post extraction. When the coldstart threshold is low, the retailer adopts ex-ante extraction (subscription fee only) or balanced extraction (both a subscription fee and a product price), depending on learning capacity; when the threshold is high, it adopts ex-post extraction (product price only). Second, a higher cold-start threshold lowers the subscription fee to attract the larger subscriber base needed for data acquisition, whereas the product price can respond non-monotonically as the retailer balances higher margins from successful matches against the loss of future subscription demand. Third, greater learning capacity makes successful future matches more likely, shifting revenue extraction toward the product price. Fourth, a higher baseline matching probability induces a quasiconcave response in the subscription fee and a quasiconvex response in the product price. Finally, a higher proportion of churn-prone consumers limits future monetization, shifting revenue extraction toward the subscription fee to capture more revenue before consumers churn.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两期博弈论模型，解释了算法驱动的"先寄后买"(STS)零售模式中零售商定价异质性的原因，识别出三种最优定价机制（事前提取、平衡提取、事后提取），并分析了冷启动阈值、学习能力、基准匹配概率和用户流失率等算法特征对定价策略的影响。
AI.research_question: 为什么在算法驱动的先寄后买(STS)零售模式中，零售商会采用不同的定价方式——仅收订阅费、仅收产品价格、或两者兼收？订阅和退货决策产生的数据如何影响定价策略？
AI.motivation: STS零售商在定价实践中表现出显著的异质性（订阅费、产品价格或两者并用），现有理论无法解释这种差异。理解算法特征（冷启动阈值、学习能力、匹配概率）如何驱动定价策略选择，对于STS零售商的定价设计具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期博弈论模型；数据获取与数据变现之间的张力；消费者订阅决策与保留/退货决策内生化为数据生成机制；算法学习特征（冷启动阈值、学习能力、基准匹配概率）建模。
AI.method: 构建两期博弈论模型，将消费者订阅行为和后续保留或退货决策内生化为提升匹配准确度所需数据来源，分析三种关键算法特征（冷启动阈值、学习能力、基准匹配概率）对最优定价策略的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 识别出三种最优定价机制：事前提取（仅订阅费）、平衡提取（订阅费+产品价格）、事后提取（仅产品价格）；(2) 冷启动阈值低时，取决于学习能力选择事前或平衡提取；阈值高时选择事后提取；(3) 较高的冷启动阈值降低订阅费以吸引更大订阅群体，产品价格可能呈非单调响应；(4) 更强的学习能力使成功匹配更可能，收入提取转向产品价格；(5) 更高的基准匹配概率导致订阅费呈拟凹响应、产品价格呈拟凸响应；(6) 更高比例的易流失消费者限制未来变现，收入提取转向订阅费。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从算法特征（冷启动阈值、学习能力、匹配概率）视角系统解释STS零售商定价异质性的成因，建立了数据获取与数据变现权衡的理论框架，揭示了消费者流失率对定价模式选择的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为STS零售商提供了基于算法能力特征的定价策略选择指南：冷启动阈值低时可选择订阅费或混合定价，阈值高时应采用纯产品价格定价；并指导零售商根据学习能力和用户流失情况动态调整定价结构。

title: The Safety Illusion: How the Mere Presence of a Dislike Button Shapes Belief in Social Media Content
affiliations: , Ivy College of Business, University of Florida and Harvard Business School

detail.title: The Safety Illusion: How the Mere Presence of a Dislike Button Shapes Belief in Social Media Content
detail.abstract: Prior research shows that visible engagement metrics, such as counts of likes, dislikes, and shares, can influence perceived content credibility. The present research examines whether the mere presence of a negative engagement affordance-a dislike button-can shape credibility judgments even when it provides no publicly visible information about how other users evaluated the content. Classic belief-formation theories suggest that such a negative affordance should prompt skepticism and lower perceived credibility. However, across one large-scale analysis of real-world social media comments (N = 40,458) and four controlled experiments (N = 1,845), the findings show that the presence of a dislike button increases perceived credibility. This effect occurs because consumers interpret the button as a signal that the platform can monitor, filter, or regulate low-quality content, creating an illusion of platform-level protection from misinformation. Consistent with this mechanism, the effect is attenuated when consumers are explicitly informed that the platform takes steps to reduce misinformation. This research advances understanding of consumer belief formation in digital environments by showing that engagement affordances can serve not only as tools for user interaction, but also as platformlevel signals that shape how consumers judge content credibility.

AI.tldr: 这项研究发现，即使不喜欢按钮不提供任何公开可见的他人评价信息，仅仅其存在就能提高消费者对内容可信度的判断。这是因为消费者将该按钮解读为平台能够监控、过滤或管制低质量内容的信号，从而产生了平台层面防虚假信息的保护错觉。
AI.research_question: 负面互动功能（不喜欢按钮）的单纯存在——即使不提供任何公开可见的他人评价信息——是否会以及如何影响消费者对内容可信度的判断？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明可见的互动指标（如点赞数、点踩数、分享数）会影响消费者对内容可信度的感知，但鲜有研究探讨互动功能本身（不提供任何可见数据）对可信度判断的影响。经典信念形成理论认为负面功能应引发怀疑并降低可信度，但这一假设尚未得到严格检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念形成理论（belief-formation theories）；平台级信号理论——消费者将界面特征解读为平台治理能力的信号，形成平台保护错觉（illusion of platform-level protection）。
AI.method: 一项大规模真实社交媒体评论分析（N=40,458）加四项受控实验（N=1,845），采用混合方法验证不喜欢按钮存在对可信度判断的影响及其心理机制。
AI.findings: 不喜欢按钮的存在提高了感知可信度，而非降低可信度。其机制在于消费者将此按钮解读为平台能够监控、过滤或管制低质量内容的信号，产生平台保护错觉。当消费者被告知平台已采取措施减少虚假信息时，该效应会被削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了数字环境下消费者信念形成的理论理解，表明互动功能不仅可作为用户交互工具，还可作为平台层面的信号，塑造消费者对内容可信度的判断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体平台设计互动功能提供了实践启示，帮助平台理解界面设计元素如何影响用户对内容可信度的认知，以及如何更有效地设计与调适平台治理信号。

title: Customer Satisfaction with Meghalaya Rural Bank Services: A Study in East Khasi Hills District, Meghalaya
affiliations: University of Science and Technology Meghalaya, University of Science and Technology Meghalaya and Assam Don Bosco University

detail.title: Customer Satisfaction with Meghalaya Rural Bank Services: A Study in East Khasi Hills District, Meghalaya

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted for academic research purposes. Informed consent was obtained from the participants before data collection, and participation was voluntary.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organisation.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Emerging Trends in Business, Marketing and Digital Transformation (1st Ed.), edited by Dr. Md. Abdur Rashid, Hari Mall Thakuri, & Dr. Dipankar Das, Sunmarg Publishers & Distributors, 2026, pp. 247–268.

detail.abstract:
Customer satisfaction is an important indicator of service performance in the banking sector, particularly for rural banking institutions that play a significant role in promoting financial inclusion and rural development. The present study examines customer satisfaction towards the services of Meghalaya Rural Bank in East Khasi Hills District, Meghalaya. Specifically, the study seeks to examine the factors associated with customer satisfaction and assess customers' perceptions regarding the banking facilities provided by the bank. The study adopted a descriptive research design and was based on primary data collected from 114 customers of Meghalaya Rural Bank through a structured questionnaire. A convenience sampling technique was employed, and the collected data were analysed using frequency distributions and percentage analysis.

The findings indicate that customers generally hold favourable perceptions towards the services provided by Meghalaya Rural Bank. Positive evaluations were particularly observed regarding the bank’s role in promoting rural development, customer trust, simplicity of banking procedures, and satisfaction with banking facilities. The findings further suggest that convenience and trust are important considerations in customers’ association with the bank. However, comparatively lower positive responses were observed with respect to service efficiency, information regarding new services, and the reasonableness of interest rates and charges, indicating scope for improvement in these areas.

The study highlights the importance of maintaining customer-oriented services, strengthening communication initiatives, and enhancing service efficiency to improve customer satisfaction and reinforce the role of Meghalaya Rural Bank in promoting financial inclusion and rural development.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对梅加拉亚邦东卡西山区114名梅加拉亚乡村银行客户的问卷调查，采用描述性研究设计和便利抽样方法，考察了客户对银行服务的满意度。研究发现客户总体上对银行服务持正面态度，尤其在促进农村发展、客户信任、流程简便性和设施满意方面评价较高，但在服务效率、新服务信息和利率收费合理性方面存在改进空间。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素与客户对梅加拉亚乡村银行服务的满意度相关？客户对该银行提供的服务设施有何看法？
AI.motivation: 客户满意度是银行业服务绩效的重要指标，尤其对在促进金融普惠和农村发展中扮演关键角色的农村银行机构而言更为重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户满意度理论框架，关注便利性、信任、服务效率等因素对客户满意度的影响。
AI.method: 描述性研究设计；通过结构化问卷收集114名客户的初级数据；采用便利抽样技术；使用频率分布和百分比分析进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 客户对梅加拉亚乡村银行的服务总体持正面看法，在促进农村发展、客户信任、银行程序简便性和银行设施满意度方面评价尤为积极。便利性和信任是客户与银行保持关系的重要因素。但在服务效率、新服务信息、利率和收费合理性方面正面评价较低，表明这些领域需要改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为农村银行服务客户满意度影响因素提供了实证证据，丰富了金融普惠背景下农村银行客户满意度研究文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究建议银行应保持客户导向服务、加强沟通宣传、提升服务效率，以改善客户满意度并强化其在促进金融包容和农村发展中的作用。

title: Impact of Digital Marketing on Sales Growth of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the e-commerce Sector of Bangladesh
affiliations: East West University

detail.title: Impact of Digital Marketing on Sales Growth of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the e-commerce Sector of Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved an anonymous online survey of business owners. Participation was voluntary, and no personally identifiable information was collected. Formal institutional ethics board approval was not sought, as is standard for undergraduate coursework research of this nature.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates how major digital marketing tools-specifically Search Engine Optimization (SEO), keyword optimization, behavioral targeting, and online advertising-influence the sales growth of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) operating within B2B and B2C e-commerce models in Bangladesh. A quantitative research design is adopted, utilizing primary data gathered through a survey of 250 SME owners and entrepreneurs. Contextualizing the study with existing literature, benchmark data indicate that keyword optimization can improve sales conversion rates by approximately 24-40% (Gupta and Bansal, 2023), and behavioral targeting can increase click-through rates by up to 670% (Yan et al., 2009). Furthermore, AI-driven marketing practices have been shown to reduce advertising expenses by 23.5% and enhance returns by 52.9% (Sun and Yu, 2025). Although these advantages are documented in great detail, the primary survey findings reveal a critically low rate of adoption among Bangladeshi SMEs. Currently, only 19.6% actively use digital marketing, 83.6% do not use SEO, and 57.6% are unaware of the significant impact of keyword optimization on sales performance. There is a substantial gap between the proportion of SME owners who acknowledge the significance of digital marketing (62.4%) and those who actually put it into practice (19.6%), resulting in an observable 42.8 percentage point deficit. Time constraints (22.8%), budget limitations (21.6%), and a lack of trust (19.6%) are identified as the primary barriers. However, among the SMEs that have embraced digital marketing, 64% report expanded geographical reach and 40.4% record growth in sales. These empirical findings support all six research hypotheses. The paper concludes that the primary impediment to digital marketing adoption is not solely financial or infrastructural constraints, but also a considerable lack of strategic digital marketing expertise. Based on these insights, the study provides targeted recommendations for SME owners, the Government of Bangladesh policymakers, academic institutions, and future researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了SEO、关键词优化、行为定向和在线广告等数字营销工具对孟加拉国B2B和B2C电商中小企业销售增长的影响。通过调查250名中小企业主发现，虽然数字营销在文献中被证明效果显著（关键词优化可提升24-40%转化率，行为定向可提升高达670%点击率），但孟加拉国中小企业的实际采用率极低（仅19.6%），存在显著的认知与实践差距（42.8个百分点）。主要障碍包括时间限制、预算不足和缺乏信任。然而，已采用数字营销的企业中64%报告了地域扩展，40.4%实现了销售增长。研究结论认为主要障碍不仅是财务或基础设施限制，更是战略数字营销专业知识的缺乏。
AI.research_question: 主要数字营销工具（SEO、关键词优化、行为定向和在线广告）如何影响孟加拉国B2B和B2C电商模式下中小企业的销售增长？以及哪些因素阻碍了这些工具的采用？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球文献充分记录了数字营销工具对销售增长的显著效果，但发展中国家的中小企业对数字营销的采用率极低。本文旨在通过实证调查揭示孟加拉国中小企业数字营销采用的现状、认知与实践之间的差距，以及阻碍采用的关键障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于数字营销效果的相关研究文献，结合SEO、关键词优化、行为定向和在线广告的理论框架，并通过六个研究假设来检验数字营销工具与中小企业销售增长之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用定量研究设计，通过对250名中小企业业主和企业家进行问卷调查收集一手数据，利用基准数据与文献进行情境化对照，并检验六个研究假设。
AI.findings: 孟加拉国中小企业数字营销采用率极低（仅19.6%积极使用），83.6%未使用SEO，57.6%不了解关键词优化的重要性；认知与实践存在42.8个百分点的差距；主要障碍为时间限制（22.8%）、预算限制（21.6%）和缺乏信任（19.6%）；但已采用数字营销的企业中64%报告地域扩展，40.4%实现销售增长；所有六个研究假设均得到实证支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过实证数据验证了数字营销工具对中小企业销售增长的影响假设，弥合了文献中数字营销理论效果与发展中国家实际采用率之间的认知差距，揭示了认知-实践差距这一重要理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国中小企业主提供数字营销采用的具体建议；为孟加拉国政府政策制定者提供决策参考；为学术机构提供数字营销教育和培训的指导方向；为未来研究者指明研究路径。

title: The WHEEL Architecture A Constraint-based Operating Model for Human-AI Systems

detail.title: The WHEEL Architecture A Constraint-based Operating Model for Human-AI Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Kwarsick Consulting LLC and the developer of commercial applications derived from portions of the WHEEL research program. These applications were not used as evidence in this paper and did not fund or otherwise influence the analysis presented here. The author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could reasonably be perceived as influencing this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, patients, identifiable personal data, or experimental interventions requiring institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was independently conducted and supported by the author.

detail.abstract:
The question “Is AI making us better or worse?” treats a human–AI system as though it had one
performance state. This paper argues that the question is underspecified. Observed output can improve
while retained human capacity declines; readings taken from different organizational positions can
diverge without either position necessarily being wrong; and even a correct reading can cease to describe
the system as conditions change. The first of these divergences is what this research program names
capacity-degradation risk. A diagnostic reading is therefore interpretable only when four questions are
separated: better along which dimension, observed from where, measured when, and which condition
currently governs the outcome?
The paper reconstructs that architecture from twelve working papers on AI adoption, governance,
collaboration, supervision, and retained human capacity. Written sequentially rather than planned as one
program, the papers examine different objects, use different mathematical forms, and include two non-
corresponding eight-ring instruments. Yet a paper-by-paper documentary audit, reported in Appendix E,
identifies a recurring diagnostic logic: system performance is disproportionately governed by a limiting
condition; the visible symptom may not be that condition; strengthening a non-binding condition yields
limited return; intervention order matters and diagnosis precedes it; and the limiting condition may move,
a claim asserted in the corpus but not demonstrated there.
Reading the papers together exposes relationships that no individual paper states. Two apparently
incompatible equations reconcile once one is interpreted as governed collaboration quality and the other is
read, as defined in its source, as observed task-output quality. Their divergence provides a formal
demonstration that a favorable output reading can coexist with deterioration in a consequential human
condition. The altitude construct then shows why observational position matters: different positions may
expose different properties, or different experiences of the same nominal condition. Time adds a further
qualifier because a reading that was correct at one moment may later become stale.
The contribution claimed is architectural rather than elemental. The possibility that assisted performance
can diverge from retained capability has substantial antecedents in automation, human-factors, motor-
learning, learning, and cognitive-support research. This paper claims no novelty for that phenomenon, nor
for multidimensional representation or scalarization as mathematical ideas. What is claimed is the
integration: a constraint-based architecture in which diagnostic meaning depends on dimension, altitude,
and time, while constraint logic asks which condition currently governs.
The paper derives, but does not empirically demonstrate, a further boundary condition. If governing
conditions can materially change as fast as or faster than an organization can reassess them, periodic
diagnosis can become structurally inadequate.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"AI使人类变得更好还是更差"这一问题本身是欠妥的，因为人-AI系统的绩效是多维度的、可从不同组织位置观察的、随时间变化的。论文通过审计十二篇工作论文，提炼出一个基于约束条件的诊断架构：系统绩效受限于某一限制条件，可见症状未必是该条件本身，干预顺序重要，且限制条件可能移动。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个能够准确诊断人-AI系统绩效的架构？具体而言，系统绩效的"好坏"应如何被定义、从何处观察、在何时测量、在什么条件下评估？
AI.motivation: "AI是否让我们变得更好"这一常见问题过于简化。观察到的产出可以改善而人类保留能力却在下降；不同组织位置的观察结果可能分歧；即使正确的读数也会随时间失效。这些分歧需要被系统性地概念化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于约束条件的架构（constraint-based architecture）：系统绩效不成比例地受制于一个限制条件；可见症状可能不是该条件本身；强化非约束条件的回报有限；干预顺序重要且诊断先于干预；限制条件可能移动。同时引入维度（dimension）、高度/位置（altitude）和时间（time）三个诊断维度。
AI.method: 对十二篇工作论文进行逐篇文档审计（documentary audit），重构其共同的诊断逻辑。包括对两个表面不相容的方程进行调和性解读，以及对八环测量工具的对比分析。
AI.findings: 两个看似不相容的方程在分别解读为"协作质量"和"观测任务产出质量"后可以调和，形式化地证明了有利的产出读数可以与人类条件的恶化并存。高度构念解释了观察位置的重要性，时间因素则说明正确的读数可能过时。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文声称的贡献是"架构性的"而非"元素性的"：整合了约束逻辑与维度-高度-时间三维诊断框架，形成统一的诊断架构。不声称对"辅助绩效与保留能力分离"现象本身的新颖性，而是贡献于这些元素的整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了诊断人-AI系统的四个分离问题框架：在哪一维度上更好、从何处观察、何时测量、当前由哪个条件决定结果。同时指出如果限制条件变化速度快于组织的评估周期，周期性诊断可能结构性失效。

title: A Strategic Case Study of MR DIY's Growth and Global Expansion
affiliations: and SPECTRUM INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY COLLEGE

detail.title: A Strategic Case Study of MR DIY's Growth and Global Expansion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests, commercial relationships, employment relationships, or personal affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relied exclusively on publicly available secondary data, including corporate disclosures, industry reports, business media sources, and academic literature. No human participants, interviews, surveys, experiments, or confidential personal data were involved. Consequently, formal ethics approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
MR DIY has evolved from a single hardware store in Malaysia into one of the largest valueretail chains in Asia through rapid expansion, operational efficiency, and a distinctive low-cost business model. Despite its remarkable growth, relatively few academic studies have examined the strategic mechanisms underpinning its competitive advantage. This study addresses this gap through a descriptive and explanatory single-case study using a deductive, theory-guided qualitative approach. Drawing upon publicly available secondary data, including corporate disclosures, industry sources, business media, and academic literature, the study analyses MR DIY through four strategic dimensions: retail entrepreneurship and business growth, digital retailing and social commerce, brand management and positioning, and international expansion supported by retail analytics. 

Established business and marketing theories-including Entrepreneurial Orientation, the Composition-Based View, the Long Tail Theory, Customer-Based Brand Equity, the Uppsala Internationalisation Model, and Dunning's OLI Paradigm-are employed as analytical lenses to interpret the company's strategic development. The findings suggest that MR DIY's sustained competitive advantage is derived not from proprietary technology or scarce resources, but from its ability to integrate ordinary resources into a highly scalable operating model supported by omnichannel retailing, strong brand positioning, data-driven decisionmaking, and disciplined international expansion. The study contributes to the literature on value retailing by demonstrating how the coordinated application of established strategic principles can enable sustained organisational growth and international competitiveness in an increasingly dynamic retail environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过单案例研究，分析马来西亚MR DIY从单一五金店发展为亚洲最大零售连锁之一的战略机制，发现其持续竞争优势并非源于专有技术或稀缺资源，而是通过将普通资源整合为高度可扩展的运营模式，辅以全渠道零售、强势品牌定位、数据驱动决策和纪律性国际扩张而实现。
AI.research_question: MR DIY的持续竞争优势背后有哪些战略机制？其竞争优-势是如何构建和维持的？
AI.motivation: 尽管MR DIY取得了显著增长，但学术界对其支撑竞争优势的战略机制研究相对较少，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业导向理论、基于组合的观点、长尾理论、基于顾客的品牌资产、Uppsala国际化模型、邓宁的OLI范式
AI.method: 描述性与解释性单案例研究，采用演绎式、理论引导的定性方法，基于公开二手数据（企业披露、行业来源、商业媒体、学术文献），从四个战略维度分析：零售创业与业务增长、数字零售与社交商务、品牌管理与定位、零售分析支撑的国际扩张。
AI.findings: MR DIY的持续竞争优势并非来自专有技术或稀缺资源，而是源于其将普通资源整合为高度可扩展的运营模式的能力，该模式由全渠道零售、强势品牌定位、数据驱动决策和纪律性国际扩张共同支撑。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了价值零售领域的文献，展示了已建立战略原则的协调应用如何实现组织持续增长及在动态零售环境中的国际竞争力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为价值零售企业提供了战略启示，说明通过整合普通资源和协调运用成熟战略原则，可实现规模扩张与国际竞争力。

title: The Brand Demand Flywheel: How Brand Search Demand and Knowledge Panels of Firms and Attorneys Impact Organic Traffic in 1,000 US Personal Injury Law Firms

detail.title: The Brand Demand Flywheel: How Brand Search Demand and Knowledge Panels of Firms and Attorneys Impact Organic Traffic in 1,000 US Personal Injury Law Firms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder and CEO of Rank Brilliance, a Semantic SEO agency that provides search engine optimization, entity-recognition, and Knowledge Graph onboarding services to clients across multiple verticals, including legal services. The research was conducted independently and does not involve any client data, proprietary engagements, or commercial partnerships with the personal injury law firms or their managing partners included in the study sample. All analyzed data were collected from publicly available sources. The author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or personally identifiable information requiring informed consent. The research is based exclusively on publicly accessible website content, search engine results, and structured data. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was self-funded and conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Brand search demand, the volume of Google queries that name a specific business or person by name, is the most direct measurable expression of a firm's audience-side salience. In the personal injury (PI) legal vertical, brand demand is also the moat: paid keywords in the vertical cost hundreds to thousands of dollars per click, so a firm whose organic traffic is driven by branded intent rather than by non-branded head terms is insulated from the auction dynamics that squeeze margins. This paper is the fourth in a series on entity-completeness signals in the top-ranking US PI vertical. It joins the two Knowledge Panel signals audited in Hussain (August 2026, Person Entity Confidence Gap) and Hussain (August 2026, Google Business Panel Completeness Gap) to a per-firm and per-attorney brand-search-volume signal, and asks two questions. First, does brand search volume predict a firm's organic traffic, controlling for domain authority, backlinks, and SERP rank? Second, does the presence of a Google Business Panel (the brand-side Knowledge Panel) or a Person Entity Panel (the attorney-side Knowledge Panel) amplify the brand-demand-to-traffic conversion, producing a compounding flywheel effect? Using the same 1,000 top-ranking US personal injury law firm sample as the two prior August 2026 papers, augmented with a fresh brand-search-volume collection covering both firm brands and managing-partner names, we find that firm brand search volume exhibits a strong positive rank correlation with organic traffic (Spearman ρ = 0.41, p < 0.001) and attorney brand search volume a smaller but highly significant positive correlation (ρ = 0.14, p < 0.001). A log-log OLS regression of organic traffic on brand demand plus authority score plus rank plus Knowledge Panel indicators explains R² = 0.66 of the variance in log traffic, with log1p(brand_sv_total) significant at p < 0.001 net of authority. The interaction analysis produces a genuinely asymmetric flywheel finding: the Person Entity Panel amplifies the brand-demand-to-traffic slope (interaction coefficient +0.179, p = 0.001), while the Google Business Panel does not amplify and if anything mildly dampens the slope (interaction coefficient-0.049, p = 0.32), consistent with the Business Panel intercepting a portion of branded queries as zero-click impressions on the SERP itself. Consistent with that dampening, firms in the "both panels" segment carry a median monthly organic traffic that is only 41% of the "neither panels" segment's median despite comparable brand demand medians. The paper introduces the Brand Demand Index (BDI), a composite of firm brand volume and attorney brand volume normalized on a 0-to-100 scale, and reports the first empirical evidence that Brand Context Optimization, the deliberate cultivation of branded search demand as a distinct SEO objective, is the dominant firm-controlled lever for organic traffic growth in the vertical.

AI.tldr: 本文是系列论文的第四篇，研究了美国人身伤害法律垂直领域中品牌搜索需求（brand search demand）对有机流量的预测作用，以及Google商业面板和人物实体面板对品牌需求到流量转化的调节效应。研究发现品牌搜索量与有机流量显著正相关，人物实体面板会放大转化（飞轮效应），而Google商业面板反而轻微抑制转化。论文引入了品牌需求指数（BDI）作为新的分析工具。
AI.research_question: 两个核心问题：（1）品牌搜索量能否在控制域名权威、外链和SERP排名后预测律所的有机流量？（2）Google商业面板（品牌侧）或人物实体面板（律师侧）的存在是否会放大品牌需求到流量的转化，产生复合飞轮效应？
AI.motivation: 在人身伤害法律垂直领域，付费关键词每次点击成本高达数百至数千美元，品牌搜索需求是企业免受拍卖动态挤压的护城河。之前的系列论文审计了Knowledge Panel信号，但尚未将品牌搜索量这一最直接的受众侧显著性度量纳入分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于受众侧显著性（audience-side salience）理论、实体完整性信号（entity-completeness signals）框架，以及品牌需求与有机流量的转化机制。
AI.method: 使用1,000家美国顶尖人身伤害律所样本，收集品牌搜索量数据（含律所品牌和管理合伙人姓名）；采用Spearman秩相关分析、对数-对数OLS回归（控制权威度、排名、知识面板指标）及交互效应分析。
AI.findings: （1）律所品牌搜索量与有机流量强正相关（Spearman ρ=0.41, p<0.001），律师品牌搜索量相关性较小但显著（ρ=0.14）；（2）回归模型解释R²=0.66的方差；（3）人物实体面板显著放大品牌需求到流量的斜率（系数+0.179, p=0.001），而Google商业面板不放大甚至轻微抑制（系数-0.049, p=0.32）；（4）"双面板"律所的中位有机流量仅为"无面板"律所的41%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证揭示人物实体面板与商业面板在品牌需求转化中的不对称飞轮效应；引入品牌需求指数（BDI）作为新的度量工具；提出"品牌情境优化"（Brand Context Optimization）作为独立SEO目标的实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律垂直领域的SEO实践提供了可操作的策略指导：品牌搜索需求的培育是律所可控的最重要有机流量增长杠杆；律师个人品牌建设（人物实体面板）比商业面板更有效；提醒商业面板可能拦截品牌查询为零点击展示。

title: Global Skills Diffusion: Remote Learning, Micro‑Credentials, and Global Talent Platforms Reshaping Human Capital Formation

detail.title: Global Skills Diffusion: Remote Learning, Micro‑Credentials, and Global Talent Platforms Reshaping Human Capital Formation
detail.abstract: The global architecture of human capital formation is being redefined by three converging forces: remote learning platforms, micro‑credential ecosystems, and borderless talent marketplaces. This report analyzes how these mechanisms collectively accelerate the diffusion of skills across regions and income levels, drawing on data from leading EdTech providers, labor platforms, and policy frameworks. It finds that digital learning has expanded access to elite instruction, micro‑credentials have lowered the cost of professional advancement, and global talent platforms have decoupled skill monetization from geography. Yet structural barriers—uneven employer recognition, infrastructure deficits, and regulatory fragmentation—continue to constrain equitable participation. The study concludes that interoperable credential frameworks, digital infrastructure investment, and adaptive labor policies are essential to harness the full potential of global skills diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了远程学习平台、微证书生态系统和无国界人才市场三大力量如何共同加速技能在全球范围内的扩散，并指出了阻碍公平参与的结构性障碍及应对政策。
AI.research_question: 远程学习平台、微证书生态系统和无国界人才市场如何共同影响全球技能扩散，以及存在哪些结构性障碍制约公平参与？
AI.motivation: 全球人力资本形成的架构正被三大趋同力量重新定义，需要系统分析这些机制如何加速技能在不同地区和收入水平间的扩散，并识别阻碍因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本形成理论、技能扩散理论、全球人才市场理论
AI.method: 基于领先教育科技提供商、劳动力平台和政策框架的多源数据分析（报告型研究）
AI.findings: 数字学习扩大了精英教学的覆盖面；微证书降低了职业进阶的成本；全球人才平台将技能变现与地理位置脱钩。但雇主认可度不均衡、基础设施缺口和监管碎片化限制了公平参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地阐述了三大机制（远程学习、微证书、全球人才平台）在技能扩散中的协同作用，并识别了制约公平参与的结构性障碍框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可互操作的证书框架、数字基础设施投资和适应性劳动力政策三项关键政策建议，以充分发挥全球技能扩散的潜力。
