detail.abstract:
תקציר בעברית: מאמר זה בוחן את האתגר שמציבות תבניות העסקה משורשרות למימוש זכות ההתארגנות האפקטיבית של עובדים, תוך התמקדות במיקור חוץ של שירותים חברתיים בישראל במסגרת מדיניות הרכש החברתי. בניגוד למודל הדיאדי שעליו נשען משפט העבודה הקיבוצי, בהעסקה משורשרת מתפזרת השליטה על תנאי העבודה בין מספר שחקנים, כאשר מזמין השירות – ובפרט המדינה – מחזיק בהשפעה ממשית על היבטים מרכזיים של ההעסקה, אך נותר מחוץ ליחסי העבודה הפורמליים. המאמר מציע מסגרת אנליטית המבוססת על שלוש הנחות יסוד של משפט העבודה הקיבוצי: קיומו של כוח מיקוח אפקטיבי, היות הצדדים שחקנים חוזרים, ויציבותה של יחידת המיקוח. נטען כי מדיניות רכש חברתי מוטת־תחרות מערערת הנחות אלה באופן שיטתי, ועלולה לרוקן את זכות ההתארגנות מתוכן. הניתוח מתבסס על בחינה מוסדית של התפתחות מדיניות הרכש החברתי בישראל, ועל שני מקרי בוחן אמפיריים של התארגנויות עובדים בשירותי רווחה וחינוך לנוער בסיכון. מקרי הבוחן מדגימים כיצד שינויים בתנאי מכרז, תחלופת מפעילים ופיצול יחידות שירות פוגעים בכוחם הקיבוצי של העובדים, אך גם כיצד, בתנאים מסוימים, ניתן לשמר התארגנות אפקטיבית חרף ההעסקה המשורשרת. על רקע זה, המאמר מנתח את פסק הדין בפרשת קורות הגג (2025) כהתפתחות חשובה אך חלקית, המעניקה זכות הידברות פרוצדורלית לעובדים מאורגנים, מבלי להבטיח שימור זכויות קיבוציות או יציבות תעסוקתית. בחלקו האחרון מציע המאמר פיתוחים דוקטרינריים ורגולטוריים מתחום דיני העבודה והמשפט המנהלי, שמטרתם להרחיב את ההגנה על זכות ההתארגנות בהקשר של רכש חברתי תחרותי.

English Abstract: This article examines the challenge that employment chains pose to workers’ rights to organize effectively, with a focus on the outsourcing of social services in Israel within the framework of social procurement policy. In contrast to the dyadic model on which collective labor law is based, employment chains disperse control over working conditions among multiple actors. In this setting, the purchasers of services—particularly the state—exert real influence over key aspects of employment, but remain outside the formal employment relationship. The article proposes an analytical framework based on three fundamental assumptions of collective labor law: the existence of effective bargaining power, the parties as repeat players, and the stability of the bargaining unit. It argues that competition-oriented social procurement policies systematically undermine these assumptions and may effectively deplete the right to organize.

The analysis is based on an institutional examination of the development of social procurement policy in Israel and on two empirical case studies of worker organizing in welfare and educational services for at-risk youth. The case studies demonstrate how changes in tender conditions, turnover of service providers, and the fragmentation of service units weaken workers’ collective power. At the same time, they show how, under certain conditions, effective worker organization can be maintained despite fissured employment arrangements. Against this background, the article analyzes the Korot HaGag (2025) judgment as an important, albeit partial, development—one that grants organized workers a procedural right to be heard without guaranteeing the preservation of collective rights or employment stability. In its final section, the article proposes doctrinal and regulatory developments in the areas of labor and administrative law, aimed at strengthening protection of the right to organize in the context of competitive social procurement.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了就业链（雇佣链）对被雇佣工人有效组织权（集体谈判权）构成的挑战，聚焦以色列社会采购政策框架下的社会服务外包。文章提出基于集体劳动法三大基本假设的分析框架，论证竞争导向的社会采购政策系统性地削弱这些假设，并通过两个实证案例和2025年"屋顶之梁"判决分析，提出劳动法与行政法的教义性和监管性发展建议。
AI.research_question: 就业链（雇佣链）模式如何削弱工人的有效组织权？在竞争导向的社会采购政策背景下，如何通过法律和监管手段保护以色列外包社会服务工人的集体组织权利？
AI.motivation: 传统集体劳动法基于双边（二元）雇佣关系模型，但就业链模式将劳动条件的控制权分散于多个行为主体之间——服务采购方（尤其是国家）对雇佣关键方面拥有实质影响力，却游离于正式雇佣关系之外。这种错位可能导致工人的组织权被架空，需要系统的理论和法律分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集体劳动法的三大基本假设构建分析框架：（1）存在有效的谈判力量（bargaining power）；（2）各方为重复博弈者（repeat players）；（3）谈判单位的稳定性（stability of the bargaining unit）。
AI.method: 定性分析：对以色列社会采购政策发展的制度性考察 + 两个关于高危青少年福利与教育服务工人组织化的实证案例研究 + 对2025年Korot HaGag判决的法律分析。
AI.findings: （1）招标条件的变化、服务运营商的更替以及服务单位的碎片化会削弱工人的集体力量；（2）在某些条件下，尽管存在碎片化雇佣安排，仍可维持有效的工人组织；（3）2025年Korot HaGag判决给予了有组织工人程序性的对话权利，但未保障集体权利的保留或就业稳定性，是重要但不完整的进展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个以集体劳动法三大基本假设为核心的分析框架，用以理解就业链对组织权的系统性侵蚀机制；指出了竞争导向的社会采购政策如何从理论上消解传统集体劳动法的制度基础；为碎片化雇佣背景下组织权的理论保护提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 在劳动法和行政法领域提出具体的教义性和监管性发展建议，旨在在竞争性社会采购背景下加强对组织权的保护；通过对Korot HaGag判决的分析，指出当前法律保护的部分性不足，为未来的立法和司法实践提供了方向性指引。

title:
Designing AI-supported Learning Environments for Learner Self-updating:
A Design-based Research Study on Making Cognitive Transformation Observable

detail.title:
Designing AI-supported Learning Environments for Learner Self-updating:
A Design-based Research Study on Making Cognitive Transformation Observable
detail.abstract:
The rapid development of generative artificial intelligence, particularly large language
models (LLMs), is reshaping the role of AI in education. Earlier generations of
educational AI primarily focused on automating practice, delivering knowledge,
personalizing learning pathways, and monitoring student progress (Holmes et al., 2022;
Luckin, 2018). LLMs, however, introduce a qualitatively different possibility: sustained
natural-language interaction that can engage not only with what learners know, but also
with how they think.
This shift raises the possibility of conceptualizing AI not simply as a tool for delivering
information, but as an interactive environment that supports learners in examining and
revising their own ways of understanding.
In previous research, this study proposed self-updatability as an educational aim for a
rapidly changing society. Self-updatability was defined as the capacity to continually
reconsider and, when necessary, reconstruct one's self-understanding, values, and
patterns of action through interaction with experience. To explain this process, a Value
Updating Cycle was proposed, in which experience generates dissonance or questions,
which lead to reinterpretation, value updating, and subsequent action.
However, this theoretical framework remains largely conceptual. It does not yet
sufficiently explain how self-updating actually manifests in educational settings or what
kinds of support may facilitate it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生成式AI（尤其是大语言模型）如何从传统的知识传递工具转变为支持学习者自我更新的交互式环境，并基于此前提出的"自我可更新性"理论和"价值更新循环"框架，指出当前框架仍停留在概念层面，亟需实证研究来阐明自我更新在教育情境中的实际表现及所需支持。
AI.research_question: 自我更新能力如何在教育情境中实际体现？什么样的支持（特别是基于大语言模型的交互环境）能够促进学习者的自我更新过程？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的发展使AI从自动化练习和知识传递转向支持学习者"如何思考"的深度交互，这为将AI视为促进学习者审视和修正自身理解方式的交互环境提供了可能。然而，此前提出的自我可更新性和价值更新循环框架仍停留在概念层面，缺乏对教育情境中实际表现的充分解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我可更新性理论（self-updatability）和价值更新循环（Value Updating Cycle），后者包含经验引发失调或疑问、重新解释、价值更新和后续行动四个环节。
AI.method: 该摘要主要基于理论推演和概念分析，尚未涉及具体的实证研究方法，但暗示需要通过实证研究来检验和发展该理论框架。
AI.findings: 当前的主要发现/认识是：大语言模型带来了教育AI的质性转变——从关注学习者"知道什么"转向关注"如何思考"；自我更新理论框架虽具有解释力，但尚需实证补充。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自我可更新性理论与生成式AI技术相结合，提出了将AI从"信息传递工具"重新概念化为"支持认知重构的交互环境"的理论视角，充实了教育AI的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育AI的设计提供了方向性指导——即开发旨在促进学习者自我审视和自我更新的交互式AI环境，而非仅停留在知识自动化传递层面。

title: Economic Resistance of the Business Sector as a Deterrent to War: A Two-Loop Model

detail.title: Economic Resistance of the Business Sector as a Deterrent to War: A Two-Loop Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: he author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper is part of the research series Internal Economic Resistance within the broader research program Economic Guarantees of Security (EGS). It develops the concept of business economic resistance as an endogenous constraint on military aggression and examines its role within a two-loop model of deterrence. Unlike conventional approaches that regard business primarily as a passive object of wartime mobilization, this study conceptualizes business as a decentralized network of autonomous economic agents possessing independent objectives, assets, contractual obligations, and decision-making authority. The paper argues that the principal source of business resistance lies not merely in expected financial losses but in the anticipated erosion of entrepreneurial freedom, property rights, contractual stability, market access, and institutional predictability. These institutional threats generate rational behavioral responses, including reduced investment, capital flight, production adjustment, contract restructuring, market reallocation, informal economic activity, and business exit. Although these responses rarely take the form of organized political protest, their diffusion through production, financial, contractual, and logistical networks gradually reduces the fiscal, technological, and organizational capacity of the state. The paper introduces the concept of an economic mobilization limit, defined as the point beyond which additional state pressure no longer increases, but instead diminishes, the effective resources available for military mobilization. Particular attention is devoted to the anticipatory nature of business behavior. Economic resistance frequently begins before the outbreak of war, as firms respond to expected sanctions, mobilization measures, regulatory restrictions, and institutional uncertainty. Consequently, well-designed systems of Economic Guarantees of Security can influence expectations at the decision-making stage, activating endogenous economic constraints before military aggression occurs. The proposed framework extends traditional deterrence theory by integrating external economic measures with internally generated behavioral responses of business. It demonstrates how decentralized economic decisions can complement international sanctions and other preventive mechanisms, thereby strengthening both the prevention of aggression and the conditions for its termination. One of the key conclusions of this work is that military aggression can be not only prevented but even stopped not only by external pressure measures but also by the economic behavior of businesses. The work presents and expands on a two-loop deterrence model that links international pressure measures with the internal disobedience of economic agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"商业经济抵抗"概念，将企业视为具有独立目标与决策权的自主经济行为者网络，论证其对军事侵略形成内生约束。文章构建了包含外循环（国际施压）和内循环（企业内生性抵抗）的双循环威慑模型，引入"经济动员极限"概念，指出企业基于对制度性威胁的预期所产生的前瞻性行为（如投资缩减、资本外逃、合同重组等）能在军事侵略发生前就激活内生约束，从而补充并强化传统的威慑理论。
AI.research_question: 企业作为自主经济行为者，如何通过内生性经济抵抗行为对军事侵略形成约束？这种约束如何在威慑框架中发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 传统威慑理论将企业仅视为战争动员的被动对象，忽视了商业部门作为自主行为者可能产生的内生性抵抗。作者认为，理解商业经济抵抗的机制及其前瞻性特征，有助于建立更全面的威慑框架，从而在军事侵略发生前就能有效预防。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威慑理论（扩展版）、双循环威慑模型、制度经济学（产权、契约稳定、制度可预测性）、预期理论（前瞻性行为）
AI.method: 概念构建与理论推演方法，基于制度经济学的逻辑分析，构建商业经济抵抗的理论框架和双循环威慑模型。
AI.findings: （1）商业抵抗的主要来源不是财务损失预期，而是对企业家自由、产权、契约稳定、市场准入和制度可预测性被侵蚀的预期；（2）企业抵抗行为虽非政治抗议形式，但通过生产、金融、契约和物流网络的扩散，逐渐削弱国家的财政、技术和组织能力；（3）存在"经济动员极限"——国家施压超过某一点后，实际可用资源不增反减；（4）企业行为的预期性使得经济抵抗在战争爆发前就已开始，因此安全保障体系可在决策阶段就激活内生约束。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将商业从威慑理论的被动客体重新定位为主动的内生约束力量；（2）提出"经济动员极限"这一新概念，丰富了战争动员理论；（3）构建双循环威慑模型，将外部经济措施与内部商业行为反应整合到统一的威慑框架中；（4）将企业行为的前瞻性/预期特征纳入威慑理论，拓展了威慑的作用时点。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为"经济安全保障"（EGS）体系的制度设计提供理论依据，表明其可通过影响企业预期来预防军事侵略；（2）为国际制裁等外部措施的设计提供参考，说明如何与内部商业抵抗形成协同效应；（3）表明军事侵略不仅可由外部压力阻止，也可由企业经济行为阻止，为大国博弈中的非军事手段提供新的政策杠杆。

title: Arming the Adversary's Adversary : Why India's Decision to Arm Armenia Is a Prudent and Near-Optimal Response to the Turkey-Pakistan-Azerbaijan Axis

detail.title: Arming the Adversary's Adversary : Why India's Decision to Arm Armenia Is a Prudent and Near-Optimal Response to the Turkey-Pakistan-Azerbaijan Axis
detail.abstract: Confronted by a Turkey that arms Pakistan in South Asia yet lies beyond India's direct reach, what should New Delhi do? This article argues that India's emergence as the principal supplier of finished weapon systems to Armenia is not merely explicable but correct-a prudent, proportionate, and near-optimal response to a revisionist Turkey-Pakistan-Azerbaijan ("Three Brothers") axis whose hostility to Indian interests is now demonstrated rather than speculative. Reading the move through balance-of-threat theory, the strategic-triangle tradition, the logic of horizontal escalation and issue-linkage, and the security-dilemma literatureand drawing on recent scholarship on arms transfers as signalling and on the patron's choice between arming and allying-the article advances a single evaluative claim: India's decision fuses three mutually reinforcing strategieslegitimate balancing against an arming-and-alignment bloc, calibrated costimposition on Turkey's exposed Caucasus flank, and a profitable indigenous defence-export programme-into one play whose principal payoff (arms revenue, defence-industrial scale, and combat-relevant validation of Indian systems) accrues regardless of whether Turkey is deterred. This decoupling of payoff from deterrent success makes the strategy robust to uncertainty about an adversary's response, and therefore a rare near-dominant option for a rising power. The article specifies the mechanism, represents it in a heuristic strategic-form model that formalises the strategy's near-dominance, and treats the principal objection-that counteralliance arming hardens two blocs-not as a reason for Indian restraint but as a cost properly attributed to the axis that initiated the competition. Throughout, contested battlefield specifics (notably from the May 2025 India-Pakistan crisis) are flagged and attributed rather than asserted, and the argument is constructed to rest only on the uncontested structural record. The analysis contributes a portable framework for understanding indigenous arms transfers as legitimate cross-theatre statecraft by rising middle powers, and concludes that India should sustain and deepen the partnership.

AI.tldr: 本文论证印度向亚美尼亚供应成品武器系统不仅是可解释的，而且是正确的——这是对土耳其-巴基斯坦-阿塞拜疆"三兄弟"轴心的谨慎、相称且近乎最优的回应。印度将三种相互强化的战略（对武装结盟集团的合法制衡、对土耳其高加索侧翼的有节制成本施加、以及有利可图的国产国防出口计划）融合为一套行动，其核心收益（军火收入、国防工业规模、实战验证）无论土耳其是否被威慑都能实现，因此是一种罕见的近主导策略。
AI.research_question: 面对在巴基斯坦武装化且超出印度直接打击范围的土耳其，新德里应该怎么做？具体而言，印度向亚美尼亚供应武器系统这一决定的战略逻辑与正确性何在？
AI.motivation: 土耳其-巴基斯坦-阿塞拜疆"三兄弟"轴心对印度利益的敌对已被证实而非推测，印度需要一种既能制衡该轴心又能规避直接对抗限制的战略回应。现有文献缺乏对中等强国跨战区军火转让作为合法国家行为的系统分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威胁制衡理论（balance-of-threat theory）、战略三角传统（strategic-triangle tradition）、横向升级与议题挂钩逻辑（horizontal escalation and issue-linkage）、安全困境文献、军火转让作为信号传递的最新研究，以及赞助国在武装与结盟之间选择的文献。
AI.method: 理论推演与战略形式模型（strategic-form model）相结合。文章具体说明了作用机制，并通过一个启发式的战略形式博弈模型形式化了该策略的近主导性，同时明确标注并归因（而非断言）有争议的战地细节，仅依赖无争议的结构性事实进行论证。
AI.findings: 印度向亚美尼亚转让武器的决策融合了三种相互强化的战略：对武装结盟集团的合法制衡、对土耳其高加索侧翼施加有节制的成本、以及盈利的本土国防出口计划。该策略的核心收益与威慑成败脱钩，因此对对手反应的不确定性具有稳健性，是一种罕见的近主导选项。对于"反向联盟武装会固化两大阵营"的主要反对意见，文章将其视为应归因于发起竞争的轴心的成本，而非印度应克制的理由。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个可移植的理论框架，用以理解本土军火转让作为崛起中等大国合法的跨战区国家行为；通过将收益从威慑成败中解耦，丰富了关于制衡战略稳健性和近主导策略的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度决策层提供了战略依据，结论是印度应持续并深化与亚美尼亚的防务伙伴关系；同时为其他面临类似战略处境的崛起中等大国提供了决策参考。

title: The Conversion Deficit: An Endowment-Conditional Diagnosis of Tourism Underperformance

detail.title: The Conversion Deficit: An Endowment-Conditional Diagnosis of Tourism Underperformance
detail.abstract: Tourism combines an endowment that gives visitors a reason to travel with delivery inputs that convert that reason into a realized sector. A destination that converts less of a given endowment than comparable destinations carries a conversion deficit, an object with a size, a profile, and a cost. We measure all three by matching each destination to the ten competitors nearest it in natural and cultural endowment and reading each delivery input against that set, a within-endowment fixed-effects comparison. The deficit is large and costly: one point of it corresponds to 2.3 log points of forgone tourism receipts per capita, and the destinations carrying the largest deficits realize between three quarters and nineteen twentieths less than the competitors holding their endowment. The cost falls on the number of visitors rather than the revenue each brings. Most deficits are broad rather than concentrated on one input, and income predicts the size of a deficit but not its profile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"转化赤字"（conversion deficit）概念，衡量旅游目的地将自然与文化禀赋转化为实际旅游产出的效率差距。通过将每个目的地与其在禀赋上最接近的十个竞争者匹配，采用禀赋内固定效应比较，测量了赤字的规模、特征分布和经济成本。研究发现赤字规模巨大且代价高昂：每一点赤字对应人均旅游收入损失2.3个对数点，赤字最严重的目的地其旅游产出仅为同等禀赋竞争者的3/4到19/20。成本主要体现在游客数量而非人均消费上，且多数赤字是广泛性的而非集中于单一投入要素。
AI.research_question: 旅游目的地存在多大程度的禀赋转化效率差距（转化赤字），这种赤字的规模、特征分布和经济成本如何衡量？
AI.motivation: 旅游业将"吸引游客前往的禀赋"与"将禀赋转化为实际旅游产出的交付投入"相结合。不同目的地即使拥有相似的自然资源和文化禀赋，其旅游产出也可能存在显著差异，这种转化效率差异（转化赤字）对目的地经济表现有重大影响，但缺乏系统的测量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于禀赋-交付两要素框架，将旅游业解构为"吸引游客的禀赋"与"将禀赋变现的交付投入"两部分；采用禀赋内固定效应比较方法，将每个目的地与其禀赋最接近的十个竞争对手进行匹配比较。
AI.method: 通过将每个目的地与在自然和文化禀赋上与其最接近的十个竞争者匹配，对每个交付投入在该参照组内进行读取比较，采用禀赋内固定效应（within-endowment fixed-effects）比较方法，系统测量转化赤字的大小、特征分布及成本。
AI.findings: （1）转化赤字规模大且代价高昂：每一点赤字对应人均旅游收入损失2.3个对数点；（2）赤字最严重的目的地实际旅游产出仅为同等禀赋竞争者的3/4到19/20；（3）成本主要来自游客数量的减少而非人均消费下降；（4）多数赤字是广谱性的（广泛分布于多个投入维度）而非集中于单一投入；（5）收入水平能预测赤字的规模但不能预测其结构特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"转化赤字"这一新的分析概念，构建了测量旅游目的地禀赋转化效率的系统框架，将旅游研究从禀赋存量视角拓展到转化效率视角，并区分了赤字的规模、特征分布与成本三个维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游目的地提供诊断工具，帮助识别转化赤字的规模与分布特征，明确改进方向（游客数量而非人均消费），并揭示收入水平与赤字规模的关系，为政策制定和资源配置提供依据。

title: What Does an Imported Good Teach?
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: What Does an Imported Good Teach?
detail.abstract: Imports can transmit foreign knowledge, but trade values alone do not reveal what that knowledge is. I compare three mechanisms in a dynamic Melitz model. Imported knowledge may be drawn from an origin-wide pool, from the origin's knowledge in the relevant product field, or from the firms selected into exporting. Trade determines where learning opportunities come from in all three cases. Under the pool mechanisms, the knowledge associated with a source is stable across destinations. Under exporter selection, it depends on the bilateral cutoff: lowering the cutoff admits less productive exporters and reduces average knowledge per import. In the Pareto benchmark, this selection effect has a negative relationship with import penetration conditional on the other determinants of the cutoff. I evaluate these predictions by linking Chinese customs transactions to importing firms' backward patent citations. Conditional on bilateral totals, the technology composition of a firm's imports from a source predicts the technologies in which it cites that source, while the benchmark's negative penetration relationship is absent in both samples. The evidence supports a substantial origin-by-product component in imported learning, while leaving room for origin-wide learning and a smaller selected-exporter component.

AI.tldr: 本文通过动态Melitz模型比较了进口知识传播的三种机制（来源国整体知识池、来源国产品领域知识、出口企业选择效应），并利用中国海关交易数据与进口企业向后专利引用数据验证，发现进口学习存在显著的"来源国×产品"成分。
AI.research_question: 进口是如何传递外国知识的？三种知识传播机制（来源国整体知识池、产品领域知识、出口企业选择）中哪一种更能解释实际观察到的进口知识学习模式？
AI.motivation: 贸易额本身无法揭示进口所传递的具体知识内容。以往的贸易研究关注总量效应，但缺乏对进口知识"是什么"以及"如何传播"的机制层面的识别和比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态Melitz模型；三种知识传播机制框架（来源国层面的知识池、来源国产品领域的知识、出口企业选择效应）；Pareto分布基准。
AI.method: 构建动态Melitz模型推导三种机制的可检验预测；利用中国海关交易数据与进口企业向后专利引用数据进行实证检验，考察进口来源的技术构成与企业引用行为的对应关系。
AI.findings: 在控制双边总量后，进口来源的技术构成能预测企业引用该来源的技术领域；但模型中Pareto基准预测的"负的进口渗透率关系"在样本中不存在。证据支持"来源国×产品"知识成分占主导，同时留有来源国整体学习和较小的出口企业选择成分的空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一的动态Melitz框架下比较三种进口知识传播机制并给出可区分的实证预测；通过识别"来源国×产品"维度的知识学习机制，深化了对进口作为知识传递渠道的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贸易政策制定者理解进口多元化的知识价值提供了证据基础；帮助企业识别从特定来源国进口的边际知识收益；为测度进口隐性知识溢出提供了方法参考。

title: Stage-Level Stock Returns and Spillovers in DOJ Antitrust Cases

detail.title: Stage-Level Stock Returns and Spillovers in DOJ Antitrust Cases
detail.abstract: I study how equity markets price United States Department of Justice (DOJ) antitrust actions across the full life cycle of an enforcement matter. Using hand-collected DOJ Antitrust Division case records linked to CRSP daily returns and, for mergers, to SDC Platinum deal milestones, I estimate three-day cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) for (i) defendants in non-merger conduct cases, (ii) acquirers and targets across six merger stages, and (iii) the merging firms' competitors, suppliers, and customers. The sample is restricted, by construction, to matters in which the DOJ filed a lawsuit. Three findings emerge. First, non-merger enforcement filings produce no economically or statistically meaningful reaction for defendants (mean CAR-0.40%, not significant). Second, merger activity is strongly priced, but almost entirely on the target side (announcement +6.2%, agreement +5.5%); acquirers earn approximately zero at every stage, and the positive reaction at regulatory milestones reflects deal-completion news rather than an enforcement effect. Third, these value effects do not spill over: competitor, supplier, and customer CARs are indistinguishable from zero at every stage. Markets price the merger, concentrated in the target and driven by completion probability, while antitrust enforcement itself moves nothing and generates no measurable spillovers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国司法部（DOJ）反垄断执法行动在整个执法案件生命周期中对股票市场定价的影响。利用手工收集的DOJ反垄断部门案件记录，结合CRSP日收益率和SDC Platinum并购里程碑数据，估计了非合并行为案件被告、并购双方（收购方和目标方）在六个并购阶段，以及合并企业竞争对手、供应商和客户的三日累计异常收益（CARs）。研究发现：第一，非合并执法起诉对被告无显著市场反应；第二，并购活动被显著定价但几乎完全体现在目标方；第三，价值效应不存在溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 股票市场如何定价美国司法部反垄断执法行动在整个执法案件生命周期中的价值影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对反垄断执法事件的市场反应证据有限且不一致，缺乏对执法案件完整生命周期（从起诉到结案）的系统考察，也缺乏对并购案件不同阶段以及产业链上下游溢出效应的全面分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效市场假说的事件研究法（Event Study），利用市场定价效率检验反垄断执法的信息含量与经济后果。
AI.method: 事件研究法：计算三日累计异常收益（CARs），覆盖三类样本——(1)非合并行为案件被告；(2)并购案件中收购方与目标方在六个并购阶段（公告、协议、监管里程碑等）；(3)合并企业的竞争对手、供应商和客户。数据来源包括手工收集的DOJ案件记录、CRSP日收益率和SDC Platinum并购数据。
AI.findings: 第一，非合并执法起诉对被告没有经济或统计上显著的反应（平均CAR为-0.40%，不显著）。第二，并购活动被显著定价，但几乎完全体现在目标方（公告+6.2%，协议+5.5%）；收购方在每个阶段收益都接近零，而监管里程碑的正面反应反映的是交易完成新闻而非执法效应。第三，价值效应没有溢出：竞争对手、供应商和客户的CAR在每个阶段都与零无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了反垄断执法事件的市场定价机制：市场定价的核心是并购交易本身（尤其是目标方）及交易完成概率，而非反垄断执法行为本身；非合并执法与合并执法的市场反应存在显著不对称性；反垄断执法缺乏产业链溢出效应的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法机构、投资者和市场参与者提供实证依据：反垄断执法本身对被告公司股价影响有限，并购定价集中在目标方且由完成概率驱动；投资者应关注并购交易基本面而非执法事件本身，执法机构也可据此评估其执法行动的市场影响与威慑效果。

title: Cyber Crisis Management in the AI Era: Confronting Disinformation and Hybrid Threats

detail.title: Cyber Crisis Management in the AI Era: Confronting Disinformation and Hybrid Threats

publicationDetails.detailsText: EU CyberNet Expert Blog Series, 5th Blog Article. https://www.eucybernet.eu/the-5th-blog-article-of-the-eu-cybernet-expert-blog-series-cyber-crisis-management-in-the-ai-era-confronting-disinformation-and-hybrid-threats/

detail.abstract: The age of artificial intelligence (AI) has intensified the potency of disinformation and cyber-attacks, fusing them into complex hybrid threats. Nation-state actors and cybercriminals increasingly leverage AI to craft and amplify false narratives while executing cyber operations, aiming to destabilise societies without triggering conventional warfare responses. This article clarifies the distinctions between misinformation, disinformation and propaganda, and situates them within foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI). It examines how AI accelerates and scales FIMI operations, presents real-world hybrid threat scenarios and explores the harms at individual, institutional and state levels. It also outlines a strategic response framework (Prepare, Detect, Respond and Recover) integrating technical, cognitive and geopolitical measures. The discussion highlights attribution challenges, international legal tensions and the implications of emerging autonomous AIenabled influence operations, concluding with a call for integrated, multi-sector resilience in the face of evolving AI-driven hybrid threats.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能时代虚假信息与网络攻击融合而成的混合威胁，厘清了错误信息、虚假信息与宣传的概念，并将其置于外国信息操纵与干扰（FIMI）框架下分析。文章考察了AI如何加速和扩大FIMI行动，呈现真实世界的混合威胁场景，探讨个体、机构和国家层面的危害，并提出"准备—检测—响应—恢复"的战略响应框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何加剧和放大外国信息操纵与干扰（FIMI）混合威胁，以及如何构建有效的战略应对框架？
AI.motivation: AI时代使虚假信息和网络攻击的复杂性大幅提升，国家行为者和网络犯罪分子利用AI制造和放大虚假叙述并执行网络行动，旨在不触发常规战争响应的情况下破坏社会稳定，亟需系统的概念澄清和应对框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 错误信息/虚假信息/宣传的概念区分框架、外国信息操纵与干扰（FIMI）框架、混合威胁理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论综述，结合真实世界混合威胁场景的案例分析，提出战略响应框架（Prepare, Detect, Respond, Recover）。
AI.findings: AI显著加速和扩大了FIMI行动的规模与效能；混合威胁在个体、机构和国家层面均造成多层次危害；有效的防御需要整合技术、认知和地缘政治维度的多维响应框架；存在归因挑战、国际法律张力以及新兴自主AI影响操作的深远影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了错误信息、虚假信息与宣传之间的概念边界，将其系统纳入FIMI分析框架，并整合了混合威胁的防御理论，提出了综合性的战略响应模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"准备—检测—响应—恢复"（Prepare, Detect, Respond, Recover）的可操作战略响应框架，结合技术、认知和地缘政治多重维度，为跨部门协同韧性建设提供了实践路径。

title: Gibbs Measures: Thermodynamic Formalism, Sanov's Theorem, and Bayesian Optimisation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Gibbs Measures: Thermodynamic Formalism, Sanov's Theorem, and Bayesian Optimisation
detail.abstract: A Gibbs measure is an exponential tilt of a reference measure by an energy, normalised by a partition function. Three literatures place this object at their centre, and they are rarely read together: the thermodynamic formalism of Sinai, Bowen and Ruelle, with its recent geometric applications; the theory of large deviations, in which Sanov's theorem identifies relative entropy as a rate function and the Gibbs conditioning principle identifies the Gibbs measure as a conditional limit; and Bayesian computation, in which the posterior is a Gibbs measure, the marginal likelihood is a free energy, and the zero-temperature limit generates proximal algorithms. We give a unified account. The organising object is the pressure functional φ → P (φ): its value solves counting and dimension problems, its gradient is the Gibbs measure, its Hessian is a covariance and hence a Riemannian metric, and its failure of smoothness is a phase transition. We prove that the canonical ensemble sees only the concave hull of the microcanonical entropy, which gives a sharp criterion for when temperature-indexed algorithms must fail and energy-indexed ones succeed; and we show that the proximal operator and Tweedie's formula are the zeroand finite-temperature gradients of a single Gaussian free energy. These results connect the formalism to work on proximal algorithms and envelopes, hierarchical duality and scale mixtures, data augmentation, vertical-likelihood and energy-level Monte Carlo, augmented probability simulation, and global-local shrinkage. We close with partition functions in analytic number theory, where the Riemann ξ function, Lee-Yang theory, generalised gamma convolutions and the log-gas all admit Gibbsian readings.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个关于吉布斯测度的统一理论框架，将热力学形式主义、大偏差理论和贝叶斯计算三个此前很少被一起阅读的文献传统联系起来。核心组织对象是压力泛函，其值解决计数和维度问题，其梯度是吉布斯测度，其海森矩阵是协方差（即黎曼度量），其不光滑性对应相变。文章证明了正则系综只看到微正则熵的凹包，为温度索引算法与能量索引算法的成败提供了尖锐判据；并证明邻近算子和Tweedie公式是单一高斯自由能的零温和有限温梯度。
AI.research_question: 如何将热力学形式主义、大偏差理论和贝叶斯计算这三个以吉布斯测度为核心但很少被一起阅读的文献传统统一到一个共同框架中，并从中获得新的理论洞见？
AI.motivation: 吉布斯测度同时是三个不同文献传统的核心对象：热力学形式主义（Sinai, Bowen, Ruelle）及其近期几何应用、大偏差理论（Sanov定理与吉布斯条件原理）、以及贝叶斯计算（后验是吉布斯测度，边际似然是自由能）。然而这三个传统很少被一起阅读，缺乏一个统一的理论框架来整合它们。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学形式主义（Sinai-Bowen-Ruelle）、大偏差理论（Sanov定理、吉布斯条件原理）、贝叶斯计算（后验分布、自由能、零温极限与邻近算法）、压力泛函理论、微正则与正则系综、高斯自由能
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析/数学证明的方法，通过压力泛函作为统一的组织对象，分析其梯度、海森矩阵及光滑性特征，并证明正则系综仅见微正则熵的凹包这一关键性质，同时建立邻近算子、Tweedie公式与高斯自由能的梯度之间的等价关系。
AI.findings: （1）压力泛函的梯度是吉布斯测度，海森矩阵是协方差（黎曼度量），不光滑处对应相变。（2）正则系综只见微正则熵的凹包，这给出了温度索引算法何时必然失败、能量索引算法何时成功的尖锐判据。（3）邻近算子是高斯自由能的零温梯度，Tweedie公式是其有限温梯度。（4）该框架连接了邻近算法与包络、层级对偶性与尺度混合、数据增强、垂直似然与能级蒙特卡洛、增广概率模拟和全局-局部收缩等方法。（5）解析数论中的黎曼ξ函数、Lee-Yang理论、广义伽马卷积和对数气体均可从吉布斯视角重新解读。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将热力学形式主义、大偏差理论与贝叶斯计算三个传统统一到一个共同框架下；（2）通过压力泛函建立了从统计力学到优化算法（邻近算法）的桥梁；（3）证明了正则系综与微正则熵凹包的关系，为算法设计提供了理论判据；（4）在解析数论中发现了新的吉布斯测度解读。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为温度索引算法和能量索引算法的选择提供了理论判据；（2）建立了邻近算子与高斯自由能之间的新联系，可能启发新的优化算法设计；（3）为贝叶斯计算中的多种方法（数据增强、能级蒙特卡洛、全局-局部收缩等）提供了统一的理论视角；（4）将数论中的关键对象（如黎曼ξ函数）与吉布斯测度理论联系起来，可能开辟新的研究方向。

title: The Venezuelan Expert Witness before the Immigration Courts

detail.title: The Venezuelan Expert Witness before the Immigration Courts

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This working paper is a doctrinal and professional analysis based on the author's prosecutorial practice and forensic document examination experience. It does not involve human subjects research, patient data, or case studies requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This working paper received no external funding. It was self-funded by the author through Latino Institute for Security Efficiency.

detail.abstract: United States immigration courts decide, on a daily basis, questions of fact about the Venezuelan criminal justice system without, in the vast majority of cases, the benefit of qualified expert testimony to assist them. This working paper examines the doctrinal framework available to correct that gap: Federal Rule of Evidence 702, the Daubert doctrine and its flexible application in administrative proceedings, and the case law of the Board of Immigration Appeals (BIA) and the federal circuit courts defining when an expert witness on foreign documents or country conditions should be admitted and what weight the testimony should receive. Building on that doctrine, the article proposes a five-element qualification standard for the Venezuelan document expert, designed specifically to satisfy the criteria courts have used both to admit and to exclude expert witnesses in analogous cases, and illustrates it with reference to the professional record of the author, a Former Venezuelan Public Prosecutor and practicing forensic examiner. The article concludes with practical recommendations for immigration judges, DHS trial attorneys, and immigration attorneys on how to properly incorporate this type of testimony into the record.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国移民法庭在裁决涉及委内瑞拉刑事司法系统事实问题时，缺乏合格专家证词的困境，并提出一个五要素的委内瑞拉文件专家资格标准，以弥合这一制度性缺口。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个符合现有法律框架的委内瑞拉文件专家证词资格标准，以帮助美国移民法院正确裁决涉及委内瑞拉刑事司法系统的案件事实问题？
AI.motivation: 美国移民法院每天都需要裁决关于委内瑞拉刑事司法系统的事实问题，但绝大多数案件缺乏合格专家证词的辅助，这导致了裁决质量的隐患。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦证据规则第702条、Daubert原则及其在行政程序中的灵活适用、移民上诉委员会（BIA）及联邦巡回法院关于外国文件或国情专家证词采信与权重的判例法。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析方法（doctrinal analysis），通过梳理判例法体系构建标准，并以作者本人作为前委内瑞拉检察官和法庭文件检验专家的专业履历进行示例说明。
AI.findings: 提出了一个五要素的委内瑞拉文件专家资格标准，该标准专门设计以满足法院在类似案件中采信和排除专家证词所用的判准，并针对移民法官、DHS出庭律师和移民律师提出了实操建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为移民法院情境下的外国文件专家证词采信提供了系统的教义框架整合，并首次针对委内瑞拉特定国别情境提出可操作的专家资格标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民法官、DHS出庭律师和移民律师提供了如何正确将此类证词纳入案件记录的实践建议，助力提高涉及委内瑞拉案件的裁决质量。

title: Whose Priorities Count in Child Welfare Planning? Paired Adolescent–Caregiver Ratings of 32 Services in China
affiliations: Southwest University, Southwest University and Southwest University

detail.title: Whose Priorities Count in Child Welfare Planning? Paired Adolescent–Caregiver Ratings of 32 Services in China
detail.abstract: Background: Child-welfare services need to know not only what young people and adults report, but also where their priorities for concrete support diverge. Such discrepancies are consequential for adolescents affected by parental migration and other family adversity, yet they are rarely examined across a complete service portfolio. Method: We analyzed independent five-category ratings of 32 survival, psychological, and development services from 716 adolescent–caregiver dyads recruited through a multisite project network spanning Chongqing's metropolitan, northeastern reservoir, and southeastern mountainous regions. Item-fixed adolescent-minus-caregiver differences were estimated with dyad-clustered CR2 standard errors, dyad bootstrap confidence intervals, prespecified multiplicity control, and wording and completeness sensitivities. Results: Mean differences were -0.081 for survival services (95% CI [-0.127, -0.035]), -0.103 for psychological services ([-0.150, -0.057]), and -0.207 for development services ([-0.254, -0.161]); all survived Holm correction, and domain differences were significant. The largest caregiver-higher contrasts concerned learning resources, life-skills training, academic tutoring, leadership development, and safety knowledge. Of 22,847 valid item pairs, 50.6% matched exactly, 29.3% were caregiver higher, and 20.1% were adolescent higher. No prespecified heterogeneity test by age, sex, adversity group, or caregiver relationship survived false-discovery-rate correction. Conclusions: The pattern indicates a modest but systematic difference in service agendas, not an accuracy hierarchy. Parallel ratings, discrepancy review, and documented reconciliation may help needs-oriented services connect adolescent voice with adult safeguarding knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于中国重庆716对青少年-照护者配对样本，对32项生存、心理和发展类服务进行独立五类评级比较，发现照护者对发展类服务（如学习资源、生活技能培训等）的评价显著高于青少年（平均差异-0.207），而差异在年龄、性别、逆境类型等维度上不存在显著异质性，表明服务优先级分歧是系统性的而非准确性的差异。
AI.research_question: 在受父母迁移及其他家庭逆境影响的青少年群体中，青少年与其照护者对不同类型儿童福利服务的优先级评价存在何种系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 儿童福利服务不仅需要了解青少年和成人的报告内容，更需要识别他们在具体支持优先事项上的分歧点。这种分歧对受父母迁移影响的青少年具有重要后果，但现有研究很少在整个服务组合层面进行全面考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 服务需求优先级理论；青少年声音与成人监护知识之间的视角差异理论
AI.method: 多地点项目网络（覆盖重庆都市区、东北部水库区和东南部山区）招募716对青少年-照护者配对；对32项服务进行独立五类别评级；采用项目固定效应的青少年减照护者差值估计，使用配对聚类CR2稳健标准误、配对靴带置信区间、预先设定的多重比较控制（Holm校正和FDR校正），并进行措辞和完整性敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 生存服务平均差异-0.081（95%CI [-0.127,-0.035]），心理服务-0.103（[-0.150,-0.057]），发展服务-0.207（[-0.254,-0.161]）；所有差异均通过Holm校正且领域间差异显著。最大照护者偏高差异集中在学习资源、生活技能培训、学业辅导、领导力发展和安全知识。22,847个有效项目对中50.6%完全匹配，29.3%照护者更高，20.1%青少年更高。年龄、性别、逆境群体或照护者关系的异质性检验均未通过FDR校正。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了青少年与照护者在服务优先级上的分歧是"温和但系统性的服务议程差异"而非"准确性层级差异"，挑战了将成人评价视为更准确的传统假设，为理解代际视角差异提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议平行评级、分歧审查和记录在案的调解程序，帮助以需求为导向的服务将青少年声音与成人监护知识相连接；为儿童福利服务的需求评估实践提供了具体的程序性改进方案。

title: Strings as the Ontology of Radiation: Dissolving String Theory’s Fifty-year Impasse

detail.title: Strings as the Ontology of Radiation: Dissolving String Theory’s Fifty-year Impasse

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for conducting this study.

detail.abstract: String theory's fifty-year impasse is not mathematical but ontological: its mathematics is highly developed, yet the physical nature of the string remains undefined. This paper proposes that strings are not undiscovered material objects at the Planck scale, but fundamental degrees of freedom of the radiation domain. The argument builds on two prior results: a redefinition of the matter-radiation boundary in terms of transferable field excitations and material structure, and a dimensional-separation argument distinguishing a matter domain with τ > 0 from a radiation domain with τ = 0. Under this interpretation, the string's one-dimensionality, fundamental massless modes, absence of material bulk, and principled inaccessibility to matter-domain observation become natural properties of a radiationdomain entity rather than unexplained anomalies. String theory's extra dimensions therefore need not be compactified within matter-space; they may instead correspond to dimensions of the radiation domain, separated by ontology rather than geometric scale. The Calabi-Yau landscape is consequently reinterpreted as arising from imposing matter-domain compactification on radiation-domain structure. The mathematical apparatus of string theory-including worldsheet conformal field theory, modular invariance, critical-dimension constraints, massless spin-2 states, gauge structures, and supersymmetry-remains formally unchanged; only its physical referent is reassigned. The proposed identification, String = Radiation, thus provides a candidate physical ontology for string theory and yields explicit conditions under which the interpretation could be falsified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出弦论中"弦"的物理本体并非普朗克尺度下未发现的物质客体，而是辐射域的基本自由度。通过将弦重新诠释为辐射（String = Radiation），该论文试图解决弦论五十年来悬而未决的实在论困境，同时保持其数学形式完全不变。
AI.research_question: 弦的物理本质是什么？弦论中的弦究竟是普朗克尺度的物质客体，还是可以被重新诠释为其他物理实体的基本自由度？
AI.motivation: 弦论数学高度发达，但其核心对象"弦"的物理本质从未被明确定义，这构成了一个本体论（ontological）而非数学上的困境。作者试图为弦论提供一种明确的物理实在论诠释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两个前期成果：（1）以可转移场激发与物质结构重新定义物质-辐射边界；（2）维度分离论证区分物质域（τ > 0）与辐射域（τ = 0）。在此框架下，弦被诠释为辐射域实体。
AI.method: 概念分析/本体论论证方法。通过重新诠释弦论中弦的一维性、无质量模式、缺乏物质体积等特征为辐射域的自然属性，并将Calabi-Yau流形景观重新解释为对辐射域结构施加物质域紧致化的结果。数学装置（worldsheet共形场论、模不变性、临界维度、无质量自旋2态、规范结构、超对称）保持形式不变，仅重新指派物理指称。
AI.findings: 提出String = Radiation的物理本体论识别方案，弦的一维性、无质量基本模式、无物质体积、对物质域观测的原则性不可及性均成为辐射域实体的自然属性；弦论的额外维度无需在物质空间内紧致化，而可对应于辐射域的维度，由本体论而非几何尺度分离。该诠释给出了可证伪的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 为弦论提供了候选物理本体论，将弦论的本体论困境从"未发现的物质客体"转向"辐射域实体"，重新定义了弦论中额外维度和Calabi-Yau流形的物理意义，为弦论物理学基础提供了新的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了明确的、可检验的证伪条件，使弦论的本体论诠释不再只是形而上学思辨，而是可被实验观察所判定；同时可能为粒子物理与引力理论中的弦论应用提供新的概念指引。

title: Stablecoin Fragmentation and Contagion Containment
affiliations: Hanyang University

detail.title: Stablecoin Fragmentation and Contagion Containment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available market data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This letter studies when stablecoin fragmentation can contain network-mediated contagion and when it merely relocates risk. It complements Shin's recent BIS working paper by isolating a distinct margin: failure-domain containment despite the liquidity and network-effects costs of fragmented rails. The academic contribution is a bridge-risk-budget model in which chains, bridges, exchanges, and liquidity pools are local domains connected by capped or uncapped exposures. The result is conditional. Fragmentation helps only when separation creates enforceable failure domains, cross-domain exposure stays below receiver capacity, and issuer, reserve, custody, oracle, and governance dependencies are separated. It is harmful or cosmetic when it destroys liquidity, leaves bridges uncapped, or lets common-mode failures reach all domains. Gross bridge volume is insufficient because shocks can be amplified before and after crossing. The policy contribution is a stress-test discipline for bridge caps, local buffers, and common-dependency mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稳定币碎片化何时能遏制网络中介的传染风险，何时仅仅是风险转移。通过建立"桥接风险预算"模型，指出碎片化仅在满足特定条件（可执行的故障域、跨域敞口低于接收能力、关键依赖分离）时有帮助，否则有害或仅具表面效果。
AI.research_question: 稳定币碎片化在何种条件下能够遏制网络中介的传染风险，又在何种条件下仅仅是风险的转移而非消除？
AI.motivation: 补充Shin最近的BIS工作论文，通过隔离一个不同的视角——尽管碎片化轨道存在流动性和网络效应成本，但故障域隔离可能带来收益——来更全面地理解稳定币碎片化的风险影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 桥接风险预算模型（bridge-risk-budget model）：将链、桥、交易所和流动性池视为由有上限或无限敞口连接的局部故障域。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建桥接风险预算模型，分析链、桥、交易所和流动性池之间的关联敞口，并通过条件分析确定碎片化有效的边界条件。
AI.findings: 碎片化的效果是有条件的：仅当（1）分离能创建可执行的故障域，（2）跨域敞口低于接收方容量，（3）发行人、储备、托管、预言机和治理依赖被分离时才有帮助。若碎片化破坏流动性、桥无上限或因共性故障波及所有域，则有害或仅具表面效果。单纯依赖桥的总交易量不足以评估风险，因为冲击在过桥前后都可能被放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出桥接风险预算模型，将稳定币碎片化的风险分析从宏观总览细化到局部故障域层面，区分了"遏制传染"与"转移风险"两种本质不同的结果，并论证了桥总量指标的不充分性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供压力测试方法论，包括桥上限设定、局部缓冲配置和共性依赖映射的纪律性框架。

title: Addressing Child Marriage in Malawi during Emergencies: A Qualitative Study of Multi-Stakeholder Interventions
affiliations: Ankara University, University of Vermont and Ankara University

detail.title: Addressing Child Marriage in Malawi during Emergencies: A Qualitative Study of Multi-Stakeholder Interventions
detail.abstract: Background Child marriage remains a major child protection concern in Malawi and may increase during emergencies, particularly climate-related disasters. However, limited research has examined prevention efforts from the perspectives of stakeholders involved in intervention work. Objective This study explored how stakeholders understand the factors shaping child marriage, the barriers to prevention in emergency settings, and the interventions and coordination mechanisms used in Malawi. Methods A qualitative case study design was adopted. The purposive sample consisted of 20 NGO workers, government officials, and other stakeholders involved in child marriage prevention. Data were collected through qualitative interviews and analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. Results Four interrelated themes emerged. Economic hardship, cultural expectations, and gender norms were described as key drivers of child marriage, while prevention was viewed as a shared responsibility. In emergency settings, legal gaps and weak case reporting and follow-up reduced the effectiveness of prevention efforts. Participants also emphasized the importance of multi-level interventions and coordinated action among stakeholders. Conclusions Preventing child marriage in Malawi requires sustained and coordinated action that addresses poverty, gender norms, cultural influences, weak enforcement, and the disruption caused by emergencies. Stronger district-level protection systems, consistent case follow-up, and community-based interventions are needed before, during, and after disasters.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过质性案例研究，采访了20名马拉维从事童婚预防工作的非政府组织工作人员、政府官员及其他利益相关者，探讨了他们在应急情境（特别是气候灾害）下对童婚驱动因素、预防障碍及干预协调机制的理解，发现经济困难、文化期望和性别规范是童婚的主要驱动因素，而法律漏洞和薄弱的案件报告与跟进机制降低了预防效果。
AI.research_question: 利益相关者如何理解塑造童婚的因素、应急情境下童婚预防的障碍，以及马拉维童婚预防的干预措施和协调机制？
AI.motivation: 童婚是马拉维重大的儿童保护问题，且在气候相关灾害等紧急情况下可能加剧，但鲜有研究从参与干预工作的利益相关者视角探讨预防工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质性案例研究方法论，采用反思性主题分析（reflexive thematic analysis）框架。
AI.method: 采用质性案例研究设计，通过目的性抽样选取20名非政府组织工作者、政府官员及其他利益相关者，使用定性访谈收集数据，并进行反思性主题分析。
AI.findings: 研究得出四个相互关联的主题：(1)经济困难、文化期望和性别规范是童婚的关键驱动因素；(2)童婚预防被视为共同责任；(3)在紧急情境下，法律漏洞及薄弱的案件报告和跟进机制降低了预防效果；(4)参与者强调多层面干预和利益相关者间协调行动的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了从利益相关者视角探讨马拉维应急情境下童婚预防的研究空白，揭示了应急情境对童婚预防工作的特有挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出需要在灾前、灾中和灾后加强地区级保护系统、持续的案件跟进和社区干预措施，为马拉维及类似情境国家的童婚预防政策制定和实践提供依据。

title: Overcoming Financial Barriers to Community-Based Health Insurance: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial in Urban Ethiopia
affiliations: University of Westminster - Policy Studies Institute, University of Westminster - Policy Studies Institute and Adama Science and Technology University

detail.title: Overcoming Financial Barriers to Community-Based Health Insurance: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial in Urban Ethiopia
detail.abstract: Low enrollment in community-based health insurance (CBHI) remains a major obstacle to achieving universal health coverage (UHC) in low-income countries. This paper evaluates whether affordability constraints or information barriers are the primary impediments to CBHI uptake among poor urban households. We conducted a randomized controlled trial involving poor and vulnerable households in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, randomly assigning participants to one of three interventions: a 50% premium subsidy, information provision, or combination of both, alongside a control group.,While information sessions achieved high participation (95%), information alone had no statistically significant effect on enrollment. In contrast, premium subsidies substantially increased enrollment. Under the intention-to-treat framework, the subsidy increased enrollment by 9 percentage points, while the combined intervention increased enrollment by 21 percentage points. Local average treatment effect estimates were considerably larger, at 61 and 98 percentage points, respectively. Besides, households receiving premium subsidies experienced significant improvements in employment outcomes and modest increases in labor supply. However, the interventions did not significantly affect healthcare utilization within one year. Cost-effectiveness analysis using real-cost data indicated that premium subsidies are substantially more cost-effective than information campaigns in expanding insurance coverage.,The findings provide causal evidence that affordability, rather than lack of awareness, is the principal constraint to CBHI enrollment among the urban poor. They indicate partial premium subsidies remain insufficient for the ultra-poor, many of whom were unable to finance their required contribution, suggesting flat-rate subsidies exclude the ultra-poor. Achieving UHC therefore requires effective targeting mechanisms combined with fully subsidized premiums for the ultra-poor.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验，在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴的贫困城市家庭中评估了保费补贴和信息提供对社区健康保险（CBHI）参保的影响。研究发现，信息干预对参保无显著效果，而保费补贴显著提高了参保率，且结合两种干预效果最佳。成本效益分析表明补贴比信息宣传更具成本效益，证实可负担性是城市贫困群体参保的主要约束而非信息不足。
AI.research_question: 在低收入国家的城市贫困家庭中，可负担性约束和信息障碍哪个是社区健康保险（CBHI）参保的主要阻碍因素？
AI.motivation: 低收入国家社区健康保险参保率低是实现全民健康覆盖（UHC）的主要障碍，但缺乏因果证据区分可负担性约束与信息障碍的相对重要性，这阻碍了有效政策的设计与资源分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和健康保险需求理论，区分经济可负担性约束（affordability constraints）与信息不对称/认知障碍（information barriers）对保险参保决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴对贫困脆弱家庭进行随机对照试验（RCT），随机分配至四组：50%保费补贴组、信息提供组、两者联合组和控制组。采用意向性治疗（ITT）分析和局部平均处理效应（LATE）估计，并结合实际成本数据进行成本效益分析。
AI.findings: （1）信息干预虽参与率高（95%）但对参保无统计显著影响；（2）保费补贴使参保率提高9个百分点（ITT），联合干预提高21个百分点（ITT），LATE估计分别达61和98个百分点；（3）补贴组家庭就业结果显著改善、劳动力供给适度增加；（4）干预在一年内未显著影响医疗服务利用；（5）成本效益分析显示保费补贴远优于信息宣传。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了可负担性而非信息不足是城市贫困群体CBHI参保主要约束的因果证据，挑战了信息干预能有效推动参保的假设，并揭示了统一比例补贴对极端贫困群体的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据：应优先采用保费补贴而非信息宣传来扩大保险覆盖；指出统一比例（flat-rate）补贴排除极端贫困群体，实现UHC需要有效瞄准机制并对极端贫困者提供全额保费补贴。

title: Interpreting Instrumental Odour Monitoring Data Across Detection Regimes: Occurrence, Concentration Distributions and Peak-To-Mean Closures
affiliations: T&A - Tecnologia e Ambiente Srl,  T&A - Tecnologia e Ambiente Srl and  T&A - Tecnologia e Ambiente Srl

detail.title: Interpreting Instrumental Odour Monitoring Data Across Detection Regimes: Occurrence, Concentration Distributions and Peak-To-Mean Closures
detail.abstract: Environmental odour assessment increasingly relies on three complementary sources of evidence: citizen observations, atmospheric dispersion modelling and Instrumental Odour Monitoring Systems (IOMSs). However, IOMS records cannot be treated as homogeneous concentration time series because outputs below the instrumental limit of detection (LOD) are not quantitatively validated. We propose a metrologically grounded framework in which the LOD determines both the scientific question and the admissible statistical analysis. Hourly records from nine months of 30-s IOMS outputs collected at two positions within a composting facility were classified as non-detect, intermittent, persistent-censored or fully detected. Non-detect and intermittent hours were characterized through occurrence, within-hour detected-run and detected-state intensity metrics; persistent-censored hours were analysed through explicit censoring. Fully detected hours provided a direct but detection-conditioned test of two-moment peak-to-mean closures. The two positions exhibited markedly different detection regimes, with non-detect fractions from 3% to 54% and strong temporal clustering. At the 30-s instrument-resolved scale, Gamma and base-Weibull closures approximated aggregate R90 under some conditions but retained substantial hour-specific error. Autocorrelation-aware finite-sample simulations confirmed that the observed quantile and higher-order departures were not explained by 120-sample variability alone. The framework defines IOMS-derived metrics for future independent comparison with citizen reports and establishes when field observations can test the PDF closures used in peak-to-mean modelling. The closure results apply to the IOMS observation scale and do not automatically transfer to unfiltered sub-30-s ambient fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于计量学（metrologically grounded）的分析框架，用于处理仪器气味监测系统（IOMS）数据中低于检测限（LOD）的输出记录。作者基于某堆肥设施两个位置九个月的30秒IOMS数据，将每小时记录分类为未检出、间歇性、持续删失和完全检出四种状态，并针对不同状态采用相应的统计分析方法。研究发现两个位置呈现出截然不同的检测机制，且Gamma和Weibull闭合在30秒时间尺度上对R90的近似存在条件和误差限制。
AI.research_question: 如何处理IOMS输出中低于检测限（LOD）的数据，使其能够用于环境气味评估，并检验峰值-均值PDF闭合模型的适用性？
AI.motivation: IOMS记录不能被视为同质化的浓度时间序列，因为低于检测限的输出未经过定量验证。现有处理方式可能产生有偏的统计分析，需要建立一个计量学上严谨的框架来规范LOD数据的使用和分析方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计量学（metrology）框架；删失数据分析（censoring analysis）；检测状态分类；峰值-均值（peak-to-mean）PDF闭合理论；Gamma和Weibull分布模型
AI.method: 对30秒IOMS输出进行小时级分类（非检出、间歇性、持续删失、完全检出）；非检出和间歇性小时用发生率、小时内检出段和检出状态强度指标刻画；持续删失小时采用显式删失分析；完全检出小时进行两矩峰值-均值闭合检验；辅以自相关感知的有限样本模拟验证。
AI.findings: 两个位置呈现显著不同的检测机制，未检出比例从3%到54%，且存在强烈的时间聚类。在30秒仪器分辨尺度上，Gamma和基础Weibull闭合在某些条件下能近似聚合R90，但保留了显著的小时级误差。自相关感知模拟确认观测到的分位数和高阶偏离不能仅由120个样本的变异性解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了IOMS数据处理的计量学框架，定义了更适合与公民观测报告比较的IOMS派生指标；明确了何时现场观测能够检验峰值-均值建模中使用的PDF闭合；识别了闭合适用性的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境气味评估提供了IOMS数据处理的标准化方法，使仪器观测、大气扩散建模和公民观测三种证据来源能够更可靠地进行交叉验证；警示闭合适用结果仅限于IOMS观测尺度，不能自动推广到未过滤的亚30秒环境波动。

title: Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Cold-Start Adaptation of Task Difficulty in Behavioral Interventions
affiliations: Polytechnic University of Milan, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Polytechnic University of Milan, Polytechnic University of Milan and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Cold-Start Adaptation of Task Difficulty in Behavioral Interventions
detail.abstract: Personalizing task difficulty in behavioral interventions requires knowing how users respond to different challenge levels, learned only through interaction; new users provide little data, and poor early recommendations risk dropout before the intervention can adapt. To address this cold-start problem, we propose RAPID (Rapid Adaptation for Personalized Intervention Difficulty via Meta-Reinforcement Learning), which builds on Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) to learn, from a behavioral simulator, an initialization that adapts quickly to a new cohort of users while protecting first-period performance. RAPID modifies MAML with a carry-over structure that aligns meta-training with deployment and a pre-adaptation-aware objective. Across five behavioral archetypes, RAPID matches or exceeds standard MAML, population-average pretraining, and random initialization, with the largest advantage over pretraining where an archetype’s optimal difficulty or behavioral dynamics diverge from the population average. Standard MAML reaches comparable final performance but sacrifices the first period. Ablations sharing RAPID’s optimizer attribute most of its advantage over pretraining to the training framework and the first-period gain to the pre-adaptation-aware objective. Because, in practice, no simulator perfectly matches its deployment population, we test generalization to a profile absent from training, where population- average pretraining’s advantage over random initialization shrinks sharply while RAPID and standard MAML retain theirs. A stress test isolates the complementary regime, where training covers every profile yet every initialization fails on one of them before adaptation. There the meta-objective becomes essential, and meta-learned adaptation reaches far higher skill gain on that profile than any pretrained initialization, with RAPID alone combining those gains with first-period usability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAPID框架，基于MAML元强化学习解决行为干预中个性化任务难度的冷启动问题，通过携带迁移结构和预适应感知目标，使模型能够快速适应新用户群体同时保护首期表现。
AI.research_question: 如何在行为干预中解决个性化任务难度推荐的冷启动问题，即在新用户数据极少的情况下快速适应其偏好，同时避免首期推荐不当导致用户流失？
AI.motivation: 个性化任务难度需要通过与用户互动来学习其响应模式，但新用户缺乏历史数据；若早期推荐不准确，用户可能在干预系统适应之前就退出，导致干预失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模型无关元学习（MAML）、元强化学习（Meta-RL）、行为模拟器
AI.method: 在MAML基础上引入携带迁移结构（将元训练与部署对齐）和预适应感知目标函数，通过行为模拟器学习初始化参数，实现对新用户群体的快速适应。
AI.findings: 在五种行为原型中，RAPID优于或持平标准MAML、群体平均预训练和随机初始化；在原型最优难度偏离群体平均时优势最大；标准MAML能达到类似最终性能但牺牲首期表现；在未见原型泛化测试中，RAPID和MAML保留优势而预训练优势显著缩小；压力测试中元目标函数至关重要，RAPID兼顾高技能增益与首期可用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将MAML应用于行为干预的个性化任务难度冷启动问题，提出携带迁移结构和预适应感知目标两项创新，阐明了元学习框架与预训练在冷启动场景下的互补优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行为干预系统（如健康应用、教育平台）提供了可快速适应新用户的个性化难度推荐框架，降低早期流失风险，提高干预效果和用户留存率。

title: Anticipating Displacement: AI Job Replacement Anxiety, Work Motivation, and Mental Well-Being in Japan
affiliations: Keio University, Keio University, University of Tsukuba, Chiba University and Osaka International Cancer Institute

detail.title: Anticipating Displacement: AI Job Replacement Anxiety, Work Motivation, and Mental Well-Being in Japan
detail.abstract: This study investigates how subjective AI-induced job replacement anxiety relates to work motivation, turnover intentions, and mental well-being among Japanese workers. Drawing on task-based theory, efficiency wage theory, and health capital models, we formalize the fear of future replacement as a microeconomic friction. To address endogeneity, we employ a simultaneous ordered probit framework using the ILO’s Global Index of Occupational Exposure to Generative AI as an excluded exogenous variable. Results reveal a strong negative association between AI anxiety and both work engagement and work meaningfulness. AI anxiety is associated with higher turnover intention in our main specification, though this result is less robust across assumption-light and linear specifications. However, we identify a non-monotonic generational pattern: middle-aged workers exhibit a defensive “lock-in” effect, whereas younger and older cohorts show increased mobility. Among the self-employed, the pattern reverses: anxiety is associated with higher work engagement and lower turnover intentions. Furthermore, AI anxiety is significantly associated with worse mental health among younger and self-employed workers. These anticipatory psychological frictions may distort labor incentives long before actual displacement, highlighting the need for human-centered AI policies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用日本工人数据，探讨AI引发的职业替代焦虑对工作动机、离职意愿和心理健康的影响。研究发现AI焦虑与工作投入度和工作意义感显著负相关，与离职意愿正相关（但稳健性有限），并呈现出非单调的代际模式：中年工人出现"锁定效应"，年轻和年长群体流动性增加；自雇者则呈现反向模式。AI焦虑还与年轻人和自雇者的心理健康恶化显著相关。
AI.research_question: 主观的AI引发的工作替代焦虑如何影响日本工人的工作动机、离职意愿和心理健康？
AI.motivation: 在AI技术快速发展的背景下，工人对未来被替代的恐惧作为一种前瞻性心理摩擦，可能在实际失业发生之前就已扭曲劳动激励。现有研究缺乏对这一心理机制的系统性因果识别，且日本作为高老龄化、高工作压力的经济体具有独特的研究价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务基础理论（Task-based theory）、效率工资理论（Efficiency wage theory）、健康资本模型（Health capital models）
AI.method: 采用联立有序概率模型（simultaneous ordered probit framework）处理内生性问题，使用ILO的生成式AI职业暴露全球指数（Global Index of Occupational Exposure to Generative AI）作为排他性外生工具变量。
AI.findings: 1. AI焦虑与工作投入度和工作意义感呈显著负相关；2. AI焦虑与离职意愿正相关，但在弱假设和线性设定下稳健性较低；3. 代际模式非单调：中年工人出现防御性"锁定效应"，年轻和年长群体流动性增加；4. 自雇者中出现反向模式：焦虑与更高工作投入和更低离职意愿相关；5. AI焦虑与年轻和自雇工人的心理健康恶化显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI替代恐惧形式化为微观经济摩擦（microeconomic friction），扩展了任务基础理论和效率工资理论在AI时代的解释力；揭示了心理预期因素在劳动力市场激励扭曲中的独立作用，为理解AI转型期的劳动力行为提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调在AI政策制定中需要纳入"人本中心"（human-centered）的考量，提示企业和政策制定者需关注AI焦虑对工人心理和行为的实际影响，而非仅关注技术替代本身；为不同代际和就业形态（雇员vs自雇）制定差异化的AI转型支持政策提供了实证依据。

title: Competition and Productivity in Middle East and Central Asia
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Competition and Productivity in Middle East and Central Asia
detail.abstract: Across much of the Middle East and Central Asia (ME&CA), market competition remains weaker than in other emerging markets, holding back productivity and income growth. Using firm-level data from Orbis for 2002–2021, this paper studies the evolution of market competition in ME&CA economies and examines how trade policy and institutions shape competitive dynamics. We find that market power remains substantial and uneven across ME&CA, with particularly high markups in resource-intensive activities, selected service sectors, and—more recently—manufacturing in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA). Higher tariff protection is systematically associated with faster growth in markups, indicating that trade barriers weaken competitive pressure, while improvements in competition policy, anti-corruption frameworks, and property rights are linked to declining market power and hence increasing competition. Although productivity gaps remain large and persistent, stronger competition is associated with faster firm-level productivity growth and higher GDP per capita growth, with these effects particularly pronounced in CCA economies. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of policies aimed at reducing trade barriers and strengthening institutional and competition policy frameworks to foster competition, raise productivity, and support long-term income growth in the ME&CA region.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Orbis数据库中2002-2021年中东与中亚（ME&CA）地区的企业层面数据，研究了该地区市场竞争的演变及其与贸易政策和制度的关系。研究发现该地区市场势力依然显著且分布不均，关税保护与加成率上升相关，而竞争政策、反腐败框架和产权制度的改善则与市场势力下降相关，更强的竞争有助于促进企业生产率和人均GDP增长。
AI.research_question: 中东与中亚地区的市场竞争如何演变？贸易政策和制度如何塑造该地区的竞争动态？
AI.motivation: 中东与中亚地区的市场竞争比其他新兴市场更弱，制约了生产率和收入增长，但对该地区竞争动态的实证研究不足，需要系统性的企业层面证据来指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场竞争与加成率理论、贸易自由化与竞争效应理论、制度经济学（竞争政策、反腐败、产权保护）框架
AI.method: 利用Orbis企业层面数据（2002-2021年），采用加成率（markup）测度市场势力，通过计量回归分析贸易政策（关税保护）和制度变量（竞争政策、反腐败框架、产权保护）对市场势力演变的影响，并检验竞争强度与企业生产率和GDP增长的关系。
AI.findings: （1）ME&CA地区市场势力依然显著且分布不均，资源密集型行业、部分服务行业以及（近年）高加索和中亚的制造业加成率尤高；（2）更高的关税保护与加成率更快增长系统性相关，贸易壁垒削弱竞争压力；（3）竞争政策、反腐败框架和产权保护的改善与市场势力下降相关；（4）尽管生产率差距大且持续，但更强竞争与企业生产率增长和人均GDP增长正相关，且该效应在高加索和中亚地区尤为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次基于大规模企业层面微观数据系统刻画ME&CA地区市场竞争的长期演变，将贸易政策、制度因素与市场势力动态纳入统一分析框架，补充了关于新兴市场中竞争与增长关系的实证证据，并识别出区域异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ME&CA地区政策制定者提供了实证依据：降低贸易壁垒、加强竞争政策和制度建设（反腐败、产权保护）有助于促进竞争、提升生产率和支撑长期收入增长，尤其对高加索和中亚地区具有重要政策启示。

title: Digital Trade and Services Globalization: Remote Work, Cloud Services, and Cross-border Digital Exports Reshaping Development Trajectories

detail.title: Digital Trade and Services Globalization: Remote Work, Cloud Services, and Cross-border Digital Exports Reshaping Development Trajectories
detail.abstract:
Digital trade and services globalization have become a defining structural shift in the world economy, with digitally deliverable services now comprising over 60% of global services exports and growing at more than twice the rate of merchandise trade. This report analyzes three forces driving that transformation—remote work, cloud infrastructure, and cross‑border digital exports—and shows how they are reshaping development trajectories. The findings reveal a widening dual‑speed economy: high‑income countries are consolidating digital advantages, while developing economies face persistent gaps in connectivity, skills, regulatory readiness, and digital financial infrastructure. As the report notes, “digitally deliverable services… have grown from a niche segment of international trade to a central pillar of the global economy” and “the connectivity gap represents the binding constraint on digital trade participation for the world’s poorest economies.”

The analysis demonstrates that cloud services now function as twenty‑first‑century infrastructure, remote work has created new global labor markets with significant wage premiums, and digital financial flows are accelerating integration into global value chains. To ensure inclusive participation, the report identifies five policy levers—connectivity investment, digital skills development, regulatory enablement, cloud and AI access, and digital financial inclusion—and provides tier‑specific recommendations for high‑, middle‑, and low‑income economies. Ultimately, the report argues that the ability to produce and export digital services will increasingly determine national development outcomes, making digital readiness a central pillar of economic strategy in the decade ahead.

AI.tldr: 本报告分析了数字贸易和服务全球化的三大驱动力——远程工作、云基础设施和跨境数字出口——如何重塑全球经济发展轨迹，揭示高收入国家与发展中经济体之间的"双速经济"分化，并提出五项政策杠杆以确保包容性参与。
AI.research_question: 数字贸易和服务全球化如何重塑各国发展轨迹？三大驱动力（远程工作、云基础设施、跨境数字出口）如何影响不同收入水平经济体的发展？
AI.motivation: 数字可交付服务已占全球服务出口的60%以上，增速是商品贸易的两倍多，成为全球经济结构性转变的核心。然而，发展中经济体在数字参与方面面临持续差距，需要系统性分析这些驱动因素并制定包容性政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 服务全球化理论、数字贸易经济学、发展经济学中的技术差距与双速经济理论
AI.method: 基于全球贸易数据的定量分析，涵盖三大驱动力（远程工作、云基础设施、跨境数字出口）的实证研究，并针对高、中、低收入经济体进行分类政策分析
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）全球呈现"双速经济"，高收入国家巩固数字优势而发展中经济体面临连通性、技能、监管准备和数字金融基础设施的持续差距；2）云服务已成为21世纪基础设施；3）远程工作创造了具显著工资溢价的全球劳动力市场；4）数字金融流动加速了全球价值链融入；5）连通性差距是低收入经济体参与数字贸易的约束瓶颈。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字贸易三大驱动力（远程工作、云基础设施、跨境数字出口）整合进发展经济学分析框架，提出"数字就绪度"作为国家发展战略核心支柱的理论观点，丰富了服务全球化与发展路径关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五项政策杠杆：连通性投资、数字技能发展、监管赋能、云与AI接入、数字金融包容性，并为高、中、低收入经济体提供分层级的具体政策建议。

title: Common-Value Fixed-Equity Auctions under Induced Risk Aversion
affiliations: University of Queensland - School of Economics, University of Auckland and University of Queensland - School of Economics

detail.title: Common-Value Fixed-Equity Auctions under Induced Risk Aversion
detail.abstract: Governments often auction natural-resource rights using a combination of an up-front payment and a predetermined equity rate. We use a laboratory experiment to study how this retained equity share affects bidding and revenue in a first-price common-value auction. Our design combines within-subject variation in equity rates with a novel between-subject treatment that induces greater risk aversion. We find that higher equity shares reduce bids and their sensitivity to signals while increasing seller revenue, consistent with the linkage principle. Induced risk aversion lowers both bids and revenue, and higher equity shares partially mitigate these effects, although the interaction estimates are imprecise. Despite these effects, subjects overbid at low signals and remain susceptible to the winner's curse.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验研究政府在拍卖自然资源权时采用"预付款+固定权益比例"组合对投标行为和卖方收入的影响。研究发现更高权益比例降低投标价格及其对信号的敏感性，但提高卖方收入（符合关联原理）；诱导风险厌恶降低投标和收入，更高权益比例可部分缓解这些效应；但被试在低信号时仍过度出价，易受赢家诅咒影响。
AI.research_question: 保留权益份额（retained equity share）如何影响一价共同价值拍卖中的投标行为和卖方收入？风险厌恶在其中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 政府拍卖自然资源权常采用预付款加固定权益比例的组合，但权益比例对拍卖结果的影响尚不清楚，需要系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关联原理（Linkage Principle）；一价共同价值拍卖理论
AI.method: 实验室实验，采用被试内设计操纵权益比例，并结合被试间设计诱导风险厌恶
AI.findings: （1）更高权益比例降低投标价格及其对信号的敏感性，但增加卖方收入；（2）诱导风险厌恶降低投标和收入；（3）更高权益比例部分缓解风险厌恶的负面效应，但交互估计不精确；（4）低信号下存在过度出价，赢家诅咒仍然显著
AI.theory_contributions: 为关联原理提供了实验证据，揭示了权益比例与风险厌恶对拍卖结果的交互作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府设计自然资源权拍卖机制提供参考，表明设置较高权益比例可提高卖方收入，并有助于缓解投标者风险厌恶带来的收入损失

title: Standing Tall at Sixteen: The Labor Market Value of Relative Height in Adolescence
affiliations: University of Bologna-Department of Economics,  and CEIS, University of Rome Tor Vergata

detail.title: Standing Tall at Sixteen: The Labor Market Value of Relative Height in Adolescence
detail.abstract: We study whether social standing during adolescence has persistent effects on later labor market outcomes, using relative height within school cohorts as a visible, predetermined marker. Using Add Health data, we reinterpret the height premium as positional rather than a return to absolute stature. Being one inch shorter than the tallest classmate is associated with 1.4% lower earnings for males, with no effect for females. The relationship is asymmetric, driven by a penalty for low standing, and persists into mature career. It operates through social integration rather than schooling or occupational sorting, suggesting adolescent hierarchies have long-lasting economic consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Adolescent Health（Add Health）数据，将身高溢价重新解读为位置效应而非绝对身高的回报。研究发现，在青少年时期，相对班级内同学的身高排名对男性成年后的劳动力市场结果有持续性影响：比最高同学矮一英寸与1.4%更低的收入相关，且该效应不对称，主要由低社会地位的惩罚驱动，并通过社会融合渠道而非教育或职业选择发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 青少年时期的社会地位是否会对成年后的劳动力市场结果产生持续性影响？具体而言，相对身高（作为可见且预先决定的地位标志）是否比绝对身高更能解释收入差异？
AI.motivation: 以往文献普遍关注身高与收入的"身高溢价"现象，但大多将其归因于绝对身高的回报。本文试图质疑这一解释，提出身高溢价可能本质上是一种社会地位效应——即个体在同辈群体中的相对位置才是关键决定因素，而非绝对生理特征本身。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会地位理论、社会分层理论、青少年社会等级形成理论。核心假设是青少年时期形成的同伴社会等级结构会通过社会融合等机制固化，对个体长期发展产生持续性影响。
AI.method: 使用美国国家青少年健康纵向调查（Add Health）数据，以学校内同伴的相对身高作为青少年社会地位的可观察且预先决定的指标，通过实证回归分析估计相对身高对成年收入的影响。
AI.findings: （1）相对身高对男性收入有显著正向影响——比最高同学矮一英寸与1.4%更低的收入相关；（2）对女性没有显著影响；（3）效应具有不对称性，主要由低社会地位的惩罚驱动；（4）该效应在职业生涯成熟期仍然持续；（5）作用机制是社会融合而非学校教育或职业选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新诠释了经典的身高溢价文献，将绝对身高回报论转变为位置效应论；为青少年社会地位的长期经济后果提供了因果证据；发现社会融合是地位影响经济结果的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解青少年时期同伴关系和社交环境的重要性提供了实证依据，对教育政策制定、青少年发展干预以及劳动力市场不平等研究具有参考意义。

title: Investor Behavior in Capital Markets: The Role of Financial Literacy and Behavioral Biases in Retail Investors' Inclination toward Sustainable Finance Products in Emerging Economies

detail.title: Investor Behavior in Capital Markets: The Role of Financial Literacy and Behavioral Biases in Retail Investors' Inclination toward Sustainable Finance Products in Emerging Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have inappropriately influenced or biased the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: This study disentangles the behavioral mechanisms that shape retail investors' inclination to allocate capital toward sustainable finance products green bonds and ESG rated mutual funds within emerging capital markets. Integrating the Theory of Planned Behavior with behavioral finance perspectives on cognitive bias, we theorize that objective financial literacy promotes sustainable allocation while cognitive biases herding and overconfidence impede it, and that risk perception mediates the literacy pathway. Drawing on a sample of 612 active retail investors across emerging market exchanges, we employ Covariance-Based Structural Equation Modeling (CB-SEM) with Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) to estimate the direct and mediated paths. The findings indicate that objective financial literacy is positively associated with sustainable allocation intention (β = 0.371, p < .001), whereas herding bias (β =-.268, p < .001) and overconfidence bias (β =-.224, p < .001) are negatively associated with it. Risk perception significantly predicts allocation intention (β = 0.312, p < .001) and significantly mediates the financial literacy pathway (indirect β = 0.142, 95% CI [0.094, 0.196]). The measurement and structural models exhibit excellent fit. The study advances behavioral finance theorizing in the under researched emerging market and sustainable finance context and offers actionable guidance for regulators, asset managers, and investor education programs.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨新兴资本市场中散户投资者对可持续金融产品（绿色债券和ESG评级共同基金）配置意向的行为机制。整合计划行为理论与行为金融学的认知偏差视角，研究发现客观金融素养正向促进可持续配置意向，而羊群效应和过度自信偏差则起抑制作用，风险感知在其中发挥中介作用。
AI.research_question: 哪些行为机制塑造了新兴资本市场中零售投资者对可持续金融产品（绿色债券和ESG评级共同基金）的资本配置意向？具体而言，客观金融素养和认知偏差（羊群效应、过度自信）如何影响这一配置意向，以及风险感知在其中扮演何种角色？
AI.motivation: 新兴资本市场的可持续金融研究尚不充分，散户投资者的行为机制未被系统厘清。理解这些机制对于推动可持续投资在新兴市场中的发展至关重要，同时现有文献缺乏整合计划行为理论与行为金融学认知偏差视角的综合性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior）与行为金融学的认知偏差视角，探讨金融素养、羊群效应、过度自信和风险感知对可持续配置意向的影响。
AI.method: 基于新兴市场交易所612名活跃散户投资者的样本，采用协方差结构方程模型（CB-SEM）结合验证性因子分析（CFA）估计直接路径与中介路径。
AI.findings: 客观金融素养与可持续配置意向显著正相关（β=0.371, p<.001）；羊群偏差（β=-.268, p<.001）和过度自信偏差（β=-.224, p<.001）与配置意向显著负相关；风险感知显著正向预测配置意向（β=0.312, p<.001），并在金融素养路径中起显著中介作用（间接β=0.142, 95% CI [0.094, 0.196]）；测量模型和结构模型拟合度优秀。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了行为金融理论在新兴市场和可持续金融情境下的理论化发展，填补了这两个交叉领域的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、资产管理者及投资者教育项目提供了可操作的指导建议，有助于促进新兴市场可持续金融的发展。

title: Stablecoins and Fragility in Fixed Exchange Rate Regimes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Stablecoins and Fragility in Fixed Exchange Rate Regimes
detail.abstract: This paper studies how dollar stablecoins affect parallel foreign-exchange markets in economies with fixed or heavily managed exchange rates. When foreign currency is rationed, the true degree of exchange-rate misalignment is not directly observed. Traditional parallel markets reveal it only imperfectly because information is dispersed across bilateral and often private trading opportunities. Stablecoins make dollar-like claims easier to access outside the official allocation system, but they also create a visible, high-frequency price that aggregates order flow in a common venue. I develop a global-games model in which households observe dispersed private signals about misalignment, while stablecoin market depth determines the precision of a common public signal. Stablecoins generate a state-dependent welfare effect. They expand access to foreign-currency and can improve allocation by making beliefs about misalignment more informative, but the same public price can also coordinate runs by making beliefs and actions more synchronized. When misalignment is low, access and allocation gains dominate, so stablecoins raise welfare. When misalignment is high, the coordination externality becomes more costly: a more precise public signal compresses belief dispersion, strengthens coordinated exit incentives, and can overturn the access benefit. This points to a state-contingent approach that preserves low-cost access in normal states while using temporary, targeted measures to manage large or run-like flows when misalignment is high.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美元稳定币如何影响固定或重度管理汇率制度下的平行外汇市场。稳定币既扩大了外汇获取渠道并改善信息聚合，但也通过公共价格信号协调了挤兑行为。福利效应取决于汇率失调程度：失调低时福利改善，失调高时协调外部性可能逆转这一收益。
AI.research_question: 美元稳定币如何影响固定或重度管理汇率制度下的平行外汇市场，以及其对福利的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在固定汇率经济体中，外汇配给导致真正的汇率失调程度无法直接观察，传统平行市场因信息分散于双边和私人交易机会中而只能不完美地揭示失调。稳定币的出现改变了这一格局，需要理解其福利影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全局博弈模型（global-games model），结合私人信号与公共信号的信息结构分析。
AI.method: 构建一个全局博弈理论模型，其中家庭观察到关于汇率失调的分散私人信号，稳定币市场深度决定公共信号的精度，分析均衡福利效应。
AI.findings: 稳定币产生状态依赖的福利效应：当汇率失调程度低时，获取渠道和配置改善的收益占主导，提高福利；当失调程度高时，更精确的公共信号压缩信念分散度、强化协调退出激励，可能逆转获取收益，导致福利下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论层面系统分析稳定币在平行外汇市场中的作用，揭示公共价格信号的协调外部性，贡献于全球博弈理论和国际金融文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了状态依存的政策方案：在正常状态下保留低成本获取渠道，在高失调状态下采用临时、有针对性的措施管理大规模或挤兑式资金流动。

title: Sizing before Testing: Incentives and the Value of Pre-Experiment Information
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics, Yale School of Management and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Sizing before Testing: Incentives and the Value of Pre-Experiment Information
detail.abstract: Firms often experiment with new initiatives before scaling them. Because experimentation is costly, however, testing every proposal may not be economically viable. They therefore often use impact sizing: a low-cost preliminary assessment produced through managerial judgment, predictive models, or simulations. Although managers possess valuable project-specific information, they also have considerable discretion over the estimates they report. We study how a firm should jointly design its sizing-based and experiment-based policies when a manager privately observes the sizing signal, is biased toward implementation, and may exert costly effort to improve project quality. We develop a principal-agent model and establish three main findings. First, even when report manipulation is costless, impact sizing can strictly improve the firm's payoff, but only within a wedge-shaped region of intermediate experimentation costs. When experimentation is inexpensive, the firm tests broadly and sizing is redundant; when it is too expensive, testing cannot profitably discipline exaggerated reports. Greater manipulation costs make truthful reporting easier to sustain and expand the conditions under which sizing creates value. Second, when manipulation costs alone cannot sustain the first-best allocation, truthful reporting may require policy distortions, including over-experimentation or adoption following unfavorable reports. Experimentation therefore both reveals project quality and disciplines reporting. Third, when the manager can improve project quality, experimentation also provides effort incentives. Sizing and effort can be complements when better screening raises the return to quality improvement, or substitutes when screening becomes an alternative to costly effort. Firms should therefore jointly design sizing governance, experimentation rules, and managerial effort incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业在管理者私下观测规模评估信号、偏向实施且可付出努力改进项目质量的情况下，如何联合设计基于规模评估和实验的政策。研究发现：即使报告操纵无成本，规模评估在中等实验成本区间内仍能严格提升企业收益；当操纵成本不足以维持最优配置时，真实报告可能需要政策扭曲（过度实验或对不利报告仍采纳）；实验还能为管理者改进项目质量提供努力激励，规模评估与努力可能是互补或替代关系。
AI.research_question: 当管理者私下观测规模评估信号、有实施偏见且可付出努力改进项目质量时，企业应如何联合设计基于规模评估和实验的政策？
AI.motivation: 企业在推广新举措前常进行实验，但实验成本高昂；规模评估（通过管理判断、预测模型或模拟）作为低成本预评估被广泛使用。然而管理者拥有私人信息且在报告上有相当大的自由裁量权，这引发了一个重要问题：企业应如何最优地利用规模评估与实验这两种机制来筛选项目？
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理模型（principal-agent model）
AI.method: 构建委托-代理理论模型，分析规模评估与实验的联合最优设计，考虑报告操纵、实施偏见和努力激励等因素。
AI.findings: 第一，即使报告操纵无成本，规模评估在中等实验成本的楔形区间内能严格改善企业收益；操纵成本增大可扩展规模评估创造价值的条件。第二，当操纵成本不足以维持最优配置时，真实报告可能需要政策扭曲，包括过度实验或对不利报告仍采纳，实验既揭示项目质量也约束报告。第三，当管理者能改进项目质量时，实验提供努力激励；规模评估与努力在更好的筛选提高质量改进回报时互补，在筛选成为昂贵努力的替代时则互相替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上建模规模评估与实验的联合最优设计，揭示了在报告操纵存在下两者之间的交互机制，扩展了关于筛选、报告激励与努力激励之间互动的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计规模评估治理、实验规则和管理者努力激励机制提供了指导，说明应联合考虑这三者而非孤立设计。

title: Digital Transformation in Internal Control and Revenue Security: Evaluating the Efficacy of Blockchain-based Bank Reconciliation Systems against Fraud and Embezzlement Risks in the Hospitality Sector

detail.title: Digital Transformation in Internal Control and Revenue Security: Evaluating the Efficacy of Blockchain-based Bank Reconciliation Systems against Fraud and Embezzlement Risks in the Hospitality Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have inappropriately influenced or biased the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: This qualitative study investigates the administrative barriers, system-readiness conditions, and fraudprevention realities of deploying distributed ledger technology (DLT) for bank reconciliation within hotel accounting ecosystems. While the technical promise of blockchain-based reconciliation immutable records, continuous matching, and cryptographic audit trails is widely asserted, the organizational realities of its deployment in the hospitality sector remain poorly understood. Grounded in the internal-control framework and routinization perspectives on technology adoption, this research adopts an exploratory multi-case design encompassing semi-structured interviews with finance directors, internal auditors, IT leaders, and external advisors across hotel operators at varying stages of DLT adoption, triangulated with documentary evidence. Thematic analysis surfaced two conditioning themes administrative barriers and system readiness a core reconciliation mechanism, and two outcome themes capturing fraud and embezzlement mitigation and revenue security through cash-leakage control. The findings reveal that automated, real-time reconciliation reduces the manual touchpoints through which asset misappropriation and cash leakage typically occur, shortens detection latency, and strengthens segregation of duties, while its efficacy is strongly conditioned by data-integration maturity, banking-API connectivity, and the resolution of governance and regulatory ambiguity. The study contributes an empirically grounded account of DLTenabled internal control and offers actionable guidance for hospitality finance leaders.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性多案例设计，探讨了分布式账本技术（DLT）在酒店会计生态系统中用于银行对账时的管理障碍、系统就绪条件和防欺诈现实。研究发现自动化实时对账减少了资产挪用和现金泄漏的手动接触点，缩短了检测延迟，并加强了职责分离，但其有效性强烈依赖于数据集成成熟度、银行API连通性以及治理和监管模糊性的解决。
AI.research_question: 分布式账本技术（DLT）在酒店会计生态系统银行对账部署中的组织现实如何？具体而言，管理障碍、系统就绪条件和防欺诈机制如何影响其实施效果？
AI.motivation: 区块链对账的技术优势（不可变记录、持续匹配、加密审计轨迹）被广泛宣称，但酒店行业部署该技术的组织现实仍缺乏理解，需要实证研究来揭示部署过程中的真实情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以内部控制框架和技术采用的常规化（routinization）视角为理论基础。
AI.method: 探索性多案例设计，包括对财务总监、内部审计师、IT负责人和外部顾问的半结构化访谈，并与文件证据进行三角验证；采用主题分析。
AI.findings: 识别出两个条件主题（管理障碍、系统就绪）和一个核心对账机制，以及两个结果主题（欺诈和贪污缓解、通过现金泄漏控制的收入安全）。自动化实时对账减少了资产挪用和现金泄漏的手动接触点，缩短检测延迟，加强职责分离；其有效性受数据集成成熟度、银行API连通性及治理监管模糊性解决程度制约。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了DLT赋能内部控制的经验性实证解释，填补了酒店行业DLT部署组织现实的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店财务领导者提供了关于DLT银行对账部署的可操作指导，包括系统就绪条件和治理要求。

title: A comprehensive review of neural network--based approaches for retinal blood vessel segmentation in fundus images
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Ostrava - University Hospital Ostrava and University of Ostrava - University Hospital Ostrava

detail.title: A comprehensive review of neural network--based approaches for retinal blood vessel segmentation in fundus images
detail.abstract: Automated analysis of retinal fundus images, particularly blood vessel segmentation, is essential for diagnosing and monitoring ocular and systemic diseases. Over the past decade, neural network-based methods for retinal vessel segmentation have grown rapidly, yet challenges remain in reproducibility, clinical validation, and generalizability. This systematic review, conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines, synthesizes retinal vessel segmentation research published between 2016 and 2025. We analyzed 198 studies selected from 4,753 records identified through Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, and PubMed. The review provides a comprehensive overview of methodological trends, dataset usage, and evaluation practices. It summarizes architectural evolution from convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to Transformers and generative adversarial networks (GANs), as well as preprocessing, augmentation, training configurations, loss functions, postprocessing methods, evaluation metrics, and reproducibility practices. Our analysis shows that CNN-based methods, particularly U-Net variants, remain the dominant approach. Although benchmark performance appears saturated, results are supported by heterogeneous and often underreported methodological choices. Important gaps persist: cross-dataset validation is inconsistent, public code availability remains limited, and statistical uncertainty is rarely reported. In addition, the heavy reliance on a small number of datasets containing predominantly healthy subjects raises concerns regarding bias and generalizability to pathological conditions. This review identifies fragmented evaluation and limited transparency as major barriers to clinical translation. By mapping methodological trends and architectural developments, we provide recommendations for standardized evaluation, diversified validation, and open-science practices to support future progress in retinal vessel segmentation research.

AI.tldr: 本文按照PRISMA 2020指南对2016-2025年间视网膜血管分割研究进行了系统综述，分析了从4,753篇记录中筛选出的198项研究，总结了方法学趋势、架构演化（从CNN到Transformer和GAN）、数据集使用和评估实践，指出基准性能虽看似饱和，但存在方法报告不透明、跨数据集验证不一致、代码可用性有限和统计不确定性报告不足等问题，并提出了标准化评估和开放科学建议。
AI.research_question: 视网膜血管分割研究在2016-2025年间的方法学发展趋势、评估实践现状以及阻碍临床转化的关键挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管神经网络方法在视网膜血管分割领域发展迅速，但该领域存在可复现性差、临床验证不足和泛化能力有限等挑战，缺乏一个系统性的综述来全面梳理方法学趋势并识别这些问题的根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统综述方法论（PRISMA 2020指南）；深度学习架构演化理论（从CNN到Transformer和GAN的技术进步框架）
AI.method: 按照PRISMA 2020指南进行系统性文献综述，从Scopus、Web of Science、IEEE Xplore和PubMed四个数据库检索文献，从4,753篇记录中筛选出198项研究进行分析，涵盖方法学趋势、数据集使用、评估实践、可复现性等多个维度。
AI.findings: CNN方法（尤其是U-Net变体）仍是视网膜血管分割的主导方法；基准性能看似饱和但受异构且报告不充分的方法选择影响；跨数据集验证不一致、公共代码可用性有限、统计不确定性报告不足；对少量以健康受试者为主的数据集的过度依赖引发偏差和病理条件泛化担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地描绘了视网膜血管分割领域2016-2025年的方法学演化图景，识别了碎片化评估和有限透明度作为临床转化的主要障碍，为领域提供了方法论层面的批判性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了标准化评估、多样化验证和开放科学实践的具体建议，为研究者提供了方法选择参考，并为推动视网膜血管分割研究的临床转化提供了路线图。

title: Working Capital Management under Inflationary Environments: Assessing the Vulnerability of Inventory and Receivable Policies to Macroeconomic Shocks in Emerging Market Service Firms
