AI.tldr: 本文通过对比2026年1-4月印度股市回撤期间100名散户投资者的匿名调查数据与AMFI/NSDL的宏观聚合数据，发现个体行为与聚合叙事存在显著背离：45%受访者抛售、64%的卖家实现亏损（与处置效应相反）、70%依赖外部信息源显示隐性羊群效应，尽管调查中仅5-9%承认从众。61%认为自身决策"基本理性"，但实际存在被迫卖出和中断SIP。研究表明市场整体韧性与个体恐慌在下跌期间并存。
AI.research_question: 在2026年1-4月印度股市回撤期间，个体投资者行为是否与聚合数据所显示的"零售韧性"叙事一致？
AI.motivation: 聚合数据（SIP创纪录、连续61个月净流入）显示印度散户在股市下跌16%期间表现出显著韧性，但聚合数据可能掩盖个体层面的恐慌行为。由于既往研究多依赖聚合数据或自我报告，缺乏对个体在急性市场压力下实际行为的直接检验，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 处置效应（disposition effect）、羊群效应（herding）、资本化投降（capitulation）理论、投资者行为理性自评偏差
AI.method: 对100名印度散户投资者进行匿名问卷调查（72%年龄≤35岁，68%市场经验<3年，81%经个人交易记录验证），并与同期的AMFI和NSDL聚合数据进行对比分析。
AI.findings: （1）45%受访者在下跌期间卖出持仓，与聚合数据的韧性叙事相悖；（2）64%的卖家实现亏损而非盈利（与处置效应相反），呈现市场底部附近的投降式抛售特征（此后指数回升约10%）；（3）直接询问时仅5-9%承认羊群行为，但70%将外部信息源列为主要影响，显示隐性羊群效应；（4）61%自评决策"基本理性"，但广泛存在被迫卖出和中断SIP的行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 发现聚合数据可能系统性掩盖个体层面的恐慌行为；提供了与经典处置效应相反的证据（下跌中亏损卖出占主导）；揭示了直接自报与间接行为证据在羊群效应测度上的显著差异；丰富了市场底部投降行为的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者教育提出启示：需要针对急性市场压力情境设计专门的教育内容，而非仅依赖聚合市场韧性指标来评估散户健康状况；提示监管者和从业者应关注聚合数据掩盖的个体脆弱性。

title: Significant Risk Transfer (SRT) as a Framework for Tokenized Real-World Assets
affiliations: City College of New York and Columbia University

detail.title: Significant Risk Transfer (SRT) as a Framework for Tokenized Real-World Assets
detail.abstract: Roughly $345 billion of real-world assets are recorded on public blockchains, and only about eight per cent of that value trades. The standard diagnoses — immature technology, regulatory uncertainty, insufficient liquidity — misidentify the constraint. This paper argues that a tokenized real-world asset is neither a security nor the underlying asset, but a synthetic risk transfer: a contract that conveys an asset’s economic exposure while legal title remains with the originator. We first set out the mechanics of both structures and show that they are the same object. We then import the analytical apparatus that the bank risk-transfer market already possesses — the supervisory assessment of whether a transfer is significant — and propose it as the organizing framework for tokenized assets. Significance, defined as the share of conveyed exposure that the originator cannot recapture, does two jobs at once: it classifies the instrument, and it prices it. We then put the apparatus to work twice more — to locate the tokenized interest in the vehicle’s capital structure, and to ask what restructuring can mean for a claim whose seniority the sponsor may alter without ever committing a default. We formalize significance, catalogue the recapture channels through which it leaks, and derive the market-structure consequences of leaving it unmeasured — adverse selection in the primary market and collateral ineligibility in the secondary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出代币化现实世界资产（RWA）本质上既不是证券也不是基础资产，而是一种合成风险转移合约——经济敞口被转移但法律所有权仍归发起人。作者借鉴银行风险转移市场的监管框架（"重要性"检验），将其作为代币化资产的分类与定价的组织框架。
AI.research_question: 代币化现实世界资产的本质是什么？如何对其分类和定价？其市场结构缺陷（流动性不足）的根本约束是什么？
AI.motivation: 约3450亿美元的现实世界资产被记录在公链上，但仅有约8%的价值进行交易。主流解释（技术不成熟、监管不确定性、流动性不足）都误判了真正的约束。作者认为需要重新理解这类资产的法律与经济本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行风险转移市场的监管分析框架（"重要性"检验）；合成风险转移理论；资本结构与优先权理论。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念建模。先论证代币化结构与传统合成风险转移是同一对象，再引入监管"重要性"概念，形式化重要性定义，编目"回捕渠道"（recapture channels），并推导市场结构后果。
AI.findings: （1）代币化RWA与银行合成风险转移在机制上是同一对象；（2）"重要性"——发起人无法重新捕获的被转移敞口份额——同时完成分类与定价两重功能；（3）该框架可用于定位代币化权益在资本结构中的位置；（4）若不对重要性进行度量，会导致一级市场逆向选择与二级市场抵押品不合格等市场结构后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个新的组织框架（基于"重要性"概念）来统一理解和分类代币化现实世界资产；将银行风险转移市场的成熟监管分析工具引入代币化资产领域；形式化了"重要性"概念并系统编目了其泄漏渠道（回捕渠道）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供一个评估代币化资产转移是否"重要"的操作框架；为市场参与者提供代币化资产的定价与分类方法；诊断了RWA二级市场流动性不足的真正结构性原因（重要性未度量导致的逆向选择与抵押品不合格）。

title: The Data Paradox: Secret Prior Art and the Hidden Risk to U.S. Patents

detail.title: The Data Paradox: Secret Prior Art and the Hidden Risk to U.S. Patents

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Modern data-centered inventions—including structured data architectures, training methodologies, datasets, and data-processing pipelines—are the core assets driving innovation in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, digital platforms, and emerging technologies. These inventions are typically deployed through cloud services and APIs that reveal functionality while concealing the data structures and methods that constitute the inventive contribution. Commercialization thus discloses nothing of technological value to the public. Yet under the doctrine of secret prior art—rooted in Judge Learned Hand’s Metallizing Engineering (1946) and preserved by the Supreme Court’s decision in Helsinn Healthcare v. Teva Pharmaceuticals (2019)—such confidential commercial activity can invalidate U.S. patents. This creates a hidden risk: patents may be destroyed by the very secrecy that makes data-centered inventions valuable, even though the public gains no knowledge from the commercial deployment. The risk is compounded by a global paradox. The United States stands alone among major patent jurisdictions in treating confidential commercial activity as novelty-destroying prior art. A data-centered invention invalidated in the United States may remain fully patentable under the European Patent Convention, in Japan, China, Korea, and every other WTO member country—all of which apply public accessibility as the exclusive standard for prior art. Drawing on the inclusive patent framework developed in the author’s prior work, this Article argues that public accessibility should become the sole touchstone for prior art in U.S. patent law. It traces the origins of activity-based prior art from Pennock v. Dialogue (1829) through the AIA, demonstrates that the Metallizing doctrine was designed to address problems unique to the now-abolished first-to-invent system, addresses counterarguments including monopoly-extension concerns and TRIPS obligations, and proposes both legislative and judicial reforms. Eliminating secret prior art would reduce uncertainty in U.S. patent validity, align U.S. law with international practice, and support the disclosure-driven innovation culture on which data-centered industries depend.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了以数据为中心的发明（如数据结构、训练方法、数据集等）通过云服务和API保密部署时，依据美国"秘密现有技术"原则（源于Metallizing Engineering案和Helsinn案）可能被无效化专利的风险。文章主张美国专利法应以"公开可获取性"作为现有技术的唯一标准，废除"基于活动的秘密现有技术"，以与国际实践接轨并减少专利不确定性。
AI.research_question: 美国专利法是否应将"公开可获取性"作为现有技术的唯一判断标准，从而废除将保密商业活动视为破坏新颖性的"秘密现有技术"原则？
AI.motivation: 以数据为中心的发明通过云服务和API部署时，虽向公众完全保密其技术贡献，但根据美国Metallizing原则，这种保密商业活动仍可能构成破坏专利新颖性的现有技术，形成"保密反而摧毁专利"的悖论。同时美国在此问题上与国际主要司法辖区（欧洲、日韩中等均以公开可获取性为标准）严重不一致，构成全球化背景下的重大制度风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现有技术（prior art）理论、秘密现有技术学说（源自Learned Hand法官在Metallizing Engineering案中的判决）、包容性专利框架（作者先前提出的inclusive patent framework）、国际专利协调理论（TRIPS义务与WTO成员国实践）。
AI.method: 法律历史分析方法：追溯从Pennock v. Dialogue（1829）到AIA的现有技术规则演变；判例法分析：考察Metallizing Engineering和Helsinn Healthcare等关键判例；比较法分析：对比美国与EPC、日本、中国、韩国及WTO成员国的现有技术标准；规范论证：回应垄断延长和TRIPS义务等反方论点。
AI.findings: （1）美国的"秘密现有技术"原则源于已废除的先发明制（first-to-invent system）时代的特殊问题，已不适应现行先申请制；（2）美国是世界上唯一将保密商业活动视为破坏新颖性现有技术的主要专利司法辖区；（3）"公开可获取性"作为唯一标准能减少美国专利有效性的不确定性，使美国法律与国际实践一致，并支持以披露为驱动的数据中心产业创新文化；（4）文章提出立法和司法两方面的改革建议以消除秘密现有技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 对现有技术理论提出根本性重构主张：将"公开可获取性"确立为美国专利法上现有技术的唯一试金石（sole touchstone），挑战并批判了Metallizing原则的正当性基础，并论证该原则是特定历史制度（先发明制）的遗留产物。
AI.practical_contributions: 为以数据为中心的科技企业提供专利风险警示：保密商业部署可能成为专利无效的隐患；提出具体的立法与司法改革路径；帮助美国专利制度与全球主要司法辖区（EPC、日本、中国、韩国等）协调一致，降低跨国专利布局的不确定性。

title: The Adaptive Intelligence Enterprise: An Architectural Model for AI‑Enabled Organisations

detail.title: The Adaptive Intelligence Enterprise: An Architectural Model for AI‑Enabled Organisations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author serves as AI Transformation Director of AI Organisational Design (In Formation, Edinburgh). AI Organisational Design operates as an emerging research and practice initiative and is not yet established as a formal legal entity. In addition to this role, the author provides independent consulting on AI operating models, including the development of architectural concepts and governance frameworks that align with the principles discussed in this manuscript. Neither the initiative nor the consulting activities involve the operation of production systems and neither exerts influence over the research presented here. These professional responsibilities may reasonably be perceived as informing the conceptual framing or strategic positioning of The Adaptive Intelligence Enterprise: An Architectural Model for AI‑Enabled Organisations within broader AI and organisational design domains.

No private, sensitive or identifiable human information was collected or processed. In accordance with standard academic practice, institutional review board (IRB) approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author in his capacity as AI Transformation Director of AI Organisational Design (In Formation), Edinburgh). The organisation did not provide financial support for the research and no institutional resources were used that could influence the findings or conclusions presented in this manuscript.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary organisations possess vast reserves of expertise, data and operational insight, yet remain structurally unable to mobilise this knowledge across functions, systems and decision pathways. Traditional organisational‑design models, workforce architectures, governance frameworks and knowledge‑management systems were built for stable, linear, human‑only environments and are increasingly misaligned with the demands of AI‑enabled enterprises. As Large Language Models (LLMs) begin participating directly in work, knowledge flow and decision‑making, organisations require new structural models capable of supporting continuous adaptation, probabilistic reasoning and hybrid human–AI cognition.

This paper presents a comprehensive architectural framework for Holistic AI Transformation, integrating sixteen organisational capabilities across four domains: Enterprise Design and Strategic Architecture, Knowledge and Intelligence Architecture, Governance, Compliance and Decision Architecture, and Safety, Ethics, Risk and Sustainability Architecture. The framework positions LLMs as structural participants within the operating model and introduces new organisational constructs including AI‑Integrated Organisational Design, AI‑Driven Workforce Capability Architecture, LLM Knowledge Infrastructure, Knowledge Flow Analytics, Probabilistic Decision Governance and Digital Forgiveness.

Across all components, the model replaces static structures with adaptive architectures, deterministic decision pathways with probabilistic reasoning, siloed repositories with dynamic knowledge flow and periodic compliance processes with continuous regulatory intelligence. By embedding LLMs as knowledge infrastructure, decision participants, governance actors and resilience mechanisms, the framework enables organisations to operate as adaptive intelligence ecosystems capable of learning from every interaction, decision and outcome. The paper argues that AI transformation is not a technological initiative but a structural evolution one that redefines how organisations think, learn, decide and perform in an AI‑enabled world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个全面的"整体性AI转型"架构框架，整合了四个领域的十六项组织能力，将大语言模型(LLM)定位为运营模型中的结构性参与者，引入了包括AI集成式组织设计、AI驱动的劳动力能力架构、LLM知识基础设施、知识流分析、概率性决策治理和数字宽恕等新组织构念，旨在帮助组织从静态结构转向自适应架构，成为能够从每次交互、决策和结果中学习的自适应智能生态系统。
AI.research_question: 当代组织如何在AI使能的环境中重新设计其结构模型，以支持持续适应、概率推理和人机混合认知？
AI.motivation: 传统组织设计模型、劳动力架构、治理框架和知识管理系统是为稳定、线性的纯人类环境构建的，与AI使能企业的需求日益脱节。随着LLM开始直接参与工作、知识流动和决策，组织需要能够支持持续适应和混合人机认知的新型结构模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整体性AI转型架构框架，涵盖四大领域：企业设计与战略架构、知识与智能架构、治理合规与决策架构、安全伦理风险与可持续架构；引入AI集成式组织设计、AI驱动劳动力能力架构、LLM知识基础设施、知识流分析、概率性决策治理、数字宽恕等新构念。
AI.method: 本文为概念性/架构性研究论文，提出综合性架构框架，整合十六项组织能力于四个领域，并系统性地将传统静态结构替换为自适应架构。
AI.findings: 该框架将LLM嵌入为知识基础设施、决策参与者、治理行动者和韧性机制，使组织能够作为自适应智能生态系统运作；AI转型不是技术倡议，而是一种结构性演化，重新定义组织在AI使能世界中的思考、学习、决策和表现方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的组织理论视角——将AI转型视为结构性演化而非技术倡议，贡献了AI集成式组织设计、概率性决策治理和数字宽恕等原创性理论构念，推动了组织设计理论向混合人机认知环境的范式延伸。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了涵盖十六项能力、四大领域的全面转型架构框架，可作为组织进行AI转型的结构性路线图，帮助实践者将LLM系统性地嵌入组织的知识基础设施、决策流程、治理机制和风险管理中。

title: Bank Run Exposure in a Paycheck-to-Paycheck Economy with Loss-Averse Depositors
affiliations: University of Leicester

detail.title: Bank Run Exposure in a Paycheck-to-Paycheck Economy with Loss-Averse Depositors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We develop a behavioral model of bank run exposure in a paycheck-to-paycheck economy with lossaverse depositors. Income is received through demand deposits, and consumption ratcheting embeds reference dependence in a parsimonious asset-pricing framework. We show that sufficiently high subjective bad-state probabilities endogenously increase liquidity demand and generate equilibrium stress states supporting bank runs. These states define a Bank Run Exposure State Space and yield a martingale representation for exposure dynamics. A proof-of-concept empirical implementation using Call Report data constructs bank-level exposure proxies from funding and lending composition. A regression-weighted composite measure modestly improves fit relative to a retail-share benchmark, with stronger amplification among small banks and during the post-Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) collapse period. The framework highlights how behavioral liquidity demand alters equilibrium reserve holdings and can crowd out productive lending.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个"月光族"经济中的银行挤兑风险暴露行为模型，其中存款人具有损失厌恶特征。收入通过活期存款获得，消费棘轮效应将参考依赖嵌入简约的资产定价框架中。研究发现，足够高的主观坏状态概率会内生性地增加流动性需求并产生支持银行挤兑的均衡压力状态。
AI.research_question: 存款人的行为偏差（损失厌恶与参考依赖）如何影响银行挤兑风险暴露及其动态特征？
AI.motivation: 传统银行挤兑模型主要基于理性预期或协调失灵，忽略了存款人的行为偏差。在"月光族"经济中，存款人依赖活期存款获取收入并维持消费水平，其损失厌恶和消费棘轮效应可能显著影响流动性需求和挤兑风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 损失厌恶理论、参考依赖（消费棘轮效应）、资产定价框架、银行挤兑理论
AI.method: 理论建模（行为资产定价模型）结合实证分析（使用Call Report数据构建银行层面的挤兑暴露代理指标，运用回归加权复合指标进行预测拟合比较）
AI.findings: （1）高主观坏状态概率内生性地增加流动性需求并产生均衡压力状态；（2）这些状态定义了"银行挤兑暴露状态空间"，并产生暴露动态的鞅表示；（3）回归加权复合指标相比零售份额基准指标在拟合上略有改善；（4）小银行及硅谷银行倒闭后的时期存在更强的放大效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将行为偏差（损失厌恶和参考依赖）纳入银行挤兑暴露的理论框架，构建了"银行挤兑暴露状态空间"和鞅表示，解释了行为流动性需求如何改变均衡准备金持有并挤占生产性贷款。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于Call Report数据的银行层面挤兑暴露代理指标构建方法，为监管机构评估银行挤兑脆弱性提供了实证工具；揭示了行为因素对银行流动性管理的政策含义。

title: ESG Investing and Stock Market Returns: Evidence from South African Mining Equities
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: ESG Investing and Stock Market Returns: Evidence from South African Mining Equities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive data. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently as part of the MSc Financial Engineering program at WorldQuant University.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance and stock market returns within the South African mining sector. Utilizing panel data regression techniques on major Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE)listed mining equities, we examine whether integrating ESG criteria penalizes or enhances portfolio performance in an emerging market context characterized by unique regulatory pressures, labor dynamics, and environmental challenges. The empirical findings indicate a nuanced relationship: while aggregate ESG scores show a neutral-to-positive association with risk-adjusted returns, the Governance (G) and Environmental (E) pillars demonstrate statistically significant positive impacts during periods of high commodity volatility. These insights contribute to the ongoing discourse surrounding sustainable investing in developing economies and offer strategic considerations for institutional investors and corporate managers. Furthermore, this paper provides reproducible Python implementations and visual evidence to bridge the gap between ESG theory and practical asset allocation. By decomposing ESG into its constituent pillars and testing performance across different market regimes, we show that ESG is not a monolithic factor. For capital-intensive sectors like mining, governance quality and environmental risk management appear to be the primary channels through which ESG creates shareholder value in South Africa, particularly when regulatory scrutiny and commodity price shocks intensify.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨南非矿业板块中ESG表现与股票市场回报之间的关系，发现总体ESG评分与风险调整后收益呈中性至正面关联，而在高商品波动期间，治理（G）和环境（E）支柱对收益具有显著正向影响。
AI.research_question: 在南非矿业这一新兴市场情境下，整合ESG标准是惩罚还是提升了投资组合的业绩表现？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场（尤其是南非矿业）面临独特的监管压力、劳工动态和环境挑战，现有文献对ESG与股票回报关系在此情境下的结论尚不明确，需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: ESG投资理论、可持续投资与资产定价理论、ESG支柱分解理论
AI.method: 基于约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）上市矿业股票的的面板数据回归分析，将ESG分解为E、S、G三大支柱，并测试不同市场制度（如高商品波动时期）下的表现差异；提供可复现的Python实现和可视化证据。
AI.findings: 总体ESG评分与风险调整后收益呈中性至正面关联；在高商品波动期间，治理（G）和环境（E）支柱对收益有统计显著的正向影响；ESG并非单一人为因素，在资本密集型矿业中，治理质量和环境风险管理是创造股东价值的主要渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将ESG分解为各组成支柱并测试不同市场制度下的表现，揭示ESG并非单一因素，丰富了新兴市场情境下可持续投资与资产定价的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者和企业管理者提供战略性考量，特别是在监管审查和商品价格冲击加剧时的投资决策参考；提供可复现的Python代码和可视化证据，弥合ESG理论与实践之间的鸿沟。

title: The Positive Title Premium: How Sentiment Framing Drives Citation Impact in Central Banking and Financial Stability Research
affiliations: Central Bank of Armenia

detail.title: The Positive Title Premium: How Sentiment Framing Drives Citation Impact in Central Banking and Financial Stability Research
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the affective framing of academic titles predicts scholarly citation impact in three closely related fields of monetary economics: central banking (CB), monetary policy (MP), and financial stability (FS). Using a hand - curated bibliometric corpus of 1,093 publications spanning 1903-2024, we construct a domain-specific sentiment lexicon calibrated to the vocabulary of financial and monetary discourse and classify each title as conveying positive, negative, or neutral affect. Unconditionally, titles with negative sentiment (e.g., invoking crisis, instability, risk) receive higher mean citation counts than positive titles, a pattern seemingly consistent with a "negativity premium" documented in media and social-science research. However, this raw association is confounded by publication vintage, sub-field, and document format. After conditioning on these factors in an ordinary least squares (OLS) framework and in a Negative Binomial citation-rate model, we find a robust and statistically significant positive-sentiment citation premium: titles conveying resilience, stability, or improvement are associated with 43-50% higher citation counts than sentiment-neutral titles, while the negative-sentiment premium is smaller and less robust across specifications. We further exploit the 2008 Financial Crisis as a natural temporal break in a difference-indifferences design to test whether the sentiment-citation relationship shifted after the crisis; we find no statistically significant differential shift, suggesting the positive-sentiment premium is a comparatively stable feature of scholarly attention in this literature rather than a crisis-contingent phenomenon. We discuss implications for research communication, journal editorial practice, and the broader bibliometrics - of science literature, and we detail the econometric and measurement limitations inherent in dictionary - based sentiment scoring of short academic titles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了货币经济学三个紧密相关领域（中央银行、货币政策、金融稳定）中学术标题的情感框架是否预测引用影响。基于1903-2024年间1,093篇文献的手工策展文献计量语料库，构建领域特定的情感词典。条件分析后发现，与情感中性标题相比，传达韧性、稳定或改善的积极情感标题与43-50%更高的引用次数相关，而消极情感溢价较小且不够稳健。利用2008年金融危机作为自然时间断点的双重差分设计发现无显著差异变化，表明积极情感溢价是该文献领域相对稳定的特征。
AI.research_question: 学术标题的情感框架（积极、消极、中性）是否以及如何预测货币经济学三个紧密相关领域（中央银行、货币政策、金融稳定）的学术引用影响？
AI.motivation: 媒体和社会科学研究中已记录"消极性溢价"现象，但学术标题情感与引用影响的关联尚未得到充分研究，且原始关联可能被出版年代、子领域和文献格式等因素混淆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情感框架理论、消极性溢价假说、文献计量学中的引用影响理论
AI.method: 基于1,093篇文献的手工策展文献计量语料库（1903-2024），构建领域特定情感词典对标题进行情感分类；采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）回归和负二项引用率模型进行条件分析；利用2008年金融危机作为自然时间断点，采用双重差分（DiD）设计检验情感-引用关系的时变性。
AI.findings: （1）无条件分析中消极情感标题获得更高平均引用数，看似支持"消极性溢价"；（2）控制出版年代、子领域和文献格式后，发现稳健且显著的积极情感引用溢价：积极情感标题比中性标题高出43-50%的引用数；（3）消极情感溢价较小且在各规格间不够稳健；（4）2008年金融危机后情感-引用关系无显著差异变化，表明积极情感溢价是相对稳定的特征。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）推翻了文献计量语境下简单的"消极性溢价"假说，揭示了在学术引用领域中存在"积极情感溢价"；（2）证明了情感-引用关系的条件性本质，强调了控制混淆变量的重要性；（3）通过准实验设计验证了情感-引用关系的稳定性，排除了危机偶然性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为研究者撰写标题提供实践指导，建议采用传达积极情感（如韧性、稳定）的标题以提升学术影响力；（2）为期刊编辑实践提供参考；（3）详细说明了基于词典的短标题情感评分的计量与测量局限性，为后续研究提供方法论参考。

title: Sentiment and Consumption in the Digital Age: Evidence from Transaction-Level Data
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen (CUHK-Shenzhen), Ant Group CO Ltd, Fudan University - School of Economics and

detail.title: Sentiment and Consumption in the Digital Age: Evidence from Transaction-Level Data
detail.abstract: Can short-lived consumer sentiment affect individual consumption? Using transaction data from a leading Chinese e-commerce platform, we find that while there is limited evidence that positive sentiment significantly impacts overall individual consumption expenditure at high frequency, it does induce a noticeable reallocation of spending from offline to online channels, followed by a rapid reversal. These patterns are more pronounced for less durable goods, affluent consumers, and more developed regions. To rationalize these facts, we develop a two-period consumption-saving model that incorporates both online and offline channels, where non-fundamental sentiment influences perceived matching values, while prices and other fundamentals remain unchanged. The model suggests reallocation rather than expansion: sentiment initially shifts expenditure toward online purchases, while diagnostic expectations drive a subsequent reversal and account for the heterogeneous responses across products, consumers, and regions. Overall, our findings suggest that sentiment shocks primarily drive consumption reallocation across shopping channels, rather than aggregate effects emphasized in existing literature. Furthermore, the rise of online platforms, by offering distinct alternatives to offline shopping, facilitates this reallocation and amplifies sentiment-driven consumption responses.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用中国领先电商平台的交易数据，发现短期消费者情绪虽然对总体消费支出影响有限，但会显著促使消费从线下渠道重新配置到线上渠道，随后快速反转。作者构建了一个包含线上线下渠道的两期消费储蓄模型，其中情绪影响感知匹配价值，模型解释了消费的重新配置而非扩张效应。
AI.research_question: 短期消费者情绪是否以及如何影响个体消费？具体而言，情绪冲击是推动总体消费扩张，还是主要导致消费在不同购物渠道（线上vs线下）之间的重新配置？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常强调情绪冲击对总体消费的宏观影响，但缺乏对高频个体消费行为微观机制的深入考察。随着电商平台的崛起，线上渠道为消费者提供了线下消费的替代选择，这为理解情绪如何影响消费的渠道重新配置提供了独特的研究场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期消费储蓄模型，包含线上和线下两个消费渠道；非基本面情绪影响感知匹配价值；诊断性预期（diagnostic expectations）驱动后续反转。
AI.method: 利用中国大型电商平台的交易数据进行实证分析，并结合理论模型（两期消费储蓄模型）进行机制解释。
AI.findings: （1）正面情绪对高频总体消费支出影响有限，但显著促使消费从线下向线上渠道重新配置，并出现快速反转；（2）重新配置效应在非耐用品、富裕消费者和更发达地区中更为明显；（3）情绪冲击主要驱动跨渠道消费重新配置，而非文献中强调的总体扩张效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将情绪冲击的消费效应从"总体扩张"范式拓展为"渠道重新配置"范式；将诊断性预期机制引入消费渠道选择模型；揭示了线上平台作为替代渠道在放大情绪驱动消费响应中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商平台和零售企业理解消费者情绪波动对渠道销售的影响提供依据；为政策制定者评估情绪冲击对消费结构（而非总量）的影响提供参考；对理解数字经济时代消费行为模式具有实践启示。

title: Hidden History: Volume II

detail.title: Hidden History: Volume II
detail.abstract:
This work presents a historical forensic analysis and systemic framework investigating the hidden administrative operating systems of global human governance. Volume II documents the concrete case studies of global population management, tracing how centralized infrastructure was adapted across succeeding empires. 

The focus of this independent investigation is entirely on structural architecture: the creation of institutions, the incentives behind regulatory decisions, the frameworks that preserve centralized control, and the historical consequences produced by those tracking structures. By examining the continuous transmission chain running from ancient Near Eastern legal and financial bookkeeping systems straight into modern central banking, state registries, and institutional networks, this monograph outlines the operational mechanics of state legibility and corporate population management.

AI.tldr: 本文通过历史取证分析，研究全球人类治理中隐藏的行政操作系统，追踪从古代近东法律与金融簿记系统到现代中央银行、国家登记册和制度网络的人口管理传导链，揭示国家"可读性"与机构化人口管理的运作机制。
AI.research_question: 全球人口治理中隐藏的行政操作系统是如何构建、传承并演变的？中央化基础设施如何在历代帝国中被适应和沿用？
AI.motivation: 揭示全球治理结构中未被充分认识的人口管理行政操作系统，独立调查其制度架构和历史后果，填补对中央控制框架与人口追踪结构的历史认知空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史取证分析框架；国家可读性理论（state legibility）；制度传承理论；中央集权控制理论；系统性人口管理框架。
AI.method: 历史取证分析（historical forensic analysis），结合系统性框架研究；通过案例研究（第二卷）追踪跨帝国的中央基础设施适应与传承。
AI.findings: 揭示了从古代近东簿记系统到现代中央银行、国家登记册和机构网络的连续传导链，展示了人口管理行政操作系统如何通过制度架构保持中央化控制，并产生相应的历史后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出全球人口治理的"行政操作系统"概念框架，将国家可读性理论与历史制度传承分析相结合，为理解现代人口管理结构提供历史深层根源性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为独立调查者、政策研究者和社会监督者提供理解全球人口管理架构的结构性分析工具，揭示制度遗产对当代治理模式的影响。

title: Energy Transition as Development Strategy: Renewable Adoption, Grid Modernization, and Energy‑cost Convergence as Drivers of Industrial Competitiveness

detail.title: Energy Transition as Development Strategy: Renewable Adoption, Grid Modernization, and Energy‑cost Convergence as Drivers of Industrial Competitiveness
detail.abstract:
The report argues that the global energy transition has evolved from an environmental agenda into a core driver of industrial competitiveness. Falling renewable energy costs, accelerating grid modernization, and narrowing industrial electricity price gaps are reshaping where manufacturing occurs and which economies attract investment. As the report states, “the levelized cost of electricity from solar PV has fallen 94% since 2010” and “industrial electricity prices are converging across major economies” .

Cheap renewable generation alone is insufficient; transmission, distribution, and digital grid upgrades are now the binding constraint on competitiveness. Countries that modernize grids, electrify industrial processes, and reduce financing costs for renewable deployment will capture disproportionate shares of future manufacturing FDI. Empirical analysis shows positive correlations between renewable penetration, lower industrial energy intensity, and higher manufacturing investment inflows. Case studies of Germany, China, Texas, and Denmark illustrate distinct strategic pathways—policy-led, scale-driven, market-driven, and system-integrated transitions.

Scenario modelling through 2050 suggests that under rapid convergence, industrial electricity prices across major economies could cluster within a narrow band of $0.05–0.08/kWh, effectively leveling the global playing field for energy‑intensive industry. The report concludes that energy transition is a historic development opportunity: economies that invest early and coherently in renewable capacity, grid flexibility, and industrial electrification will strengthen long‑term competitiveness, while those that delay risk structural decline.

AI.tldr: 该报告论证全球能源转型已从环境议题演变为产业竞争力的核心驱动力。仅靠廉价可再生能源不足，输配电及数字电网升级才是竞争力的约束条件。2050年情景建模显示，在快速趋同下主要经济体的工业电价将聚集在0.05-0.08美元/kWh的窄区间内，能源密集产业的全球竞争格局将被拉平。早期且协调投资于可再生能源、电网灵活性和工业电气化的经济体将获得长期竞争优势，而延迟者面临结构性衰退。
AI.research_question: 全球能源转型如何从环境议程演变为产业竞争力的核心驱动力？哪些因素决定各国在能源转型中能否吸引制造业投资并保持长期竞争力？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源成本大幅下降（太阳能光伏LCOE自2010年下降94%），工业电价在全球主要经济体间趋同，能源转型正在重塑制造业区位选择和投资流向。理解这一转变对各国产业竞争力的影响具有重要的战略意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业竞争力理论、能源转型经济学、可再生能源成本趋同理论、制造业投资区位选择理论
AI.method: 实证分析（可再生能源渗透率、工业能源强度与制造业投资流入的相关性分析）、多国案例研究（德国、中国、德克萨斯、丹麦）、到2050年的情景建模
AI.findings: 1) 可再生能源渗透率与制造业投资流入呈正相关；2) 廉价可再生能源本身不足，电网现代化和数字化是决定竞争力的关键约束；3) 2050年快速趋同情景下工业电价将聚集在0.05-0.08美元/kWh的窄区间，全球能源密集型产业竞争格局趋于拉平；4) 各国呈现政策主导（德国）、规模驱动（中国）、市场驱动（德克萨斯）、系统集成（丹麦）四条差异化转型路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能源转型从环境治理框架重新概念化为产业竞争力理论的核心变量，提出电网现代化和工业电气化是超越可再生能源成本本身的关键竞争力约束变量，丰富了能源转型与产业区位选择的关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政府提供能源转型的战略决策参考：早期协调投资可再生能源、电网灵活性和工业电气化可获得制造业FDI的先发优势；识别了四条可借鉴的差异化转型路径（政策、规模、市场、系统集成）；为评估能源转型对产业竞争力的影响提供了量化情景分析工具。

title: Dosage Theory and the Statistical Identification of Chefs-de-Race in Thoroughbred Pedigree Analysis
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Dosage Theory and the Statistical Identification of Chefs-de-Race in Thoroughbred Pedigree Analysis
detail.abstract: We develop a formal statistical framework for Thoroughbred dosage analysis, formalizing the systems of Vuillier (c. 1910), Varola (1974), and Roman (1981) as a coherent set of weighted-moment statistics. The Dosage Profile is a generation-weighted tally of aptitudinal contributions from chefsde-race. The Dosage Index and Center of Distribution are derived as a speed-to-stamina ratio and a weighted mean on a five-point aptitudinal lattice, respectively. We introduce a benchmark regression for identifying new chefs-de-race: a candidate sire qualifies when his generation-weighted pedigree presence explains incremental variation in offspring optimal distance beyond what the current list captures. Applied to English Channel (Smart Strike-Belva, by Theatrical), the regression recovers a highly significant coefficient of approximately +2.4 furlongs (p < 0.001), supporting a Classic/Solid designation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个正式的统计框架来系统化纯血马"Dosage分析"方法，将Vuillier、Varola和Roman三种传统体系统一为加权矩统计量，并提出一种基准回归方法用于识别新的"chef-de-race"（种马），通过实证验证了English Channel马匹的Classic/Solid分类。
AI.research_question: 如何将传统的纯血马Dosage分析（Vuillier、Varola和Roman体系）形式化为统一的统计框架，并提出客观的统计方法来识别新的chefs-de-race（关键种马）？
AI.motivation: 传统的Dosage分析体系虽然已被广泛用于纯血马育种与赛马距离预测，但缺乏严谨的统计形式化，且识别新chef-de-race的过程依赖主观判断。需要建立正式的统计框架以提高方法的科学性和客观性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加权矩统计理论（Dosage Profile作为逐代加权的能力贡献统计量）；Dosage Index作为速度-耐力比；Center of Distribution作为五点评分格上的加权均值
AI.method: 将三种传统Dosage体系形式化为加权矩统计；提出基准回归方法：候选种马的逐代加权谱系存在性对后代最优距离的增量解释力作为识别chefs-de-race的统计标准；以English Channel为例进行实证回归检验。
AI.findings: 对English Channel的回归分析发现高度显著的系数（约+2.4弗隆，p<0.001），支持其被归类为Classic/Solid级别的chef-de-race。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将三个传统Dosage分析体系统一为连贯的加权矩统计框架，为纯血马育种分析提供了严谨的数学基础，并建立了可检验的新厨师种马识别统计方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为赛马育种者提供了一种客观、可重复的统计工具来识别关键种马并预测后代的最优赛程距离，有助于改善育种决策和赛马距离安排。

title: Institutional Channels of Diffusion: Governments, Multilateral Banks, Private Platforms, and Diaspora Networks as Conduits for Innovation Spread

detail.title: Institutional Channels of Diffusion: Governments, Multilateral Banks, Private Platforms, and Diaspora Networks as Conduits for Innovation Spread
detail.abstract:
Innovation does not diffuse through a single, amorphous “market,” but through four identifiable institutional channels—governments, multilateral development banks, private platforms, and diaspora networks—that collectively determine the speed, scale, and fidelity of global technology spread. The report argues that these channels are the diffusion system: each possesses distinct transmission mechanisms, interacts differently with national absorptive capacity, and exhibits powerful complementarities when operating together.

Governments act as the most potent diffusion engine, using procurement to create early demand, national research institutes to absorb and adapt frontier technologies, regulatory harmonization to scale standards across markets, and public venture capital to bridge seed‑stage gaps. As the report notes, “virtually every general-purpose technology of the modern era…traces its origins to government-funded research and procurement.”

Multilateral institutions serve as the global scaling infrastructure, converting successful pilots into international policy norms through lending conditionality, knowledge products, technical assistance, and treaty-based norm-setting. Their role in spreading conditional cash transfers from Mexico to 60+ countries exemplifies their unique capacity for cross-border institutional diffusion.

Private platforms compress diffusion timelines from decades to days by eliminating fixed costs, standardizing digital environments, and enabling complementary innovation at planetary scale. AWS, Android, and GitHub illustrate how platform architectures function as high-throughput diffusion systems rather than mere commercial products.

Diaspora networks operate as high-bandwidth, low-loss channels that transmit tacit knowledge, entrepreneurial norms, and investment practices across borders—often compensating for weak domestic absorptive capacity. As the report highlights, immigrant founders accounted for “44% of Silicon Valley startups by 2012 and 51% of US billion‑dollar unicorns.”

The report concludes that innovation policy is systematically skewed toward creation rather than diffusion. Strengthening diffusion infrastructure—procurement systems, standards bodies, multilateral scaling mechanisms, and diaspora engagement strategies—represents one of the highest-return opportunities for governments and development institutions seeking broad-based productivity gains.

AI.tldr: 该报告论证创新并非通过单一的"市场"扩散，而是通过四个制度性渠道（政府、多边开发银行、私人平台、侨民网络）组成的扩散系统传播。各渠道具有独特的传导机制，且相互之间存在强大的互补性。当前创新政策系统性偏向"创造"而非"扩散"，强化扩散基础设施是政府和开发机构获得广泛生产力提升的高回报机会。
AI.research_question: 全球技术扩散通过哪些制度性渠道进行？这些渠道如何决定技术传播的速度、规模与保真度？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将创新扩散视为通过单一、无差别的"市场"完成，忽略了实际的制度性传导机制。理解真实扩散渠道对于政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度渠道理论（四个渠道：政府、多边机构、私人平台、侨民网络）；技术扩散理论；国家吸收能力理论
AI.method: 基于案例研究的政策分析报告，运用多个实证案例（如现金转移支付从墨西哥扩散至60多个国家、硅谷移民创始人数据、AWS/Android/GitHub平台案例）来支撑论证。
AI.findings: 1) 政府是最强大的扩散引擎（通过采购、国立研究机构、监管协调、公共风险资本）；2) 多边机构是全球扩展基础设施（通过贷款条件、知识产品、技术援助、条约规范）；3) 私人平台将扩散时间从数十年压缩至数天；4) 侨民网络是高带宽低损耗的隐性知识传导渠道；5) 各渠道联合运作时具有强大互补性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创新扩散从抽象"市场"概念重构为具体的制度渠道系统，提出四个可识别的制度化扩散途径，并指出各渠道与吸收能力的不同交互方式及互补性，丰富和深化了创新扩散理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和开发机构提供政策导向：应加强采购体系、标准机构、多边扩展机制和侨民参与战略等扩散基础设施的建设，而非仅关注创新创造端。

title: Default Priors in Econometrics
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Default Priors in Econometrics
detail.abstract: Econometricians estimate high-dimensional parameters and report low-dimensional nonlinear functionals of them: an elasticity, a long-run multiplier, an impulse response, an indirect effect, a variance share. A prior that is flat in the natural parameterisation is generally not flat in the reported quantity, and where identification is weak the discrepancy does not vanish with the sample size. This paper catalogues default priors for econometrics under one criterion, taken from Bhadra, Datta, Polson and Willard (2016): regular variation. Regular variation is closed under the sums, maxima, products, ratios and rational functions from which econometric quantities are built, and is therefore the property that makes flatness survive the map from parameter to estimand. We develop a tail calculus for induced priors and prove five results. The prior induced on a ratio of coefficients is Cauchy tailed with constant p 2 (0)E|θ 1 |, so diffusing the first-stage prior makes the implied prior on the elasticity tighter and manufactures identification. On a product, a coordinate spike at the origin compounds: the induced density grows like log 3 where a bounded prior gives log. A half-Cauchy prior on a global scale induces exactly the arcsine, or Beta(1/2, 1/2), prior on the population R 2 , which recovers the horseshoe law as a statement about model fit and identifies R2-D2 as its reparameterisation. Any prior with positive density at the unit root implies an infinite prior mean half-life and multiplier. And the induced prior on a maximum keeps the coordinate tail index, which a purely global scale destroys. We then catalogue some thirty priors in current use, classify each by behaviour at the origin and in the tail, and trace the consequences through regression, instrumental variables, large VARs, factor models, time-varying parameter and stochastic volatility models, discrete choice and causal machine learning. Two numerical illustrations and a set of practical recommendations close the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文研究计量经济学中高维参数估计后所报告的低维非线性函数（如弹性、长期乘数、脉冲响应等）的先验分布问题。作者基于正则变化（regular variation）这一标准，系统性地目录化计量经济学中的默认先验，证明正则变化在参数到估计量的映射下能保持"扁平性"（flatness），并发展了一套尾部演算来推导诱导先验的性质。文章证明了一系列关键结果（如系数比诱导柯西尾部、半柯西先验诱导反正弦先验等），并分类了约三十种常用先验。
AI.research_question: 在弱识别条件下，计量经济学中自然参数化下的扁平先验在映射到所报告的非线性函数（弹性、乘数、脉冲响应等）后是否仍然扁平？如何系统地分析和比较不同默认先验在该映射下的行为？
AI.motivation: 计量经济学家通常估计高维参数并报告低维非线性函数（如弹性、长期乘数、脉冲响应等），但这些函数映射会扭曲先验的扁平性。在弱识别情况下，这种扭曲不会随样本量增加而消失，可能人为制造或破坏识别。目前缺乏一个统一标准来目录化和评估这些默认先验的性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 正则变化理论（regular variation）：该性质在参数到估计量的常见映射（和、最大值、乘积、比率、有理函数）下封闭，因此能保证扁平性在映射中得以保持。同时运用尾部渐近分析、贝叶斯先验理论以及具体分布（柯西、半柯西、反正弦/Beta(1/2,1/2)、马蹄形先验等）的性质。
AI.method: 数学证明与渐近分析：发展尾部演算（tail calculus）来推导诱导先验的性质；证明五个核心定理；对约三十种常用先验进行分类（按原点行为与尾部行为）；通过两个数值示例说明理论结果；在回归、工具变量、大规模VAR、因子模型、时变参数/随机波动率模型、离散选择与因果机器学习等场景中追踪先验选择的后果。
AI.findings: （1）系数比上诱导的先验呈柯西尾部，且扩散第一阶段先验会使弹性先验更紧并制造识别；（2）在乘积上，原点处的尖峰会复合放大——有界先验给出log增长，而坐标尖峰给出log^3增长；（3）全局尺度的半柯西先验恰好诱导出总体R²上的反正弦（Beta(1/2,1/2)）先验，将马蹄形定律恢复为关于模型拟合的陈述，并识别R2-D2为参数化重述；（4）任何在单位根处具有正密度的先验都会隐含无穷大的先验均值半衰期和乘数；（5）最大值上的诱导先验保持坐标尾部指数，而纯全局尺度会破坏这一性质。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了正则变化作为计量经济学默认先验目录化的统一标准；发展了一套诱导先验的"尾部演算"；提供了五个新的理论结果（系数比、乘积、R²、单位根、最大值上的先验行为）；将马蹄形先验与模型拟合（R²上的反正弦先验）联系起来，为贝叶斯收缩方法提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为计量经济学实践者提供了一套约三十种常用先验的系统分类（按原点与尾部行为）；给出了两个数值示例说明先验选择的实际影响；提出了一套实用的先验选择建议，帮助研究者在回归、IV、VAR、因子模型、时变参数、离散选择和因果机器学习等场景中做出更好的先验决策。

title: Mimicking ETF Indexes: Costly Variable Selection and the Geometry of Sparse Index Tracking
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Mimicking ETF Indexes: Costly Variable Selection and the Geometry of Sparse Index Tracking
detail.abstract: An exchange-traded fund that samples rather than fully replicates its benchmark must decide which securities to hold. We show that this is Lindley's [1968] variable selection problem with a cost per variable, whose solution is weighted ℓ 0-regularized least squares. Three tuning constants-George and McCulloch's [1997] threshold of practical significance, the prior inclusion probability of a spike-and-slab prior, and the ℓ 0 penalty-are coordinates of one economic primitive, the per-name cost of carrying a position. The dictionary inverts, so an observed basket reveals the cost that rationalizes it. Under a K-factor return model the tracking objective depends on the basket only through a sufficient statistic of dimension K(K+1)/2+K+1: in our calibration, 55 numbers describing 10 27 baskets, at least 10 22.7 of which lie within one percent of the optimum. Selection is therefore both easy and unstable. Reproducing George and McCulloch's S&P 500 analysis, greedy ℓ 0 search attains the global optimum in 90% of problems solved exactly by enumeration and beats index-weight sampling by 1.03 percentage points of tracking error at ten holdings; but a re-optimized basket replaces thirteen names a year and pays 66 basis points to do so. Pricing turnover and imposing factor structure cuts the fund's total objective from 89 to 32 basis points, the largest effect we document. Selection instability, not selection quality, is the binding constraint on optimization-based index sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文表明，ETF指数抽样（部分复制基准而非完全复制）在数学上等价于Lindley（1968）的可变选择问题（加权ℓ0正则化最小二乘），其中的三个调优常数（实际显著性阈值、spike-and-slab先验包含概率、ℓ0惩罚项）都是同一个经济基本参数——持有头寸的单只证券成本——的不同坐标。通过字典反转，观察到的篮子可以揭示使其合理化的成本。在K因子收益模型下，跟踪目标仅依赖于一个维度为K(K+1)/2+K+1的充分统计量，使得选择既容易又不稳定。实证发现，贪婪ℓ0搜索在90%的问题中达到全局最优，但篮子重优化导致每年更换13只股票并支付66个基点的成本，将换手和因子结构纳入后基金总目标从89降至32个基点。选择不稳定性而非选择质量，是优化型指数抽样的关键约束。
AI.research_question: ETF在抽样而非完全复制基准时，应如何选择持有的证券？选择不稳定性是否比选择质量更关键地制约优化型指数抽样？
AI.motivation: ETF抽样复制基准时需要决定持有哪些证券，这是一个重要的实务与理论问题。作者希望将这一问题统一到已有的统计选择框架下，并揭示其背后的经济本质（持有证券的成本），同时探究优化型指数抽样的关键约束究竟是选择质量还是选择稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lindley（1968）可变选择问题；加权ℓ0正则化最小二乘；George和McCulloch（1997）的实际显著性阈值；spike-and-slab先验；K因子收益模型
AI.method: 理论推导将指数抽样问题映射为ℓ0正则化最小二乘问题，并通过字典反转从观测篮子中恢复隐含成本；数值校准使用K因子模型；实证部分复制George和McCulloch的S&P 500分析，采用贪婪ℓ0搜索与精确枚举对比，并评估换手成本与因子结构约束的效果。
AI.findings: （1）指数抽样问题与Lindley可变选择问题同构，三个调优常数均源于同一经济参数；（2）K因子模型下目标函数仅依赖55个充分统计量（校准中描述约10^27个篮子），至少10^22.7个篮子位于最优值的1%以内，选择容易但不稳定；（3）贪婪ℓ0搜索在90%的问题中达到全局最优，比指数权重抽样改善1.03个百分点跟踪误差（10只持仓时）；（4）但重优化篮子每年更换13只股票，付出66个基点成本；（5）对换手定价并施加因子结构可将总目标从89降至32个基点，这是最大的效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ETF指数抽样问题与统计学中的可变选择理论（Lindley 1968）统一起来，揭示了该问题中多个看似不同的调优参数背后的共同经济基础（单只证券持有成本），并通过充分统计量刻画了在因子结构下该问题的维数，深化了对选择优化问题中"容易但不稳定"这一内在张力的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ETF基金经理提供了指数抽样优化的实用指导：应重视选择的不稳定性（换手成本）而非仅关注选择质量；将换手定价和因子结构约束纳入优化可大幅降低基金总目标（从89降至32个基点），这对实际ETF构建和换手管理具有直接指导意义。

title: Stochastic Music: From Markov Chains to Transformers
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Stochastic Music: From Markov Chains to Transformers
detail.abstract: In November 1949 Bell Telephone Laboratories circulated Technical Memorandum MM-49-150-29, Composing Music by a Stochastic Process, by John R. Pierce and Mary E. (Betty) Shannon. The memorandum generates tonal music from a finite state Markov chain with a hand elicited transition table and hard rules imposed on top. It appears one year after Claude Shannon's Markov approximations to English and seven years before the Illiac Suite. We review what the historical record supports, develop the mathematics of the construction, and then argue that every structural element of the 1949 scheme survives in an autoregressive transformer: the chain becomes an adaptive order kernel smoother, the rule set becomes exponential tilting through temperature, truncation and preference optimisation, and the elicited table becomes an estimated conditional with parameter sharing. The change is one of function class and estimation, not of generative principle. We give a worked three chord example, a Bayesian treatment of the transition table, a free energy identity that calibrates the strength of a rule set, the Diaconis and Freedman theorem as the representation result behind in context learning, a reading of Bowie's Verbasizer as the zeroth order case in which the artist supplies the tilt by hand, a survey of machine learning in music, and an honest account of what the comparison does not deliver.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了1949年贝尔实验室John R. Pierce和Mary E. (Betty) Shannon撰写的技术备忘录《Composing Music by a Stochastic Process》，该备忘录使用有限状态马尔可夫链生成调性音乐。作者论证了这一1949年的方案中的每一个结构元素都保留在现代自回归Transformer中：马尔可夫链演变为自适应阶数核平滑器，规则集通过温度、截断和偏好优化的指数倾斜实现，手工生成的转移表变为带参数共享的条件估计。这本质上是函数类和估计方法的变化，而非生成原理的变化。
AI.research_question: 1949年贝尔实验室的随机音乐生成方案与现代自回归Transformer在生成原理上是否具有本质一致性？其各结构元素如何在现代架构中得以保留和演化？
AI.motivation: 音乐生成和生成式AI领域通常将现代深度学习方法视为一种根本性突破，但作者认为需要审视其历史根源。通过深入分析1949年一份几乎被遗忘的技术备忘录，作者意图揭示现代自回归Transformer的生成原理其实早在七十多年前就已确立，变革仅体现在函数类和估计方法层面。这不仅是对历史的还原，也是对"创新叙事"的一种纠偏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限状态马尔可夫链；自回归Transformer；指数倾斜（指数族倾斜）；贝叶斯推断；Diaconis-Freedman定理（作为上下文学习背后的表示结果）；自由能恒等式；核平滑
AI.method: 历史文献分析（审查历史记录所支持的事实）；数学推导（形式化1949年构造的数学原理）；结构类比（将1949年方案与现代Transformer逐元素对比）；工作示例（三和弦示例）；贝叶斯处理（转移表的贝叶斯分析）；问卷调查（机器学习在音乐中的应用综述）
AI.findings: 1949年方案的全部结构要素均在现代自回归Transformer中存续：马尔可夫链对应自适应阶数核平滑器；硬规则集对应通过温度、截断和偏好优化实现的指数倾斜；手工elicited转移表对应带参数共享的条件概率估计。生成原理本身没有改变，变化的只是函数类（从有限状态表到深度网络）和估计方法（从手工设定到数据驱动学习）。文中还提供了三和弦示例、转移表的贝叶斯处理、校准规则集强度的自由能恒等式，以及将Diaconis-Freedman定理作为上下文学习表示基础的理论论证。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了1949年随机音乐生成方案与现代自回归Transformer之间的形式化对应关系；提出了将规则集强度用自由能恒等式校准的理论框架；将Diaconis-Freedman定理引入为上下文学习的表示理论；论证了生成原理的历史连续性，挑战了"深度学习范式根本创新"的叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了三和弦的具体工作示例以阐明原理；对Bowie的Verbasizer进行了重新解读（作为零阶情况，艺术家手工提供倾斜）；对机器学习在音乐中的应用进行了全面综述；对1949年备忘录的历史记录进行了澄清和考证。

title: The Use of Debt Covenants to Curb Risk Shifting
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School and Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: The Use of Debt Covenants to Curb Risk Shifting
detail.abstract: Debt contracting invites excessive risk taking on the part of borrowers. We study how accounting-based debt covenants affect a borrower's project choice if there is uncertainty about the borrower's economic state. In general, covenants serve a dual role: cutting losses on loans expected to go bad and disciplining the borrower's risk-shifting incentive. By increasing the expected recovery, the liquidation option lowers the face value of debt, thereby reducing the borrower's incentive to take risks. We show that such covenants can curb risk shifting on projects seen through to completion, but never for borrowers in the bad state. Moreover, the value of covenants is non-monotonic in the financing needs (or leverage). Covenants become more effective the more informative the accounting system and the more uncertain the project quality (e.g., in R&D-intensive firms). We also allow the borrower to exert effort at the outset to increase the value of projects seen through to completion. Contrary to standard incomplete contracting ("hold-up") arguments, this can strengthen the case for covenants: the benefit of committing to safer projects can outweigh the risk of upfront effort being wasted due to inefficient liquidation. The model generates empirical predictions relating the incidence of covenants to accounting quality, the ex-ante uncertainty about borrower characteristics, financial leverage, and growth options.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在借款人经济状态不确定的情况下，基于会计的债务契约如何影响借款人的项目选择。契约具有双重作用：对预期变差的贷款止损，以及约束借款人的风险转移激励。通过提高预期回收率，清算期权降低了债务面值，从而减少借款人承担风险的激励。研究发现契约可以抑制风险转移，但对处于差状态的借款人无效；契约价值与融资需求（杠杆）呈非单调关系；会计信息越丰富、项目质量不确定性越高（如研发密集型公司），契约越有效。与标准不完全契约（"套牢"）论点相反，借款人前期努力可以强化契约的存在理由。
AI.research_question: 当借款人经济状态存在不确定性时，基于会计的债务契约如何影响借款人的项目选择（尤其是风险承担行为）？
AI.motivation: 债务契约天然诱发借款人过度风险承担（风险转移问题），但现有文献对基于会计的债务契约如何缓解这一问题，特别是在借款人经济状态不确定的背景下，缺乏系统的理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险转移理论、债务契约理论、不完全契约理论、信息经济学
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论/契约理论分析），考虑借款人选择风险项目与安全项目、会计系统信息含量、项目质量不确定性等维度。
AI.findings: (1) 债务契约（含清算期权）可以抑制风险转移，但对处于差经济状态的借款人无效；(2) 契约价值与融资需求（杠杆）呈非单调关系；(3) 会计信息越丰富、项目质量不确定性越高（如研发密集型公司），契约越有效；(4) 借款人前期努力可能增强而非削弱契约的价值，与标准不完全契约"套牢"论点相反；(5) 模型产生关于契约发生率与会计质量、借款人特征事前不确定性、财务杠杆和增长期权关系的实证预测。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次在借款人经济状态不确定条件下系统分析会计型债务契约的双重作用（止损与纪律约束）；(2) 识别出契约抑制风险转移的边界条件（对差状态借款人无效）；(3) 发现契约价值与杠杆的非单调关系，丰富了债务契约设计理论；(4) 挑战了不完全契约框架下"前期努力被套牢"的传统观点，指出承诺安全项目的收益可以超过努力浪费的风险。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为债务契约中会计型条款的设计提供了理论指导；(2) 为理解研发密集型企业的债务契约安排提供了新视角；(3) 产生可检验的实证预测，有助于实务中评估会计质量与契约设计的关系。

title: From Sentiment and Risk to Trade: A Country-level Study on Geopolitical Trade Effects

detail.title: From Sentiment and Risk to Trade: A Country-level Study on Geopolitical Trade Effects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper. No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Can geopolitical risk reshape international trade? I construct directed, monthly measures of bilateral geopolitical risk and its associated sentiment from approximately 5.1 million news articles in the GDELT Event Database, and estimate their effect on trade among eight Asia-Pacific economies at the HS2 product level over 2015-2025, using Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood gravity local projections with high-dimensional fixed effects. Pooled across countries, rising risk produces an immediate expansion of trade led by verbal threats and by news tone orthogonal to event content, rather than by material acts, indicating that how a conflict is reported can move trade before the conflict materializes. A home-country heterogeneity specification uncovers a sharp asymmetry: when bilateral risk rises, the United States expands imports (roughly +12 percent per standard deviation, cumulatively) while contracting exports (about-10 percent), and the two adjustments differ in timing: the import expansion arrives on impact and fades within three quarters, while the export contraction emerges only after a quarter and persists for more than a year. The import response is uniform across the product space rather than concentrated in storable goods, so it does not reflect selective inventory accumulation. Sustained bilateral hostility therefore widens the American deficit with the partner rather than closing it, while smaller connector economies instead contract on one or both sides of trade. The findings identify geopolitics as an upstream driver of the bilateral trade shares that the invoicing-currency and exchange-rate pass-through literature take as given.

AI.tldr: 本文利用GDELT事件数据库中约510万篇新闻文章，构建了2015-2025年间八个亚太经济体之间定向的月度双边地缘政治风险及其情绪指标，并通过泊松伪极大似然引力局部投影模型（含高维固定效应）在HS2产品层面估计其对贸易的影响。研究发现：风险上升会立即带来贸易扩张（主要由口头威胁和与事件内容正交的新闻情绪驱动，而非实质性行为）；美国存在显著不对称效应——双边风险上升时进口扩张约12%（影响当期显现并在三个季度内消退），而出口收缩约10%（滞后一个季度显现并持续一年以上）。持续的双边敌对关系扩大而非缩小美国对伙伴国的赤字，而较小的连接型经济体则在贸易单边或双边收缩。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险如何重塑国际贸易？具体而言，双边地缘政治风险及其情绪的变化如何影响不同国家（特别是美国与小型经济体）的进出口规模和时序动态？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中地缘政治风险对贸易影响的研究多采用总量或单一国家视角，缺乏对双边地缘政治风险的精细度量；同时，传统文献（如计价货币与汇率传递研究）往往将双边贸易份额视为给定，忽视了地缘政治作为上游驱动因素的作用。本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易引力模型；地缘政治风险与贸易关系的理论框架；汇率传递与计价货币理论（作为被超越的基准）；贸易风险与库存行为理论（作为被检验的替代解释）。
AI.method: 利用GDELT事件数据库约510万篇新闻构建定向月度双边地缘政治风险度量及其情绪指标；采用泊松伪极大似然（PPML）引力局部投影模型，包含高维固定效应；在HS2产品层面估计八个亚太经济体2015-2025年的贸易效应；通过国家异质性设定和产品空间分布检验探索机制。
AI.findings: （1）风险上升立即扩张贸易，主要由口头威胁和独立于事件内容的新闻情绪驱动，而非实质物质行为；（2）美国呈现显著不对称：进口扩张约+12%/标准差（即时显现，三季内消退），出口收缩约-10%（滞后一季出现且持续一年以上）；（3）美国进口扩张在产品空间均匀分布，而非集中于可储存商品，排除选择性库存积累解释；（4）持续双边敌对扩大而非缩小美国对伙伴国赤字；较小的连接型经济体则在单边或双边收缩。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）构建了更精细的基于新闻的双边地缘政治风险与情绪度量方法，区分了事件内容与报道基调的独立效应；（2）揭示"报道如何影响贸易先于冲突实体化"的机制，拓展了地缘政治风险传导贸易的理论视角；（3）识别出地缘政治是双边贸易份额的上游驱动因素，对计价货币与汇率传递文献提出了重要理论修正；（4）通过国家异质性发现大国与小经济体的对称/不对称反应差异，丰富了地缘政治经济学的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供了预警工具：新闻情绪和口头威胁可作为贸易变动的先行指标；（2）揭示了美国在双边冲突中贸易结构失衡的机制（进口即时扩张、出口持续收缩），为贸易政策与供应链管理提供参考；（3）帮助企业与投资者理解地缘政治风险对进出口的差异化时序影响，优化风险管理和库存决策；（4）为亚太区域经济体在双边紧张局势下的贸易策略调整提供实证依据。

title: Beyond Responsible AI: Institutional Resistance and the Politics of AI Governance in Developing Countries

detail.title: Beyond Responsible AI: Institutional Resistance and the Politics of AI Governance in Developing Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, personal, or professional relationships that could e perceived as having influenced the research or its findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because the study involved analysis of publicly available policy, strategy, and regulatory documenrs and did not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Responsible Artificial Intelligence (Responsible AI) has emerged as the dominant normative paradigm for governing artificial intelligence, underpinned by growing international consensus on principles such as fairness, transparency, accountability, human oversight, and respect for human rights. Despite this convergence, the implementation of Responsible AI remains uneven across institutional contexts. Existing scholarship increasingly acknowledges implementation challenges but primarily explains them through technical, regulatory, or organisational barriers, paying comparatively less attention to the institutional dynamics that mediate governance outcomes. This paper argues that the persistent gap between ethical commitments and institutional practice is better understood through the concept of institutional resistance. Drawing on Responsible AI scholarship, institutional theory, and public administration, the paper conceptualizes institutional resistance as the formal and informal processes through which institutions delay, dilute, reinterpret, selectively implement, or symbolically adopt Responsible AI commitments despite publicly endorsing their underlying ethical principles. Building on this concept, the paper proposes the Institutional Resistance Framework (InRF), comprising five interrelated dimensions: normative, administrative, political, capacity-based, and symbolic resistance. The framework repositions implementation as an institutional and political process rather than a predominantly technical or regulatory challenge. By integrating institutional theory into Responsible AI governance, the paper contributes a new conceptual lens for understanding implementation failures and offers a foundation for future empirical research on institution-centered AI governance, particularly in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"制度性抵抗"（Institutional Resistance）概念来解释负责任人工智能（Responsible AI）从伦理承诺到制度实践之间的持续落差，并构建了一个包含规范性、行政性、政治性、能力性与象征性五个维度的制度性抵抗框架（InRF），将负责任AI的实施重新定位为一个制度和政治过程，而非单纯的技术或监管挑战。
AI.research_question: 为什么负责任人工智能的伦理承诺与其制度实践之间存在持续鸿沟？如何理解制度动态在负责任AI治理结果中的中介作用？
AI.motivation: 尽管国际上在负责任AI原则（公平、透明、问责、人类监督、尊重人权）上已形成共识，但负责任AI的实施在不同制度情境中仍不均衡。现有文献主要从技术、监管或组织障碍角度解释实施挑战，而较少关注中介治理结果的制度动态。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负责任AI学术研究、制度理论（Institutional Theory）与公共行政理论（Public Administration）的交叉整合。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过文献综合与理论建构提出"制度性抵抗"概念及"制度性抵抗框架"（InRF）。
AI.findings: 提出制度性抵抗的正式与非正式过程概念，涵盖制度在公开认可伦理原则的同时通过延迟、稀释、重新解释、选择性实施或象征性采纳来规避负责任AI承诺；构建包含规范性、行政性、政治性、能力性与象征性五个维度的InRF框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度理论整合进负责任AI治理研究，为理解实施失败提供新的概念透镜，将实施重新定位为制度与政治过程而非技术或监管挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来以制度为中心的AI治理实证研究提供理论基础，尤其对发展中国家的负责任AI实施具有指导意义。

detail.abstract: Food-system resilience is measured today almost exclusively as an ordinal score: indices rank countries on composites of structural indicators, but the resulting numbers have no economic dimension. They tell a policymaker who is more resilient without telling them what resilience is worth. The United Nations' own science-policy panel has noted that resilience suffers from limited orthodoxy in definition and still less consistency in measurement (HLPE-FSN, 2025). This paper responds by converting resilience from a score into a price. The paper's principal theoretical result is the Loss-Shifting Proposition: policy instruments do not eliminate nutritional service loss but relocate it between price and availability, which is why a price-only resilience metric can rank a rationed economy as resilient. The paper also separates a capacity index (RBI-C) from an outcome index (RBI-O) to break a circularity that would otherwise invalidate empirical validation, and specifies a dose-response validation design in which resilience is tested against realised losses conditional on measured shock exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将粮食系统韧性从序数评分转化为经济价格，通过"损失转移命题"（Loss-Shifting Proposition）揭示政策工具并未消除营养服务损失，而只是在价格与可获得性之间转移，并区分能力指数（RBI-C）与结果指数（RBI-O）以打破循环论证，设计剂量-反应验证框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将粮食系统韧性从序数评分转化为具有经济维度的价格度量，从而回答"韧性值多少钱"的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有粮食系统韧性测量几乎完全依赖序数评分（指数排名），缺乏经济维度，无法告知政策制定者韧性的经济价值；同时联合国科学政策小组指出韧性在定义和测量上缺乏一致性的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 损失转移命题（Loss-Shifting Proposition）：政策工具不消除营养服务损失，而是在价格与可获得性之间转移损失。
AI.method: 提出韧性价格化理论框架；构建能力指数（RBI-C）与结果指数（RBI-O）以打破循环性；设计剂量-反应验证设计，在控制冲击暴露条件下将韧性与实际损失进行检验。
AI.findings: 损失转移命题表明，仅基于价格的韧性指标可能将配给经济误判为有韧性；区分能力指数与结果指数可避免经验验证中的循环论证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将韧性从序数评分转化为价格，提出损失转移命题这一核心理论贡献，并区分能力与结果韧性指数以解决测量循环性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具有经济可解释性的韧性度量工具，帮助其了解韧性的经济价值，并规避价格-仅指标在配给经济中的误导性排名。

detail.abstract:
Colleges affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University (RJU), a public university founded in 2017, are experiencing declining admission numbers in Bachelor-level programmes such as BSc.CSIT, BCA and BBA across the Kathmandu Valley. This paper investigates whether this decline reflects a problem specific to individual colleges or a wider structural condition in Nepal's higher-education sector, using published national statistics rather than any single institution's internal assumptions.

The research finds that Nepal's domestic higher-education applicant pool has been shrinking for years due to large-scale outbound student migration — over 543,000 No Objection Certificates (NOCs) for foreign study were issued between fiscal years 2018/19 and mid-2024/25, with 123,092 issued in 2025 alone — while the number of competing colleges has not shrunk to match, leaving an estimated 65 percent of Nepal's roughly 1,440 colleges "running with difficulty" per the University Grants Commission. Even Kathmandu University reported roughly 30 percent of seats vacant in 2023. University-graduate unemployment stood at 26.1 percent in 2024 (ILO) — except in information technology, where exports crossed USD 1 billion in 2025.

The paper profiles RJU and, as case studies, six of its Kathmandu Valley affiliated colleges, documenting at least 15 institutions offering BSc.CSIT under RJU affiliation in Kathmandu district alone. It concludes with a root-cause analysis separating what a single college can and cannot influence, and proposes an evidence-based response framework, usable by any RJU-affiliated college, for the 2083 B.S. admission cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文基于尼泊尔国家统计数据和Rajarshi Janak University（RJU）及其加德满都谷地六所附属学院的案例研究，调查RJU学士学位课程（BSc.CSIT、BCA、BBA）招生人数下降的根本原因，识别出该问题源于尼泊尔高等教育系统性的结构困境——包括大规模学生出国留学导致的申请池萎缩、学院数量过剩（约65%的学院经营困难）、高毕业生失业率等——而非个别学院的独立问题，并提出基于证据的应对框架。
AI.research_question: RJU附属学院学士学位课程招生人数下降，反映的是个别学院特有的问题，还是尼泊尔高等教育部门更广泛的结构性问题？
AI.motivation: RJU（2017年成立的公立大学）附属学院在加德满都谷地的BSc.CSIT、BCA和BBA等学士课程面临招生人数持续下降，有必要基于国家公开统计而非单一机构的内部假设，判断这一下降的性质与根本原因，并为应对提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用结构性分析框架和根因分析（root-cause analysis）方法，区分单个学院可影响与不可影响的因素，结合高等教育供求失衡理论进行分析。
AI.method: 使用已发布的尼泊尔国家统计数据（包括NOC出国留学数据、UGC学院运营状况数据、ILO就业数据、IT出口数据等），结合RJU及其六所加德满都谷地附属学院的案例研究，进行根因分析并构建基于证据的应对框架。
AI.findings: （1）尼泊尔国内高等教育申请池因大规模学生出国留学而持续萎缩——2018/19至2024/25财年发放超54.3万份NOC，仅2025年就签发123,092份；（2）竞争学院数量未同步缩减，大学拨款委员会估计约1,440所学院中65%"经营困难"；（3）连Kathmandu University在2023年也有约30%的席位空缺；（4）2024年大学毕业生失业率达26.1%（ILO），但IT领域例外，2025年出口额突破10亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过实证数据揭示尼泊尔高等教育招生危机系结构性失衡所致，区分了个别学院层面与系统层面的可干预因素，为理解发展中国家高等教育招生下降问题提供了案例证据和分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了基于证据的应对框架，可供RJU任何附属学院在2083 B.S.招生周期使用，能帮助学院区分自身可影响与不可影响的因素，制定更有效的招生态势应对策略。

title: Barbara Bergmann: Human Capital and Related Applications

detail.title: Barbara Bergmann: Human Capital and Related Applications
detail.abstract: This paper presents a perspective on human capital based on Barbara Brtgmann's work and compares it to the approach developed by Gary Becker and others. The paper shows thar one can begin with a simple model to gain some insight. From that start added elements, many in related studies well-known in the literature, can be used to complete a more comprehensive picture. A range of other themes is possible. The discussion then turns to several domains in which the Bergmann approach can be applied. Notably, international competition; models of competition among various occupational groups arising from new technologies such as in IT and AI; pressure on global resources in the modern world economy. Also mentioned but not developed are colonial relationships such as with a home country and their colonies Time diary studies show a substantial convergence of time allocation of men and women as of the late 1970's; for women, a notable exodus from housekeeping as a primary activity to a wide range of market occupations. As discussed elsewhere and consistent with Bergmann, migration across these ostensibly nominal occupational categories leads to occupational economic mobility upward and downward, as measured by the average annual wage, can be part of the study of economic growth. Upward mobility from reduced crowding can result in positive economic growth and did, as in the US, 1975-2012. The discussion presents a synthesis of the Becker and Bergmann views in what is called occupationspecific human capital (OSHC) as it applies to the middle life course 'time squeeze' and related well-being impacts. Reducing the impact of the time squeeze by parental leave or other family-based systems is discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Barbara Bergmann的人力资本视角，与Gary Becker等人的传统人力资本理论进行比较，提出"职业特定人力资本"（OSHC）的综合框架。文章从简单模型出发，逐步加入已有文献中的要素，构建更全面的图景，并将该视角应用于国际竞争、新技术（IT/AI）引发的职业群体竞争、全球资源压力等多个领域。论文还通过时间日记研究显示1970年代末以来男女性时间分配的趋同，以及女性从家务向市场职业的迁移，并讨论职业间流动对经济增长的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何基于Bergmann的人力资本视角，整合Becker传统理论，提出"职业特定人力资本"（OSHC）框架，并应用于理解职业间流动、时间挤压及其对经济增长和福祉的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统Becker式人力资本理论侧重于个体投资回报，但Bergmann的视角更强调职业结构、群组竞争和流动性的作用。作者希望提出一个综合框架，弥合两者差异，以更好地解释劳动力市场的动态变化（如女性职业迁移、职业间流动带来的经济增长），并应用于当代重大议题（如AI冲击职业竞争、国际竞争、全球资源压力）。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bergmann的人力资本视角（强调职业特定性、拥挤效应、职业流动）；Becker的传统人力资本理论（强调个体投资与回报）；职业特定人力资本（OSHC）综合框架；时间分配理论（时间日记研究）
AI.method: 本文属于理论/视角性论文，采用概念综合与文献整合的方法论。作者从简单模型出发逐步扩展，结合时间日记研究的实证证据（如1970年代末男女时间分配趋同），以及美国1975-2012年的历史数据来支持职业流动与经济增长的关系。
AI.findings: 1）Bergmann视角可有效应用于多个领域，包括国际竞争、新科技引发的职业群体竞争、全球资源压力。2）时间日记研究显示1970年代末以来男女时间分配显著趋同，女性从家务主导向广泛的市场经济职业迁移。3）职业间迁移（即使名义上属于不同职业类别）会带来以平均年工资衡量的向上和向下的职业经济流动，这构成经济增长研究的一部分。4）减少职业拥挤带来的向上流动可促进正向经济增长（如美国1975-2012年的经验）。5）OSHC框架可解释中年"时间挤压"及其福祉影响，并通过育儿假或家庭支持系统减轻其影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统整合Bergmann与Becker两种人力资本理论，提出"职业特定人力资本"（OSHC）的综合框架。2）将职业间流动性引入经济增长分析，丰富了人力资本对宏观经济增长作用的理论机制。3）将时间分配（时间挤压）纳入人力资本理论框架，拓展了人力资本理论对福祉影响的解释力。4）将Bergmann视角拓展至国际竞争和全球资源压力等宏观经济议题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为理解新技术（IT/AI）冲击下不同职业群体的竞争动态提供了分析框架。2）为公共政策（如育儿假、家庭支持系统）减缓"时间挤压"提供了理论基础。3）为理解和推动职业流动性以促进经济增长提供了政策启示。

title: The Bio-Digital Bridge
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Bio-Digital Bridge
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Bio-Digital Bridge: a framework for understanding institutional sovereignty as a physical state grounded in the biological charge of the human operators who constitute every institution. Every governance decision originates in the electrochemical activity of a human nervous system. Every institutional instruction is executed as an electromagnetic signal moving through physical hardware. We argue that these two factsbiological source and physical execution-mean that institutions are subject to real energetic constraints that legal and administrative frameworks cannot see. Drawing on the established biophysics of mitochondrial energy production, we derive a fundamental frequency for the human governance substrate: 36.26 THz. We define Biological Autonomy (A b) as the measure of how much of that original biological signal survives the journey from human intent to physical execution. We introduce the AI Event Horizon as the governance threshold where external machine inference begins driving institutional behavior more than the humans inside it. This paper is Working Paper No. 1 in a research program that extends into platform governance, micro-sovereignty dynamics, and entropy measurement in live social environments-including TikTok Live rooms as an empirical site. Working Paper No. 2 will develop the Projection Loop Circuit: a formal electrical model of how biological charge enters a governance system, gets distorted, amplified, and either returned coherently or captured by platform inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生物-数字桥梁"框架，将机构主权重新定义为一种物理状态，其基础是构成每个机构的人类操作者的生物电荷。论文从线粒体能量生产的生物物理学中推导出人类治理基质的基本频率为36.26太赫兹，并定义了生物自主性（A_b）和AI事件视界两个核心概念，用于衡量生物信号在从人类意图到物理执行过程中存活的程度，以及外部机器推断开始主导机构行为的阈值。
AI.research_question: 机构主权如何作为一种基于人类操作者生物电荷的物理状态来被理解？机构和治理决策是否受到法律和行政框架无法识别的真实能量约束？
AI.motivation: 每个治理决策都源于人类神经系统的电化学活动，每一次机构指令都以电磁信号通过物理硬件执行。这两个事实意味着机构受到真实能量约束的限制，但现有的法律和行政框架无法看到这些约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线粒体能量生产的生物物理学；机构主权理论；生物自主性（A_b）概念；AI事件视界概念
AI.method: 该论文为工作论文系列的第一篇，采用跨学科理论构建方法，结合生物物理学原理推导人类治理基质的基础频率，并建立概念性框架（生物-数字桥梁、AI事件视界），为后续平台治理、微观主权动力学和熵测量的实证研究奠定理论基础。
AI.findings: 推导出人类治理基质的基本频率为36.26太赫兹；定义了生物自主性（A_b）作为生物信号从人类意图到物理执行过程中存活程度的度量；引入AI事件视界作为外部机器推断开始主导机构行为的治理阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出生物-数字桥梁框架，将机构主权重新概念化为基于生物电荷的物理状态，建立了生物学与治理理论之间的理论桥梁，引入了AI事件视界和生物自主性等新概念来理解AI对治理的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和评估AI系统对机构治理的影响提供了新的度量标准（生物自主性和AI事件视界），为平台治理、微观主权动力学和实时社交环境（如TikTok直播）中的熵测量提供了理论基础。

detail.title: Impact of the Global Economic Crisis on Developing Countries, in Particular LDCs, and the Role of Trade Financing
detail.abstract: ABSTRACTThe Global economic crisis exposed the vulnerability of developing countries and least-developed Countries (LDCs) to shocks in the global trading system. Falling demand, declining exports and shrinking access to finance intensified economic pressures, particularly on trade-dependent economies. This paper examines these impacts while highlighting the critical role of trade finance sustaining international commerce. It argues that stronger financial support, international cooperation and inclusive trade policies are essential for building resilient developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球金融危机对发展中国家和最不发达国家贸易体系的冲击，强调了贸易融资在维持国际贸易中的关键作用，并提出加强金融支持、国际合作和包容性贸易政策对于建设有韧性的发展中经济体至关重要。
AI.research_question: 全球金融危机如何影响发展中国家和最不发达国家的贸易体系？贸易融资在其中发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 全球经济危机暴露了发展中国家和最不发达国家在全球贸易体系中面对冲击的脆弱性，需要深入理解这些影响并寻找增强经济韧性的路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易脆弱性理论、贸易融资与国际商业可持续性相关理论
AI.method: 基于全球经济危机数据的定性分析，考察贸易需求下降、出口减少和融资渠道收缩对发展中经济体的影响
AI.findings: 贸易依赖型经济体在危机中面临需求下降、出口萎缩和融资通道收窄的多重压力；贸易融资是维持国际商业的关键支撑；加强金融支持、国际合作与包容性贸易政策是建设韧性的必要举措。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对危机情境下发展中经济体贸易脆弱性的理论理解，阐明了贸易融资在危机传导与韧性建设中的机制作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于加强金融支持、国际合作和包容性贸易政策以增强发展中经济体韧性的实践建议。

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract: This paper investigates a structural puzzle in comparative politics: the steady migration of modern autocratization away from violent military coups and toward the legalized, incremental dismantling of democratic institutions. Using a quantitative panel design that integrates Two-Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) regression, Sun & Abraham (2021) staggered difference-indifferences , and counting-process Cox Proportional Hazards models across 6,380+ country-year observations (V-Dem, 1990-2023), I test a structural theory of institutional capture. Unlike traditional authoritarian breakdowns, modern executive aggrandizement generates a facade of constitutional legitimacy. My theory argues this creates a highly predictable sequence of decay: chief executives must preemptively neutralize the judiciary before systematically targeting legislative constraints. Furthermore, this paper identifies a "dual-capture" threshold, where the simultaneous subversion of both branches triggers a severe, discrete penalty in liberal democratic health, but establishes a saturating relationship where further executive aggrandizement inflicts less marginal damage. Contrary to the assumption that hyper-polarization actively accelerates executive overreach, lagged interaction models indicate that political polarization acts as a floor effect, neutralizing legislative fire alarms through partisan loyalty before structural subversion is required. Finally, through rigorous sensitivity testing of regime-death survival models, this paper establishes a profound empirical asymmetry between continuous democratic erosion (the "sickness") and terminal breakdown (the "death"). The results indicate that while dual institutional capture dictates the severity of continuous democratic erosion, formalized executive aggrandizement acts as a consistent and significant catalyst for terminal regime death.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了现代威权化从暴力军事政变向合法化、渐进式拆除民主制度转变的结构性难题。通过整合双向固定效应回归、交错DID和计数过程Cox比例风险模型的定量面板设计（覆盖V-Dem 1990-2023年6,380+国家-年观测），验证了制度捕获的结构性理论：现代行政权力膨胀产生宪法合法性外观，形成可预测的衰退序列——行政首长必须先发制人地中立化司法部门，再系统性地攻击立法约束。研究识别出"双重捕获"阈值，即同时颠覆两个分支会引发自由民主健康的严重离散惩罚，但呈饱和关系（进一步行政膨胀的边际损害递减）。政治极化通过党派忠诚中和立法火焰警报，产生地板效应而非加速行政越权。最后，通过政权死亡生存模型的敏感性检验，确立了持续民主侵蚀（"疾病"）与终极崩溃（"死亡"）之间的经验不对称性：双重制度捕获决定侵蚀严重程度，而正式化的行政膨胀是政权终结死亡的一致且显著的催化剂。
AI.research_question: 现代威权化如何从暴力军事政变转向合法化、渐进式的民主制度拆除？制度捕获的顺序、阈值效应及其对民主侵蚀与政权崩溃的不同影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统研究聚焦于威权崩溃的暴力路径，但现代威权化日益通过法律化、增量化的行政膨胀实现，学界对这一结构性转变的系统理解不足，特别是制度捕获的可预测顺序、极化与制度捕获的关系，以及持续侵蚀与终极崩溃之间的经验不对称性尚未被充分检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度捕获的结构性理论：1）行政膨胀的宪法合法化外观理论；2）可预测的腐败序列理论（先司法后立法）；3）"双重捕获"阈值理论；4）极化作为地板效应的理论；5）民主侵蚀（"疾病"）与政权崩溃（"死亡"）的不对称理论。
AI.method: 定量面板设计，整合三种计量方法：双向固定效应（TWFE）回归、Sun & Abraham（2021）交错差分（staggered DID）模型、计数过程Cox比例风险模型。数据来源为V-Dem 1990-2023年6,380+国家-年观测样本。
AI.findings: 1）现代行政膨胀遵循可预测的腐败序列：先中立化司法，再攻击立法约束；2）存在"双重捕获"阈值，同时颠覆司法和立法分支引发自由民主健康的严重离散下降，但呈饱和效应（边际损害递减）；3）政治极化并非加速行政越权，而是通过党派忠诚中和立法监督产生地板效应；4）持续民主侵蚀（"疾病"）与政权终结（"死亡"）存在不对称性：双重制度捕获决定侵蚀严重程度，而正式化的行政膨胀是政权死亡的持续显著催化剂。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出并验证了现代威权化的制度捕获结构性理论，填补了对非暴力民主倒退路径的解释空白；2）提出"双重捕获"阈值概念，揭示了制度颠覆的非线性影响机制；3）挑战了极化加速行政越权的传统假设，提出极化地板效应理论；4）建立了民主侵蚀与政权崩溃之间经验不对称性的理论区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者和国际组织提供民主衰退早期预警的制度顺序识别工具（先司法后立法）；2）"双重捕获"阈值可为民主保护干预提供关键时间节点；3）对极化的重新理解有助于调整民主韧性建设的策略优先级。

title: Measuring Financial Responsibility of Private Higher Education Institutions
affiliations: Illinois Wesleyan University and Illinois Wesleyan University

detail.title: Measuring Financial Responsibility of Private Higher Education Institutions
detail.abstract: The U.S. Department of Education's Financial Responsibility Composite Score aggregates three accounting ratios to assess the financial health of private higher education institutions, yet its predetermined weights lack a formal statistical foundation. This paper argues that a data-driven alternative better summarizes institutional financial condition. Using Principal Component Analysis on the Primary Reserve Ratio, Equity Ratio, and Net Income Ratio calculated from 2025 audited statements for 30 private nonprofit bachelor's institutions in the greater Chicago regional market, we derive empirically-determined weights. The resulting PCA-based score correlates positively with the official FRCS but produces meaningfully different institutional rankings. Relative to our composite score, the FRCS overweights the Primary Reserve and Net Income Ratios while underweighting the Equity Ratio. We also show that the PCA weights are rather stable over time.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国教育部用于评估私立高校财务健康状况的Financial Responsibility Composite Score（FRCS）提出质疑，认为其预设权重缺乏统计基础。作者使用主成分分析（PCA）对芝加哥地区30所私立非营利学士学位院校的三大财务比率（Primary Reserve Ratio、Equity Ratio、Net Income Ratio）进行实证分析，得出数据驱动的权重。研究发现PCA得分与官方FRCS正相关，但产生不同的院校排名，且FRCS高估了Primary Reserve和Net Income比率的权重，低估了Equity Ratio的权重。PCA权重在时间上具有稳定性。
AI.research_question: 美国教育部财务责任综合得分（FRCS）的预设权重是否具有统计合理性？数据驱动的替代权重是否能更好地评估私立高校的财务状况？
AI.motivation: 美国教育部FRCS使用三个会计比率的预设权重来评估私立高校财务健康，但这些权重缺乏正式的统计基础。需要探索一种数据驱动的替代方法来更准确地总结机构财务状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主成分分析（Principal Component Analysis, PCA）——一种降维技术，用于从数据中提取最大方差的线性组合，从而确定各财务比率的经验权重。
AI.method: 使用2025年审计报表数据，对芝加哥大都市区30所私立非营利学士学位院校的Primary Reserve Ratio、Equity Ratio和Net Income Ratio进行主成分分析，得出实证权重，并与官方FRCS进行对比分析。
AI.findings: (1) PCA得分与官方FRCS正相关，但产生明显不同的院校排名；(2) 相较于PCA复合得分，FRCS高估了Primary Reserve和Net Income比率的权重，低估了Equity Ratio的权重；(3) PCA权重在时间维度上表现稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 为高等教育财务健康评估提供了数据驱动的统计方法框架，证明了PCA可作为官方预设权重评估方法的有效替代方案，并揭示了现有FRCS权重分配的系统性偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和高等教育管理者提供了改进FRCS指标的方法论建议；帮助私立高校更准确地理解自身财务健康状况的评估维度；为美国教育部优化财务监管指标提供了实证依据。

title: Deporting Disability
affiliations: George Washington University Law School

detail.title: Deporting Disability
detail.abstract:
Since the enactment of the earliest migration laws in the United States, people with disabilities have been targeted for exclusion and expulsion based on stereotypes that they are either dangerous or not productive. Although some of the pejorative language regarding disability in the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) has changed over time, certain statutory provisions and the very structure of the INA still allow ableism to operate broadly in immigration adjudications. This Article focuses on the subtle, but pervasive, ways that immigration law disfavors noncitizens with disabilities. In particular, this Article examines ableism in the context of removal (commonly known as “deportation”) proceedings, with a focus on two aspects: (1) the exercise of discretion in adjudicating requests for relief, and (2) determinations of whether a noncitizen’s testimony is credible.

In removal proceedings, immigration adjudicators have broad discretion to grant or deny relief, even when a noncitizen has met otherwise stringent statutory requirements. For example, a refugee who cannot maintain steady work because employers do not provide adequate accommodations for his disability may fulfill all the statutory requirements for a defense from deportation, but ultimately may be denied relief if the immigration judge determines that he is not contributing enough to society due to his difficulties with employment. Likewise, manifestations of certain disabilities can also have an impact on credibility assessments, such as when a person’s disability results in their demeanor not conforming to what the adjudicator expects to observe during testimony. By focusing on discretion and credibility—two fundamental components of deportation cases—this Article reveals the extent to which ableism permeates even facially neutral aspects of immigration law and policy. It also proposes several paths toward eradicating ableism in removal proceedings.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦美国移民法（特别是驱逐程序）中对残障非公民的系统性歧视（能者主义/ableism），通过分析裁量权的行使和可信度评估两个关键环节，揭示即便是表面中立的移民法条款和实践也深深渗透着对残障人士的偏见，并提出了消除此类歧视的路径。
AI.research_question: 美国移民法（尤其是驱逐程序）中，残障非公民如何因能者主义而受到系统性不利对待？
AI.motivation: 尽管《移民与国籍法》（INA）中关于残障的贬损性语言有所改变，但法律的结构和某些条款仍允许能者主义在移民裁决中广泛运作。作者希望通过揭示这种微妙且普遍存在的歧视，为消除移民法中的能者主义提供理论依据和改革方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能者主义（Ableism）理论——即基于残障身份对个体进行歧视性预设（认为残障者危险或无生产力）的法律分析框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与规范研究，聚焦驱逐程序中的两个核心方面：（1）救济申请裁决中裁量权的行使；（2）对非公民证词可信度的认定。
AI.findings: （1）即使在满足严格法定要求的情况下，移民裁决者仍拥有广泛的自由裁量权批准或拒绝救济，例如残障难民因雇主未提供合理便利而无法稳定工作时，可能因被认定对社会贡献不足而被拒绝救济；（2）残障人士的某些表现形态（如肢体语言、仪态不符合裁决者的预期）可能影响其证词的可信度评估。这些表明能者主义甚至渗透在表面中立的移民法律和政策中。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能者主义分析引入移民法研究，揭示裁量权和可信度认定这两个看似中立的法律机制如何充当能者主义的隐性载体，扩展了残障法律研究与移民法研究的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了多条消除驱逐程序中能者主义的具体路径，为政策制定者、移民裁决者和倡导者提供改革方向，推动移民法对残障人士的公平对待。

title: Visual Impairment and Blindness Among Adults (≥40 Years) in an Underserved Population of Kano State, Northwestern Nigeria
affiliations: Bayero University, University of Oxford, Bayero University, Bayero University and Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital

detail.title: Visual Impairment and Blindness Among Adults (≥40 Years) in an Underserved Population of Kano State, Northwestern Nigeria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval for this study was secured from the Kano State Ministry of Health with approval number NHREC/17/03/2018–SHREC/2024/4879. All adult participants gave informed consent during data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background: Globally, visual impairment remains a significant challenge that substantially affects the quality of life (social participation, mobility, etc.) of those affected. Among persons aged ≥40 years in the Bunkure Local Government Area of Kano State, this study aims to determine the prevalence of visual impairment and blindness, as well as associated factors.

Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study and multistage sampling based on probability proportional to size procedures was used to identify a cross-sectional community representative sample of 422 persons ≥40 years of age from Bunkure LGA. Visual acuity at distance was measured with an Illiterate Snellen tumbling-E chart at 6M. Presenting visual acuity was recorded, and refraction was performed in all sampled adults. Clinical evaluation was conducted for all participants, and those presenting with vision < 6/12 in either eye underwent dilated fundus examination.

Findings: The study found a visual impairment prevalence of 53·10% (95% CI: 48·22-57·98), and blindness was 13·70% (95% CI: 10·27-17·17). The leading causes of blindness and severe visual impairment were cataract and glaucoma. Among the blind, 96·55% were due to avoidable causes. There is a significant association (P<0·05) between age, gender, tribe, occupation, level of education, and residence/location and visual impairment. Age and residence were predictors of blindness in this setting.

Interpretation: There were differences across wards, and the focus should be on ensuring the delivery of eye care services across underserved communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用描述性横断面研究设计，通过多阶段抽样调查了尼日利亚卡诺州Bunkure地方政府辖区422名40岁及以上居民的视力损害和失明患病率。研究发现视力损害患病率为53.10%，失明患病率为13.70%，白内障和青光眼是导致失明和严重视力损害的主要原因，其中96.55%的失明源于可避免的原因。年龄、性别、部落、职业、教育水平和居住地均与视力损害显著相关。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚卡诺州Bunkure地方政府辖区40岁及以上人群中，视力损害和失明的患病率及其相关影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 视力损害在全球范围内仍然是对生活质量（如社会参与、行动能力等）产生重大影响的重大挑战，但在尼日利亚卡诺州Bunkure地方政府辖区内缺乏相关的流行病学数据，亟需了解该地区视力损害和失明的患病情况及风险因素，以便为眼保健服务的规划和资源分配提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于公共卫生流行病学视角，采用横断面研究设计，以概率比例规模抽样方法为基础，评估社区层面的视力损害负担及其社会人口学决定因素。
AI.method: 采用描述性横断面研究设计，通过基于概率比例规模程序的多阶段抽样，从Bunkure地方政府辖区选取422名40岁及以上人群作为社区代表性样本。使用6米处识字Snellen tumbling-E视力表测量远视力，记录呈现视力，并对所有样本成人进行屈光检查。对所有参与者进行临床评估，对任一眼视力低于6/12的参与者进行散瞳眼底检查。
AI.findings: 视力损害患病率为53.10%（95% CI: 48.22-57.98），失明患病率为13.70%（95% CI: 10.27-17.17）。白内障和青光眼是失明和严重视力损害的主要原因。在失明者中，96.55%是由于可避免的原因所致。年龄、性别、部落、职业、教育水平和居住地与视力损害之间存在显著关联（P<0.05）。年龄和居住地是该地区失明的预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究填补了尼日利亚北部农村地区40岁及以上人群视力损害和失明流行病学数据的空白，揭示了该地区视力损害患病率高于许多其他地区的现实情况，并确认了可避免性失明的高比例，为视力损害的社会人口学决定因素提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果强调了在不同行政区/选区之间存在差异，提示应重点关注向服务不足社区提供眼保健服务。为当地卫生政策制定者提供了关于白内障和青光眼防治、以及可避免性失明干预的优先方向和数据支持。

title: Foreign Government Spending and National GDP
affiliations: University of Western Ontario - Department of Economics and University of Quebec at Montreal (UQAM)

detail.title: Foreign Government Spending and National GDP

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Many studies have assessed the link between national government spending and national gross domestic product (GDP); however, the link between foreign government spending and national output is still an open question. We use a connectedness method, an SVAR method, and data from 23 advanced and emerging countries from 1962-Q1 to 2022-Q4 to answer that critical question. A panel method with a fixed effect is also used to assess the effect of trade openness on the connectedness between the two mentioned variables. The results from the SVAR method show that global government spending shock leads, at its impact, to an increase in the GDP growth for all countries in our sample. The results from the connectedness method show that foreign government spending directly impacts the domestic GDP. The results from the panel method with fixed effect show that trade openness helps to mitigate the connectedness from foreign government spending to national GDP. This connectedness decreases with the country's trade openness. This can be explained by the fact that a country that is more open to trade has more options to reduce its national DGP fluctuation and protect itself from foreign government spending shocks than a country with less trade.

AI.tldr: 本文使用连通性方法、SVAR方法以及1962年第一季度至2022年第四季度23个发达和新兴国家的数据，考察外国政府支出与国内GDP之间的关系，并利用固定效应面板方法评估贸易开放度对二者连通性的调节作用。研究发现：全球政府支出冲击会即时提升各国GDP增长；外国政府支出直接影响国内GDP；贸易开放度有助于削弱外国政府支出对国内GDP的连通性。
AI.research_question: 外国政府支出如何影响国内生产总值（GDP）？贸易开放度在这一关系中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 已有大量研究探讨本国政府支出与本国GDP之间的关系，但外国政府支出对国内产出的影响仍是一个未解问题，本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际宏观经济学中的溢出效应理论、贸易开放度与外部冲击传导理论
AI.method: 连通性方法（connectedness method）、结构向量自回归（SVAR）方法、带固定效应的面板方法；数据涵盖23个发达和新兴国家，时间跨度为1962年第一季度至2022年第四季度。
AI.findings: 1. SVAR结果显示，全球政府支出冲击在当期会使样本所有国家的GDP增长上升；2. 连通性方法结果显示，外国政府支出直接影响国内GDP；3. 固定效应面板方法结果显示，贸易开放度有助于削弱外国政府支出对国内GDP的连通性，即连通性随国家贸易开放度提高而降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将外国政府支出纳入对国内产出影响的分析框架，拓展了政府支出-经济增长关系的跨国溢出研究，并揭示了贸易开放度作为外部冲击缓冲机制的理论作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政策制定者提供了启示：提高贸易开放度可以帮助国家降低外国政府支出冲击对本国经济的影响，从而增强经济韧性。

title: Regionally Anchored? FOMC Voting Dynamics during the Great Inflation

detail.title: Regionally Anchored? FOMC Voting Dynamics during the Great Inflation
detail.abstract: Do regional economic conditions shape national monetary policy decisions?
