Modern evidence from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) suggests that they do, with policymakers responding disproportionately to the economic conditions of the regions they represent or are personally connected to. This dissertation revisits that question during the Burns-era Federal Reserve (1970-1978), a policy regime marked by severe macroeconomic instability and fundamentally different monetary policy beliefs. Using a newly reconstructed real-time information set, it shows that regional economic conditions did not meaningfully influence policy preferences once national developments are accounted for. Instead, voting behaviour responded primarily to national real economic conditions, with a one percentage-point increase in monthly jobs growth increasing the probability of a hawkish vote by over 50 percentage points. These findings suggest that regional bias in monetary policymaking is contingent on the policy environment rather than a structural feature of decentralised central banking, implying that regional representation may broaden the informational basis of policy decisions without compromising national outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究伯恩斯时代（1970-1978）美联储FOMC的货币政策决策是否受地区经济条件影响，利用新构建的实时信息集发现，在国家层面经济变量得到控制后，地区经济条件并未显著影响政策偏好，投票行为主要响应全国实际经济状况（月度就业增长每提高1个百分点，鹰派投票概率增加50个百分点以上）。
AI.research_question: 地区经济条件是否以及如何影响国家货币政策决策？具体而言，在伯恩斯时代的美联储（1970-1978）这一政策体制下，FOMC委员的区域经济联系是否导致其投票偏好产生区域性偏差？
AI.motivation: 现代FOMC的证据表明政策制定者会对所代表或本人关联地区的经济状况作出不成比例的回应，但这一发现是否具有普遍性尚不清楚。伯恩斯时代是一个宏观经济高度不稳定且货币政策理念截然不同的政策体制，为检验地区偏差的普遍性提供了天然场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地区代表性理论/分散化中央银行制度下的区域偏差理论；货币政策偏好理论；FOMC投票行为理论。
AI.method: 利用新重建的实时信息集（real-time information set），采用计量经济学方法分析FOMC委员投票行为，在国家层面经济变量控制下检验地区经济条件对政策偏好的影响。
AI.findings: 在国家发展得到控制后，地区经济条件并未显著影响政策偏好；投票行为主要响应全国实际经济状况，月度就业增长每提高1个百分点，鹰派投票概率增加超过50个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明货币政策中的地区偏差取决于政策环境而非分散化中央银行制度的结构性特征；为地区代表性的信息价值提供了新的理论视角，表明地区代表可以拓宽政策决策的信息基础而不损害国家层面的结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 对中央银行制度设计中地区代表性安排的有效性提供实证依据；有助于理解不同货币政策体制下FOMC决策行为的差异。

title: Property Tax Assessment Ratios and Calibration in Santiago, Chile

detail.title: Property Tax Assessment Ratios and Calibration in Santiago, Chile
detail.abstract: Property taxation depends on the calibration and uniformity of the underlying assessment roll, yet independent audits of tax-base quality are rare outside a handful of high-income countries. We assemble a semiannual cadastral-transactional panel (2018-2025) for 34 municipalities of Greater Santiago, Chile, comprising 282,502 hygienized assessment-declared-price pairs, and apply the International Association of Assessing Officers (IAAO) ratio-study framework to audit assessment calibration, dispersion, and spatial and socioeconomic uniformity, adjusting for non-random transaction selection via inverse-probability weighting. The median assessment-to-declared-price ratio is 0.511, against a calibration target of 0.60 most recently declared by the tax administration, with a coefficient of dispersion of 43.6-roughly three times the IAAO residential ceiling-in all 34 municipalities studied. The price-related bias coefficient falls within the IAAO acceptable range, while the price-related differential does not, indicating mild regressivity on that dimension. Selection adjustment leaves these findings materially unchanged, and a socioeconomic gradient in assessment ratios across territorial deciles is not statistically distinguishable from zero. We further recompute statutory liability under the tax administration's own declared calibration target, holding exemption status fixed, as a conditional mechanical simulation rather than a forecast: aggregate billing rises by 2.1 percent, reclassifying over 45,000 properties into and nearly 44,000 out of the tax base. We interpret these results as evidence of a base-quality and calibration problem, not a tax-level problem, with implications for horizontal equity and for the design of Chile's postponed 2027 general revaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用智利大圣地亚哥34个市镇2018-2025年半年度地籍交易面板数据（282,502个评估-申报价格配对），运用IAAO比率研究框架审计房产税基质量。研究发现评估与申报价格中位数比率为0.511（远低于0.60的校准目标），离散系数43.6（约为IAAO住宅上限的三倍），价格相关偏差系数在可接受范围内但价格相关差异不在（呈轻微累退性）。选择调整不改变结论，社会经济梯度不显著。若按税务管理部门自有校准目标重新计算法定税负，总税额将上升2.1%，超过45,000处房产被重新纳入税基、近44,000处被移出。研究证明这是税基质量和校准问题而非税率问题，对横向公平和智利延迟至2027年的总重估设计具有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 智利大圣地亚哥地区房产税的评估基数质量如何？评估结果是否校准良好、一致且公平？
AI.motivation: 房产税依赖于评估名册的校准和均一性，但除少数高收入国家外，对税基质量的独立审计极为罕见。现有文献缺乏对中低收入国家房产税基质量的系统性实证审计。
AI.theoretical_framework: IAAO比率研究框架（评估校准、离散度、空间和社会经济均一性）；非随机交易选择调整（逆概率加权）；横向公平理论
AI.method: 构建2018-2025年半年度地籍-交易面板数据（34个市镇，282,502个评估-申报价格配对），应用IAAO比率研究框架审计评估校准（中位数比率）、离散度（离散系数）、空间与社会经济均一性；采用逆概率加权调整非随机交易选择；进行条件性机械模拟重算法定税负。
AI.findings: （1）评估与申报价格中位数比率为0.511，远低于0.60的校准目标；（2）离散系数43.6，约为IAAO住宅上限的三倍，且34个市镇全部超标；（3）价格相关偏差系数在可接受范围，但价格相关差异不在，呈轻微累退性；（4）选择调整不改变结论；（5）评估比率的社会经济梯度在统计上不显著；（6）按税务部门自有校准目标模拟，总税额上升2.1%，超过45,000处房产进入税基、近44,000处被移出。
AI.theory_contributions: 将IAAO专业评估审计框架系统应用于中低收入国家的税基质量评估，填补了该领域实证空白；证明税基校准问题可通过机械模拟与税收总额问题分离；深化了对横向公平与评估均一性在发展中国家情境下的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智利2027年总重估设计提供实证依据；揭示当前税基存在系统性校准不足和离散问题；为税务管理部门提供具体的评估质量审计指标和基准；为其他中低收入国家建立税基质量审计机制提供方法论参考。

title: The Murder at Agnes Banks: Unravelling Truth, Lies, and 19th Century Justice

detail.title: The Murder at Agnes Banks: Unravelling Truth, Lies, and 19th Century Justice
detail.abstract: The setting for a murder that took place in the early days of the New South Wales penal colony in Australia was the regional town of Agnes Banks. Beginning with an outline of the transported convicts William Williams from England in 1798 and Julia Leahy from Ireland, the paper follows the life of their daughter, Mary Ann, who married the unrelated Robert Williams in 1840, who had the distinction of having all four grandparents as convicts. Some forty years later, in 1881, the now mentally challenged Robert was charged with murdering a neighbour, William Freeman, and was committed to an insane asylum where he remained for the rest of his life. The research reflected in this paper shows that there were numerous flaws in the prosecution's case, which was treated as open and shut. Robert had pleaded not guilty, and there was every chance he was correct. This paper examines the lead-up to the trial and the questions that should have been asked to avoid a possible miscarriage of justice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过追踪新南威尔士流放殖民地Agnes Banks地区一起谋杀案的历史背景，考察了罪犯后代Robert Williams于1881年被控谋杀邻居William Freeman的案件。文章指出控方证据存在诸多缺陷，Robert可能无辜却仍被送入精神病院终老，揭示了一场可能发生的司法误判。
AI.research_question: 1881年Robert Williams谋杀案中，控方的证据和审判过程存在哪些漏洞，Robert是否可能被冤枉？
AI.motivation: 该案被视为"一目了然"的简单案件，但深入历史档案后发现控方案情存在大量疑点，作者希望揭示可能发生的司法不公。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史学与司法史视角，通过对殖民时期档案、家族谱系和法庭记录的重建来审视案件。
AI.method: 历史档案研究法，通过追踪罪犯后代家族谱系（William Williams、Julia Leahy及女儿Mary Ann），结合法庭记录与审判材料进行案件重审。
AI.findings: 控方在案件中存在多个缺陷，案件并非表面上那样"铁证如山"；Robert Williams声称无罪可能确属实情，但审判过程未提出关键质询，导致可能发生司法误判。
AI.theory_contributions: 从微观历史视角补充了对殖民时期刑事司法系统运作的理解，揭示了所谓"简单案件"背后可能存在的系统性误判风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代司法实践提供历史警示：即使是看似证据确凿的案件，也应严格审视控方证据链的完整性，避免类似司法误判。

title: Transparency in Debt Crises
affiliations: and University of Minnesota - Minneapolis - Department of Economics

detail.title: Transparency in Debt Crises
detail.abstract: We study a sovereign's choice of whether to disclose information about its repayment capacity to international lenders in a 3-period Eaton and Gersovitz (1981) environment. Under full disclosure, debt is priced at actuarially fair rates for each type; under non-disclosure, a pooling equilibrium generates cross-subsidization across types. We show that non-disclosure is preferred when the probability of being the low type is small: the adverse selection discount the high type bears under pooling is then small, making opacity relatively cheap. Moreover, non-disclosure is preferred when deadweight losses from default are small: the insurance value of pooling then dominates the pricing gains from transparency. Two pieces of evidence support the framework. Mexico's pre-1995 reserve-disclosure regime illustrates a durable, pre-committed disclosure rule consistent with the model. Using IMF Data Standards Initiatives, we document that no country has ever moved to a lower transparency tier, that countries facing higher recession risk are more often observed to adopt transparency tiers, an association consistent with the model's threshold comparative static, and that early adopters exhibit, for two of the three tier margins, more dispersed residualized issuances than eligible non-adopters, in a direction consistent with the model.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个三期Eaton和Gersovitz（1981）框架下研究主权国家向国际贷款人披露还款能力信息的决策。研究发现，当低类型概率较小时，不披露（信息不透明）更受青睐；当违约导致的死重损失较小时，不披露同样更受青睐。作者利用墨西哥1995年前的储备披露制度及IMF数据标准倡议提供了支持性证据。
AI.research_question: 主权国家在国际借贷中应选择披露还是隐瞒其还款能力信息？何种条件下不披露（信息不透明）是最优选择？
AI.motivation: 主权债务市场中信息披露的透明度选择是一个重要的现实问题，但理论上对于"为何一些国家选择信息不透明"缺乏系统性解释。本文试图从逆向选择和保险价值的角度阐明信息不透明作为均衡选择的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Eaton和Gersovitz（1981）主权借贷模型；逆向选择理论（adverse selection）；混同均衡（pooling equilibrium）与交叉补贴（cross-subsidization）理论。
AI.method: 构建三期理论模型，比较完全披露（按类型精算公平定价）与非披露（混同均衡下的交叉补贴）两种机制的福利；并结合墨西哥案例与IMF数据标准倡议的实证证据进行检验。
AI.findings: （1）当低类型概率较小时，不披露更优——因为此时高类型在混同均衡下承担的逆向选择折扣较小，透明度代价较低；（2）当违约死重损失较小时，不披露更优——混同的保险价值超过透明度带来的定价收益；（3）实证证据：墨西哥1995年前的储备披露制度符合模型预测；IMF数据表明没有任何国家转向更低透明度层级，面临更高衰退风险的国家更多采用透明度层级，早期采用者在两个层级边界上表现出更分散的发行行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在主权债务框架中系统阐明"信息不透明"可以是有意选择而非信息摩擦的被动结果；将保险价值与逆向选择权衡引入主权信息披露决策分析；为信息披露的寡头（透明 vs 不透明）均衡提供了理论微基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际金融机构（如IMF）设计信息披露标准提供理论依据；解释不同国家在透明度层级选择上的异质性；帮助理解透明度承诺（如预先承诺披露规则）的制度设计价值。

title: Protected choice and endogenous portfolio formation

detail.title: Protected choice and endogenous portfolio formation
detail.abstract: We study portfolio formation when a future counterparty can choose compensation from assets left outside a limited protection set. Acquisitions therefore change both standalone value and future compensation exposure. Under pure in-kind compensation, optimal protection reduces to a rank-based problem, generating an acquisition wedge that can deter a positive-value asset or induce a negative-value sacrificial asset. With multiple acquisitions and an exact counterparty ranking, a frontier representation characterizes the global optimum despite nonmodular interactions and remains valid under an acquisition-count cap; every optimal portfolio contains at most one negative-standalone-value acquisition, which must be the unique sacrificial asset. Under ranking uncertainty, no finite count bound survives uniformly across environments, even for ranking distributions arbitrarily close to deterministic ones, but aggregate discipline survives: the total standalone loss from such acquisitions is bounded by their joint option-value gain, and strict deterministic optima are locally stable for fixed primitives. A cash option creates a cash-option cliff, lumpy acquisition, and a sharp premium threshold for uniform acquisition neutrality. Bilateral benchmarks separate transfer selection, transaction timing, and acquisition; in the fixed-exposure cliff environment, transaction-neutral cash makes the private--bilateral gap equal the counterparty's expected compensation rent. Protected-player compensation in professional baseball provides a direct application.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当未来交易对手可以从受限保护集之外的资产中选择补偿时，企业的资产组合（收购）决策。收购不仅改变独立价值，还改变未来补偿敞口。在纯实物补偿下，最优保护可简化为排序问题，产生收购楔子；多次收购下前沿表征刻画全局最优。在排序不确定下无有限数量界，但加总纪律仍成立。现金期权产生现金悬崖、块状收购和溢价阈值。双边基准分离转移选择、交易时点和收购。职业棒球受保护球员补偿提供了直接应用。
AI.research_question: 当未来交易对手可以从未受保护资产中选择补偿时，企业应如何构建最优资产组合（收购）？
AI.motivation: 现有模型通常只考虑收购对资产独立价值的影响，忽略了收购同时改变未来补偿敞口这一维度。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究保护集限制下收购与补偿敞口的相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排序（rank-based）最优化、前沿表征（frontier representation）、非模（nonmodular）交互博弈、确定性最优的局部稳定性、双边基准分析。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导，包括排序问题转化、前沿表征方法、鲁棒性分析（排序不确定性）、最优性条件推导及职业棒球案例应用。
AI.findings: （1）纯实物补偿下最优保护简化为排序问题，收购楔子可阻止正价值资产或诱使负价值牺牲资产；（2）多次收购下前沿表征刻画全局最优，最优组合至多含一个负独立价值收购（必须是唯一牺牲资产）；（3）排序不确定下无有限数量界，但加总纪律成立（总独立损失有界于联合期权价值增益），严格确定性最优局部稳定；（4）现金期权产生现金悬崖、块状收购及溢价阈值；（5）双边基准分离了转移选择、交易时点和收购。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画保护集约束下收购与补偿敞口的交互作用；提出前沿表征方法解决非模交互下的全局最优问题；建立排序不确定性下的鲁棒性边界与加总纪律；引入现金期权悬崖和块状收购等新概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在面对未来补偿义务时提供资产组合决策框架；对职业棒球受保护球员补偿制度提供直接指导；为各类存在保护集约束的并购场景提供理论支撑。

title: Algorithm-Driven Svars: Navigating the Wilderness of Big Data
affiliations: University of Zurich and Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: Algorithm-Driven Svars: Navigating the Wilderness of Big Data
detail.abstract: Every SVAR result is conditional on two choices: the restrictions that identify the shock and the variables on which they operate. The literature disciplines the first; the second is chosen by hand. We develop a Bayesian methodology that constructs information sets, uses an out-of-sample criterion, and retains the largest system it admits. Under recursive identification, output rises with housing production rather than household credit alone. For monetary policy, an anchor-free joint Bayesian proxy SVAR with multiple instruments strengthens the credit spread channel. A core system augmented with the selected corporate spread identifies expected default risk as a potent transmission margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种贝叶斯方法来自动选择SVAR（结构向量自回归）模型中的变量集。现有文献关注识别约束的选择，但变量集通常由研究者手工指定。作者开发了一种贝叶斯方法，利用样本外准则构建信息集，并保留其允许的最大系统。在递归识别下发现，产出增长与住房生产（而非仅家庭信贷）相关；在货币政策分析中，使用多工具的无锚联合贝叶斯代理SVAR强化了信用利差渠道；核心系统加上选定的公司利差变量，识别出预期违约风险是重要的传导渠道。
AI.research_question: 如何在SVAR模型中系统性地选择变量集，以替代传统手工选择变量的做法？不同变量集选择如何影响宏观经济学因果推断的结论？
AI.motivation: SVAR模型的估计结果取决于两个选择：识别冲击的约束以及这些约束所作用的变量集。文献对第一个选择有严格的规范，但第二个选择通常由研究者手工决定，缺乏系统性的方法，可能导致结论偏差或选择性报告。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型；贝叶斯推断；代理变量（proxy）方法；递归识别；样本外预测准则；信用利差传导渠道。
AI.method: 开发一种贝叶斯方法论，通过样本外准则构建信息集，自动选择变量，并保留能够容纳的最大系统。在应用层面，采用递归识别下的住房/信贷模型，以及使用多个工具的无锚联合贝叶斯代理SVAR（anchor-free joint Bayesian proxy SVAR）分析货币政策。
AI.findings: (1) 在递归识别下，产出随住房生产而非仅家庭信贷上升；(2) 在货币政策分析中，多工具无锚联合贝叶斯代理SVAR强化了信用利差渠道；(3) 在核心系统上加入选定的公司利差变量后，识别出预期违约风险是强劲的传导渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 为SVAR模型中的变量选择提供了系统化的贝叶斯方法论，弥补了文献中变量集选择缺乏理论指导的空白，使得因果推断更加稳健和可复制。揭示了变量选择对宏观经济学结论的重要影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证宏观经济学家提供了一种自动化的变量选择工具，减少研究者主观选择带来的偏差；为理解住房市场、货币政策传导机制以及信用风险传染提供了新的实证证据。

title: Relative Stock Pricing Before Macro Announcements: Evidence from China's PMI
affiliations: Renmin University of China, School of Business, Renmin University of China, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and

detail.title: Relative Stock Pricing Before Macro Announcements: Evidence from China's PMI
detail.abstract: We document that relative stock pricing before macro announcements is informative in predicting upcoming macroeconomic news under China’s PMI setting. Using an announcement-day approach to estimate stock-level PMI shock sensitivity, we construct a long-short portfolio whose return we call the "PMI spread". The PMI spread shortly before the announcement positively predicts the PMI shock, whereas the same spread ten-to-eight-days earlier negatively predicts the shock. This pattern is consistent with strategic trading by early-informed investors. Overall, our results highlight the non-monotonic incorporation of macroeconomic information into the cross-section of stock prices before scheduled macro announcements.

AI.tldr: 本文以中国PMI（采购经理人指数）为背景，发现宏观公告前的相对股价能够预测即将公布的宏观经济消息。通过公告日方法估计个股对PMI冲击的敏感度，构建多空组合（"PMI价差"），发现公告前不久的PMI价差正向预测PMI冲击，而公告前8-10天的价差则负向预测，这一模式与知情交易者的策略性交易一致。
AI.research_question: 在中国PMI公告背景下，宏观公告前的相对股价是否能够预测即将公布的宏观经济消息？具体而言，不同时间窗口的股价信息含量是否存在非单调模式？
AI.motivation: 已有文献通常关注宏观公告前整体股价水平的预测能力，但较少探讨横截面层面的股价差异（相对定价）在预测宏观消息中的作用。本文旨在填补这一空白，并揭示知情交易者在不同时间窗口的策略性交易行为如何影响股价的信息含量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知情交易理论（informed trading）：早期知情的投资者会在宏观公告前进行策略性交易，通过跨期交易影响股价的横截面信息含量，导致不同时间窗口的预测方向出现非单调变化。
AI.method: 采用公告日方法（announcement-day approach）估计个股对PMI冲击的敏感度，据此构建多空投资组合（PMI价差），并检验公告前不同时间窗口（临近公告vs.公告前8-10天）的价差对PMI冲击的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1) 公告前不久的PMI价差正向预测PMI冲击；2) 公告前8-10天的同一价差负向预测PMI冲击；3) 这种非单调模式与早期知情投资者的策略性交易行为一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了宏观信息在公告前如何以非单调方式融入股票价格的横截面中，拓展了知情交易理论在宏观公告情境下的应用，为理解股价信息含量与时间窗口的关系提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了一种基于相对股价构建的宏观消息预测工具（PMI价差），有助于在公告前优化交易策略；同时为监管者理解宏观公告前市场信息流动提供了参考。

title: How Common is Common? Common Institutional Ownership and Corporate Policy Similarity
affiliations: Gonzaga University - School of Business Administration, University of Queensland - Business School and Stevens Institute of Technology - School of Business

detail.title: How Common is Common? Common Institutional Ownership and Corporate Policy Similarity
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether firms operating within the same industry make similar capital investment decisions when they share institutional owners. We focus on firms’ capital investment behavior and propose that common institutional ownership influences investment decisions, in part through the information environment. Using a large panel of firm pairs, we find that higher common institutional ownership is associated with greater investment similarity among peer firms. The effect is particularly strong in highly competitive product markets, among firms with weaker governance, and when common ownership is held by longer-horizon institutional investors. We further show that common ownership is associated with greater similarity in other corporate financial decisions, including SG&A, R&D, cash holdings, and payout behavior. A difference-in-differences analysis using institutional mergers as exogenous shocks confirms that common ownership leads to greater investment similarity among peer firms. Our findings are robust to alternative measures, matching and selection corrections, and instrumental variable techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了同行业企业因共享机构投资者而表现出相似资本投资决策的现象。研究发现共同机构所有权与同行企业投资相似度正相关，该效应在竞争激烈的产品市场、治理较弱的企业以及长期机构投资者持股的企业中更为显著。通过机构合并作为外生冲击的DID分析及多种稳健性检验确认了因果关系。
AI.research_question: 同行业企业之间共享机构投资者是否会促使它们在资本投资决策上变得更加相似？这种相似性通过什么机制产生？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究探讨了机构投资者对公司治理的影响，但共同机构所有权（即同一机构同时持有多家同行业公司股份）是否会影响同行企业间的投资决策趋同，这一问题尚未得到充分研究。理解这一现象有助于揭示机构投资者的信息传导作用及其对行业竞争格局的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息环境理论（信息传导与协调机制）、机构投资者持股理论与公司治理理论。
AI.method: 使用大规模企业配对面板数据进行分析；采用差异中差异（DID）方法，以机构合并作为外生冲击；辅以替代变量测度、匹配与选择修正、工具变量等多种稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）共同机构所有权越高，同行企业间的投资相似度越高；（2）该效应在竞争激烈的产品市场、治理较弱的企业以及长期投资者持股的企业中更强；（3）共同所有权还与其他财务决策（SG&A、研发、现金持有、股利政策）的相似性相关；（4）DID分析确认了因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了机构投资者持股对公司决策影响的研究，揭示了共同机构所有权通过信息环境渠道促进同行企业决策趋同的机制，丰富了信息传导与公司决策趋同的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者理解机构投资者集中持股对行业竞争和公司独立决策的潜在影响提供了实证证据；为企业管理层认识外部股东结构对自身决策的影响提供了参考。

title: The Price of Exit: Why Buyouts Fail in College Athletics

detail.title: The Price of Exit: Why Buyouts Fail in College Athletics
detail.abstract:
The emergence of direct compensation for college athletes has transformed the contractual relationship between athletes and universities. As schools increasingly enter into multi-year agreements with athletes, buyout provisions have emerged as a potential mechanism for pricing athlete mobility, protecting institutional investment, and allocating the risks associated with early termination. Yet the enforceability of these provisions remains uncertain, as courts have confronted college-athlete buyouts without direct precedent governing their application in this context.

This Article examines college-athlete buyouts through the lenses of contract law and law and economics. It argues that enforceable buyouts can function as credible price signals, allowing athletes and institutions to price the cost of exit ex ante while reducing uncertainty and transaction costs associated with transfers. The Article further argues that courts applying the penalty doctrine should account for the difficulty of estimating an institution’s prospective losses at the time of contracting, particularly where a buyout is clearly disclosed, negotiated at arm’s length, and entered into with the assistance of counsel. In such circumstances, buyouts are better understood as contractual mechanisms for allocating risk than as penalties designed to compel performance.

Greater certainty regarding enforcement would preserve athletes' mobility while allowing parties to contract around the risks posed by increasingly professionalized college athletics. In doing so, enforceable buyouts may encourage longer-term contracting, reward institutions that invest in athlete development, and provide athletes with greater income stability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨大学运动员买断条款的可执行性问题，认为可执行的买断条款是有效的价格信号，有助于运动员和学校在事前为退出成本定价，法院在适用惩罚条款原则时应考虑机构预期损失难以估算的实际情况。
AI.research_question: 大学运动员买断条款的可执行性应如何界定？法院应如何适用惩罚条款原则来评估这些条款？
AI.motivation: 随着大学运动员获得直接补偿，学校与运动员之间签订多年期协议日益普遍，买断条款应运而生，但其可执行性在司法实践中缺乏直接先例，存在重大的法律不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同法与法律经济学
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，运用合同法与法律经济学理论框架进行论证
AI.findings: 可执行的买断条款可作为可信的价格信号，在事前为退出成本定价，减少转会中的不确定性和交易成本；法院在适用惩罚条款原则时应考虑机构预期损失难以估算的特殊性，在条款明确披露、公平谈判且有律师协助的情况下，买断条款更应被视为风险分配机制而非惩罚性条款。
AI.theory_contributions: 将合同法中的惩罚条款原则与法律经济学理论相结合，为大学运动员买断条款的可执行性提供了新的理论解释框架，拓展了惩罚条款原则在新型职业化背景下的适用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院裁判大学运动员买断条款案件提供指导性标准，有助于运动员与学校在更确定的规则下签订契约，促进长期合同签订，保障投资运动员发展的机构利益，同时为运动员提供更稳定的收入。

title: Bank Responses to Targeted Macroprudential Capital Regulation: Evidence from Unsecured Retail Lending in India
affiliations: Government of India - Reserve Bank of India

detail.title: Bank Responses to Targeted Macroprudential Capital Regulation: Evidence from Unsecured Retail Lending in India
detail.abstract: Portfolio-specific capital regulation is central to macroprudential policy, yet its effects are understudied relative to broad capital requirements. Using the Reserve Bank of India’s November 2023 increase in risk weights on unsecured consumer credit, and exploiting cross-bank differences in pre-policy exposure, we find that more-exposed banks contract unsecured lending, most sharply in credit card receivables. The reduction does not represent an overall contraction in credit, but a reallocation across segments. Credit does not flow into the untreated secured retail segments, despite their lower capital charges, but toward industry and services. This departs from the rebalancing toward low-risk-weight assets documented for bank-wide capital shocks, indicating that reallocation under a targeted shock is not governed by capital-cost minimization alone. The response is similar across banks and, as all are well capitalized, reflects incentives rather than constraints. Targeted capital regulation reshapes the composition of bank credit in ways broad requirements do not.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度储备银行2023年11月提高无担保消费信贷风险权重的政策，以及各银行事前暴露程度的差异，发现暴露程度更高的银行收缩了无担保贷款，尤其是信用卡应收账款。但这种收缩并非整体信贷的下降，而是跨部门的信贷重新配置——信贷并未流向资本费用更低的未受监管的担保零售部门，而是流向工业和服务业。这表明定向资本冲击下的信贷再配置并非仅由资本成本最小化驱动，且所有银行资本充足，反应反映的是激励而非约束。
AI.research_question: 针对特定组合的资本监管（组合特定资本监管）如何影响银行信贷的构成和重新配置？其影响是否不同于宽泛的资本充足率要求？
AI.motivation: 组合特定资本监管是宏观审慎政策的核心工具，但其效果相较于宽泛的资本要求研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本监管与银行信贷配置理论；资本成本最小化假设；定向监管冲击下的激励效应分析。
AI.method: 利用印度储备银行2023年11月提高无担保消费信贷风险权重的准自然实验，结合银行事前暴露程度的横截面差异进行差分分析。
AI.findings: 1) 暴露程度更高的银行收缩无担保贷款，信用卡应收账款收缩最显著；2) 收缩并非整体信贷下降，而是跨部门再配置；3) 信贷未流向未受监管的担保零售部门（尽管其资本费用更低），而是流向工业和服务业；4) 所有银行均资本充足，反应反映激励而非约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 发现定向资本冲击下的信贷再配置并非由资本成本最小化主导，偏离了银行-wide资本冲击研究中发现的向低风险权重资产再平衡的模式，揭示了定向监管与宽泛监管的不同传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观审慎政策制定者提供组合特定资本监管如何重塑银行信贷构成的实证证据，表明定向资本监管会以宽泛资本要求所不能的方式影响信贷配置，对政策设计具有直接启示。

title: Text-Based Risk Similarity and Economic Links
affiliations: Shanghai International Studies University and Central South University

detail.title: Text-Based Risk Similarity and Economic Links
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a text-based risk similarity measure using firms' risk disclosures, and documents a cross-stock momentum effect among firms with high similarity (“risk peers”). This measure cannot be subsumed by the well-documented cross-stock momentum patterns, and uncovers linkages not captured by existing economic link measures. The effects are stronger when: 1) focal firms receive less attention or have higher limits to arbitrage; 2) risk peers are not in the same industry; 3) there are changes in risk disclosure. The predictability also extends to higher-order moments of returns. Overall, similarity in risk disclosures offers a broad and informative lens for identifying firm-level economic links and their implications for cross-stock return predictability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用公司风险披露文本构建风险相似度指标，识别出"风险同行"公司间的横截面股票动量效应，该效应无法被已有动量模式所解释，且揭示了现有经济关联指标未捕捉到的联系。
AI.research_question: 基于公司风险披露文本构建的风险相似度指标能否识别出新的经济关联，并产生可预测的横截面股票回报效应？
AI.motivation: 现有经济关联指标（如行业分类、供应链关系等）无法全面捕捉企业间的经济联系，而风险披露文本包含了丰富的企业特质信息，可能提供更广泛的企业关联视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息扩散理论、横截面动量效应、有限关注与套利限制理论
AI.method: 基于文本分析构建风险披露相似度指标，通过投资组合分析和横截面回归检验风险同行之间的动量效应，并进行多种异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 风险同行间存在显著的横截面动量效应；2) 该效应无法被已有动量模式所涵盖；3) 效应在焦点公司关注度低、套利限制高时更强；4) 效应在风险同行非同行业时更强；5) 风险披露变化时效应增强；6) 可预测收益的高阶矩。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了经济关联识别的理论框架，将文本披露信息纳入资产定价模型，丰富了横截面动量效应的驱动机制理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了一种新的选股信号和风险管理工具，帮助企业识别潜在的风险传导渠道，对公司治理和风险管理实践具有启示意义。

title: CAN-ECS: A Syntactic Control Layer for Trust Propagation in Increasingly Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems

detail.title: CAN-ECS: A Syntactic Control Layer for Trust Propagation in Increasingly Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with people or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this work. This research was conducted independently under XWHYZ/WHYLD, an independent research practice founded and directed by the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical protocol-design study and did not involve human participants, personal data, animal subjects, or any research activity requiring ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Decentralized trust propagation protocols for autonomous multi-agent systems (e.g., DTPP-Ω) constrain which trust state transitions are valid but typically leave the representational medium of inter-agent communication unconstrained. As agent capability increases-including the possibility of gradual behavioral drift in agents operating over long time horizons-unconstrained natural-language communication between agents creates two risks: semantic drift (meaning shifting gradually across repeated interactions without any single invalid message) and an unnecessarily large expressive attack surface (ambiguity, authority mimicry, scope laundering, and related manipulation patterns that a constrained grammar cannot express). This paper presents CAN-ECS (Compact Assertion Notation-Evolving Control System), a design hypothesis for a fixed, versioned, humanand-agent-legible notation grammar intended to function as part of a multi-agent trust protocol's control boundary, not merely as a compression convenience. We present the architecture as nine falsifiable subhypotheses (H1-H9), a corrected verification-escalation formalism, a multi-dimensional Sybil-resistant riskaggregation rule aligned to DTPP-Ω's existing coalition-detection pattern, and an explicit boundary discipline (H9) distinguishing bounded admission-control risk accounting from the global trust scores that decentralized trust protocols typically prohibit. We report this as a design hypothesis at the pre-implementation stage: several structural defects identified during internal review are documented alongside their corrections, and a concrete evaluation plan and falsification conditions are specified for future empirical work. AI Use Disclosure The author originated the problem framing, the integration target (DTPP-Ω), the non-negotiable design constraints (e.g., no runtime-extensible grammar, §2.3), and every design decision, mechanism, and correction presented in this paper. An AI assistant was used for manuscript drafting and language, for structuring the document, and for mechanical consistency-checking of the author's own stated formulas against their worked examples-this check surfaced an internal formatting inconsistency between a formula and an illustrative table in an earlier design iteration, which the author then corrected (§6.2). The author reviewed, directed, and is solely responsible for all content, conclusions, and claims in this paper. AI use here was confined to drafting, structuring, and consistency support, and did not substitute for the author's own analysis, design decisions, or research direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAN-ECS，一种固定的、版本化的、人类和智能体可读的符号语法，作为多智能体去中心化信任传播协议（如DTPP-Ω）的控制边界，以应对自然语言通信导致的语义漂移和表达攻击面过大的两类风险。论文以九个可证伪子假设（H1-H9）的形式呈现架构，并给出了修正的验证升级形式体系、抗Sybil风险聚合规则及边界纪律，目前处于预实现的设计假设阶段。
AI.research_question: 如何为去中心化信任传播协议中的多智能体通信设计一种受限的符号语法，以同时降低语义漂移风险和缩小表达攻击面，同时保持与现有信任协议（如DTPP-Ω）的集成兼容性？
AI.motivation: 现有的去中心化信任传播协议（如DTPP-Ω）约束了信任状态转换的合法性，但未约束智能体间通信的表示媒介。随着智能体能力的增强（包括长期运行中的逐步行为漂移），无约束的自然语言通信会产生两类风险：（1）语义漂移——含义在重复交互中逐渐改变，没有任何单条消息是不合法的；（2）表达攻击面过大——模糊性、权威模仿、范围清洗等操纵模式在受限语法下无法表达，但在自然语言中却可发生。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文基于去中心化信任传播协议、控制边界（control boundary）理论、可证伪假设框架、形式化验证-升级体系（verification-escalation formalism）、Sybil抵抗风险聚合及对抗性设计等理论视角。
AI.method: 设计/假设研究方法：以九个可证伪子假设（H1-H9）形式化呈现CAN-ECS架构，包含固定版本化语法设计、修正的验证升级形式体系、多维抗Sybil风险聚合规则（对齐DTPP-Ω的联盟检测模式），以及明确的边界纪律（H9）。当前处于预实现阶段，内部审查中发现的若干结构缺陷及其修正被记录，并给出了具体的评估计划和证伪条件。
AI.findings: 论文报告了预实现阶段的设计假设结果：识别了自然语言通信在信任协议中的两类核心风险（语义漂移和表达攻击面过大）；提出了CAN-ECS作为九个子假设的架构设计；记录了内部审查中发现的若干结构缺陷及其修正（包括公式与表格之间的格式不一致问题）；明确了未来实证工作的评估计划和证伪条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：（1）将通信表示媒介的约束纳入去中心化信任协议的控制边界，而非仅作为压缩便利；（2）提出九个子假设（H1-H9）的形式化架构，为后续实证检验提供可证伪的理论基础；（3）引入边界纪律（H9），将有限制的准入控制风险核算与去中心化信任协议通常禁止的全局信任评分区分开来；（4）修正了验证升级形式体系中的形式化缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：（1）提供了一种可版本化、人类和智能体均可读的紧凑符号语法（CAN-ECS），可直接集成到现有信任协议（如DTPP-Ω）中作为控制边界；（2）通过受限语法缩小了操纵攻击面，降低了语义漂移带来的长期信任退化风险；（3）给出了具体的评估计划和证伪条件，为后续实证实施提供了清晰的路径指引。

title: Information Diffusion and Return Predictability across Business and Ownership Networks: Evidence from Korea
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University and Department of Fintech, SKK Business School, Sungkyunkwan University

detail.title: Information Diffusion and Return Predictability across Business and Ownership Networks: Evidence from Korea
detail.abstract: We examine return predictability across economically connected firms and ask whether control-based ownership linkages contain incremental information beyond business-relatedness. Using Korean-listed firms, we construct annually updated business networks from annual-report disclosures using term frequency--inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) and large language model (LLM) embeddings. We also construct control-based ownership networks from largest-shareholder records and business-group affiliations. Lagged peer returns from both layers predict focal-firm returns and generate positive risk-adjusted portfolio returns. In joint Fama-MacBeth regressions, business-only, ownership-only, and overlapping peer-return signals remain significant, while bidirectional spanning tests show that neither network subsumes the other. Point estimates are larger among KOSDAQ firms, and business-network predictability is stronger when ownership is diffuse. Although these cross-sectional patterns are descriptive, the overall evidence is consistent with the gradual incorporation of peer information into prices across both business and control-based ownership links.

AI.tldr: 本文研究经济关联企业之间的收益可预测性，探讨基于控制权的所有权关联是否在商业关联之外提供增量信息。利用韩国上市公司数据，通过TF-IDF和大语言模型嵌入构建年度更新的商业网络，同时基于最大股东记录和企业集团隶属关系构建所有权网络。研究发现两个网络的滞后同行收益均能预测焦点企业收益并产生正的风险调整组合收益，且两种网络信号在联合检验中均保持显著，表明网络间不可相互替代。
AI.research_question: 基于控制权的所有权关联是否包含超越商业关联的收益可预测性增量信息？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常分别考察商业关联或所有权关联对收益预测的影响，但缺乏对两种关联网络在收益可预测性上相对贡献的系统比较。作者希望厘清控制权关联是否在商业关联之上提供额外的信息价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息逐渐融入价格假说（gradual information incorporation）、经济关联网络与收益可预测性理论
AI.method: 利用韩国上市公司数据，使用TF-IDF和LLM嵌入从年报披露中构建年度商业网络；从最大股东记录和企业集团隶属信息构建控制权所有权网络；采用滞后同行收益预测焦点企业收益、Fama-MacBeth联合回归、双向跨度检验等实证方法。
AI.findings: 1）商业网络和所有权网络的滞后同行收益均能预测焦点企业收益并产生正的风险调整组合收益；2）在联合Fama-MacBeth回归中，纯商业、纯所有权和重叠的同行收益信号均保持显著；3）双向跨度检验显示两种网络互不包含；4）KOSDAQ企业的点估计更大；5）所有权分散时商业网络预测力更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了控制权所有权关联网络与商业关联网络在收益可预测性上具有互补而非替代关系，丰富了信息传播机制的理论理解，表明同行信息通过多种经济渠道逐渐融入股价。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了结合商业网络和所有权网络的综合同行信号构建方法，有助于改善投资组合收益；也为监管者和市场参与者理解企业间信息传递机制提供了参考。

title: Federated Brains: An Operating Pattern for Governed AI Adoption in Organisations

detail.title: Federated Brains: An Operating Pattern for Governed AI Adoption in Organisations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of GustoMind.ai (Gusto Mind Ltd), which provides advisory services relating to the operating pattern described in this paper, and is also employed by the University of Bath. The implementation observations reported in Section 8 arise from work carried out in that commercial capacity. This commercial interest is disclosed in Section 8.1 of the paper and should be weighed by the reader. No other personal or financial relationships have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper reports no study involving patients or participants, and makes no validation claims. The implementation observations in Section 8 are illustrative practice observations drawn from the author's own firm and from client engagements, reported at a structural level only, with client identity withheld and no individuals identified.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Organisations adopting generative and agentic AI confront a recurring governance dilemma early in deployment: unconstrained autonomy produces fragmented, individually tied assets that decay when their creators depart, while centralised control suppresses precisely the edge-level innovation that identifies viable use cases — or displaces it into unmonitored shadow use. This paper names the dilemma and proposes a resolution observed and refined in practice: a deliberately minimal, centrally owned frame — comprising a short doctrine, a shared platform, an asset registry with ownership succession, and a promotion path — inside which teams build freely. The organisation's knowledge base is treated not as a repository but as a managed system (the "managed brain"), curated by a small steward function, and federated across organisational levels: team-level brains inherit shared context downward, while proven assets are promoted upward through stewardship review. The pattern is grounded in Nonaka and Takeuchi's knowledge-creation spiral, which it operationalises: AI-assisted work externalises tacit judgement as recorded decisions and rationale; stewardship combines them into governed organisational assets; consuming teams internalise them through AI-mediated work. Propositions are developed regarding compounding, succession risk, and adoption incentives, drawing on the author's implementations in micro and small firms and on a structural observation from the leadership team of a large enterprise.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了组织在部署生成式AI和代理式AI时面临的治理两难：无约束的自主性导致碎片化的个人资产且随创始人离开而衰退，而集中控制则抑制边缘创新并导致影子使用。作者提出一种实践中验证的解决方案——最小化但集中所有的"框架"（包含简短原则、共享平台、资产注册表和晋升路径），在此框架内团队可自由构建。该模式将组织知识库视为"受管理的头脑"（managed brain），通过小型管理功能进行策展，并在组织层级间进行联邦式管理。
AI.research_question: 组织在早期部署生成式和代理式AI时，如何解决"无约束自主性导致资产碎片化"与"集中控制抑制边缘创新并导致影子使用"之间的治理两难？
AI.motivation: 组织在采用生成式和代理式AI时面临一个反复出现的治理困境：完全放任自主会产生碎片化、个人绑定的资产（创作者离职即衰败），而过度集中控制则会压制边缘创新（边缘创新恰恰能识别可行用例），甚至将其推入不受监控的影子使用。这一两难尚未被命名和系统解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以Nonaka和Takeuchi的知识创造螺旋理论为基础，将其操作化：AI辅助工作将隐性判断外化为记录决策和理由；管理功能将其整合为受治理的组织资产；消费团队通过AI中介工作将其内化。
AI.method: 基于作者在微型和小型企业中的实施实践，以及对一家大型企业领导团队的结构性观察，提出关于复利效应、继任风险和采用激励的命题。
AI.findings: 提出了一种在实践中观察并精炼的解决方案：最小化但集中所有的框架——包含简短原则（doctrine）、共享平台、带所有权继承的资产注册表、以及晋升路径——在此框架内团队可自由构建。组织知识库被视为受管理的系统（"managed brain"），由小型管理功能策展，并在组织层级间联邦化：团队级头脑向下继承共享上下文，经验证的资产通过管理审查向上晋升。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Nonaka和Takeuchi的知识创造螺旋理论操作化于生成式和代理式AI的治理语境中，为AI时代的知识管理提供了"受管理的头脑"这一概念框架，填补了AI治理两难缺乏系统化理论回应的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了可操作的AI治理框架——最小化集中框架（原则+平台+注册表+晋升路径），以及联邦式知识管理的实施模式，帮助组织在保持边缘创新的同时避免资产碎片化，并降低关键人员离职带来的知识损失风险。

title: Low-Latency Limit Order Book Reconstruction and Real-Time Market Data Analytics Using kdb+/q: A Single-Process Benchmark Harness and a Proposed Production Architecture

detail.title: Low-Latency Limit Order Book Reconstruction and Real-Time Market Data Analytics Using kdb+/q: A Single-Process Benchmark Harness and a Proposed Production Architecture
detail.abstract: High-frequency trading generates massive streams of market events that must be processed with minimal latency to maintain an accurate limit order book (LOB) and to support real-time analytics. This paper reports on a fully in-memory, single-process kdb+/q benchmark harness for LOB reconstruction and microstructure analytics, and separately proposes how that harness maps onto a production-grade tickerplant/realtime-database/historical-database/gateway (TP/RDB/HDB/Gateway) architecture of the kind used in live market-data systems. On the implemented harness, we progressively apply a set of qspecific optimizations-vectorized column operations, correctlyscoped table attributes (s, u, g, p), an as-of join (aj) for tradeto-book analytics alignment, functional-q query construction, and event batching-and measure their effect on an synthetic event stream calibrated to NASDAQ ITCH-like distributions, together with a 500-million-event ITCH validation sample. All latency, throughput, memory, and correctness figures reported here are unchanged from the underlying experiments: the fully optimized single-process configuration reaches a p99 processing latency of 92 µs at 1 M events/s, reduces p99.9 tail latency by more than 90% relative to a naive event-loop baseline, and sustains 4.8 M events/s. Correctness is verified against a reference Python implementation over 100 M replayed events. Building on this implemented and measured core, we present a proposed TP/RDB/HDB/gateway architecture-covering IPC, end-of-day rollover, splayed/partitioned/ segmented HDB storage, and multicore scaling via peach-and we are explicit throughout about which parts of the paper are implemented and measured, which are implemented but scope-limited, and which are proposed design or future experimental work. The result is a reusable blueprint for how a single-process kdb+/q research prototype extends into a production low-latency market-data system.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个完全内存、单进程的kdb+/q基准测试框架，用于限价订单簿重建和微观结构分析，并提出将其扩展到生产级TP/RDB/HDB/Gateway架构的设计蓝图。通过一系列q语言优化（向量化操作、表属性、as-of join、函数式查询、事件批处理），在合成NASDAQ ITCH风格事件流和5亿事件验证样本上实现了p99处理延迟92µs（100万事件/秒）、p99.9尾延迟降低90%以上、持续吞吐480万事件/秒的性能。正确性通过1亿事件与Python参考实现验证。
AI.research_question: 如何通过kdb+/q的特定优化手段，在单进程中构建高性能的限价订单簿重建与微观结构分析系统，并将其架构扩展到生产级市场数据系统？
AI.motivation: 高频交易产生海量市场事件流，需要以极低延迟处理以维护准确的限价订单簿并支持实时分析。现有研究中缺乏对kdb+/q语言级优化手段在LOB重建场景中系统性的量化评估，也缺乏从研究原型到生产架构的完整映射蓝图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 限价订单簿（LOB）重建理论、kdb+/q语言的列式存储与向量化处理模型、微观结构分析（trade-to-book对齐）方法。
AI.method: 构建单进程kdb+/q基准测试框架，在合成NASDAQ ITCH风格事件流和5亿事件真实ITCH验证样本上，逐步应用六类q优化（向量化列操作、表属性s/u/g/p、as-of join、函数式查询、事件批处理），测量延迟、吞吐、内存和正确性指标；然后提出并讨论TP/RDB/HDB/Gateway生产架构映射方案。
AI.findings: 完全优化的单进程配置在100万事件/秒负载下达到p99处理延迟92µs；相比朴素事件循环基线，p99.9尾延迟降低超过90%；持续吞吐达480万事件/秒；通过1亿事件与Python参考实现验证正确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了各种kdb+/q语言级优化在LOB重建场景中的性能贡献，为基于列式数据库的实时市场数据处理提供了可复用的方法论和评估基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个从单进程研究原型扩展到生产级TP/RDB/HDB/Gateway架构的完整蓝图，涵盖IPC、日终rollover、splayed/partitioned/segmented存储和多核扩展（peach），并明确区分了已实现测量、范围受限实现与建议设计部分，可直接指导实际系统开发。

title: “Apani Dukaan” as a Governed Platform Architecture for Household Economics, Eligibility, and Payments-First Inclusive Commerce in India
affiliations: and Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapeeth (MGKVP)

detail.title: “Apani Dukaan” as a Governed Platform Architecture for Household Economics, Eligibility, and Payments-First Inclusive Commerce in India
detail.abstract:
Paper 1 established Apani Dukaan as an inclusive business and entrepreneurial ecosystem with a payments-first logic, operating at the intersection of entrepreneurship, financial inclusion, social inclusion, and poverty alleviation (Pandey and Tripathi, 2026a). Paper 2 moves from this conceptual justification to an operating model and asks how such a system can be made workable in practice. The central issue is no longer whether the idea is socially meaningful, but how it can be organised so that it is transparent, disciplined, auditable, and scalable.

This paper argues that Apani Dukaan’s developmental promise depends on turning the concept into a governed platform with clear rules for household participation, payment pathways, role allocation, and exception handling. Without such structure, a payments-first inclusive business risks becoming either too informal to scale or too rigid to remain inclusive. The paper therefore defines the architecture and operating logic that make the model viable, and shows how these design elements operationalise the four-dimensional framework introduced in Paper 1.

The paper contributes to the Apani Dukaan series in three ways. First, it explains the platform as a multi-layered institutional system rather than a single storefront or loan product, aligning with inclusive business literature that emphasises value-chain integration, commercially viable design, and ecosystem coordination. Second, it identifies the workflow and governance logic required to support inclusive commerce at scale, drawing on financial inclusion critiques that stress product design, consumer protection, and institutional quality. Third, it sets the foundation for later papers in the series that will address household scoring, policy and compliance, ERP design, and social return on investment (SROI) measurement. In doing so, Paper 2 acts as a bridge between the conceptual case made in Paper 1 and the empirical and technical work that will follow.

AI.tldr: 本文是Apani Dukaan系列论文的第二篇，从第一篇文章的概念性论证转向运营模式设计，探讨如何将支付优先的包容性商业平台构建为可治理、透明、有纪律、可审计且可扩展的制度系统，并为其后续的实证与技术工作奠定基础。
AI.research_question: 如何将Apani Dukaan这一包容性商业和创业生态系统从概念论证转化为可运作的运营模式，使其具备透明性、纪律性、可审计性和可扩展性？
AI.motivation: 第一篇文章已确立了Apani Dukaan的社会意义与概念合理性，但核心问题已从"这个想法是否具有社会意义"转向"如何组织该系统使其可行"。若缺乏治理结构，支付优先的包容性商业可能要么过于非正式而无法规模化，要么过于僵化而失去包容性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文借鉴了包容性商业文献（强调价值链整合、商业可行性设计和生态系统协调）以及金融包容性批评（强调产品设计、消费者保护和制度质量）两大理论框架。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性/理论性分析方法，定义平台的架构和运营逻辑，阐述如何通过具体设计要素将第一篇文章提出的四维框架（创业、金融包容、社会包容、减贫）操作化。
AI.findings: 本文认为Apani Dukaan的发展承诺取决于将其转化为一个治理良好的平台，需要明确家庭参与规则、支付路径、角色分配和例外处理机制。该平台应被理解为一个多层次的制度系统，而非单一的店面或贷款产品。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文有三个理论贡献：（1）将平台阐释为多层次制度系统，与包容性商业文献中的价值链整合和生态系统协调观点一致；（2）识别了支持大规模包容性商业所需的工作流程和治理逻辑；（3）为系列后续论文（家庭评分、政策合规、ERP设计、SROI测量）奠定概念基础，充当概念论证与实证技术工作之间的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为Apani Dukaan的实际运营提供了平台架构和治理逻辑的清晰设计蓝图，明确了家庭参与、支付路径、角色分配和例外处理的规则体系，使其运营具备透明性、纪律性、可审计性和可扩展性，为后续技术与实证实施提供了操作框架。

title: Semantic Physical Unification for Humanoid Systems: A Mathematical Framework

detail.title: Semantic Physical Unification for Humanoid Systems: A Mathematical Framework
detail.abstract: Unlike hybrid systems, control barrier functions, shielded reinforcement learning, and assume guarantee verification, which govern modules or enforce local invariants, Industry-10.0 governs semantic physical state evolution by defining admissibility on the measurable product space X := X p × Z s (physical state × operational semantics) and by introducing a global admissibility operator K gov. Concretely, K gov is the greatest fixed point of a measurable preimage operator Φ on the subobject lattice Sub(X)-equivalently, the viability kernel of the joint semantic physical system under specified disturbance and latency bounds. Operational semantics Z s is a finite collection of typed variables and measurable belief distributions (language goals, symbolic task graphs, typed affordances, annotated latent vectors). All guarantees are stated for bounded environments and task classes. Certificateable conditions are proved under explicit assumptions: a Lipschitz grounding map φ : Z s → X p , bounded latencies, and bounded disturbances. A decidable convex fragment enables polynomial time admissibility checks, and a receding horizon approximate verifier is provided for the general nonlinear case. A complete constructive counterexample demonstrates the expressivity gap between local module level verification and the global admissibility operator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Industry-10.0框架，通过全局可容许性算子K_gov在可测乘积空间（物理状态×操作语义）上定义语义物理状态演化的可容许性，以超越传统局部模块级验证方法（如控制屏障函数、屏蔽强化学习等），实现全局语义物理系统的形式化验证。
AI.research_question: 如何从全局层面形式化定义和验证语义物理系统的状态演化可容许性，以克服局部模块级验证方法的表达力局限？
AI.motivation: 现有方法（混合系统、控制屏障函数、屏蔽强化学习、假设-保证验证）仅管理模块或强制局部不变性，缺乏对系统全局语义物理状态演化的形式化治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可测乘积空间X := X_p × Z_s（物理状态×操作语义），定义全局可容许性算子K_gov为可测预image算子Φ在子对象格Sub(X)上的最大不动点（等价于联合语义物理系统在指定扰动和延迟界下的可行性核/viability kernel）。
AI.method: 通过Lipschitz接地映射φ: Z_s → X_p、有界延迟、有界扰动等显式假设建立可证明条件；提出可判定凸片段支持多项式时间可容许性检查；为一般非线性情形提供滚动时域近似验证器；通过构造性反例证明表达力差距。
AI.findings: 1) 在有界环境和任务类别下，全局可容许性算子K_gov可证明地界定语义物理系统的状态演化；2) 可判定凸片段支持多项式时间的可容许性检查；3) 滚动时域近似验证器适用于一般非线性情形；4) 构造性反例揭示了局部模块级验证与全局可容许性算子之间的表达力差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Industry-10.0这一新兴治理范式，将验证从局部模块级提升到全局语义物理层面；建立了全局可容许性算子与可行性核之间的形式化等价联系；严格刻画了局部验证与全局验证之间的表达力边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了多项式时间可判定的凸片段算法用于实际可容许性检查；为一般非线性系统提供了滚动时域近似验证工具；为工业系统全局语义物理安全治理提供了可操作的验证框架。

title: Regulation of Cryptocurrencies in Uganda: Policy Issues and Considerations
affiliations: Mawazo Policy Institute

detail.title: Regulation of Cryptocurrencies in Uganda: Policy Issues and Considerations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper is an analysis of the policy issues to be considered in framing any regulatory mechanism. The paper proceeds in six parts. Part one is the introduction. Part two is a primer on cryptocurrencies explaining what they are and how they function. Part three covers cryptocurrency use in Uganda. Part four examines the current regulatory mechanisms for cryptocurrencies such as monetary regulation, electronic transaction regulation and taxation. Part five looks at the policy issues to be borne in mind by policy makers as they frame future regulation. Part six deals with the legal issues surrounding cryptocurrency use in Uganda. The conclusion notes that blocking cryptocurrencies is almost impossible therefore regulation is the only alternative.

AI.tldr: 本文分析框架加密货币监管机制时需考虑的政策问题，以乌干达为案例，探讨加密货币的本质、使用现状、现行监管机制以及未来政策制定中的关键议题，结论认为彻底封禁加密货币几乎不可能，监管是唯一可行的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 在制定加密货币监管机制时，政策制定者需要考虑哪些政策与法律问题？
AI.motivation: 加密货币在全球迅速普及，但在乌干达等发展中国家对其监管框架的研究不足。由于封禁加密货币几乎不可能，亟需探索合理的监管路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该文主要采用政策分析与法律分析框架，涉及货币政策监管、电子交易监管以及税收监管等理论视角。
AI.method: 规范性政策分析方法，通过六个部分的结构化论述展开分析，包括概念解析、现状考察、现有机制梳理、政策议题识别与法律问题探讨。
AI.findings: 1) 加密货币在乌干达已有一定使用基础；2) 现行监管机制涵盖货币监管、电子交易监管和税收等多个层面；3) 封禁加密货币几乎不可能，因此需要以监管替代封禁。
AI.theory_contributions: 为加密货币监管研究提供了一个发展中国家（乌干达）的具体案例，系统梳理了监管框架设计中的政策议题和法律考量，丰富了加密货币治理的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了框架加密货币监管时需考虑的完整政策清单，包括货币监管、电子交易监管、税收等具体领域，有助于制定切实可行的监管方案。

title: The Roles of the Mass Media in Promoting Cybercrimes Among Undergraduates of Usmanu Danfodiyo University Sokoto in Sokoto State, Nigeria

detail.title: The Roles of the Mass Media in Promoting Cybercrimes Among Undergraduates of Usmanu Danfodiyo University Sokoto in Sokoto State, Nigeria
detail.abstract:
This study examined the role of mass media in promoting cybercrimes among undergraduate students of
Usmanu Danfodiyo University, Sokoto, Nigeria. Using a descriptive survey design, primary data were
collected from 249 respondents through a structured questionnaire. The sample comprised predominantly
male (83.5%), single (95.2%), and student (62.1%) respondents, with 66.1% aged 26–45 years and 89.1%
identifying as Islamic. Data were analyzed using SPSS Version 29, with results presented through frequency
distributions and pie charts.
Key findings revealed near-universal daily social media engagement (99.6%), with Facebook dominating
usage (69.8%) and 52.8% of respondents spending 4–6 hours daily online. In contrast, traditional media
consumption was low (25.8% daily TV/radio) and journal reading was minimal (67.3% never). Cybercrime
exposure was significant: 37.5% had encountered cybercrime, 36.7% were victims, and 42.3% knew a victim.
Critically, 99.2% believed that the portrayal of cybercrime in mass media affects their online risk, while 66.9%
strongly agreed that mass media contributes to the spread of cybercrime. However, only 44.8% were aware of
preventive measures, indicating a substantial knowledge gap.
The study concludes that mass media, particularly social media platforms serves as a double-edged sword:
It highlights awareness of cyber threats but simultaneously normalizes and glamorizes cybercriminal tactics,
thereby increasing vulnerability among digitally immersed undergraduates. Recommendations include
integrating cybercrime prevention education into university curricula, launching media literacy campaigns,
and promoting responsible content creation to counter sensationalized cybercrime narratives.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了尼日利亚索科托乌斯马努丹福迪奥大学本科生的网络犯罪情况，发现大众媒体（尤其是社交媒体）在提高网络威胁意识的同时，也通过正常化和美化网络犯罪手法增加了学生的网络风险，呼吁在大学课程中整合网络犯罪预防教育。
AI.research_question: 大众媒体在促进尼日利亚本科生网络犯罪中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 网络犯罪日益猖獗，大学生作为数字重度用户面临较高网络风险，但大众媒体在其中的作用机制尚不明确，尤其缺乏针对非洲发展中国家的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体效应理论（媒介涵化理论/社会学习理论），即媒体内容对受众认知和行为的影响。
AI.method: 描述性调查研究设计，通过结构化问卷收集249名受访者的一手数据，使用SPSS Version 29进行数据分析，通过频数分布和饼图呈现结果。
AI.findings: 社交媒体每日使用率高达99.6%，Facebook占主导（69.8%），52.8%每天上网4-6小时；传统媒体消费低（25.8%）。37.5%遇到过网络犯罪，36.7%曾是受害者，42.3%认识受害者。99.2%认为媒体对网络犯罪的描述影响其网络风险，66.9%强烈认同媒体助长网络犯罪传播。但仅44.8%了解预防措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证揭示媒体"双刃剑"效应：在唤起网络威胁意识的同时，也通过正常化和美化网络犯罪手法增加用户脆弱性，丰富了媒介效应理论在网络犯罪研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将网络犯罪预防教育纳入大学课程、开展媒体素养宣传活动、促进负责任的内容创作以对抗耸人听闻的网络犯罪叙事，为高校和媒体监管提供可操作的政策建议。

title: Own Your AI Before It Owns You: A Graph Theory of Civilization, and Its Only Two Futures

detail.title: Own Your AI Before It Owns You: A Graph Theory of Civilization, and Its Only Two Futures
detail.abstract: An AI that remembers a person becomes more useful with every interaction -- and more costly to leave. The accumulated model that carries this continuity is emerging as a new kind of asset. This paper asks a structural question: who ultimately controls it? Civilization is modeled as a graph of people, machines, and channels, with economic rent collecting wherever traffic has no practical way around. Six recurring patterns are drawn from two centuries of historical record. One -- the retreat -- says that when a tolling position is opened or commoditized, collection moves inward toward the next scarce position. Applied to the present AI buildout, that movement ends at the learned model of the individual: the "twin," the accumulated state that lets an AI know one person and preserve continuity over time. Copies multiply; final authority does not divide. The completeness theorem of secure multiparty computation removes a crucial technical constraint: useful computation on private state can occur without giving an intermediary custody of that state. A person can hold the keys while outside systems continue to provide useful computation, making genuine portability -- leaving without starting over -- technically possible. The two resulting futures are machine-side capture or person-side cryptographic key custody. Their keys or yours..

AI.tldr: 本文从结构性视角探讨一个根本问题：当AI持续记忆一个人并累积其个人模型（"数字孪生"）时，谁最终控制这一资产？作者将文明建模为人、机器和通道组成的图，其中经济租金聚集在流量无法绕行的位置。通过两百年历史中的六种模式，提出"撤退"模式：当收费站被开放或商品化时，收租向下一稀缺位置内移。将其应用于当前AI建设，这一移动终止于个人的学习模型——"孪生"。安全多方计算完全性定理揭示，对私有状态的有用计算可以不将状态托管给中介，使真正可移植性（离开而不从头开始）在技术上成为可能。最终未来是机器侧捕获或个人侧密码密钥托管。
AI.research_question: 当AI通过累积个人模型形成持续记忆时，谁最终控制这一新型资产？控制权落在机器侧还是个人侧？
AI.motivation: AI对个人的持续记忆使每个交互都更有价值，也使其更难以离开——累积的连续性模型正成为一种新型资产，但对其最终控制权的结构性分析尚属空白。这一问题的答案决定了AI时代的权力分配格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文明建模为图论框架（人、机器、通道），经济租金理论，六个历史模式（重点是"撤退"模式——收费站开放后收租内移的规律），安全多方计算完全性定理。
AI.method: 结构性问题分析：将文明抽象为图模型，从两百年历史记录中提取六种重复模式，将"撤退"模式应用于当前AI建设场景进行推演，并以安全多方计算的完全性定理作为关键技术约束的消除条件。
AI.findings: 当AI个人模型的收费站被开放或商品化时，收租会内移至下一个稀缺位置，最终落脚于个人的学习模型（"孪生"）。副本可无限复制，但最终权威不可分割。安全多方计算完全性定理证明：对私有状态的有用计算可以无需中介托管状态，人可持有密钥而外部系统继续提供计算服务，实现真正的可移植性。两个可能的未来是：机器侧捕获或个人侧密码密钥托管。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将历史经济租金模式（"撤退"规律）系统应用于AI个人数据资产的控制权分析；揭示安全多方计算完全性定理对个人数据主权理论的关键技术解放意义——消除"中介必须托管状态才能计算"这一隐含约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人数字主权的技术实现提供可行路径（密钥托管而非数据托管）；为政策制定者和AI平台设计者提供关于个人模型控制权的结构性预见；阐明"离开而不从头开始"（真正可移植性）在技术上是可实现的，从而影响产品设计、监管框架和用户权利讨论。

title: Policy Brief & Industry Handbook :Strategic Sectoral Mapping of Botswana's Draft AI Policy

detail.title: Policy Brief & Industry Handbook :Strategic Sectoral Mapping of Botswana's Draft AI Policy
detail.abstract: As the Government of Botswana advances toward finalizing its 1st National Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy, this brief acts as both a roadmap for policymakers and a strategic handbook for economic actors. Grounded in the foundational principle of Botho - that technology must elevate human agency and not replace it, this document outlines a unique framework for sovereign AI governance across Botswana’s 17 sectors and sub-sectors. We provide actionable steps to transform Botswana from a passive consumer of foreign technologies into an active creator of innovative and ethical artificial intelligence. Every organization, whether a local enterprise, investor, regional competitor, or an international partner can use this guide to evaluate what the draft AI Policy means for their operations.

AI.tldr: 本文档为博茨瓦纳政府制定首部国家人工智能政策提供路线图，以"Botho"（以人为本）原则为基础，提出主权AI治理框架，覆盖该国17个行业和子行业，旨在将博茨瓦纳从外国技术的被动消费者转变为创新和伦理人工智能的积极创造者。
AI.research_question: 博茨瓦纳应如何设计主权AI治理框架，使其从外国技术的被动消费者转变为创新和伦理AI的积极创造者？
AI.motivation: 博茨瓦纳政府正在推进其首部国家人工智能（AI）政策的最终定稿，需要一份既能指导政策制定者决策、又能为经济参与者提供战略参考的指南文件。
AI.theoretical_framework: "Botho"原则——强调技术必须提升人的自主性而非取代人，构建以人为中心的主权AI治理理念。
AI.method: 基于政策分析框架，提出覆盖博茨瓦纳17个行业和子行业的主权AI治理路线图，并提供可操作的步骤建议。
AI.findings: 提出了一个独特的主权AI治理框架，为地方企业、投资者、区域竞争对手和国际合作伙伴提供了评估AI政策草案对各自运营影响的指南。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非洲本土哲学原则"Botho"融入AI治理理论，提出了主权AI治理的新概念框架，丰富了发展中国家AI政策制定的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为博茨瓦纳政策制定者提供了可操作的AI政策路线图；为各类经济参与者（地方企业、投资者、区域竞争者和国际合作伙伴）提供了评估AI政策影响的实用指南。

title:
Proof is Stronger than Policy: 
Why Decision Evidence has become the Foundation of Modern Accountability
affiliations: Indiana University, Indianapolis - Indiana University Indianapolis and Indiana University, Indianapolis - Indiana University Indianapolis

detail.title:
Proof is Stronger than Policy: 
Why Decision Evidence has become the Foundation of Modern Accountability
detail.abstract:
Organizations have historically demonstrated accountability through policies, procedures, compliance programs, accreditation standards, audits, and regulatory oversight. These governance mechanisms remain indispensable because they establish expectations, allocate authority, promote consistency, and define organizational responsibilities. However, they share a common limitation: they primarily communicate how consequential decisions should be made rather than preserving evidence explaining how those decisions were made.

As artificial intelligence (AI), predictive analytics, automation, enterprise decision-support systems, and complex information environments become increasingly integrated into organizational operations, expectations for accountability are changing. Courts, regulators, governing boards, insurers, accrediting organizations, shareholders, and the public may require organizations to demonstrate not only that governance structures existed, but how authority was exercised in consequential decision-making. Increasingly, organizations are expected to demonstrate how authority was exercised, what information informed consequential decisions, how professional judgment interacted with technological recommendations, and why one course of action was selected over another.

This paper argues that accountability is undergoing a fundamental transformation from policy-centered governance, which emphasizes organizational intent, toward evidence-centered governance, which emphasizes reconstructable proof explaining how consequential decisions were made. The paper introduces the Proof Pyramid, an original conceptual model developed by Fleming and Broaddus illustrating the progression from Policy → Procedure → Documentation → Decision Evidence → Proof. The model proposes that accountability exists along an evidentiary continuum in which each successive level provides greater explanatory value regarding organizational decision-making.

Within this framework, Justice Decision Observability™ (JDO™) is introduced as the operational methodology through which decision evidence is systematically generated. Rather than evaluating whether decisions were correct or auditing technological performance, Justice Decision Observability documents the execution layer of governance by preserving the interaction among organizational policy, contextual conditions, available information, human judgment, supervisory oversight, and technology-supported recommendations.

Unlike traditional governance models that primarily evaluate organizational preparedness or procedural compliance, the framework advanced in this paper focuses on reconstructability—the organization's ability to explain, through contemporaneous evidence, how consequential decisions were actually made.

The authors conclude that the future of accountability will increasingly depend not upon the quantity of organizational policy but upon the quality of organizational evidence. Policies remain essential because they establish expectations. Proof has become essential because it demonstrates accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出问责制正从以政策为中心的治理向以证据为中心的治理转变，并引入"证据金字塔"（Proof Pyramid）概念模型和"司法决策可观测性"（Justice Decision Observability™, JDO™）方法，主张组织需要通过可重建的同期证据来证明重大决策是如何做出的，而非仅仅依赖政策和程序的存在。
AI.research_question: 在AI、预测分析和复杂信息环境日益融入组织运营的背景下，组织的问责机制应如何转型以适应对决策过程可解释性的新要求？
AI.motivation: 传统治理机制（政策、程序、合规项目、审计等）主要传达决策应如何做出，而非保留解释决策如何做出的证据。随着AI等技术融入决策过程，法院、监管机构、董事会、股东和公众越来越要求组织展示权力如何被行使、信息如何被使用、专业判断与技术建议如何互动，因此需要新的问责框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出两个核心概念：（1）证据金字塔（Proof Pyramid），由Fleming和Broaddus开发，展示从政策→程序→文件→决策证据→证明的递进关系；（2）司法决策可观测性（Justice Decision Observability™, JDO™）作为系统生成决策证据的操作方法。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，提出原创概念模型并进行论证性分析。
AI.findings: 问责制的未来将越来越取决于组织证据的质量而非组织政策的数量。政策仍然必要，因为它们建立期望；但证明（Proof）已成为必要，因为它展示问责。组织需要沿证据连续性光谱逐步提升，每一层级提供更高的决策解释价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"证据金字塔"（Proof Pyramid）原创概念模型，将问责从政策中心范式转向证据中心范式，引入了"可重建性"（reconstructability）作为问责的核心标准，并提出了JDO™作为系统化生成决策证据的操作方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了从政策导向治理转向证据导向治理的实践路径：通过保留组织政策、上下文条件、可用信息、人类判断、监督监督和技术支持建议之间的交互，使组织能够以同期证据向法院、监管者、董事会、保险公司、认证机构和公众解释重大决策的实际做出过程。

title: Rebuilding Ratios: AI Distortion in Value Measurement

detail.title: Rebuilding Ratios: AI Distortion in Value Measurement
detail.abstract:
Firms are building their first broadly institutionalized generation of AI value measures: return on investment, cost per outcome, output per employee, spend as a share of revenue or operating cost, utilization, deflection, and new consumption based procurement benchmarks. The arithmetic of these ratios is familiar. The objects being divided increasingly are not. This paper argues that AI driven change in the objects of measurement, the baseline, population, unit, reference point, or economic relationship beneath a ratio, does not itself constitute distortion; distortion arises when the change violates a comparability assumption required to interpret the measure as evidence of value and remains unrecognized or unadjusted. The resulting number can be accurate in its observations yet economically misleading in its comparison.

Four mechanisms recur. First, the measure can become coupled to the measured: successful automation changes the headcount or cost base against which AI spend and productivity are judged. Second, populations can sort themselves: automation absorbs tractable work and leaves humans a progressively harder residual, making both machine and human averages move for compositional reasons. Third, units can drift beneath stable names: a token, task, conversation, or resolved case can change materially in capability, complexity, compute, or human involvement while continuing to be counted as the same unit. Fourth, the unit of trade itself can migrate, as seat based software economics give way to credits, actions, conversations, and other consumption units that are not directly comparable across vendors or time.

These mechanisms matter because value measurement requires more than accurate observations; it requires economically valid matching, and the matching fails from two directions. The mechanisms alter the economic objects being measured. Structural features of AI economics, benefits lagging the investment vintages that created them, capital and expense scattered across owners and accounting treatments, determine whether the right objects are joined at all. Together they can break the match between current benefits and prior investment, between reported spend and the full economic capital employed, between treatment and counterfactual populations, and between nominal units across periods. The consequences extend beyond noisy dashboards. Distorted measures can create false scale and false stop decisions, budget whipsaws, incentive and procurement errors, gaming without false reporting, self reinforcing allocation loops, and ultimately loss of confidence in management information.

NPV, IRR, ROIC, payback, and unit economics remain useful when their inputs refer to comparable economic objects. The practical task is therefore to rebuild the ratios: version the reference, condition the population, match costs, benefits, capital, and time, normalize to stable outcomes where possible, and separate ex post performance measurement from ex ante decision measurement. AI does not make ratios obsolete. It makes their construction consequential.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI价值衡量指标（如ROI、成本/产出、人均产出等比率）在AI时代面临的失真问题。作者认为AI驱动的衡量对象（基线、人口、单位、参照点或经济关系）变化本身并非扭曲，但当这种变化违反可比性假设且未被识别或调整时，就会产生经济上具有误导性的衡量结果。文章识别出四种反复出现的机制：衡量指标与被衡量对象的耦合、人口的自选择、单位在稳定名称下的漂移、交易单位本身的迁移，并指出这些机制会破坏经济对象匹配，导致虚假规模、错误止损决策、预算震荡等后果。
AI.research_question: AI时代的价值衡量比率在哪些机制下会失真？当衡量对象变化违反可比性假设时，会如何导致经济上误导性的决策？
AI.motivation: 企业正在构建第一代制度化AI价值衡量指标（ROI、成本/产出、人均产出等），但这些比率所衡量的经济对象正在快速变化。理解这些变化何时构成扭曲、何时不构成扭曲，对于避免决策错误至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可比性假设理论——衡量指标作为价值证据需要经济层面的有效匹配，而不仅是准确的观测。文章区分了测量对象的改变（本身不构成扭曲）与违反可比性假设（构成扭曲）之间的界限。
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论阐述，通过识别四种反复出现的失真机制（耦合、自选择、单位漂移、交易迁移）以及两种匹配失败方向，建立分析框架。
AI.findings: 四种机制导致价值测量失真：(1)指标与被测量对象的耦合；(2)人口的自选择（自动化吸收简单工作，留下更难的残余）；(3)单位在稳定名称下漂移（token、任务、对话等的实质内容变化）；(4)交易单位迁移（从seat许可转向credits、actions等不可比消费单位）。这些机制会导致收益与投资错配、报告支出与全部经济资本错配、处理组与反事实组错配、跨期名义单位不可比。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出衡量扭曲的新定义框架：区分"衡量对象的变化"与"违反可比性假设"的差异；识别四种系统性失真机制；将NPV、IRR、ROIC等传统比率分析延伸至AI经济学背景下的可比性重建问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供实践性的指标重建方法论：版本化参照系、条件化人口、匹配成本收益资本与时间、归一化到稳定产出、区分事后绩效衡量与事前决策衡量。帮助管理者避免虚假规模、错误止损、预算震荡、激励与采购错误、游戏化行为等陷阱。

title: REAL-AI: AI Competence for Accountability-bearing Enterprise Roles - A Working Note on the Conceptual Framework

detail.title: REAL-AI: AI Competence for Accountability-bearing Enterprise Roles - A Working Note on the Conceptual Framework
detail.abstract: The two predominant approaches for artificial intelligence (AI) competence, AI Literacy and AI Fluency, have produced validated competence instruments, but neither was designed for professionals whose AI-augmented decisions carry organizational accountability. This note sets out, in compact form, the logic by which REAL-AI (Reflexive, Enacted, Applied, Literate AI) competence, reflected through a four-layer, nine-dimension framework, is derived from that gap. This working note presents the derivation as an explicit chain that builds on a literature gap, identifies design implications and potential architectural features, and summarizes them in a traceability table to ensure that the originality claim of the framework is grounded through a specific, verifiable structure. A more comprehensive discursive treatment, with the underlying evidentiary argument, is planned for a separate conference paper; this note intends to establish the architecture and scope of the framework on the record ahead of that publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REAL-AI（反思性、实践性、应用性、素养性人工智能）能力框架，该框架通过四层九维结构填补了现有AI素养与AI流畅度理论在面向专业决策者（其AI增强决策需承担组织责任）方面的空白。本文以工作说明的形式，明确呈现了从文献缺口到框架设计的推导链条，并通过可追溯性表格验证框架的原创性主张。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个面向承担组织责任的专业决策者的AI能力框架，以弥补现有AI素养与AI流畅度框架在此场景中的不足？
AI.motivation: 现有两种主流AI能力方法（AI素养与AI流畅度）虽然各自开发了经过验证的能力测量工具，但都未针对那些AI增强决策承载组织问责制的专业人士进行设计，存在明显的理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: REAL-AI能力框架：由四层（反思性Reflexive、实践性Enacted、应用性Applied、素养性Literate AI）和九个维度构成的能力复合框架。
AI.method: 概念性/理论推导方法：从文献缺口出发，通过显式的推导链条建立框架，识别设计启示与潜在架构特征，并以可追溯性表格（traceability table）结构化呈现以支撑原创性主张。
AI.findings: 本文呈现了一个四层九维的REAL-AI能力框架及其完整的推导逻辑链，并通过可追溯性表格确保框架的原创性主张具有可验证结构。完整的证据论证将在后续会议论文中展开。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了AI能力理论在组织问责场景中的空白，提出了超越传统AI素养与AI流畅度的多维能力框架，并通过显式的可追溯推导结构来保障理论建构的严谨性与原创性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为承担组织责任的专业决策者提供了可操作的AI能力框架架构，可作为后续开发能力测评工具、设计培训方案与组织AI治理机制的基础蓝本。

title: A Framework for Assurance of Learning and Curriculum Integration in Information Systems Capstones
affiliations: Central Michigan University and Central Michigan University

detail.title: A Framework for Assurance of Learning and Curriculum Integration in Information Systems Capstones

keywords: Generating response Copilot said: Information Systems Education

detail.abstract: This study develops and evaluates a milestone-based framework for Information Systems (IS) capstone courses that integrates Assurance of Learning (AoL), curriculum alignment, and experiential learning. Addressing persistent challenges in IS education, including fragmentation of prerequisite knowledge, variability in client-based projects, and limited integration between assessment and curriculum improvement, the framework integrates milestone sequencing, Introduce-Reinforce-Emphasize (I-RE) curriculum mapping, and a multi-method assessment system into a unified architecture. Drawing on five years of program-level longitudinal data (2021-2025), the study demonstrates how this integrated design functions as a scalable AoL architecture that links project-based learning with program-level diagnostics. Results show consistently high attainment of Student Learning Outcomes (87.9%-93.3%) and identify targeted opportunities for curriculum improvement, particularly in communication and database competencies. These findings are presented as descriptive trends that inform curriculum adjustments rather than causal effects. The study contributes by demonstrating how commonly used capstone elements can be systematically integrated into a coherent, scalable AoL architecture for continuous curriculum improvement. For IS educators, the framework offers practical guidance for aligning prerequisite coursework, structuring client engagement, and using assessment evidence to enhance student learning and program quality.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并评估了一个基于里程碑的信息系统（IS）顶点课程框架，该框架集成了学习保障（AoL）、课程对齐和体验式学习，通过五年纵向数据展示了其作为可扩展AoL架构的有效性，学生成果达成率稳定在87.9%-93.3%，并为课程改进提供了针对性方向。
AI.research_question: 如何将里程碑排序、I-RE课程映射和多方法评估系统整合为一个统一的AoL架构，以解决IS顶点课程中先修知识碎片化、客户项目变异性大以及评估与课程改进脱节等挑战？
AI.motivation: IS教育面临三大持续挑战：先修知识碎片化、客户导向项目存在变异性、评估与课程改进之间缺乏整合。现有研究缺乏一个统一的框架来系统性地整合这些要素，因此需要一个可扩展的AoL架构来连接项目式学习与项目级诊断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习保障（AoL）框架、里程碑排序理论、Introduce-Reinforce-Emphasize (I-RE)课程映射理论、体验式学习理论
AI.method: 基于2021-2025年五年项目级纵向数据，采用描述性趋势分析方法，评估集成了里程碑排序、I-RE课程映射和多方法评估的统一框架在学生成果达成和课程改进识别方面的效果。
AI.findings: 学生成果达成率持续稳定在87.9%-93.3%的高水平；识别出针对性的课程改进机会，尤其是在沟通能力和数据库能力方面；发现以描述性趋势呈现，用于指导课程调整而非因果推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个如何将常用的顶点课程要素系统整合为连贯、可扩展的AoL架构的示范，填补了IS教育中整合性框架的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IS教育者提供实用指导，包括如何对齐先修课程、结构化客户参与以及利用评估证据来提升学生学习和项目质量的框架指南。

title: The Security of Self: A Human-centric Approach to Cybersecurity, edited by Emily B. Laidlaw and Florian Martin-Bariteau
affiliations: Thompson Rivers University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Security of Self: A Human-centric Approach to Cybersecurity, edited by Emily B. Laidlaw and Florian Martin-Bariteau
detail.abstract: The Security of Self seeks to ‘breathe life’ into a shift underway in law, policy, and scholarship on cybersecurity towards a human-centric approach to the topic. The Introduction to the volume begins with the observation that ‘[t]ypically, cybersecurity has been conceived narrowly’ as protecting the privacy and integrity of data systems ‘usually in the context of national security or to protect corporate assets.’ The editors argue that ‘many of the individual and collective ways that humans are put at risk have been unexamined, or underresearched.’ Humans have tended to feature in the dominant paradigm only as ‘a threat to be stopped, or as potential victims to be saved from some impending doom.’ The book ‘offers a new approach to human-centric cyber-security: the security of self.’ This ‘invites a paradigm shift’ in which ‘cybersecurity’s core purpose is to protect people—and society—from harm,’ and collective rights to a secure cyber environment are central.

AI.tldr: 该书提出"自我安全"（The Security of Self）这一新概念，倡导将网络安全从传统的以数据和系统为中心、以国家安全和企业资产保护为导向的范式，转向以人为中心的安全范式。核心主张是网络安全的根本目的是保护人和社会免受伤害，并强调集体享有安全网络环境的权利。
AI.research_question: 如何在法律、政策和学术研究中推动网络安全从传统技术中心范式向人本中心范式转变？网络安全的"自我安全"范式应如何定义和构建？
AI.motivation: 传统网络安全概念过于狭隘，局限于保护数据系统的隐私与完整性，通常服务于国家安全或企业资产保护。人类在主导范式中仅被视为"需要阻止的威胁"或"等待被拯救的潜在受害者"，个体和集体的多种受风险方式未被充分审视或研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人本中心网络安全理论（human-centric cybersecurity）；"自我安全"范式（security of self）；集体安全权利理论
AI.method: 该书为编辑性学术著作（edited volume），通过多篇论文的汇编与导论论述，综合法律、政策与学术视角，提出并论证人本中心网络安全的概念框架与范式转变。
AI.findings: 该书主张网络安全的核心目的应转变为保护人和社会免受伤害，强调集体享有安全网络环境的权利是核心要义，并以此邀请学界和实务界进行范式转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"安全自我"（security of self）这一新的理论框架，挑战传统以数据、系统和机构为中心的网络安全范式，将人本主义视角引入网络安全理论，并确立了集体网络安全权利的学术地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律制定者和政策制定者提供了人本中心网络安全的实践指南，推动网络安全的立法与政策从保护系统资产转向保护个体和社会的实际安全需求。

title: Governing Agentic AI in FinTech
affiliations: Department of Computer Science, School of Engineering & Computer Science, Baylor University

detail.title: Governing Agentic AI in FinTech
detail.abstract:
Financial institutions are beginning to delegate consequential decisions to agentic AI systems
that decompose goals, coordinate models and tools, and act with little human oversight. How-
ever, agentic AI governance in FinTech remains under-investigated. We argue that the binding
governance constraint on this shift is not capability but verifiability. We define the Verifiability
Gap as the positive shortfall between the verification demanded by delegated authority and the
explainability and reproducibility retained after a specific decision. The construct asks whether
the system preserves evidence sufficient for a named verifier, evidentiary standard, and audit
lag. We develop an agentic AI multilevel governance theory and examine its mechanisms in
three studies over nine model versions, ranging from a three-billion-parameter local model to
a commercial frontier system. Study 1 shows that provider releases alter historical financial
actions, and that the controls replay requires belong to the provider, not the firm: the current
frontier model rejects temperature, top_p, and top_k outright and never exposes a random
seed. Under the tightest controls each endpoint allows, a local model reproduced 320 of 320
executions, while hosted models reproduced 319 of 320 and 959 of 960. Study 2 shows that or-
chestration is a latent policy layer. Architecture changes final actions, and no execution record
repeated in any configuration at any model scale. The frontier model reproduces its own actions
more often than the local ones, but its execution record is no better, and it loses a comparable
share of its verdict differentiation. Capability buys a higher starting point, not auditability.
Study 3 shows two deterministic credit-model versions that each reproduce their current action
perfectly, while the current one cannot recover a historical one. We conceptualize reproducibility
as a governance profile rather than a scalar, yielding evidence-contingent delegation: authority is
defensible only while retained evidence can substantiate its exercise. Beyond financial services,
this framework extends to other high-stakes domains of agentic AI governance where rigorous
auditability is required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可验证性差距"（Verifiability Gap）概念，认为金融科技中代理式AI治理的约束不在于能力而在于可验证性。作者构建了代理式AI多层级治理理论，并通过三项研究（涵盖九个模型版本）证明：模型提供商发布、编排架构和模型版本都会影响决策可复现性，而能力提升并不会带来审计性的增强。
AI.research_question: 在金融科技中，代理式AI系统（agentic AI）的可验证性差距如何影响其委托授权的治理边界？具体而言：1）模型提供商的控制机制是否可被金融机构有效利用以实现可复现性；2）编排（orchestration）作为隐性的策略层如何影响可复现性；3）模型版本迭代是否保证历史决策的可恢复性。
AI.motivation: 金融机构正开始将重要决策委托给代理式AI系统，但代理式AI治理在金融科技领域研究不足。现有文献多关注AI能力提升，而忽视了可验证性这一关键治理约束。随着AI从辅助工具走向自主代理，需要新的理论框架来理解"谁可以验证什么"这一核心问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出代理式AI多层级治理理论（agentic AI multilevel governance theory），核心构念为"可验证性差距"（Verifiability Gap），定义为委托授权所要求的验证程度与特定决策后保留的可解释性和可复现性之间的正缺口。该构念要求系统保留足以满足指定验证者、证据标准和审计滞后期要求的证据。
AI.method: 三项实证研究，覆盖九个模型版本，从30亿参数的本地模型到商业前沿模型。研究1测试模型提供商的超参数控制（temperature、top_p、top_k、随机种子）对历史金融行动复现的影响；研究2考察编排架构变化对最终决策和可复现性的影响；研究3比较确定性信用模型不同版本的历史决策可恢复性。
AI.findings: 研究1：模型提供商发布改变历史金融行动，且重放所需控制属于提供商而非金融机构；前沿模型完全拒绝temperature、top_p、top_k参数且不暴露随机种子；最严格控制下本地模型320/320完全复现，托管模型为319/320和959/960。研究2：编排是潜在的政策层，架构改变最终行动，任何配置和模型规模下都没有重复的执行记录；前沿模型比本地模型更频繁复现自身行动，但执行记录质量无改善。研究3：两个确定性信用模型版本能完美复现当前行动，但当前版本无法恢复历史行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"可验证性差距"这一新构念，将AI治理研究的焦点从能力约束转向可验证性约束；2）构建代理式AI多层级治理理论，涵盖模型层、编排层和版本层的治理机制；3）将可复现性概念化为治理剖面（governance profile）而非标量，提出"证据依存的委托授权"（evidence-contingent delegation）原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融机构提供了评估代理式AI可审计性的具体操作框架（验证者、证据标准、审计滞后三元组）；2）揭示了模型提供商控制权对金融机构治理的实质性影响，提示机构需在设计治理安排时考虑提供商层面的可验证性能力；3）框架可扩展到金融之外的其他高风险代理式AI治理场景。

title: The Terminator Orbit
affiliations: and University of Washington

detail.title: The Terminator Orbit

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The lead author has a paid research engagement with Turion Space. Co-author Ryan Westerdahl is Turion Space’s co-founder and chief executive officer. The paper applies the same critical lens to claims favorable to Turion as to any other operator.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported through a paid research engagement with Turion Space.

detail.abstract: The case for building data centers in orbit has moved from fringe pitch to filed business plan in barely a year. This paper argues that orbital computing is not one market but two, and that for each the conventional wisdom runs backward. A small niche, where data are born in orbit and the useful output is compact, already pays for itself through the downlink it avoids, and its natural form is the add-on: marginal compute riding constellations that fly anyway, which closes at commercial launch prices already in view, long before a standalone data center does. The gigawatt clusters in the headlines are the harder case: on the best independent numbers and our extension of them, they close only for one vertically integrated builder, only against a slow ground, and no earlier than the early 2030s; the latency case for orbital inference likewise belongs to the one operator with a laser mesh. We reframe the decision around discounted cost per effective compute-year and show viability is conjunctive: launch, power density, heat rejection, build cost, refresh, and finance must clear at once. Two ledgers resist the pitch: the terrestrial comparator keeps improving, and the environmental term, stratospheric metal from reentering fleets above a filling dawn-dusk commons, is real and unpriced.

AI.tldr: 本文认为轨道计算并非单一市场而是两个截然不同的市场，且各自传统认知与实际相反。小型利基市场（数据在轨道上产生、有用输出紧凑）已能通过避免下行链路实现自给自足，其自然形态是附加计算载荷搭载于既有星座；而头条新闻中的吉瓦级集群则困难得多，仅在特定条件下（单一垂直整合建造商、地面数据中心发展缓慢、不早于2030年代初）才能实现经济闭合。本文以"每有效计算年的折现成本"重构决策框架，论证可行性是联合性的，并指出地面替代品持续改进和重返大气层金属碎片的环境成本这两项因素阻碍了该构想。
AI.research_question: 轨道数据中心的经济可行性究竟如何？轨道计算是否构成一个统一市场？在什么条件下轨道计算能够实现经济闭合？
AI.motivation: 轨道计算的构想已在不到一年内从边缘概念演变为正式商业计划，但缺乏系统性的经济可行性分析，且公众讨论多受头条新闻误导，需要厘清真实的市场结构与成本条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 折现成本分析框架（每有效计算年的折现成本）、市场细分理论、联合可行性分析（launch、power density、heat rejection、build cost、refresh、finance六要素同时满足）
AI.method: 基于独立数据的成本建模与经济分析，扩展已有数据以检验吉瓦级轨道数据中心的闭合条件，从市场细分、成本维度对比和外部性评估三个层面展开论证。
AI.findings: （1）轨道计算分为两个市场：小型利基市场（天生成数据+紧凑输出）已能自给自足，以附加计算载荷形式搭载既有星座即可闭合，无需独立数据中心；（2）吉瓦级集群仅对单一垂直整合建造商、且地面数据中心发展缓慢的条件下可行，经济闭合不早于2030年代初；（3）轨道推理的延迟优势仅属于拥有激光网状架构的单一运营商；（4）可行性要求六项条件同时满足，是联合性的而非单项满足；（5）地面替代品持续改进和重返大气层金属碎片的环境成本（未定价）是两项难以逾越的障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将轨道计算从单一市场迷思中解放，提出"双市场"细分框架；引入"每有效计算年的折现成本"作为统一比较基准；提出"联合可行性"（conjunctive viability）概念，强调多条件同时满足而非单项突破。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和商业计划制定者提供清晰的市场识别工具（区分利基附加计算与独立数据中心）；揭示吉瓦级轨道集群的真实闭合条件与时间窗口；提出环境外部性（平流层金属碎片）未被定价的风险因素，推动政策与商业层面的反思。

reference: International Journal of Law and Information Technology, volume 34, 2026[10.1093/ijlit/eaag011]
title: Book review of Rewiring Democracy: How AI Will Transform Our Politics, Government, and Citizenship, by Bruce Schneier and Nathan E. Sanders
affiliations: Thompson Rivers University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Book review of Rewiring Democracy: How AI Will Transform Our Politics, Government, and Citizenship, by Bruce Schneier and Nathan E. Sanders

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Law and Information Technology, volume 34, 2026[10.1093/ijlit/eaag011]

detail.abstract: This book makes an incisive and technically informed contribution to a rapidly growing body of work on AI and politics. Its central chapters survey the tangible ways AI will alter democratic practices, including political campaigning, lawmaking, administration, and legal judgment. The book is framed by the authors’ conception of democracy as “an information system that translates individual preferences into group policy decisions”, a system that can be optimized through effective use of AI. This conception has its merits, but it underplays democracy as a normative order structured by constitutional limits, institutional friction, public reasoning, and commitments to political equality — and leads the authors, in places, to understate AI’s potential impact on some of its most important dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本书对人工智能与政治这一快速发展的研究领域做出了深刻且技术性强的贡献，探讨了AI将如何改变民主实践（包括政治竞选、立法、行政和司法裁判），但作者将民主视为"将个体偏好转化为群体政策决策的信息系统"这一框架存在局限，忽视了民主作为受宪法约束、制度摩擦、公共理性和政治平等承诺塑造的规范性秩序。
AI.research_question: AI将如何在哪些具体维度改变民主实践，以及现有关于民主的"信息系统"概念框架是否足以捕捉AI对民主的影响？
AI.motivation: AI与政治关系的研究日益增多，本书旨在提供技术上精准的分析，指出AI将如何切实改变民主运作方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将民主概念化为"将个体偏好转化为群体政策决策的信息系统"，可借AI进行优化。
AI.method: 对政治竞选、立法、行政、司法裁判等民主核心环节进行技术化的系统综述与分析。
AI.findings: AI将在政治竞选、立法、行政和司法等多个民主实践领域产生切实影响；但作者认为该书采用的"信息系统"框架低估了AI对民主更深层规范性维度的潜在冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判性地指出将民主简化为信息系统的框架缺陷——它忽视了宪法约束、制度摩擦、公共推理和政治平等等规范性维度，从而可能低估AI的深远影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 系统梳理AI在民主各实践环节（竞选、立法、行政、司法）的具体应用方式，为政策制定者和研究者提供参考。

title: Sharing the Spotlight? Credit Attribution, Assortative Collaboration, and Creator Stratification on Content Platforms
affiliations: , Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information & Systems Management and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST)

detail.title: Sharing the Spotlight? Credit Attribution, Assortative Collaboration, and Creator Stratification on Content Platforms
detail.abstract: Collaboration is central to the creator economy, yet opaque credit attribution makes joint production risky when contributors cannot verify or monetize their individual roles. Major platforms have introduced formal credit systems to make collaboration visible, but evidence remains limited on whether these systems increase collaboration, how they change partner selection, and which creators benefit. We examine these questions on Bilibili, a major video-sharing platform that piloted a formal credit attribution system for music creators.
