Employing a three-hypothesis exhaustive elimination method-the cultural department is either (1) a base value, (2) a null effect, or (3) a multiplicative multiplier-this paper demonstrates through logical derivation that only the multiplier hypothesis holds. This conclusion is corroborated by two empirical observations: large firms universally maintain cultural departments while small firms do not, suggesting a scale threshold; and during economic downturns, cultural department budgets are the first to be cut, indicating they are treated as discretionary multipliers rather than essential base functions. The paper further suggests that this logical framework can be extended to other organizational functions-such as legal, compliance, and human resources-offering a generalizable analytical lens for distinguishing base departments from multiplier departments in organizational design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三假设穷举排除法（基础价值、无效、乘数效应），逻辑推导并辅以两个经验观察（大企业普遍设有文化部门而小企业不设；经济下行时文化部门预算首先被削减），论证企业文化部门是生产函数中的"乘数"而非"基础价值"，并将该框架推广至法律、合规、人力资源等其他组织职能。
AI.research_question: 企业文化部门在企业生产函数中的根本性质是什么？它是直接产生产出的基础价值，还是放大现有生产能力的乘数？
AI.motivation: 几乎所有大型组织都设有专门的文化部门（负责内部活动、团队建设、价值推广和员工参与），但该部门在企业生产函数中的根本性质尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三假设穷举排除法框架：文化部门要么是（1）基础价值，要么是（2）无效效应，要么是（3）乘法乘数，通过逻辑推导排除前两者。
AI.method: 逻辑推导结合经验观察：采用三假设穷举排除法进行逻辑推演，并辅以两个经验观察佐证——大企业普遍设立文化部门而小企业不设（暗示规模阈值）；经济下行期间文化部门预算最先被削减（暗示其被视为可自由支配的乘数而非必要的基础功能）。
AI.findings: 通过逻辑推导，只有乘数假设成立。两个经验观察（规模阈值现象和预算削减的优先级顺序）均与乘数假设一致，而排除基础价值假设和无效假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可推广的分析框架，用于区分组织设计中的"基础部门"与"乘数部门"，可延伸至法律、合规、人力资源等其他组织职能，为组织理论提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理实践提供指导：文化部门的预算决策应基于其作为生产能力放大器的定位来考量；在经济下行时优先削减文化部门预算的管理实践有了理论依据；同时为不同规模企业是否应设立文化部门提供了参考（存在规模阈值）。

reference: William & Mary Law School Research Paper Forthcoming; Harvard Environmental Law Review (forthcoming)
title: Unsustainable Presidential Administration
affiliations: William & Mary Law School

detail.title: Unsustainable Presidential Administration

publicationDetails.detailsText: William & Mary Law School Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: William & Mary Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The first Trump Administration prioritized speed and salience over legal soundness, and its unilateral deregulatory efforts—some fairly characterized as "regulatory slop"—were largely undone once Trump left office. This essay argues that the second Trump Administration, despite being more prepared and more aggressive, has not learned this lesson: it continues to elevate executive branch unilateralism over the slower, harder work of legislative or judicial engagement. The administration’s reliance upon executive orders and unilateral action has sacrificed sustainability for speed. Where the administration’s efforts are most likely to result in lasting legal or policy change, the administration is relying upon cooperation with other branches, such as by working with Congress to pass Congressional Review Act resolutions or prompting judicial review and endorsement of new understandings of existing environmental laws.The Administration's unilateral actions may be consequential, but they are not sustainable: lasting change to environmental law will come only through legislation or judicial ratification, not executive decree alone.

AI.tldr: 本文认为第二届特朗普政府虽然比第一届更有准备且更激进，但并未吸取教训，仍过度依赖行政单边主义而非立法或司法途径，导致其环境法规改革虽具影响力却不可持续，唯有通过立法或司法确认才能实现持久变革。
AI.research_question: 第二届特朗普政府的环境去监管化行动是否具有可持续性？其依赖行政单边主义的策略能否产生持久的环境法律变革？
AI.motivation: 第一届特朗普政府的单边去监管化努力在离任后大多被推翻，而第二届特朗普政府虽然更充分准备且更具攻击性，但似乎仍未汲取教训，继续以行政单边主义取代立法或司法参与的更缓慢而艰巨的工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政单边主义理论、行政法与立法/司法互动的制度制衡理论、政策可持续性理论（涉及行政命令的稳定性与持久性分析）。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析/法律评论文章，通过对两届特朗普政府行政行动的案例分析，评估其去监管化努力的可持续性与制度路径选择。
AI.findings: 第二届特朗普政府以牺牲可持续性换取速度，其行政单边行动虽有影响力但不可持久；只有当行政当局与国会合作（如通过国会审查法决议）或促使司法审查确认对环境法的新理解时，其努力才最有可能产生持久的法律或政策变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对行政单边主义局限性的理论认识，阐明了行政命令在环境法变革中缺乏持久性的制度原因，并厘清了行政、立法与司法三种路径对政策可持续性的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律从业者提供启示：欲实现持久的环境法律变革，应优先考虑与国会合作及寻求司法确认，而非单纯依赖行政命令；同时也提示行政当局如何更有策略性地选择制度路径以实现政策目标。

title: Originalism As Anti-Woman: An Examination Of Dobbs And Bruen
affiliations: Mercer University School of Law

detail.title: Originalism As Anti-Woman: An Examination Of Dobbs And Bruen
detail.abstract:
In recent years, the United States Supreme Court's problematic commitment to originalism has strengthened. An originalist mode of constitutional interpretation is particularly concerning for women, who were excluded from the democratic and lawmaking process at the time the Constitution was enacted and who were considered legally inferior to men. 

The deeply anti-woman issues with originalism are exemplified in two recent blockbuster opinions: Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization, in which the Court not only overturned Roe v. Wade, but also determined the Constitution does not protect the right to obtain an abortion; and New York State Rifle and Pistol Association, Inc. v. Bruen, in which the Court held the Second Amendment right to bear arms extends to public carry of a handgun. Each of these cases begins with an anti-women "input" by requiring courts to adopt the worldview of people who did not believe that women were entitled to the same legal rights as men. Each case results in an anti-woman "output" because the policy results of this interpretive frame harm women. 

This Article examines how, in Dobbs and Bruen, the Court relied problematically on an anti-woman originalist mode of constitutional interpretation. It then reviews some of the devastating outcomes that have harmed women in their aftermath. This Article concludes by proposing bold solutions for constitutional interpretation moving forward by addressing both the importance of expressive messaging coming from the Court and the creation of a form of legal analysis that works to support women.

AI.tldr: 本文批判美国最高法院在原旨主义宪法解释中根深蒂固的反女性偏见，以多布斯案（推翻罗伊诉韦德案）和布鲁恩案（扩大第二修正案持枪权）为例，揭示原旨主义如何以排斥女性的历史世界观作为解释输入，并产生损害女性的政策输出，最后提出支持女性的宪法解释改革方案。
AI.research_question: 美国最高法院的原旨主义宪法解释方式如何在多布斯案和布鲁恩案中体现反女性偏见，并如何改革以支持女性？
AI.motivation: 近年来美国最高法院对原旨主义的承诺不断加强，而原旨主义要求采信制宪时期的世界观——当时女性被排除在民主立法进程之外且法律上被视为低于男性，这种解释模式对女性构成严重威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 原旨主义宪法解释理论、女性主义法学理论
AI.method: 案例分析法——深入分析多布斯案和布鲁恩案两份最高法院判决，考察其原旨主义推理逻辑及对女性的实际影响。
AI.findings: 原旨主义在输入层面要求采纳反女性的历史世界观（不承认女性享有与男性同等法律权利），在输出层面产生损害女性的政策结果（如剥夺堕胎权、扩大公共场所持枪权）。这两案在后续产生了严重危害女性的后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了"输入-输出"分析框架来揭示原旨主义对女性的双重危害，将原旨主义的性别批判系统化，并提出以支持女性为目标的法律分析形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两项切实可行的改革建议：一是强调最高法院在传达信息（expressive messaging）层面的重要性，二是创建一种旨在支持女性的新型法律分析方法，为未来的宪法解释实践提供方向。

title: The Divided Subject and the Symbolic Garment Psychoanalysis, Sexuation, and the Fashioning of Modern Femininity
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Divided Subject and the Symbolic Garment Psychoanalysis, Sexuation, and the Fashioning of Modern Femininity
detail.abstract: This monograph develops a theoretical framework for understanding modern femininity not as a fixed essence but as a set of historically variable technologies for managing an ineliminable psychic impossibility: the non-coincidence of the subject with the image through which she seeks recognition. Rather than treating psychoanalysis as a repository of static claims about "woman," the argument traces feminine subjectivity from Freud's early and unfinished speculations, through the object-relational and culturalist revisions of Klein, Horney, and Deutsch, to Lacan's formalization of the divided subject, the phallic signifier, the objet petit a, the gaze, jouissance, and the formulas of sexuation. This apparatus is then set to work alongside Beauvoir's existentialist account of woman as situation, Irigaray's and Butler's deconstructions of sexual difference, Mulvey's theory of the cinematic gaze, Barthes's and Baudrillard's semiotics of the fashion-sign, Bourdieu's sociology of taste and distinction, and Foucault's account of disciplinary and confessional technologies of the self. The synthesis that results proposes that haute couture, perfume advertising, cinema, feminist critique, psychoanalytic treatment, and contemporary self-branding are not successive replacements of one another but structurally related attempts to give a barred subject a stable symbolic form. Chanel and Saint Laurent are treated not as objects "explained" by theory but as historical sites where this structural impossibility becomes visible, marketable, and endlessly repeatable. The monograph closes by considering the ethical stakes of an image that promises closure it cannot deliver, and by asking what forms of feminine subjectivity become thinkable once that promise is understood as structural rather than personal.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理论框架，将现代女性气质理解为一系列历史性可变的技术，用以管理主体与寻求承认之图像之间不可消除的心理不可能性——即主体与镜像的非重合性。作者综合精神分析（弗洛伊德、克莱因、霍尼、多伊奇、拉康）、存在主义（波伏瓦）、后结构主义（伊里加蕾、巴特勒、穆尔维）、符号学（巴特、鲍德里亚）与社会学（布迪厄、福柯）等理论资源，论证高级定制时装、香水广告、电影、女性主义批评、精神分析治疗与当代自我品牌化并非相互替代的关系，而是在结构上相互关联的、为受阻主体赋予稳定象征形式的尝试。
AI.research_question: 现代女性气质如何被理解为一种历史性可变的技术系统，用以管理主体与自我图像之间不可消除的结构性不可能性？这一不可能性如何在高级时装、广告、电影与自我品牌化等文化实践中被呈现、售卖和重复？
AI.motivation: 既有的精神分析理论往往将女性气质视为静态本质，而文化理论又常与精神分析割裂。作者试图超越这一分裂，建立一套综合的理论框架，同时避免将香奈儿、圣罗兰等时尚对象简单地视为被理论"解释"的客体，而是将其视为结构不可能性得以显现的历史场域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精神分析理论（弗洛伊德的早期思辨、克莱因与霍尼的客体关系与文化主义修正、拉康的分裂主体/菲勒斯能指/对象a/凝视/享乐/性化公式）、波伏瓦的存在主义（女性作为处境）、伊里加蕾与巴特勒的性别差异解构、穆尔维的电影凝视理论、巴特与鲍德里亚的时尚符号学、布迪厄的趣味与区隔社会学、福柯的规训与忏悔技术
AI.method: 理论综合与文本分析：将精神分析概念装置与存在主义、后结构主义、符号学、社会学等多重理论资源进行交叉整合，并以香奈儿、圣罗兰等时尚品牌作为历史个案进行理论阐释。
AI.findings: 高级定制时装、香水广告、电影、女性主义批评、精神分析治疗和当代自我品牌化在结构上是相互关联的——它们都是为"被划杠的主体"赋予稳定象征形式的尝试。这一结构性不可能性在时尚实践中变得可见、可市场化且可无限重复。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出女性气质不是固定本质，而是历史性可变的"技术"；将精神分析与文化理论整合为统一的理论框架；重新定位时尚对象为理论话语中的能动场域而非被动解释对象；将女性主体性的不可能性重新概念化为结构性而非个人性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解时尚工业、广告与自我品牌化背后的心理与文化机制提供分析工具；对当代女性主体提出伦理反思——当图像承诺了它无法兑现的闭合，何种女性主体性形式成为可思考的；为女性主义批评与精神分析实践提供新的综合视野。

title: Leadership Characteristic and Loyalty
affiliations: , Politeknik Tuanku Sultanah Bahiyah and Seberang Perai Polytechnic, Penang, Malaysia

detail.title: Leadership Characteristic and Loyalty
detail.abstract: Performance is a priority for the organization to keep remaining in the market. Leadership characteristics are required to build up and increase loyalty among the employees. Throughout, good characteristics, for instance listening skills, empathy, and ability to motivate, may cause employees to be happy and satisfaction to lead loyalty. In addition, loyalty can contribute to better employee performance where they utilize skills, experience, and knowledge to achieve objectives. This study discusses how good leadership characteristics can enhance loyalty and vice versa. Performance is also related to leadership characteristics, where an employee is willing to work for the organization if they have a good relationship with the leader.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了良好的领导特质（如倾听技巧、同理心和激励能力）如何增强员工忠诚度，以及忠诚度如何反过来提升员工绩效，同时考察了领导特质与员工绩效之间的直接关联。
AI.research_question: 良好的领导特质如何增强员工忠诚度，以及领导特质、员工忠诚度与员工绩效之间如何相互影响？
AI.motivation: 组织绩效是维持市场竞争力的优先事项，而领导特质对建立和提升员工忠诚度至关重要，因此需要探讨这三者之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导特质理论；员工忠诚度理论；组织绩效理论
AI.method: 基于文献综述和理论分析的概念性研究，探讨领导特质、员工忠诚度与员工绩效之间的相互关系。
AI.findings: 良好的领导特质（倾听技能、同理心、激励能力）能够提升员工满意度与幸福感，从而增强忠诚度；忠诚度有助于员工更好地运用技能、经验和知识以实现目标，提升绩效；员工与领导者之间的良好关系也会影响其工作意愿与绩效表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了领导特质、员工忠诚度与绩效三者之间的双向互动关系，丰富了领导力与组织行为领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供了通过培养良好领导特质来增强员工忠诚度和提升绩效的实践指导。

title: The Organisation as the Executable Unit: Towards an Executable Organisational Operating Model for AI-Native Software Engineering
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Organisation as the Executable Unit: Towards an Executable Organisational Operating Model for AI-Native Software Engineering
detail.abstract: Software engineering has historically depended on organisational structures, shared objectives, delegated authority, reviewed decisions, and institutional knowledge that outlives any individual contributor, to sustain systems across changes in personnel and technology. Contemporary artificial intelligence systems increasingly perform substantial engineering work, including code generation, architectural proposal, and review, yet operate largely outside these organisational structures: without delegated authority, without persistent organisational responsibility, and without accountability that survives the interaction in which a decision was made. The paper argues that this absence of organisational structure, not insufficient model capability, is the primary obstacle to safely extending AI autonomy across the software engineering lifecycle. It proposes an executable organisational operating model in which the organisation itself is the unit that persists, not the individual participant or the AI agent. Objectives justify capabilities. Capabilities expose governed services. Services are delivered through accountable roles. Roles are fulfilled by interchangeable participants. Those participants may be human, artificial, or external. They produce artefacts, evidence, and organisational knowledge. The paper distinguishes this approach from existing agent-orchestration and workflow-coordination systems, which coordinate interactions and activities but do not execute an organisation with explicit authority, accountability, and institutional memory. It discusses the conditions under which this becomes necessary as the number of autonomous participants in an engineering organisation grows, the limitations of governance as a guarantee of process rather than judgement, and the extension of the model beyond software engineering to other knowledge-intensive domains.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，阻碍AI在软件工程全生命周期中安全扩展自主性的主要障碍并非模型能力不足，而是缺乏组织结构的约束。论文提出一种可执行的"组织操作系统"模型——让组织本身作为持久化单元，通过目标→能力→治理服务→负责任角色→可互换参与者（人、AI或外部实体）的层级结构，赋予AI以权威、问责和制度记忆，从而区别于现有的agent编排与工作流协调系统。
AI.research_question: 如何通过组织结构而非单纯的技术能力，安全地扩展AI在软件工程生命周期中的自主性？
AI.motivation: 传统软件工程依赖组织结构、委托授权、审查决策和制度知识来支撑系统在人员与技术变迁中的可持续性。而当代AI系统虽然承担大量工程工作（代码生成、架构建议、审查），却游离于这些组织结构之外——缺乏委托权威、缺乏持续的组织责任、缺乏超出交互时刻的问责机制，这构成了安全扩展AI自主性的核心障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织学理论（组织结构、权威委托、问责机制、制度记忆）；软件工程治理理论；多智能体系统与AI治理理论
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，提出可执行的组织操作系统模型，包含五个层级：目标支撑能力、能力暴露治理服务、服务通过负责任角色交付、角色由可互换参与者（人类/人工/外部）履行、参与者产出工件/证据/组织知识。并从组织理论角度论证其与agent编排系统和流程协调系统的本质区别。
AI.findings: 1) AI安全扩展自主性的首要障碍是组织结构缺失而非模型能力不足；2) 提出了以组织为持久化单元的"可执行组织操作系统"模型；3) 该模型区别于现有agent编排与工作流协调系统——后者协调交互与活动，但未执行具备明确权威、问责与制度记忆的组织；4) 讨论了当工程组织中自主参与者数量增长时该模型的必要性临界条件、治理作为过程保证而非判断保证的局限性，以及模型向其他知识密集型领域的扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织理论与AI治理相结合，提出"组织结构缺失是AI安全扩展的主要障碍"这一核心命题，并为AI参与工程建立了权威、问责与制度记忆的理论框架，区分了"协调系统"与"可执行组织"的本质差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的组织设计蓝图：通过目标-能力-服务-角色-参与者的层级结构，使AI能以负责任、可问责、可持续的方式融入软件工程全生命周期，并可作为其他知识密集型领域AI组织化治理的参考模型。

title: The Yin and Yang of Organizational Silence: The Mediating Role of Psychological Safety and Attachment Orientations in Organizational Commitment and Burnout
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Yin and Yang of Organizational Silence: The Mediating Role of Psychological Safety and Attachment Orientations in Organizational Commitment and Burnout

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, personal relationships, or financial competing interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this manuscript, as it is a purely conceptual/theoretical study that did not involve human participants, animal subjects, patients, or empirical data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or non-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Why do employees often choose not to speak up, even when they have something meaningful to say? This paper argues that part of the answer lies in early relational history. Drawing on Adult Attachment Theory and Social Exchange Theory, it proposes a conceptual framework linking individual attachment orientations (secure, anxious, avoidant, and disorganized) to workplace silence through the mediating mechanism of psychological safety (Hazan & Shaver, 1990; Edmondson, 1999). Rather than treating silence as a single, uniform behavior, the framework distinguishes its destructive forms, defensive and acquiescent silence ("Yin"), from its constructive form, prosocial silence ("Yang") (Van Dyne, Ang, & Botero, 2003). The model further traces how each pathway shapes emotional burnout and affective organizational commitment, drawing on recent meta-analytic evidence that links attachment insecurity to burnout (Warnock, Ju, & Katz, 2024) and links psychological safety to silence behavior (Hao et al., 2022; Sherf, Parke, & Isaakyan, 2021). The paper closes with practical recommendations for HR and leadership practice, and it outlines a specific empirical gap this framework is positioned to address. Namely, whether secure attachment predicts greater engagement in prosocial silence specifically, rather than merely less negative silence.

AI.tldr: 本文基于成人依恋理论与社会交换理论，提出一个概念框架，将员工的依恋取向（安全型、焦虑型、回避型和紊乱型）通过心理安全感的中介机制与职场沉默行为联系起来，并区分了破坏性沉默（防御性沉默和默许性沉默，"阴"）与建设性沉默（亲社会沉默，"阳"），进一步追踪各路径对情绪耗竭和情感组织承诺的影响，最后提出实践建议并指出未来实证研究的方向。
AI.research_question: 为什么员工即使有重要的事情要说，却常常选择不发声？早期关系史（依恋取向）如何通过心理安全感影响不同类型的职场沉默行为？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将职场沉默视为单一行为，且较少从早期关系史（依恋取向）的角度解释沉默的个体差异。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，构建一个更细致的框架来理解沉默的类型及其形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成人依恋理论（Adult Attachment Theory）和社会交换理论（Social Exchange Theory）；心理安全感（Psychological Safety）作为中介机制；沉默类型学（防御性沉默、默许性沉默、亲社会沉默）
AI.method: 概念性论文（Conceptual Paper），通过整合现有理论与元分析证据构建理论框架，提出研究命题和实证研究方向。
AI.findings: 提出不同依恋取向（安全型、焦虑型、回避型、紊乱型）通过心理安全感的中介作用分别影响不同类型的沉默行为（防御性、默许性、亲社会沉默），进而影响情绪耗竭与情感组织承诺；并指出安全型依恋可能特别预测亲社会沉默（建设性沉默）这一未来实证研究缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将依恋理论引入职场沉默研究，为理解沉默的个体差异提供新的理论视角；2) 区分沉默的"阴"（破坏性）与"阳"（建设性）双面性，深化对沉默行为的类型学理解；3) 整合心理安全感作为中介机制，连接依恋取向与沉默行为之间的理论链条；4) 将依恋与沉默的研究拓展到情绪耗竭与组织承诺等结果变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR和领导力实践提供针对性建议，帮助管理者根据员工的依恋取向差异进行管理干预；通过提升心理安全感来减少破坏性沉默、促进建设性沉默；并为组织改善员工福祉（减少情绪耗竭）和增强组织承诺提供实践指导。

title: Audi Sport (Volkswagen Group) Leading in the Luxury High-performance Market while Embracing Electrification

detail.title: Audi Sport (Volkswagen Group) Leading in the Luxury High-performance Market while Embracing Electrification
detail.abstract: Audi Sport faces critical strategic challenges as it navigates the transformation of the premium automotive segment towards electrification and sustainability. This analysis evaluates the division's capabilities and opportunities within the Volkswagen Group's Progressive brand portfolio, focusing on maintaining premium performance positioning while embracing technological innovation. The external environment shows increasing complexity in competitive dynamics, with both traditional manufacturers and new technology companies competing for market share. Key challenges include battery technology limitations, charging infrastructure standardization, manufacturing sustainability, and diverse regional market requirements. Internally, Audi Sport builds on its strong engineering expertise and motorsport heritage while developing new capabilities in electric vehicle technology and digital integration. The division is actively pursuing technological transformation through specialized electric platforms and the Volkswagen Group's Cariad software initiative. Substantial electric vehicle production and sales growth demonstrate strong commitment to this transition. Success in this transformation requires balancing traditional performance values with new sustainability demands through strategic initiatives in electric powertrain innovation, digital platform integration, market specific electrification strategies, and motorsport excellence. The implementation roadmap outlines a phased approach from establishing digital infrastructure to developing autonomous ecosystem capabilities. Strategic resource allocation across financial, human capital, and technological domains, supported by comprehensive risk management and performance monitoring systems, will be crucial for success. Through systematic execution of these strategies, Audi Sport can maintain its leadership position while driving the redefinition of premium performance in an electrified automotive future. By focusing on these core areas, Audi Sport is positioned to leverage its heritage and capabilities to lead the premium performance segment's transition to sustainable mobility, ensuring long-term competitive advantage in an evolving market landscape

AI.tldr: 本文分析了奥迪运动部门（Audi Sport）在高端汽车行业向电动化和可持续发展转型过程中面临的战略挑战与机遇，提出了涵盖电动动力总成创新、数字平台整合、区域市场电动化策略和赛车运动卓越等方面的分阶段转型路线图，以确保其在电动化未来中保持领导地位。
AI.research_question: 奥迪运动部门如何在电动化与可持续发展转型中保持高端性能定位并维持竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 高端汽车行业正经历向电动化和可持续发展的深刻转型，奥迪运动部门面临传统制造商与新兴科技公司的双重竞争压力，需要制定明确的战略以应对电池技术、充电基础设施、制造可持续性和区域市场差异等复杂挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略管理理论，结合Volkswagen集团渐进式品牌组合视角，运用内外部环境分析框架（涵盖竞争动态、能力评估与资源分配）来分析组织的战略定位与转型路径。
AI.method: 定性战略分析，包括外部环境分析（竞争动态、技术挑战、市场差异化）和内部分析（工程专长、赛车传承、电动化能力建设），并提出分阶段实施路线图。
AI.findings: （1）奥迪运动部门具备坚实的工程专长和赛车运动传承作为竞争优势基础；（2）通过专业电动平台和Cariad软件计划积极推动技术转型，电动车型产销增长显著；（3）成功转型需要在传统性能价值与新兴可持续需求之间取得平衡；（4）分阶段路线图涵盖数字基础设施建设到自动驾驶生态系统能力开发的完整路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 为高端汽车品牌在电动化转型中平衡传统性能定位与新兴可持续发展要求提供了战略分析框架，丰富了关于传统汽车制造商战略转型的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奥迪运动部门及同类高端性能汽车品牌提供了具体的转型实施路线图和资源分配建议，涵盖财务、人力资本和技术领域的战略性配置，以及风险管理与绩效监控体系的构建方案。

title: Adapting Auto Specs Grading for the AI Era: An in-class Approach
affiliations: St. Mary's College of Maryland and St. Mary's College of Maryland

detail.title: Adapting Auto Specs Grading for the AI Era: An in-class Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Generative AI (Claude Opus and Scite) was used for assistance with the literature review, as well as drafting and editing sections. Sources were verified and compiled by the authors. All human subjects provided informed consent and the study was approved by St. Mary’s College of Maryland Institutional Review Board. All data is sensitive and cannot be provided.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Generative AI is pushing instructors to reevaluate grading practices, as assignments completed outside the classroom can now be produced using AI. We adapt an earlier version of specifications grading, auto specs grading, by bringing all assessments inside the classroom. A student's final grade is determined by a two-tier sequence of pass/fail quizzes that students may attempt more than once during regular class meetings. We describe the implementation in an intermediate microeconomics course organized into seven content modules. Because all gradedetermining work occurs in class, AI cannot be used during assessment, which lets the instructor adopt an otherwise unrestrictive AI policy. We report a single small-scale implementation and find that the system was feasible to run and received positively by students, though our evidence is observational and we do not measure learning outcomes. The approach protects the integrity of grades even as AI continues to advance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"自动规格评分"（auto specs grading）的评分方法改进版，将所有考核移至课堂内进行，通过两层级联的及格/不及格测验决定学生最终成绩，从而确保AI无法参与考核，保护成绩的完整性，并允许教师在课堂外采取宽松的AI使用政策。作者在中级微观经济学课程的七个内容模块中实施了该方案，初步证据表明系统可行且受学生欢迎。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI时代，如何设计一种评分体系，既能在课堂内完成所有考核以确保成绩的完整性（防止AI作弊），又能保留规格评分（specifications grading）的灵活性（如多次尝试机会）？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI使课堂外完成的作业可以被AI代写，迫使教师重新审视评分方式。传统评分方法在AI时代面临成绩完整性的威胁，需要一种既能防止AI作弊又不限制学生使用AI的新评分体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规格评分（specifications grading）理论：以通过/失败（pass/fail）为标准进行评分，强调掌握（mastery）而非部分积分；"自动规格评分"（auto specs grading）是该理论的先前版本。
AI.method: 将先前版本的"自动规格评分"进行改进，将所有评估转移到课堂内进行。课程分为七个内容模块，学生的最终成绩由两层级联的可多次尝试的通过/失败测验决定。在中级微观经济学课程中进行单一小规模实施，收集实施可行性和学生反馈的观察性证据。
AI.findings: 该系统运行可行，并受到学生的积极评价。但证据是观察性的，未测量学习成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为AI时代的评分实践提供了新的理论框架视角，证明将规格评分与课堂内评估相结合可以有效保障成绩完整性，而不必采用全面的AI禁令。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教师提供了在生成式AI时代保护成绩完整性的具体可行方案：将所有考核移至课堂内，允许在课外采取宽松的AI使用政策；同时通过多次测验尝试机制保留了规格评分的灵活性和学生容错空间。

title: Practitioners’ Perspectives on Their Everyday Practice With Children in Extended Education: A Comparative Exposition
affiliations: Griffith University, Mid Sweden University - Department of Education, Zurich University of Applied Sciences, Griffith University, University of Melbourne, Zurich Institute of Teacher Education and Linkoping University

detail.title: Practitioners’ Perspectives on Their Everyday Practice With Children in Extended Education: A Comparative Exposition
detail.abstract: Supervised services for school children outside of compulsory school hours are becoming increasingly important internationally. IThis article explains how staff in extended education work and thus influence children's well-being, learning, and development in Australia, Sweden, and Switzerland. Data from each country (literature reviews, policy documents, interviews with staff, and other related material) was collected and analysed. The Theory of Practice Architecture (Kemmis, 2014) provided a theoretical framing to examine workforce qualifications and training in extended education. The descriptions provided by the staff about their work have made their practice visible. The findings highlight the need for staff in extended education to develop a more explicit didactic awareness that connects intentions (sayings), actions (doings), and relationships (relatings) in everyday practice. It is critical for developing curricula and resources for professional learning in each of the three countries. This is one of the first comparative studies on this topic.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了澳大利亚、瑞典和瑞士三国校外扩展教育（compulsory school hours之外的有监督服务）中工作人员如何通过其工作影响儿童的福祉、学习和发展。研究运用实践架构理论（Theory of Practice Architecture），通过多国数据收集与分析，发现扩展教育工作人员需要在日常实践中建立更明确的教法意识，将意图（言说）、行动（作为）和关系（关联）联系起来，这对三国专业学习课程和资源的开发至关重要。
AI.research_question: 扩展教育工作人员如何开展工作，进而影响儿童在澳大利亚、瑞典和瑞士三国中的福祉、学习和发展？
AI.motivation: 校外扩展教育服务在国际上日益重要，但关于其工作人员资质和培训的研究仍然有限，且缺乏跨国比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实践架构理论（Theory of Practice Architecture, Kemmis, 2014），该理论用于检视扩展教育中工作人员的资质与培训。
AI.method: 多国比较研究。数据来源包括各国文献综述、政策文件、对工作人员的访谈及其他相关材料，并进行收集与分析。
AI.findings: 扩展教育工作人员需要发展更明确的教法意识，将日常实践中的意图（sayings）、行动（doings）和关系（relatings）联系起来。工作人员对自己工作的描述使其实践得以可视化。
AI.theory_contributions: 这是该主题首批比较研究之一，为扩展教育领域提供了跨国比较的理论视角，运用实践架构理论检视了工作人员资质与培训问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果为三个国家开发扩展教育工作人员专业学习的课程和资源提供了关键依据。

title: Towards Responsible AI in Academic Research: Ethical Principles, Challenges, and a Practical Framework
affiliations: ANAAM Centre for Educational Research  and Apex University

detail.title: Towards Responsible AI in Academic Research: Ethical Principles, Challenges, and a Practical Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Required
declarations.funderStatement: No funder

detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping academic research by supporting literature review, data analysis, scientific writing, programming, and knowledge synthesis. While these capabilities enhance research efficiency and accessibility, they also raise important concerns related to research integrity, transparency, accountability, fairness, privacy, and intellectual property. Although several international organizations have developed ethical guidelines for AI governance, researchers often lack practical guidance for applying these principles consistently throughout the research lifecycle. This study addresses this gap by proposing a framework for the responsible integration of generative AI into academic research. Adopting a narrative review approach, the study synthesizes evidence from recent scholarly literature and internationally recognized governance frameworks, including those developed by UNESCO, the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), the Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE), and the International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE). The review identifies shared ethical principles and integrates them into a framework comprising six interconnected dimensions: reliability through evidence verification, human responsibility and oversight, transparency and disclosure, fairness and ethical reflection, protection of privacy and intellectual property, and continuous learning and improvement. The proposed framework positions AI as an assistive technology that complements, rather than replaces, human judgement and scholarly responsibility. By translating widely accepted governance principles into a practical model tailored to academic research, the study offers guidance for researchers, higher education institutions, journal editors, publishers, and policy-makers seeking to promote trustworthy, transparent, and ethically responsible AI-assisted research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过叙事综述方法，综合UNESCO、OECD、NIST、COPE和ICMJE等国际组织的伦理治理框架，提出一个包含六个相互关联维度的框架，用于指导生成式人工智能（GenAI）在学术研究中的负责任整合。该框架将AI定位为辅助性技术，补充而非取代人类判断和学术责任。
AI.research_question: 研究者如何在研究全生命周期中一致地应用生成式人工智能的伦理原则？即如何弥合国际治理原则与研究者实践指导之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管GenAI能显著提升研究效率和可及性，但其使用引发了研究诚信、透明度、问责制、公平性、隐私和知识产权等方面的担忧。虽然多个国际组织已制定AI治理伦理指南，但研究者往往缺乏在整个研究生命周期中一致应用这些原则的实用指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际公认的AI治理框架，包括UNESCO、OECD、NIST、COPE和ICMJE等组织制定的伦理原则，并综合已有学术文献中的共享伦理原则。
AI.method: 采用叙事综述（narrative review）方法，综合近期学术文献和国际公认治理框架的证据。
AI.findings: 识别出国际框架中的共享伦理原则，并将其整合为六个相互关联的维度：（1）通过证据验证确保可靠性；（2）人类责任与监督；（3）透明度与披露；（4）公平性与伦理反思；（5）隐私与知识产权保护；（6）持续学习与改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 将广泛接受的治理原则转化为针对学术研究量身定制的实用模型，填补了国际伦理指南与研究者日常实践之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、高等教育机构、期刊编辑、出版商和政策制定者提供促进可信、透明和伦理负责的AI辅助研究的实践指导。

title: Competition Law Challenges in Digital Markets: An Analysis of India's Regulatory Response to Big Tech

detail.title: Competition Law Challenges in Digital Markets: An Analysis of India's Regulatory Response to Big Tech
detail.abstract: The rapid ascent of global technology conglomerates commonly referred to as "Big Tech" has exposed significant structural limitations in India's competition law framework. Enacted in 2002 to replace the outdated Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act, 1969, the Competition Act was designed for conventional markets and lacks the doctrinal tools to address the distinctive economic features of digital platforms: network effects, data network externalities, multi-sided market structures, and winner-takes-all dynamics. This paper examines whether India's existing competition law framework is adequate to address competition distortions caused by Big Tech companies operating in Indian digital markets, and what structural reforms are necessary. Through a doctrinal analysis of the Competition Act's provisions on abuse of dominance and anticompetitive agreements, a critical examination of the Competition Commission of India's landmark decisions in the Google Android case (2022), the Google Play Store case (2022), Matrimony.com v. Google (2018), and the WhatsApp privacy policy investigation (2021), and a comparative analysis of the European Union's Digital Markets Act and United States antitrust enforcement against Big Tech, this paper argues that India's current ex post, case-by-case enforcement model suffers from structural inadequacies that cannot be remedied through judicial interpretation alone. The Competition (Amendment) Act, 2023 while introducing welcome reforms including a deal value threshold for merger control and hub-and-spoke cartel provisions falls significantly short of the structural transformation required. The paper identifies five critical gaps in the existing framework and proposes targeted legislative and institutional reforms, including a standalone Digital Competition Act designating Systematically Significant Digital Enterprises. It concludes that while ex ante regulation introduces risks, the structural limitations of ex post enforcement in rapidly evolving digital markets make legislative reform both necessary and constitutionally viable, provided proportionate procedural safeguards are incorporated.

AI.tldr: 本文通过教义学分析、判例审查和比较法研究，论证印度现行基于事后个案执行的竞争法框架无法有效应对大型科技公司在数字市场中的竞争扭曲问题，并提出制定独立的《数字竞争法》以进行结构性改革。
AI.research_question: 印度现行竞争法框架是否足以应对大型科技公司在印度数字市场造成的竞争扭曲？需要哪些结构性改革？
AI.motivation: 大型科技公司的崛起暴露了印度2002年《竞争法》的结构性局限——该法为传统市场设计，缺乏应对网络效应、数据网络外部性、多边市场结构和赢家通吃动态等数字平台经济特征的教义工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法理论（滥用支配地位、反竞争协议）、数字平台经济特征理论（网络效应、多边市场结构、赢家通吃动态）、事前监管与事后执行框架比较理论。
AI.method: 教义学分析（doctrinal analysis）方法，包括：1）对《竞争法》滥用支配地位和反竞争协议条款的教义审查；2）对印度竞争委员会在Google Android案、Google Play Store案、Matrimony.com v. Google案及WhatsApp隐私政策调查等标志性判决的批判性分析；3）与欧盟《数字市场法》和美国反垄断执法进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 印度现行事后、逐案执行模式存在结构性不足，无法仅通过司法解释来弥补；2023年《竞争（修正）法》虽引入交易价值门槛和轴辐式卡特尔条款等改革，但远未达到结构性转型的要求；论文识别出五个关键缺口并提出包括指定"系统性重要数字企业"在内的独立《数字竞争法》改革方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证了事后逐案执行模式在快速演变的数字市场中的结构性局限超越司法解释的补救范围，并为事前监管的合宪性提供了理论论证，同时强调需纳入相称的程序保障。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度竞争法改革提供具体的立法和制度建议，包括制定独立的《数字竞争法》并设计"系统性重要数字企业"指定机制，为政策制定者和监管机构提供改革路线图。

title: Disentangling the Past: Relation and Event Extraction with Schema-Constrained LLM Generation
affiliations: University of Zurich

detail.title: Disentangling the Past: Relation and Event Extraction with Schema-Constrained LLM Generation
detail.abstract: Extracting relational and event data from historical printed sources at scale is a central but unsolved measurement problem in political science. This paper introduces an open-source Python package (text2rel) that turns unstructured printed sources into network-ready data-pairing layout-preserving OCR, evidence-grounded retrieval, and schema-constrained large language model (LLM) outputs-with an evaluation framework that makes the resulting measurement error visible and auditable. Rather than answering isolated questions as in question-answering (QA) systems, the pipeline extracts many relations and events jointly under a fixed schema, links every record to its source passage, and routes passages to human coders, benchmarking LLM ground-truth agreement against inter-and intra-coder validation. Evaluated against a handlabeled sample from a 52-volume Colombian genealogical corpus, both tasks are recall-limited, with recall exceeding precision (relations ≈ 0.79/0.72; events ≈ 0.76/0.70 at the θ = 0.80 cut). Relation scores rise faster as the threshold relaxes-as expected, since a triplet has fewer components than a quintuple and a higher chance of a full-tuple match. Error is argument-limited : the relation type and event verb are almost always recovered (≈ 0.99, ≈ 0.96), so residual error sits in argument fields-names, dates, places-not the categorical core. Two diagnostics prove informative though imperfect: match quality declines with input length, and LLM self-reported confidence weakly tracks correctness. The package enables using these signals in an iterative workflow, letting users refine prompts against assessed evidence. As a face-validity check, the reconstructed elite kinship network recovers sensible structure: elected presidential candidates are more betweenness-central and denser in their ego-networks than unsuccessful ones. A future version will characterize hallucinations directly and benchmark cloud against local open-weights models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个开源Python包（text2rel），它结合版面保持OCR、基于证据的检索和模式约束的大语言模型输出，将非结构化的历史印刷资料转化为可用于网络分析的数据，并提供评估框架使测量误差可见可审计。在52卷哥伦比亚家谱语料库上的评估表明，该管线在关系抽取和事件抽取中均表现出召回率高于精确率的特点，错误主要集中在参数字段而非类别核心。
AI.research_question: 如何在大规模历史印刷资料中可靠地、可审计地提取关系数据和事件数据，以解决政治学中的测量问题？
AI.motivation: 从历史印刷资料中大规模提取关系数据和事件数据是政治学中一个核心但尚未解决的测量问题，现有方法缺乏系统性的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量方法论、信息抽取理论、大语言模型应用框架、编码者间一致性检验理论
AI.method: 开发text2rel开源Python包，采用三阶段管线：（1）版面保持OCR处理文本；（2）基于证据的检索定位相关段落；（3）模式约束的大语言模型联合抽取关系和事件。同时构建评估框架，包括人工编码者交叉验证、LLM与人工标注的一致性基准测试，以及诊断指标（输入长度对匹配质量的影响、LLM置信度与正确性的相关性）。
AI.findings: （1）两项任务均为召回率受限，召回率高于精确率（关系≈0.79/0.72；事件≈0.76/0.70，θ=0.80截止点）；（2）关系得分随阈值放宽上升更快，因为三元组比五元组组件更少、完整匹配概率更高；（3）错误主要限于参数字段（姓名、日期、地点），关系和事件动词几乎总能恢复（≈0.99，≈0.96）；（4）匹配质量随输入长度下降，LLM自信度与正确性弱相关；（5）作为表面效度检验，重建的精英亲属网络恢复了合理结构——当选总统候选人的中介中心性更高、自我网络更稠密。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将测量误差可见化、可审计化的评估框架，弥补了政治学中历史数据测量方法论的空缺；揭示了LLM在结构化抽取任务中错误分布的结构性特征（参数受限而非类别受限）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个开源工具包（text2rel），使研究者能够将非结构化历史资料转化为网络就绪数据；支持迭代工作流，允许用户根据评估证据优化提示词；为LLM基于历史数据抽取提供了可验证的方法。

title: Building High-performance Educational Organisations through Effective Leadership
affiliations: Oxford Academy and George Mason University

detail.title: Building High-performance Educational Organisations through Effective Leadership
detail.abstract:
Educational organisations are expected to deliver learning quality, equity, resilience, and continuous improvement under resource pressure and social change. Leadership is frequently presented as the mechanism that converts policy and resources into organisational performance, yet the relationship is indirect and context-sensitive. This thesis examines how effective leadership can contribute to high-performance educational organisations, using Jordan as the primary setting, the United Kingdom as an international comparator, and selected Middle Eastern systems as regional benchmarks. A pragmatic comparative case-study design integrates published OECD Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) 2022 indicators, official policy documents, and a structured synthesis of leadership literature. The evidence covers 7,799 students in 260 schools in Jordan and 12,972 students in 451 schools in the United Kingdom. Descriptive analysis compares achievement, minimum proficiency, school autonomy, staffing constraints, resources, and continuity-of-learning indicators. It does not attribute national score differences causally to leadership.

Jordan shows a substantial performance and proficiency gap relative to the United Kingdom, accompanied by large differences in selected school decision rights. Only 5% of students in Jordan attended schools where principals had the main responsibility for hiring teachers and 3% attended schools where teachers had the main responsibility for choosing learning materials; corresponding United Kingdom figures were 81% and 89%. Staffing shortages affected both systems, but exposure to inadequate or poorly qualified staff was markedly higher in Jordan. The findings indicate that high performance cannot be reduced to one leadership style or to autonomy alone. It requires an aligned architecture combining strategic direction, instructional leadership, professional capability, distributed participation, bounded autonomy, reciprocal accountability, evidence-informed improvement, and resilience. The thesis proposes a six-domain High-Performance Educational Leadership and Organisation framework and a phased implementation roadmap. Its principal contribution is a context-sensitive model that treats leadership as an organisational capability rather than a heroic individual trait.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"高绩效教育领导力与组织"六域框架，将领导力视为组织能力而非个人特质，通过约旦与英国等国际比较，揭示高绩效教育组织需要战略方向、教学领导、专业能力等要素的协同架构，而非单一领导风格或自治权。
AI.research_question: 有效领导力如何促进高绩效教育组织？在不同教育系统中领导力与组织绩效之间的关系如何体现？
AI.motivation: 教育组织面临资源压力和社会变革，领导力被认为是将政策与资源转化为组织绩效的机制，但这种关系是间接且情境敏感的，需要更深入的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力作为组织能力而非英雄式个人特质的理论视角；高绩效教育组织的架构理论（战略方向、教学领导、专业能力、分布式参与、有限自治、相互问责、循证改进、韧性）。
AI.method: 采用务实的比较案例研究设计，整合OECD PISA 2022指标、官方政策文件和领导力文献的结构化综合。数据包括约旦260所学校7,799名学生、英国451所学校12,972名学生。采用描述性分析比较成就、最低熟练度、学校自治、人员配置约束、资源和学习连续性指标。
AI.findings: 约旦在学业表现和熟练度上与英国存在显著差距，且学校决策权差异巨大（约旦仅5%学生所在学校校长负责招聘教师，英国为81%）。人员短缺在两国均存在，但约旦学生更常接触不合格或资质不足的教职人员。高绩效不能归结为单一领导风格或自治权，需要多种要素的协同架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出情境敏感的高绩效教育领导力与组织模型，将领导力重构为组织能力而非英雄式个人特质，并发展出六个域的理论框架及分阶段实施路线图。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育领导者和管理者提供高绩效教育组织的六域框架和实施路线图，可用于指导教育政策制定和组织改进实践。

title: Paired Trade Reconciliation: Detecting and Attributing Live-Backtest Divergence in Systematic Trading Strategies

detail.title: Paired Trade Reconciliation: Detecting and Attributing Live-Backtest Divergence in Systematic Trading Strategies
detail.abstract: When a systematic strategy moves from backtest to production, realised trades diverge from simulated ones. Practitioners assess this divergence informally, by comparing live and backtested performance ratios. We show that comparing performance distributions is close to powerless for this task: a distributional test based on multivariate optimal transport fails to detect five pips of slippage or twenty-five percent of missed fills. The reason is structural. Comparing two independent samples pays the sampling variance of both, while the quantity of interest is a difference that is an order of magnitude smaller. We propose instead a paired protocol, Paired Trade Reconciliation (PTR). Live and backtested trades are matched one to one on instrument and entry date, and three statistics are computed on the matched set: the fraction of backtested trades recovered, the fraction of live trades with no backtested counterpart, and the mean per-trade return difference normalised by the return dispersion, which we call the normalised paired execution gap and denote δ. The pairing removes between-sample variance and detects an entry-price shift of 0.2 pip, roughly twenty-five times smaller than the smallest perturbation the distributional test resolves. The three statistics are diagnostic rather than merely detective: they identify which of execution quality, order capture, or strategy identity has changed. We validate the protocol against ground truth on six strategy families spanning trend and contrarian logic, horizons from five to two hundred fifty-two days, and both market and limit entry, using degradations whose nature is known by construction. The normalisation transports: a one-pip entry shift yields δ between 0.0125 and 0.0191 across all six families. We derive an explicit applicability condition from the calibrated noise floors, and document a limitation that follows from capacity constraints: when position slots are limited, a missed order frees a slot and a substitute trade is taken, so the three statistics are not orthogonal. Inverting the protocol yields a pre-launch execution budget. We report the cost of a one pip entry shift in units of the edge statistic and find it declines with the strength of the edge, from roughly half the t-statistic at t ≈ 1 to a tenth at t ≈ 5.5, so that robustness to execution is governed by the margin a strategy holds above its significance bar rather than by a fixed tolerance in pips.

AI.tldr: 本文提出配对交易对账（PTR）协议，用于检测系统性策略从回测转向实盘时的执行偏差。作者证明基于分布比较的检验（如多元最优传输）几乎无法检测到实际存在的执行滑点或错失成交，因为独立样本比较包含了两倍的抽样方差。PTR通过按标的和入场日期一对一配对回测与实盘交易，计算三个统计量（恢复率、无对应实盘比例、归一化配对执行缺口δ），将检测灵敏度提升约25倍（可检测0.2个pip的入场价偏移）。三个统计量具有诊断性而非仅检测性，能区分执行质量恶化、订单捕获问题或策略本身变化。
AI.research_question: 如何从统计上严格且灵敏地检测系统性策略从回测转向实盘时产生的执行偏差（滑点、错失成交等），并诊断偏差的来源？
AI.motivation: 实践中交易员通常非正式地比较实盘和回测绩效比率来评估执行偏差，但本文证明基于分布比较的统计检验（即使采用多元最优传输）在检测典型幅度的执行偏差时几乎无能为力——无法检测5个pip的滑点或25%的错失成交。这种结构性失效源于独立样本比较需承担双方的抽样方差，而感兴趣的实际差异小了一个数量级，因此需要新的方法论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于配对样本检验的统计学原理（消除样本间方差）、多元最优传输理论（作为分布比较基准方法）、以及配对实验设计框架，构建了执行偏差检测与诊断的统一协议。
AI.method: 提出配对交易对账（PTR）协议：将实盘与回测交易按标的和入场日期一对一匹配，计算三个统计量——回测交易恢复率、无回测对应体的实盘交易比例、归一化配对执行缺口δ（每笔回报差异均值除以回报离散度）。在六个策略族（趋势/逆向逻辑、5至252天持仓期、市价/限价入场）上用已知性质的退化进行地面真实验证。
AI.findings: （1）分布检验的检测极限约为5个pip滑点，而PTR能检测0.2个pip的入场偏移，灵敏度提升约25倍；（2）三个统计量分别诊断执行质量、订单捕获和策略一致性；（3）1个pip入场偏移在所有六个策略族中产生δ在0.0125至0.0191之间，具有跨策略可移植性；（4）当持仓槽位受限时，三个统计量不再正交（错失订单释放槽位导致替代交易）；（5）反向使用协议可得到上市前执行预算：1个pip偏移的成本从t≈1时约半个t统计量下降到t≈5.5时的十分之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了分布比较检验在检测执行偏差时的结构性局限（同时承担双方抽样方差），并证明配对设计可将检测灵敏度提升约25倍；建立了执行偏差检测的统一协议和跨策略归一化标准（δ的可移植性），为量化交易中的执行质量评估提供了严谨的统计框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实务交易者提供了可直接部署的PTR协议（三统计量诊断框架），可精确区分执行质量、订单捕获和策略身份三类偏差来源；提供上市前执行预算工具，帮助交易者根据策略的显著性余量而非固定pip容差来评估执行鲁棒性；跨六个策略族的验证保证了协议的广泛适用性。

title: Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards under the New York Convention: Public Policy, Due Process and the Limits of Judicial Review
affiliations: Senior Judicial Magistrate at Bangladesh Judicial Service

detail.title: Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards under the New York Convention: Public Policy, Due Process and the Limits of Judicial Review
detail.abstract: The effectiveness of international commercial arbitration ultimately depends less on the tribunal's power to render an award than on the willingness of national courts to recognise and enforce it. The Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards 1958 (the New York Convention) supplies the central international architecture for that task. With 172 parties, the Convention has achieved near-universal reach, but its success rests on a carefully calibrated bargain: enforcement is the rule, while judicial refusal is confined to limited grounds. This article examines three pressure points within that bargain-public policy, due process, and the permissible limits of judicial review. It argues that Article V should not be treated as an appellate jurisdiction in disguise. Public policy is a safety valve, not a vehicle for correcting errors of law or fact; due process protects a meaningful opportunity to participate, not an entitlement to ideal procedure; and jurisdictional review, although sometimes necessarily intensive, must remain conceptually distinct from merits review. The article also considers the relationship between seat courts and enforcement courts, including Article V(1)(e), transnational issue estoppel, and the emerging "Primacy Principle". Particular attention is given to Dallah, Kabab-Ji, Deutsche Telekom, Vijay Karia and the Supreme Court of India's 2026 NEW YORK CONVENTION-RECOGNITION AND ENFORCEMENT 2 decision in Nagaraj V Mylandla v PI Opportunities Fund-I. The article proposes a structured enforcement methodology designed to preserve both the Convention's pro-enforcement purpose and the minimum procedural legitimacy on which arbitral finality depends.

AI.tldr: 本文考察《纽约公约》第五条在承认与执行外国仲裁裁决中的三个压力点——公共政策、正当程序和司法审查的限度，主张第五条不应被用作变相的上诉管辖，并提出一套结构化的执行方法以兼顾公约的支持执行宗旨与程序正当性的最低要求。
AI.research_question: 《纽约公约》第五条下的公共政策、正当程序和司法审查限度三个压力点应如何界定，以保持公约支持执行的基本宗旨与程序合法性之间的平衡？
AI.motivation: 《纽约公约》虽已实现172个缔约方的接近普遍性覆盖，但其成功取决于执行与拒绝之间的精妙平衡。实践中，法院可能将第五条误用为变相上诉管辖，损害国际商事仲裁的终局性与有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《纽约公约》第五条的解释框架；公共政策作为安全阀理论；正当程序作为"有意义参与机会"理论；司法审查与实体审查的概念区分；"首要原则"（Primacy Principle）及跨国争点禁反言。
AI.method: 法律条文分析、判例法比较研究，重点分析Dallah、Kabab-Ji、Deutsche Telekom、Vijay Karia以及印度最高法院Nagaraj V Mylandla v PI Opportunities Fund-I等关键案例。
AI.findings: 公共政策是安全阀而非纠正法律或事实错误的手段；正当程序保护有意义参与的机会而非理想程序的权利；管辖权审查虽有时需要深入，但必须与实体审查保持概念上的区分。文章进一步审视了仲裁地法院与执行地法院之间的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出第五条不应被视为变相上诉管辖的规范性主张；系统阐述公共政策作为安全阀而非纠错工具的边界；阐释管辖权审查与实体审查的概念区分原则；提出"结构化执行方法论"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为执行地法院提供一套结构化的裁决执行审查方法，帮助其在不损害公约支持执行宗旨的前提下维护最低限度的程序正当性；为仲裁从业者正确理解第五条各拒绝事由的边界提供指引。

title: The Price of Error Reversibility as a Factor of Production

detail.title: The Price of Error Reversibility as a Factor of Production

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for this article

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces reversibility as a factor of production purchased ex ante. Reversibility, denoted RHO, is the capacity of an institutional environment to allow an agent to return to a viable state after an error, at a finite and known cost; by reducing the effective loss from failure, it governs an economy's volume of experimentation and operates as a factor of production in its own right.

An agent installs capital and chooses, at a cost, the degree RHO between 0 and 1 to which the stake can be undone once uncertainty resolves. Five results follow. Value decomposes additively into a bare production block and a correction option specific to the factor RHO. The shadow price of reversibility equals the discounted expected volume of corrected errors, a magnitude observable in reversal data — asset sales, liquidation recoveries, exits from activity — which makes the factor empirically identifiable. The value of the option rises with risk in the sense of Rothschild and Stiglitz, and its marginal value rises as the environment deteriorates in the first-order sense, whence a scissors effect — clemency is worth most where agents can least afford it. Optimal reversibility increases with exposure to shocks, and the gap between the optimal and the observed level measures the institutional trap. Since the correction option is convex in RHO, half-reforms are dominated whenever the cost of clemency lacks convexity — the optimal regime jumps from one extreme to the other. Finally, reversibility puts a floor under the marginal return of capital, which founds the complementarity between clemency and investment and sheds light on capital flight from irrecoverable environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可逆性"（RHO）作为一种事前购买的独立生产要素。可逆性指制度环境允许代理人在犯错后以有限且已知的成本恢复到可行状态的能力。通过降低失败的有效损失，它决定经济体的试验规模。文章建立模型，推导出价值分解、影子价格、期权价值随风险变化、最优可逆性、制度陷阱、半改革问题及可逆性与投资的互补性等五个核心结果。
AI.research_question: 可逆性（RHO）能否作为独立的生产要素纳入经济分析？其定价机制、最优选择及其对投资与制度设计的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统生产要素（资本、劳动等）无法解释制度环境（如司法宽容度、破产制度）对经济试验与投资的影响。作者希望将"可逆性"——即犯错后恢复的能力——概念化为一种可交易、可选择的要素，从而为制度经济分析提供新的理论工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权定价理论（将可逆性视为纠正期权）、Rothschild-Stiglitz风险比较理论、一阶随机占优（环境恶化）、凸性分析与最优控制。
AI.method: 理论建模：代理人预先安装资本并在0到1之间选择可逆性程度RHO（付出成本），在不确定性实现后依据可逆性决定是否撤销风险敞口。通过价值函数分解、影子价格计算、比较静态与最优化分析推导五个核心结论。
AI.findings: (1) 价值可加性分解为纯生产块与RHO特有的纠正期权；(2) 可逆性的影子价格等于贴现后的预期纠正错误量，可从逆转数据（资产出售、清算回收、退出活动）中观测识别；(3) 纠正期权价值随Rothschild-Stiglitz风险上升而上升，其边际价值随环境一阶恶化而上升，产生"剪刀效应"；(4) 最优可逆性随冲击暴露增加，最优与观测水平之差度量制度陷阱；(5) 纠正期权在RHO上凸，当宽容成本缺乏凸性时半改革被占优，最优制度发生跳变（非此即彼）；(6) 可逆性为资本边际回报设下限，奠定宽容与投资的互补性，解释资本从不可恢复环境中逃逸。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将可逆性（RHO）概念化为一种事前购买、独立于资本与劳动的生产要素，扩展生产要素理论；将期权定价思想引入制度分析，建立纠正期权框架；通过Rothschild-Stiglitz风险与一阶占优比较静态，揭示宽厚度与风险暴露的"剪刀效应"；提出可逆性凸性导致的制度改革跳变（全有或全无）理论，解释半改革的低效。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度设计（司法宽容、破产法、监管政策）提供量化依据——可逆性的影子价格可从逆转移数据实证识别；为理解资本外逃、投资激励与制度陷阱提供诊断工具（最优与观察可逆性之差）；指导改革策略——表明半改革在缺乏成本凸性情况下无效，需全面彻底的制度变革。

title:
The Sleeper Cell Liability: 
How Add on Acquisitions Quietly Erode the Exit Value of Private Equity Backed Healthcare Platforms

detail.title:
The Sleeper Cell Liability: 
How Add on Acquisitions Quietly Erode the Exit Value of Private Equity Backed Healthcare Platforms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Marcus J. Frazier, is the Founder and Managing Partner of Koru Health, a healthcare operations and transformation consulting firm, and this report is published under the Koru Research Institute, a research initiative of Koru Health. As such, the author has a financial interest in the subject matter insofar as Koru Health provides consulting and pre diligence advisory services related to the operational challenges discussed in this report, including provider credentialing, payer enrollment, and operational risk assessment for healthcare platforms pursuing or undergoing private equity transactions. The report combines previously published third party data with original analytical frameworks developed by the author; all primary sources are cited transparently, and illustrative models and hypothetical examples are clearly identified as such throughout. No client, partner, or external party reviewed or influenced the findings prior to publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding, grants, or financial sponsorship of any kind. It was conceived, researched, and produced independently by the author as part of the Koru Research Institute’s ongoing publication series, and was funded solely through the internal resources of Koru Health.

detail.abstract:
This report examines an underrecognized risk inside healthcare private equity roll up strategy: the
credentialing, licensing, and payer enrollment gaps inherited with every add on acquisition, which
accumulate silently across a platform's growth and surface as value destroying findings during the
platform's own eventual exit.

The analysis is set against a demographic and economic backdrop that is already locked in: national health
spending is projected to grow from $5.3 trillion in 2024 to nearly $9.0 trillion by 2034, rising from 18.0
percent to 20.6 percent of the United States economy, driven in significant part by the aging of the baby
boomer generation into peak years of healthcare consumption. Platforms scaling through serial acquisition
during this window are scaling directly into that demand, and directly into the operational exposure this
report describes.

Drawing on previously published data on healthcare credentialing cycle times, denial rates, and revenue
impact established in Koru Research Institute's first two reports, this report introduces the Koru Integration
Koru Research Institute Debt Index, an original framework spanning six dimensions of operational liability, credentialing and enrollment, provider data, workflow fragmentation, compliance exposure, systems incompatibility, and governance, that accumulate across sequential acquisitions. The report illustrates how that liability varies by platform type, walks through two contrasting illustrative platform timelines, one where the exposure goes undetected until a sale process forces it into view, and one where it is priced and resolved at every close, and closes with a practical set of signals operators can check before they close their next deal. 

The analysis indicates that platforms completing four or more add on acquisitions without a unified remediation process across these six dimensions carry meaningfully higher diligence risk than single site organizations, exposure that standard financial and legal diligence practices are not structured to detect.

AI.tldr: 本报告识别了医疗保健私募股权"滚雪球式"收购策略中一个未被充分认识的风险：每次附加收购所继承的资质认证、许可和付款方登记缺口，这些缺口在平台增长过程中悄然累积，并在平台最终退出时成为破坏价值的尽职调查发现。
AI.research_question: 医疗保健私募股权平台在滚雪球式收购策略中，每次附加收购所继承的资质认证、许可和付款方登记缺口如何累积为运营负债，并如何在退出时产生价值破坏效应？
AI.motivation: 在美国医疗支出预计从2024年的5.3万亿美元增长至2034年的近9.0万亿美元（占GDP比重从18.0%升至20.6%）、婴儿潮一代进入医疗消费高峰的人口经济背景下，通过连续收购扩张的平台正直接面临需求增长和运营风险敞口。标准财务和法律尽职调查无法检测这些累积性的操作风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引入Koru整合债务指数（Koru Integration Debt Index），一个涵盖六个维度的运营负债原创框架：资质认证与登记、提供者数据、工作流碎片化、合规风险敞口、系统不兼容性及治理。
AI.method: 基于Koru研究所前两份报告中已发表的医疗资质认证周期时间、拒付率和收入影响数据，构建六维度整合债务指数框架；通过对比两个典型平台时间线（一个在出售过程中才暴露风险、另一个在每次关单时即定价并解决风险）进行案例分析。
AI.findings: 完成四次或以上附加收购、且未在六个维度建立统一修复流程的平台，其尽职调查风险显著高于单一站点组织；这种风险敞口是标准财务和法律尽职调查实践无法检测的。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"整合债务"（Integration Debt）概念框架，系统地将收购过程中被忽略的运营合规缺口理论化为可量化的负债维度，填补了私募股权医疗平台并购研究中对非财务、非法律操作性风险的系统性理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗私募股权运营者提供了可在下次关单前检查的实用信号清单；按平台类型展示了负债差异；为在收购交易中定价和解决此类风险提供了可操作的时间线参照框架。

title: Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation-Imposed Ankle Co-contraction Increases Postural Sway Despite Increased Joint Quasi-Stiffness
affiliations: , University of Toronto - Department of Computer Science, Oregon Health and Science University, University of Toronto, University of Toronto - University Health Network and University of Toronto - University Health Network

detail.title: Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation-Imposed Ankle Co-contraction Increases Postural Sway Despite Increased Joint Quasi-Stiffness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study protocol was approved by the University Health Network Research Ethics Board (REB No. 23-5663; approved February 5, 2024). All participants provided written informed consent prior to participation.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported in part by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC) through a Discovery Grant awarded to K.M. The funding source had no role in the study design; data collection, analysis, or interpretation; preparation of the manuscript; or the decision to submit the manuscript for publication.

detail.abstract: Increased ankle co-contraction is common in older adults and individuals with neurological disorders and is often interpreted as a compensatory strategy to increase apparent joint stiffness and enhance joint stability. However, increased joint stiffness does not necessarily translate into improved postural stability; greater co-contraction is frequently accompanied by larger postural sway. Because voluntary co-contraction involves concurrent changes in neural control, attention, and postural strategy, its mechanical contribution remains unclear. We used neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) to impose ankle co-contraction, independent of voluntary motor commands, and investigated its influence on postural stability during quiet standing. Seventeen healthy adults completed a control condition and three NMES-imposed co-contraction conditions targeting the soleus (SOL) and tibialis anterior (TA). Shear wave elastography quantified muscle stiffness, ankle joint quasi-stiffness was estimated using established biomechanical methods, and postural sway was assessed using the standard deviation of center-of-mass acceleration. NMES-imposed co-contraction significantly increased SOL and TA stiffness and ankle joint quasi-stiffness by 32–40%. Despite these increases, postural sway increased by 35–60% (p < 0.001), demonstrating a stiffness–instability trade-off. Repeated-measures correlations revealed significant positive associations among muscle stiffness, ankle joint quasi-stiffness, and postural sway. Linear mixed-effects models further showed that TA stiffness was more strongly associated with ankle joint quasi-stiffness and postural sway than SOL stiffness. These findings indicate that NMES-imposed ankle co-contraction can increase postural sway despite increasing ankle joint quasi-stiffness. This mechanical–functional dissociation may help explain why elevated co-contraction is frequently associated with impaired balance in older adults and individuals with neurological disorders.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）在17名健康成年人中强制施加踝关节共收缩（不依赖于主动运动指令），发现尽管肌肉刚度和踝关节准刚度显著增加32-40%，但姿势晃动却增加了35-60%，揭示了刚度-不稳定性权衡，表明踝关节共收缩的机械效应与功能表现存在解离。
AI.research_question: 强制施加的踝关节共收缩（不涉及自主运动控制）如何机械性地影响站立姿势稳定性？肌肉刚度和关节准刚度的增加是否必然改善姿势稳定性？
AI.motivation: 老年人及神经系统疾病患者中常见的踝关节共收缩增加通常被解读为代偿策略，以增加关节刚度并提升稳定性。然而，关节刚度增加并不必然转化为姿势稳定性改善，高共收缩常伴随更大的姿势晃动。由于自主共收缩涉及神经控制、注意力和姿势策略的并发变化，其机械贡献仍不明确，本研究旨在隔离机械因素进行探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于肌肉共收缩与关节刚度关系的生物力学理论，以及刚度-稳定性权衡假说，运用剪切波弹性成像量化肌肉刚度、生物力学方法估算关节准刚度，以及重心加速度标准差衡量姿势晃动。
AI.method: 实验研究：17名健康成年人完成对照条件及三种针对比目鱼肌（SOL）和胫骨前肌（TA）的NMES强制共收缩条件。使用剪切波弹性成像量化肌肉刚度，用已建立的生物力学方法估算踝关节准刚度，用重心加速度标准差评估姿势晃动。采用重复测量相关分析和线性混合效应模型进行统计分析。
AI.findings: NMES强制共收缩显著增加了SOL和TA肌肉刚度及踝关节准刚度32-40%，但姿势晃动反而增加了35-60%（p < 0.001），表现出刚度-不稳定性权衡。重复测量相关分析显示肌肉刚度、踝关节准刚度与姿势晃动之间存在显著正相关。线性混合效应模型进一步表明TA刚度与踝关节准刚度和姿势晃动的关系比SOL刚度更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究通过NMES隔离了共收缩的机械效应（排除神经控制和注意力等混杂因素），首次在实验层面证实了踝关节共收缩导致的关节刚度增加与姿势稳定性下降之间的机械-功能性解离，为理解老年人及神经系统疾病患者中共收缩与平衡受损的关联提供了机制性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 该研究结果提示，临床上不能简单地将共收缩增加视为改善姿势稳定性的代偿机制；在评估和治疗老年人及神经系统疾病患者的平衡障碍时，需要区分共收缩的机械效应与神经控制效应，避免过度依赖增加关节刚度的干预策略。

title: Administering the Unspoken: On the Wrong Question about Anthropic’s “J-Space”

detail.title: Administering the Unspoken: On the Wrong Question about Anthropic’s “J-Space”
detail.abstract: Anthropic's interpretability team recently reported an emergent, word-readable structure in some large language models: the "J-space," a set of unspoken words reflecting what a model is reasoning about, including objections that never reach the user. Reception has centered on machine consciousness. This note argues that is the wrong question: unanswerable as posed, and a distraction from effects already underway. Drawing on the post-Saussurean tradition and the extended mind, I ask not what stands behind the words but what the words are doing and who administers the layer that shapes them.

AI.tldr: 本文反对将Anthropic可解释性团队发现的LLM"J空间"（模型内部隐含推理的字词结构）视为机器意识问题的证据。作者认为这个问题本身无法回答且具有误导性，转而从后索绪尔传统和延展心灵理论出发，探讨这些词语在做什么、由谁管理塑造它们的层级。
AI.research_question: LLM中发现的"J空间"（模型内部未说出的推理词汇）应如何被理解？我们应关注什么而非机器意识问题？
AI.motivation: 学术界对"J空间"的讨论集中于机器意识这一无法回答的问题，作者认为这是错误的方向，会分散对已实际发生的效应的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后索绪尔语言学传统（post-Saussurean tradition）、延展心灵理论（extended mind）
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性论证（非实证研究），通过哲学和语言学框架重新框定对"J空间"的讨论。
AI.findings: "J空间"不应被解读为意识的证据；更恰当的问题是词语在做什么以及谁在管理塑造这些词语的层级。这一视角关注已在实际产生的效应而非意识这一不可回答的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将后索绪尔传统与延展心灵理论应用于LLM内部表征的理解，提供了一个替代机器意识框架的分析视角，强调话语的功能和治理层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 引导研究者和公众关注LLM内部语言层的实际社会效应与管理问题，而非陷入无法验证的意识争论。

title: The Price of Error - Reversibility as a Factor of Production

detail.title: The Price of Error - Reversibility as a Factor of Production

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for this article

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces reversibility as a factor of production purchased ex ante. Reversibility, denoted RHO, is the capacity of an institutional environment to allow an agent to return to a viable state after an error, at a finite and known cost; by reducing the effective loss from failure, it governs an economy's volume of experimentation and operates as a factor of production in its own right.

An agent installs capital and chooses, at a cost, the degree RHO between 0 and 1 to which the stake can be undone once uncertainty resolves. Five results follow. Value decomposes additively into a bare production block and a correction option specific to the factor RHO. The shadow price of reversibility equals the discounted expected volume of corrected errors, a magnitude observable in reversal data — asset sales, liquidation recoveries, exits from activity — which makes the factor empirically identifiable. The value of the option rises with risk in the sense of Rothschild and Stiglitz, and its marginal value rises as the environment deteriorates in the first-order sense, whence a scissors effect — clemency is worth most where agents can least afford it. Optimal reversibility increases with exposure to shocks, and the gap between the optimal and the observed level measures the institutional trap. Since the correction option is convex in RHO, half-reforms are dominated whenever the cost of clemency lacks convexity — the optimal regime jumps from one extreme to the other. Finally, reversibility puts a floor under the marginal return of capital, which founds the complementarity between clemency and investment and sheds light on capital flight from irrecoverable environments.

AI.tldr: 本文引入"可逆性"（RHO）作为事前购买的生产要素，即制度环境允许代理人在犯错后以有限且已知成本恢复到可行状态的能力。通过减少失败的有效损失，可逆性决定经济体的实验规模，并作为一种独立生产要素发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 可逆性（RHO）作为生产要素如何影响经济体中的实验量、资本价值和制度设计？
AI.motivation: 现有生产理论忽视了环境可逆性作为独立生产要素的作用；代理人在不确定环境中犯错后能否以低成本恢复，直接影响实验意愿与资本配置，但这一维度尚未被正式建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权理论（校正期权）、Rothschild-Stiglitz风险比较、一阶随机占优、凸性分析、制度陷阱理论
AI.method: 通过构建代理人选择资本与可逆度RHO（0到1之间）的正式模型，在不确定性结束前设置赌注可撤销程度，推导出五个核心定理。
AI.findings: （1）价值可加性分解为纯生产模块与RHO特定的校正期权；（2）可逆性的影子价格等于贴现的预期校正错误量，可在资产出售、清算回收、退出活动等数据中观测；（3）期权价值随Rothschild-Stiglitz意义上的风险上升，边际价值随一阶意义上的环境恶化而上升，产生"剪刀效应"；（4）最优可逆性随冲击暴露增加而增加，最优与观测值的差距衡量制度陷阱；由于校正期权凸于RHO，当宽恕成本缺乏凸性时半改革被支配，最优制度在极端间跳跃；（5）可逆性为资本边际回报设置下限，支撑宽恕与投资之间的互补性，并解释资本从不可逆环境外逃。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可逆性正式确立为独立生产要素；提出可观测的影子价格概念（基于反转数据）；发现剪刀效应与制度陷阱的衡量方式；证明宽恕（可逆性）与投资互补性的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供衡量制度质量的实证工具（基于反转数据识别影子价格）；解释资本外逃与不可逆制度环境的关系；为宽恕性制度设计（如破产法、清算机制）提供最优跳跃式改革的依据。

title: The Rise and Risks of Synthetic Risk Transfers
affiliations: Bank of England, Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and BIS/Financial Stability Board

detail.title: The Rise and Risks of Synthetic Risk Transfers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Yes, the March 2026 BIS Quarterly Review (BIS Quarterly Review, March 2026)

detail.abstract: Synthetic risk transfers (SRTs) are used by banks for capital and credit risk management. They have grown significantly in recent years but remain small relative to bank balance sheets. European banks have traditionally dominated SRT issuance, but their North American peers have seen an increase in issuance more recently. SRT-related risks appear to be modest at present. However, this may change as the market expands, structures become more complex and banks rely more heavily on non-bank financial institutions for credit protection. Limited and fragmented information heightens the potential for SRT-related risks to build undetected, highlighting the need for enhanced monitoring of risks for individual banks and from a system-wide perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了合成风险转移（SRTs）在银行资本和信用风险管理中的使用情况。尽管SRT市场近年来增长显著，但相对于银行资产负债表规模仍然较小。欧洲银行传统上主导SRT发行，但北美银行近期发行量增加。当前SRT相关风险看似温和，但随着市场扩张、结构复杂化以及银行更多依赖非银行金融机构提供信用保护，风险可能上升。信息有限且碎片化增加了SRT风险未被察觉积累的可能性，凸显了加强个体银行和系统层面风险监测的必要性。
AI.research_question: 合成风险转移（SRTs）在银行体系中的使用规模、风险状况及潜在系统性影响是什么？
AI.motivation: SRT市场快速增长且结构日趋复杂，但关于其风险的信息有限且碎片化，需要对SRT相关风险进行全面评估，以识别潜在的系统性隐患。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷风险转移理论、资本监管框架、系统性风险监测理论
AI.method: 基于市场数据对SRT发行规模、地理分布、风险状况进行描述性统计分析，并结合定性评估分析潜在风险。
AI.findings: （1）SRT市场近年增长显著，但仍相对银行资产负债表较小；（2）欧洲银行传统上主导发行，北美银行近期发行增加；（3）当前SRT相关风险看似温和，但随市场扩张、结构复杂化和对非银行金融机构依赖加深，风险可能上升；（4）信息碎片化可能使风险积累不被察觉。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解新兴信用风险转移工具（SRT）在银行体系中的风险累积机制提供了系统性视角，补充了关于非银行金融机构参与银行信用风险转移的系统性风险文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了关于加强SRT风险监测——包括个体银行层面和系统层面——的政策建议依据，有助于防范潜在金融风险积累。

title: Does Financial Inclusion Create Social Value? State-level Evidence from India

detail.title: Does Financial Inclusion Create Social Value? State-level Evidence from India
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether financial inclusion and social value move together across Indian states, or whether formal financial depth crowds out welfare outcomes for vulnerable households. Using official state-level data on bank deposits, Self-Help Group (SHG) savings and lending, consumption, literacy, health vulnerability and non-performing assets, I construct two composite measures: a Financial Inclusion Index (FIIndex) and an SROI-inspired social-value index (SROIMetrics), together with a non-overlapping variant that excludes SHG components shared with FIIndex. Cross-sectional correlations and robust OLS regressions show that FIIndex has a weak and statistically insignificant relationship with the non-overlapping social-value measure, whereas rural consumption and literacy are the strongest predictors of social value. Formal financial depth, measured by log deposits, is negatively but insignificantly associated with social value. These findings caution against interpreting deposit growth or credit expansion alone as evidence of inclusive social value and suggest that socioeconomic conditions explain more variation in stakeholder outcomes than financial inclusion metrics. The analysis demonstrates a transparent method for integrating financial and social indicators in inclusive finance, while highlighting the need for household or institution-level panel data and stronger counterfactual designs to identify causal effects.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度各邦的官方数据构建金融包容指数(FIIndex)和社会价值指数(SROIMetrics)，通过横截面相关性和OLS回归发现金融包容与社会价值之间关系微弱且不显著，而农村消费和识字率才是社会价值的最强预测因素，提示单纯依赖存款增长或信贷扩张来证明包容性社会价值的做法需谨慎。
AI.research_question: 金融包容与社会价值在印度各邦之间是否同步变动，还是说正规金融深度会挤出弱势家庭的社会福利结果？
AI.motivation: 现有文献和政策实践常将金融包容指标（如存款增长、信贷扩张）等同于社会价值的提升，但缺乏系统证据表明金融包容确实带来包容性社会价值；本文旨在通过构建可比较的综合指标来检验二者的实际关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容理论（Financial Inclusion）与社会投资回报（SROI, Social Return on Investment）框架。
AI.method: 使用印度各邦官方数据（银行存款、自助小组SHG储蓄与贷款、消费、识字率、健康脆弱性和不良资产），构建金融包容指数（FIIndex）和SROI启发的社会价值指数（SROIMetrics），并构建排除重叠成分的非重叠变体；采用横截面相关性分析和稳健OLS回归。
AI.findings: （1）FIIndex与非重叠的社会价值指标之间关系微弱且统计不显著；（2）农村消费和识字率是社会价值最强的预测因素；（3）以log存款衡量的正规金融深度与社会价值呈负相关但不显著；（4）社会经济条件比金融包容指标更能解释利益相关者结果的变异。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了金融包容自动转化为社会价值的隐含假设，为金融包容与社会福利关系的理论提供实证批判；提出了将金融与社会指标整合分析的透明方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融从业者提供警示：不应单独以存款增长或信贷扩张作为包容性社会价值的证据；建议政策关注农村消费和识字率等社会经济基础因素；指出未来需要家庭或机构层面的面板数据及更强的反事实设计以识别因果关系。

title: Cost‑Curve Compression in Frontier Technologies — Solar, Batteries, Compute, and Biotech: How Learning Curves Reshape Global Adoption

detail.title: Cost‑Curve Compression in Frontier Technologies — Solar, Batteries, Compute, and Biotech: How Learning Curves Reshape Global Adoption
detail.abstract:
Cost-curve compression is one of the most powerful and predictable forces shaping modern technological change. As cumulative production doubles, unit costs fall by a consistent percentage—a dynamic formalized by Wright’s Law and observed across solar photovoltaics, lithium‑ion batteries, semiconductor compute, and genome sequencing. These frontier technologies exhibit unusually steep learning rates: solar PV costs have fallen over 99% since 1975, batteries ~90% since 2010, compute has delivered a trillion‑fold improvement in cost per transistor, and genome sequencing has achieved the fastest cost decline ever recorded, dropping from $100M to under $50 per genome in two decades.

These declines are not automatic. They arise from manufacturing scale, modular architectures, policy‑driven early demand, and technology‑push innovation cycles. Where these structural conditions align, learning curves become self‑reinforcing—deployment drives learning, learning drives cost reduction, and cost reduction expands demand. Where they fail, learning curves can reverse entirely, as seen in Eroom’s Law, where drug‑development costs double roughly every nine years despite scientific advances.

The report concludes that learning curves provide a strategic framework for forecasting technology transitions, designing effective policy, and identifying sectors where exponential cost declines will unlock new markets. Understanding these dynamics is essential for investors, policymakers, and firms navigating the accelerating technological shifts of the 21st century.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了成本曲线压缩作为现代技术变革中最强大且可预测的力量之一，阐释了Wright定律如何在不同前沿技术领域中驱动成本指数级下降，并讨论了其形成机制、失败案例以及战略启示。
AI.research_question: 成本曲线压缩（学习曲线）如何塑造现代技术变革？其形成机制、潜在失败条件以及战略意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 现代前沿技术（如太阳能光伏、锂离子电池、半导体计算、基因组测序）展现出异常陡峭的成本下降曲线，但这些下降并非自动发生。理解其底层机制对于预测技术转型、设计有效政策和识别新市场至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wright定律（学习曲线理论）：累计产量每翻倍，单位成本按一致百分比下降；同时涉及Eroom定律作为反向案例对比。
AI.method: 基于多个前沿技术领域（太阳能光伏、锂离子电池、半导体、基因组测序）的实证数据回顾与对比分析，辅以案例对比（Eroom定律的药物研发成本上升）。
AI.findings: 1) 四条前沿技术均展现异常陡峭的学习曲线——光伏成本自1975年下降超99%，电池自2010年下降约90%，计算成本每晶体管改善万亿倍，基因组测序实现史上最快成本下降（从1亿美元降至不足50美元）。2) 成本下降源于制造规模、模块化架构、政策驱动的早期需求和技术推动的创新循环等结构性条件。3) 当结构性条件对齐时，学习曲线自我强化（部署驱动学习、学习驱动降本、降本扩大需求）；当条件失败时（如Eroom定律），学习曲线可能完全逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Wright定律扩展为解释技术变革的战略框架，阐明了学习曲线自我强化与逆转的条件边界，为技术预测和制度设计提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和企业提供基于学习曲线的战略框架，帮助预测技术转型、设计有效政策、识别指数级成本下降将解锁的新市场领域。

title: An Explainable Artificial Intelligence Framework for Decision-Making in Critical Information Technology Systems

detail.title: An Explainable Artificial Intelligence Framework for Decision-Making in Critical Information Technology Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: AI systems are now being deployed inside the critical IT systems like intrusion detection systems, IT operations analytics (AIOps), cloud governance platforms, clinical decision support systems and more. Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are now being incorporated into critical information technology (IT) infrastructure such as intrusion detection systems, IT operations analytics (AIOps), cloud governance platforms, clinical decision support systems and more. Deep learning and ensemble methods provide better predictive accuracy but have the disadvantage of being "black-box" algorithms, which makes them less trusted by operators, harder to regulate and create the potential for undetected propagation of errors in critical applications. Explainable AI (XAI) is now the main solution to this lack of transparency, though there is a disciplinary divide in the literature and no synthesis of technical methods of explainability and operational, human factors and governance needs of critical IT systems exists. This review aims to identify, integrate and apply 32 peer-reviewed and archival research papers published mainly during the period of 2019 to 2025, in addition to foundational research, to build an integrated XAI framework for critical IT decision making. The methodology is guided by a structured narrative-systematic review protocol covering explainability techniques, applications in the domain of cybersecurity, AIOps, and infrastructure in the healthcare domain, and governance instruments like the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Post-hoc model-agnostic methods, especially SHAP and LIME, are the most applied methods today, especially in intrusion detection and financial risk applications, and are significantly preferred over intrinsically interpretable and attentionbased methods, despite the latter's better transparency-performance trade-offs, according to the review. A conceptual five-layer model is suggested, that combines the concepts of data provenance, the generation of explainability, interpretation with human in the loop, and the governing process that is auditable. Persistent issues are highlighted such as the instability of explanations, computational complexity, and inconsistent evaluation of explanations, as well as the lack of a standardised fidelity measure. The review shows that instead of single explainability techniques, it is a need for coordinated progress in technical methods, how to design interfaces, and the alignment of the regulations to make operational explainability in critical systems possible.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化叙事-系统综述方法，整合2019-2025年间32篇同行评审论文及基础研究，构建了一个面向关键IT系统决策的可解释AI（XAI）综合框架。综述发现SHAP和LIME等事后模型无关方法目前应用最广，并提出了一个包含数据溯源、可解释性生成、人机交互解释和可审计治理过程的五层概念模型。
AI.research_question: 如何整合技术可解释性方法与运营、人因和治理需求，构建适用于关键IT系统决策的综合XAI框架？
AI.motivation: 深度学习与集成方法虽预测精度高，但作为"黑盒"算法降低了操作者信任度、增加监管难度，且存在错误传播风险。现有文献存在学科分野，缺乏将技术可解释性方法与关键IT系统的运营、人因和治理需求进行综合的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化叙事-系统综述协议、NIST AI风险管理框架、可解释性技术分类（事后模型无关方法、内在可解释方法、注意力方法）
AI.method: 采用结构化叙事-系统综述方法，覆盖可解释性技术、网络安全/AIOps/医疗基础设施等应用领域及治理工具（如NIST AI风险管理框架），对32篇2019-2025年间及基础研究论文进行识别、整合和分析。
AI.findings: （1）SHAP和LIME等事后模型无关方法是最广泛应用的技术，尤其在入侵检测和金融风险领域，显著优于内在可解释和注意力方法（尽管后者具有更好的透明度-性能权衡）；（2）提出了五层概念模型：数据溯源、可解释性生成、人机交互解释、可审计治理过程；（3）识别出解释不稳定、计算复杂度高、解释评估不一致、缺乏标准化保真度度量等持续性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次整合技术可解释性方法与运营、人因和治理需求，弥合了XAI文献中的学科分野，构建了综合性的五层XAI概念框架，为关键IT系统的可解释性研究提供了统一的系统化视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关键IT系统（如入侵检测、AIOps、云治理、临床决策支持）的可解释AI部署提供实践指导；确立SHAP和LIME作为当前最佳实践方法；指出实现运营可解释性需要在技术方法、界面设计和监管对齐三方面协同推进。

title: Enforceability of Arbitral Awards Under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, Cap 5 of Uganda Author: Onoke John Valentine

detail.title: Enforceability of Arbitral Awards Under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, Cap 5 of Uganda Author: Onoke John Valentine
detail.abstract: This article provides a comprehensive, doctrinally grounded assessment of the taxonomy and enforceability of arbitral awards under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, Cap 5 of Uganda. Written with the pedagogical elegance of a British academic narrative, it seeks to demystify and decipher the complex procedural and substantive categories of awards that emerge during the arbitration cycle. The study maps the core statutory and judicial distinctions among final, interim, partial, consent, and additional awards, situating each category within Uganda's modern legal framework. It then evaluates the specialized international classifications of awards, namely New York Convention awards and ICSID Convention awards, and their unique pathways to registration and execution in the High Court of Uganda. The article analyzes the form, content, and procedural requirements governing the delivery of awards, contrasting the limited grounds for setting aside domestic awards with the restrictive framework for resisting the enforcement of foreign decisions. Drawing on a rich record of Ugandan case law, including landmark rulings from the Commercial Division, the study examines the strict judicial treatment of statutory limitation periods and the narrow interpretation of the public policy defense. Finally, it evaluates the impact of the landmark Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Act, 2024, and offers concrete operational and regulatory recommendations to strengthen party autonomy, minimize unwarranted judicial intervention, and elevate Uganda as a leading, competitive seat for domestic and international dispute resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文对乌干达《仲裁与调解法》（Cap 5）下的仲裁裁决类型及其可执行性进行了全面的、基于法理的系统评估，涵盖终局裁决、临时裁决、部分裁决、合意裁决和补充裁决等国内分类，以及纽约公约裁决和ICSID公约裁决等国际分类，并分析了2024年修正案的影响。
AI.research_question: 乌干达法律框架下仲裁裁决的分类体系及其可执行性如何？各种类型裁决的构成要件、程序要求和司法审查标准是什么？
AI.motivation: 乌干达仲裁法律体系复杂，仲裁裁决的类别划分及其在法院的登记与执行路径存在诸多模糊之处，需要系统性的法理梳理以澄清实践中的困惑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于乌干达《仲裁与调解法》（Cap 5）的成文法框架，结合纽约公约和ICSID公约的国际仲裁法律体系，以及乌干达国内判例法中的公共政策抗辩和时效期间理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析方法（doctrinal legal analysis），系统梳理成文法条款、司法判例（尤其是商业法庭的标志性裁决）以及2024年修正案立法文本。
AI.findings: 乌干达国内仲裁裁决的撤销事由极为有限，而对外国裁决的执行抗辩也受到严格限制；法院对法定时效期间采取严格司法态度，对公共政策抗辩采用狭义解释；2024年修正案对当事人意思自治和司法干预程度产生了重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统构建了乌干达仲裁裁决分类的法理分析框架，厘清了国内裁决与国际裁决（纽约公约、ICSID公约）在执行路径上的制度差异，并评估了立法修正对仲裁制度理论的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌干达的仲裁从业者、法院和立法者提供了具体的操作性和监管性建议，旨在增强当事人意思自治、减少不必要的司法干预，并提升乌干达作为国内外争议解决优选地的竞争力。

title: The Coherence Solvency Bound

detail.title: The Coherence Solvency Bound

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent practitioner-scholar. The frameworks and outcomes described in this paper were developed through direct executive engagement across enterprise AI transformation programs. No external funding was received for this research. No conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on practitioner case evidence from enterprise programs in which the author held direct executive responsibility. All organizational references have been anonymized where appropriate to protect confidentiality. No human subjects research, patient data, or formal experimental methodology was employed. Formal ethics approval was not required.
